declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasProperSupport_pushforwardStructureSheaf_iff
declarations.doc:
**The proper-support entry of the dictionary of Stacks 0D00, in both directions.**  Let
`g : X ⟶ T` be locally of finite type and let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subspace with inclusion `i`.
The module `i_*𝒪_Z` has support proper over `T` in the sense of Stacks 0CZD exactly when the
composite `Z ⟶ T` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasProperSupport_pushforwardStructureSheaf_iff (g : X ⟶ T)
    (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g.hom) :
    HasProperSupport B S hS X.property T.property g.hom hg
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (pushforwardStructureSheaf B S hS X Z)) ↔
      IsProper B S hS (Z.1.ι ≫ g.hom)
declarations.comment: the proper-support entry of the dictionary, both directions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hilbertFamilyOfQuotConditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D00, the converse construction.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic
spaces of finite presentation, let `T` be a scheme of the site over `Y`, and let `W` be a closed
subspace of the base change `X_T` with inclusion `i`.  If the quotient `𝒪_{X_T} ⟶ i_*𝒪_W` it
determines is of finite presentation, is flat over `T` and has support proper over `T`, then `W`
is a family classified by the Hilbert functor of `f` over `T`.
declarations.statement:
def hilbertFamilyOfQuotConditions (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (T : SchemesOverPresheaf B S hS Y)
    (W : ClosedSubspaces B S hS (schemeBaseChange f T))
    (hfpq : (pushforwardStructureSheaf B S hS
      (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T) W).IsFinitePresentationOnSite)
    (hflat : IsFlatOver B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).property
      (schemeBaseChangeProjectionHom B S hS f T).hom
      (pushforwardStructureSheaf B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T) W))
    (hproper : HasProperSupport B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).property
      (schemeOverSpace T).property (schemeBaseChangeProjectionHom B S hS f T).hom
      (isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
        (isFinitePresentation_schemeBaseChangeProjection f hf T).1)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
        (pushforwardStructureSheaf B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T) W))) :
    HilbertFamily f T
declarations.comment: the converse construction: a quotient of the structure sheaf is a Hilbert family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hilbertFamily_definingIdealSheaf_eq_of_quotConditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D00, the converse construction from the sheaf of ideals.**  A sheaf of ideals
`𝓘 ⊆ 𝒪_{X_T}` whose quotient `𝒪_{X_T}/𝓘` is of finite presentation, flat over `T` and with
support proper over `T` is the defining ideal sheaf of a family classified by the Hilbert functor
of `f` over `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hilbertFamily_definingIdealSheaf_eq_of_quotConditions (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (T : SchemesOverPresheaf B S hS Y)
    (I : (SheafOfModules.unit
      (structureRingSheaf B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T))).Submodule)
    (hfpq : (cokernel I.ι : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).1
      (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).2).IsFinitePresentationOnSite)
    (hflat : IsFlatOver B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).property
      (schemeBaseChangeProjectionHom B S hS f T).hom
      (cokernel I.ι : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).1
        (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).2))
    (hproper : HasProperSupport B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).property
      (schemeOverSpace T).property (schemeBaseChangeProjectionHom B S hS f T).hom
      (isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
        (isFinitePresentation_schemeBaseChangeProjection f hf T).1)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (cokernel I.ι :
        Modules.{u, u} B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).1
          (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T).2))) :
    ∃ z : HilbertFamily f T,
      definingIdealSheaf B S hS (schemeBaseChangeSpace f T) ⟨z.Z, z.closed⟩ = I
declarations.comment: the converse construction, from a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hilbertPresheafIso_quotSitePresheaf
declarations.doc:
In Situation 0CZY we have `Hilb_{X/B} = Quot_{𝒪_X/X/B}`: the Hilbert functor of `f` and the
Quot functor of its structure sheaf are isomorphic presheaves on the schemes of the big fppf site,
by an isomorphism over `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hilbertPresheafIso_quotSitePresheaf :
    ∃ e : hilbertPresheaf f ≅ (structureSheafQuotSituation f hf).quotSitePresheaf,
      e.hom ≫ (structureSheafQuotSituation f hf).quotSitePresheafToBase =
        hilbertPresheafToBase f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hilbertFamilySubobject_mem
declarations.doc:
The quotient of `F_T` that a family classified by the Hilbert functor of `f` over `T`
determines lies in `Quot_{𝒪_X/X/B}(T)`: it is quasi-coherent, of finite presentation, flat over
`T` and has support proper over `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hilbertFamilySubobject_mem (z : HilbertFamily f T) :
    hilbertFamilySubobject f hf T z ∈
      (structureSheafQuotSituation f hf).properlySupportedQuotients
        (structureSheafTestScheme T)
declarations.comment: the forward construction: a Hilbert family is a quotient of the structure sheaf

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlatOver_pushforwardStructureSheaf_iff
registrations.comment: the flatness entry of the dictionary, both directions

registrations.name: isFinitePresentationOnSite_pushforwardStructureSheaf_hilbertFamily_unconditional
registrations.comment: the finite-presentation entry of the dictionary, for a Hilbert family

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hilbertPresheafModel_isAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D01.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ B` of algebraic spaces over `S` which is of finite
presentation and separated, the Hilbert functor `Hilb_{X/B}` of Stacks 0CZY is an algebraic space
locally of finite presentation over `B`: there is a model of the Hilbert presheaf in the universe
of the site which is an algebraic space and whose canonical morphism to `B` is locally of finite
presentation.

This is the source's deduction from Stacks 0D00 and Stacks 09TU, both of which are carried as
hypotheses because neither is in the library. Stacks 09TU is `N` together with `halg` and `hlfp`:
a model of the Quot presheaf of a situation on `f` which is an algebraic space whose morphism to
`B` is locally of finite presentation. Stacks 0D00 is `e` together with `he`: an isomorphism of
the Hilbert presheaf with that Quot presheaf, compatible with the two canonical morphisms to `B`.
The source's standing hypotheses that `f` be of finite presentation and separated are recorded as
`_hfp` and `_hsep`; the deduction itself does not consume them, since they enter through
Stacks 09TU, which is carried. The content delivered is the transport: the Quot model is already a
model of the Hilbert presheaf through `e`, and its morphism to `B` is the Hilbert one by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HilbertPresheafModel.toBase_eq_of_iso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hilbertPresheafModel_isAlgebraicSpace {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (D : QuotSituation B S hS) (f : X ⟶ D.Y)
    (_hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (_hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (N : QuotSitePresheafModel D) (halg : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS N.presheaf)
    (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS N.toBase)
    (e : hilbertPresheaf f ≅ D.quotSitePresheaf)
    (he : e.hom ≫ D.quotSitePresheafToBase = hilbertPresheafToBase f) :
    ∃ M : HilbertPresheafModel f,
      IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS M.presheaf ∧
        IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS M.toBase

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hilbertPresheafModel_isAlgebraicSpace_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme and `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`. If `f` is of
finite presentation and separated, then the Hilbert functor `Hilb_{X/Y}` of Stacks 0CZY is an
algebraic space locally of finite presentation over `Y`: it has a model in the universe of the
site which is an algebraic space whose canonical morphism to `Y` is locally of finite
presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hilbertPresheafModel_isAlgebraicSpace_of_isSeparated
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) :
    ∃ M : HilbertPresheafModel f,
      IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS M.presheaf ∧ IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS M.toBase

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.picardToCoherent
declarations.doc:
The natural map `Pic_{X/B} ⟶ Coh_{X/B}` as a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids
over the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.comment: the natural map Picardstack_{X/B} -> Cohstack_{X/B} as a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids, (T, g, L) going to (T, g, L), for f flat and proper, f of finite presentation being part of the standing data D of Situation 08KB

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_subset_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus_of_isInvertibleModule
declarations.doc:
If the pullback `F_{T'}` of an object `F` of `Coh_{X/Y}` along `X_g : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T` is
invertible, then `|T'|` maps into `U = T ∖ f_T(|X_T| ∖ W₁)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_subset_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus_of_isInvertibleModule
    (D : CoherentSituation B S hS) {T' T : SchemesOver D.Y} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2)
    (hqc : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (hfp : F.IsFinitePresentationOnSite)
    (hflat : IsFlatOver B S hS (D.space T).2 (D.projection T).hom F)
    (hF : IsInvertibleModule (D.space T') ((modulePullback B S hS (D.relativeMap g)).obj F)) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).obj T'.left).1
        ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).map g.left).hom) ⊆
      fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus D T F
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the implication (b) => (a) complete, at the source's own U = T \ f_T(|X_T| \ W_1) and the source's own condition (b): if F_T' is invertible then |T'| maps into U. The hypotheses on F are 0CZT's own three conditions, which an object of Coh_{X/Y} has.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasOpenLocus_picardToCoherent
declarations.doc:
**The open locus of the natural map.**  For every scheme-valued point `y` of `Coh_{X/Y}`
over an object `U` of the big fppf site of `S`, there is an open subscheme `V ⊆ U` through which
an object `T` of the big fppf site of `U` factors exactly when `y(T)` comes from `Pic_{X/Y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasOpenLocus_picardToCoherent (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS D.f.hom) (hproper : IsProper B S hS D.f.hom) :
    Stack.HasOpenLocus B S hS (picardToCoherentBased D hflat hproper)
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the open subscheme U of every object (T, g, F) of Cohstack_{X/B}, read on scheme-valued points: an object over the base factors through U exactly when its image comes from Picardstack_{X/B}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_and_isOpenImmersion_picardToCoherent
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ B` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is flat, of finite
presentation and proper, given by the data `D` of Situation 08KB with `hflat` and `hproper`.  The
natural map `Pic_{X/B} ⟶ Coh_{X/B}` is representable by open immersions: it is representable by
algebraic spaces (Stacks 02ZW), and every algebraic space representing its base change along a
scheme-valued point of `Coh_{X/B}` is an open subspace of that scheme (Stacks 04XB at open
immersions).
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_and_isOpenImmersion_picardToCoherent
    (D : CoherentSituation B S hS) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS D.f.hom)
    (hproper : IsProper B S hS D.f.hom) :
    Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (picardToCoherent D hflat hproper).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B S hS (picardToCoherent D hflat hproper)
declarations.comment: the whole statement: the natural map Picardstack_{X/B} -> Cohstack_{X/B}, for f flat, of finite presentation (the standing data D of Situation 08KB) and proper, is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion in the sense of Tag 04XB, which together are representability by open immersions (Tag 04YL (1))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.picardObjectToCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the first part of the proof: the natural map `Pic_{X/B} ⟶ Coh_{X/B}` on
objects.**  A triple `(T, g, L)` of the Picard stack of Section 0372 is sent to the same triple
`(T, g, L)` viewed in Situation 08KB.

The three conditions of Situation 08KB hold for an invertible `L` for the reasons the source
gives, and all three are proved.  Finite presentation is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentationOnSite_of_isInvertibleModule` and quasi-coherence
follows from it.  Flatness over `T` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlatOver_of_isInvertibleModule` applied to the projection `X_T ⟶ T`,
which is flat by Stacks 03MO.  Properness of the support over `T` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProperOver_supportOfSheaf_of_isInvertibleModule` applied to the same
projection, which is proper by Stacks 04WP and therefore locally of finite type.
declarations.comment: part one of the proof, the well-definedness of the natural map, on objects: the triple (T, g, L) of Section 0372 goes to the same triple in Situation 08KB. All three conditions 08KB imposes are proved, with no hypothesis beyond the tag's own flatness and properness of f. Finite presentation of an invertible module -- and with it quasi-coherence -- is Tag 0B8N(b) on the small etale site. The two citations the source makes are performed: the projection X_T -> T is flat by Tag 03MO and proper by Tag 04WP (isFlat_projection, isProper_projection). Their module-theoretic halves are isFlatOver_of_isInvertibleModule (Tag 05VV, through the geometric-stalk criterion and Tag 05VX(1), the geometric stalk of an invertible module being free of rank one) and isProperOver_supportOfSheaf_of_isInvertibleModule (Tag 0CZD, the support being closed by Tag 07TZ and proper over the base by Tag 04XY). What remains of the tag is the second part of its proof, the open locus in T.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_fibrewiseEtaleFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the construction of the open `U` of the second part of the proof.**  The locus
is open in `|T|` when `f` is proper.

The étale free locus is open, so its complement is closed, and the projection `|X_T| ⟶ |T|` is a
closed map because `X_T ⟶ T` is proper by Stacks 04WP; the image of that complement is therefore
closed and the locus, its complement, is open.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpen_fibrewiseEtaleFreeLocus (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS D.f.hom) (T : SchemesOver D.Y)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2) :
    IsOpen (fibrewiseEtaleFreeLocus D T F)
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the construction of the open T \ f_T(|X_T| \ W) and its openness, unconditionally, as an open SUBSET of |T| for the point topology -- realizing it as an open subscheme of T is done in hasOpenLocus_picardToCoherent of Quot/PicardStackOpenImmersion.lean. W is the etale free locus of Tag 0CZT, open by the mechanism of that tag's openness clause (isOpen_of_etale_witness); the projection X_T -> T is proper by Tag 04WP, hence closed on points. This is the FIRST of the source's two reductions only; the source's own U is the same construction at the RANK-ONE locus, isOpen_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus, which performs both reductions at once. The source's parenthetical quasi-compactness assumption on T is not needed for either: it belongs to the decomposition X_T = X_0 + X_1 + ... by rank, which the rank-one locus makes unnecessary.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the construction of the open `U` of the second part of the proof, at the
source's own `U`.**  The rank-one locus is open in `|T|` when `f` is proper.

The rank-one étale free locus `W₁` is open with no hypothesis
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_etaleRankOneFreeLocus`, the mechanism of the openness clause of
Stacks 0CZT), and the projection `|X_T| ⟶ |T|` is a closed map because `X_T ⟶ T` is proper by
Stacks 04WP; so the image of the closed complement is closed and the locus is open.  No
decomposition of `X_T` by rank is used, and so no quasi-compactness of `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpen_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS D.f.hom) (T : SchemesOver D.Y)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2) :
    IsOpen (fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus D T F)
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the construction of the open U = T \ f_T(|X_T| \ W_1) and its openness, unconditionally, as an open SUBSET of |T| for the point topology -- realizing it as an open subscheme of T is done in hasOpenLocus_picardToCoherent of Quot/PicardStackOpenImmersion.lean. W_1 is the locus of Tag 0CZT with the rank pinned to ONE, and this U is the source's own U: it is the composite of the source's two reductions, since |X_T| \ W_1 = (|X_T| \ W) + X_0 + X_2 + ..., so the source's decomposition of a finite locally free module by rank is not needed and neither is its parenthetical quasi-compactness assumption on T. Openness of W_1 is the mechanism of the openness clause of 0CZT (isOpen_of_etale_witness) and the projection X_T -> T is proper by Tag 04WP, hence closed on points.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the implication (a) ⟹ (b) of the second part of the proof, on points.**  If a
morphism `g : T' ⟶ T` of test schemes over `Y` maps `|T'|` into the locus, then the induced
morphism `X_g : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T` maps `|X_{T'}|` into the étale free locus of `F`.

A point `x'` of `|X_{T'}|` goes to a point `x` of `|X_T|` lying over the image in `|T|` of the
point of `|T'|` below `x'`, because `X_g` commutes with the two projections to the test schemes;
that image lies in the locus, so `x` lies in the étale free locus.  No base-change property of
the locus is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    {T' T : SchemesOver D.Y} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2)
    (hg : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).obj T'.left).1
        ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).map g.left).hom) ⊆ fibrewiseEtaleFreeLocus D T F) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (D.space T').1 (D.relativeMap g).hom) ⊆
      etaleFreeLocus B S hS F
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the implication (a) => (b) on points, unconditionally: if |T'| maps into U -- which is how condition (a), that T' -> T factors through U, is read here, U being produced as an open subset of |T| -- then |X_T'| maps into the etale free locus W of F. This is the direction that needs no base-change property of W, as the source's own argument shows; it is the commutation of X_g with the projections to the test schemes together with the description of U as the points whose whole fibre lies in W. The remaining step needs neither the rank decomposition nor a conditional clause of Tag 0B8Q: the rank decomposition is not needed at all -- pinning the rank to one at the level of the locus replaces it, see range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleRankOneFreeLocus -- and the clause of Tag 0B8Q the step would use is the UNCONDITIONAL one, which holds at this site. What the step does need is recorded on that rank-one statement.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleRankOneFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the implication (a) ⟹ (b) of the second part of the proof, on points, at the
source's own `U`.**  If a morphism `g : T' ⟶ T` of test schemes over `Y` maps `|T'|` into the
rank-one locus, then `X_g : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T` maps `|X_{T'}|` into the rank-one étale free locus
of `F`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_of_subset_fibrewiseLocus` at
`W₁`, and it is the implication the source proves — its `U` is the rank-one locus, so what (a)
yields is rank-one freeness at every point of `|X_{T'}|` rather than freeness of some rank.  No
decomposition by rank and no base-change property of the locus is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleRankOneFreeLocus (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    {T' T : SchemesOver D.Y} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2)
    (hg : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).obj T'.left).1
        ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).map g.left).hom) ⊆
      fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus D T F) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (D.space T').1 (D.relativeMap g).hom) ⊆
      etaleRankOneFreeLocus B S hS F
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the implication (a) => (b) on points at the source's own U, unconditionally: if |T'| maps into U = T \ f_T(|X_T| \ W_1) -- which is how condition (a), that T' -> T factors through U, is read here, U being produced as an open subset of |T| -- then |X_T'| maps into the RANK-ONE etale free locus W_1 of F. This is the direction that needs no base-change property of the locus, as the source's own argument shows; it is the commutation of X_g with the projections to the test schemes together with the description of U as the points whose whole fibre lies in W_1. Pinning the rank to one at the level of the locus is what replaces the source's decomposition X_T = X_0 + X_1 + ... by rank, which is not available for algebraic spaces. The passage from rank-one freeness in an etale neighbourhood of every point of |X_T'| to invertibility of F_T' takes two steps -- the easy inclusion of the base-change clause of Tag 0CZT and the local-to-global refinement for the unconditional clause of Tag 0B8Q; both steps are proved (preimage_etaleRankOneFreeLocus_subset and isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_of_forall_mem_etaleRankOneFreeLocus), and the complete implication -- |T'| into U gives F_T' INVERTIBLE, unconditionally -- is isInvertibleModule_modulePullback_relativeMap_of_subset_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus below.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus_of_forall_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the implication (b) ⟹ (a) of the second part of the proof, on points.**  If
the pullback of `F` along `X_g : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T` is free in an étale neighbourhood of every point
of `|X_{T'}|` — which is the case when that pullback is invertible — then `X_g` maps `|X_{T'}|`
into the étale free locus of `F`.

This is the source's "if `T' ⟶ T` satisfies (b) then `|X_{T'}| ⟶ |X_T|` maps into `W`", and it
is exactly where the base-change clause of Stacks 0CZT enters.  That clause is now proved, as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleFreeLocus_modulePullback_eq` of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/EtaleFreeLocusBaseChange.lean`, so this statement is
unconditional.  `F` carries Stacks 0CZT's own hypotheses — quasi-coherent, of finite presentation
and flat over `T` — which is what an object of `Coh_{X/Y}` is, and local finite presentation of
the projection `X_T ⟶ T` costs nothing
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_projection`).  The square of the
morphism of test schemes is cartesian by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPullback_baseChangeMap`, which is the form the clause is stated at.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus_of_forall_mem
    (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    {T' T : SchemesOver D.Y} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2)
    (hqc : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (hfp : F.IsFinitePresentationOnSite)
    (hflat : IsFlatOver B S hS (D.space T).2 (D.projection T).hom F)
    (hF : ∀ x' : points B S hS (D.space T').1,
      x' ∈ etaleFreeLocus B S hS ((modulePullback B S hS (D.relativeMap g)).obj F)) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (D.space T').1 (D.relativeMap g).hom) ⊆
      etaleFreeLocus B S hS F
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the implication (b) => (a) on points: if F_T' is free in an etale neighbourhood of every point then |X_T'| maps into the etale free locus W of F. UNCONDITIONAL. This is the direction the source derives from the base-change clause of Tag 0CZT, and that clause is proved: etaleFreeLocus_modulePullback_eq of Spaces/EtaleFreeLocusBaseChange.lean, registered on 0CZT with a which-part note, states the EQUALITY W(F_T') = |X_g|^(-1)(W(F)) at an arbitrary cartesian square. This statement binds no hypothesis standing in for that equality; its binders are D, g, F, 0CZT's own three conditions on F, and the antecedent (b). The source's route is what was assembled: clause (4) of Tag 0CZS (exists_chartOpen_over_iso_free_iff_flat_geometricFibreModuleStalk) at the image point, the base-change invariance of clause (1) (flat_geometricFibreModuleStalk_modulePullback_iff of Spaces/GeometricFibreStalkBaseChange.lean) for the transport, and the etale-locality of clause (1) (flat_geometricFibreModuleStalk_comp_modulePullback_iff of Spaces/GeometricFibreStalkEtaleLocal.lean) at the point upstairs. Condition (2) of Tag 05WY is NOT needed and is still neither stated nor proved; that is a gap in the registration of Tag 05WY alone. F carries 0CZT's own three hypotheses, quasi-coherent, of finite presentation and flat over T, which is exactly what an object of Coh_{X/Y} is (CoherentObject), so no consumer pays for them.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus_of_isInvertibleModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the implication (b) ⟹ (a) of the second part of the proof, at the source's
own condition (b).**  If the pullback `F_{T'}` of `F` along `X_g : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T` is *invertible*
— which is condition (b) of the source, and not merely the étale-local freeness that
`Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus_of_forall_mem` asks for — then `X_g` maps
`|X_{T'}|` into the étale free locus of `F`.

The passage from invertibility of `F_{T'}` to its freeness in an étale neighbourhood of every
point of `|X_{T'}|` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mem_etaleFreeLocus_of_isInvertibleModule` and is
unconditional: it is the converse clause of Stacks 0B8Q at the small étale ringed site of an
algebraic space, which is locally ringed by Stacks 04KH, together with the comparison of
Stacks 04M0 between the slices of that site and the small étale sites of the chart spaces.  The
base-change clause of Stacks 0CZT is still used, for the same reason as in
`Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus_of_forall_mem`, and it is now proved
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleFreeLocus_modulePullback_eq`), so this statement is
unconditional as well; `F` carries Stacks 0CZT's own hypotheses here too, which is what an
object of `Coh_{X/Y}` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleFreeLocus_of_isInvertibleModule
    (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    {T' T : SchemesOver D.Y} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2)
    (hqc : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (hfp : F.IsFinitePresentationOnSite)
    (hflat : IsFlatOver B S hS (D.space T).2 (D.projection T).hom F)
    (hF : IsInvertibleModule (D.space T')
      ((modulePullback B S hS (D.relativeMap g)).obj F)) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (D.space T').1 (D.relativeMap g).hom) ⊆
      etaleFreeLocus B S hS F
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the implication (b) => (a) on points, with (b) at the source's own condition that F_T' be INVERTIBLE rather than at the etale-local freeness of the preceding statement. The step from invertibility to freeness in an etale neighbourhood of every point is unconditional here (mem_etaleFreeLocus_of_isInvertibleModule): the converse clause of Tag 0B8Q applies to the small etale ringed site of an algebraic space, which is locally ringed by Tag 04KH, in its universe-flexible form -- the site has its objects one universe above the sections of its structure sheaf, so the two carriers of 0B8Q stated for a bare ringed site do not instantiate -- and Tag 04M0 identifies a trivialization on a slice of that site with freeness of the pullback to the chart space, which is how the locus W of Tag 0CZT is phrased. UNCONDITIONAL. The base-change clause of Tag 0CZT, which this direction needs, is now proved: etaleFreeLocus_modulePullback_eq of Spaces/EtaleFreeLocusBaseChange.lean. This statement binds no hypothesis standing in for that equality; its binders are D, g, F, 0CZT's own three conditions on F, and the antecedent (b). The base-change invariance of clause (1) of Tag 0CZS (flat_geometricFibreModuleStalk_modulePullback_iff) does NOT need condition (2) of Tag 05WY. The converse implication, from |T'| mapping into U to invertibility of F_T', does not need the source's rank decomposition of X_T. The decomposition is replaced by pinning the rank to one at the level of the locus (etaleRankOneFreeLocus), and that converse is complete in isInvertibleModule_modulePullback_relativeMap_of_subset_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus. F carries 0CZT's own three hypotheses, quasi-coherent, of finite presentation and flat over T, which is exactly what an object of Coh_{X/Y} is (CoherentObject).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isInvertibleModule_modulePullback_relativeMap_of_subset_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the implication (a) ⟹ (b) of the second part of the proof, complete.**  If a
morphism `g : T' ⟶ T` of test schemes over `Y` maps `|T'|` into the source's own locus
`U = T ∖ f_T(|X_T| ∖ W₁)`, then the pullback `F_{T'}` of `F` along `X_g : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T` is
*invertible* — which is the source's condition (b).  Unconditionally.

The three steps are each unconditional.  Condition (a) puts every point of `|X_{T'}|` over a
point of the rank-one étale free locus of `F`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleRankOneFreeLocus`); the easy
inclusion of the base-change clause of Stacks 0CZT carries that locus forward along `X_g`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preimage_etaleRankOneFreeLocus_subset`, a pullback of a rank-one free
module being rank-one free); and a module whose rank-one étale free locus is all of `|X_{T'}|`
has rank one on the small étale site
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_of_forall_mem_etaleRankOneFreeLocus`,
the local-to-global refinement), hence is invertible by the unconditional clause of Stacks 0B8Q
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isInvertibleModule_iff_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one`).

Neither the base-change clause of Stacks 0CZT nor the source's decomposition of `X_T` by rank is
used: the hard inclusion of that clause is what the *converse* implication needs, and the
decomposition is replaced by pinning the rank to one at the level of the locus.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvertibleModule_modulePullback_relativeMap_of_subset_fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus
    (D : CoherentSituation B S hS) {T' T : SchemesOver D.Y} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (D.space T).1 (D.space T).2)
    (hg : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).obj T'.left).1
        ((schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS).map g.left).hom) ⊆
      fibrewiseEtaleRankOneFreeLocus D T F) :
    IsInvertibleModule (D.space T') ((modulePullback B S hS (D.relativeMap g)).obj F)
declarations.comment: part two of the proof, the implication (a) => (b) COMPLETE and unconditional, at the source's own U and the source's own condition (b): if |T'| maps into U = T \ f_T(|X_T| \ W_1) -- which is how condition (a), that T' -> T factors through U, is read here, U being produced as an open SUBSET of |T| for the point topology -- then F_T' is INVERTIBLE. This completes the direction whose last two steps were recorded as missing on range_pointsMap_relativeMap_subset_etaleRankOneFreeLocus: (i) the easy inclusion of the base-change clause of Tag 0CZT, |X_g|^{-1}(W_1(F)) subset W_1(F_T'), which is preimage_etaleRankOneFreeLocus_subset and holds for an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces; and (ii) the local-to-global refinement from a trivialization through every POINT of |X_T'| to a trivializing covering family of every OBJECT of the small etale site, which is isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_of_forall_mem_etaleRankOneFreeLocus -- the chosen neighbourhoods form an etale covering, so their charts cover the final object (coversTop_of_isEtaleCovering, the slice form of Tag 04M0), and the rank clause of Tag 0409 is local on such a family. The unconditional clause of Tag 0B8Q then gives invertibility. The source's decomposition of X_T by rank is not used, and neither is the base-change clause of Tag 0CZT: the hard inclusion of that clause is what the CONVERSE implication (b) => (a) needs, and it is proved in etaleFreeLocus_modulePullback_eq of Spaces/EtaleFreeLocusBaseChange.lean.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.picardToCoherentHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D03, the natural map on hom-sets is a bijection.**  The hom-sets of `Pic_{X/B}`
and of `Coh_{X/B}` between two objects and their images are the same pair of data — a morphism of
test schemes over the base and an isomorphism of the inverse image of the module of the target
with the module of the source — so the natural map identifies them.

So the natural map is fully faithful, and `Pic_{X/B}` is the full subcategory of `Coh_{X/B}` on
the objects whose module is invertible: the fibre of the map over an object `(T, g, F)` of
`Coh_{X/B}` is the set of proofs that `F` is invertible, which is a subsingleton.  That is the
structural reason the tag asserts an *open immersion* rather than a general morphism.
declarations.statement:
def picardToCoherentHomEquiv (D : CoherentSituation B S hS) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS D.f.hom)
    (hproper : IsProper B S hS D.f.hom) (A C : PicardObject D.toPicardSituation) :
    PicardHom A C ≃ CoherentHom (picardObjectToCoherent D hflat hproper A)
      (picardObjectToCoherent D hflat hproper C)
declarations.comment: the natural map Picardstack_{X/B} -> Cohstack_{X/B} on hom-sets, together with picardObjectToCoherent on objects: the first part of the source's proof, in which the triple (T, g, L) of Section 0372 is sent to the same triple in Situation 08KB and the morphism (h, a) to the morphism (h, a). The map on hom-sets is a BIJECTION, so the natural map is fully faithful and Picardstack_{X/B} is the full subcategory of Cohstack_{X/B} on the objects with invertible module. The binders are D and the tag's own flatness and properness of f, which the object map needs. The whole statement of the tag is isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_and_isOpenImmersion_picardToCoherent of Quot/PicardStackOpenImmersion.lean.

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicStack_picardCFG
registrations.comment: the full statement. f : X ⟶ B is flat (hflat), of finite presentation (a field of the standing datum D of Situation 08KB) and proper (hproper); then Picardstack_{X/B} is an algebraic stack. Nothing is assumed beyond the source's hypotheses.

declarations.doc:
**Statement (A) — (3) ⇒ (2).** If `U` has the finite subcovering property,
then `U` has the finite refinement property.
declarations.statement:
