square of rings has a right adjoint.  Its value on `(N, M', φ)` is naturally the `B'`-module
`N ×_φ M'` of compatible pairs.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_rightAdjoint_extensionOfScalarsToPullback
    {B' : Type uB'} {B : Type uB} {R' : Type uR'} {R : Type uR}
    [CommRing B'] [CommRing B] [CommRing R'] [CommRing R]
    (toB : B' →+* B) (toR' : B' →+* R') (BtoR : B →+* R) (R'toR : R' →+* R)
    (comm : BtoR.comp toB = R'toR.comp toR') :
    ∃ (F : CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uB, uR, max u uB uR' uR} BtoR)
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR', uR, max u uB uR' uR} R'toR) ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u uB uR' uR} B')
      (e : ∀ X, F.obj X ≃ₗ[B']
        compatiblePairsModule.{u} toB toR' BtoR R'toR comm X)
      (adj : extensionOfScalarsToPullback.{u} toB toR' BtoR R'toR comm ⊣ F),
      (∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : F.obj X),
        (e Y (F.map f p)).1.1 = f.fst (e X p).1.1 ∧
          (e Y (F.map f p)).1.2 = f.snd (e X p).1.2) ∧
      ∀ (L : ModuleCat.{max u uB uR' uR} B') (X) (h : L ⟶ F.obj X) (l : L),
        (e X (h l)).1.1 =
            ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).fst ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[B',toB] l) ∧
          (e X (h l)).1.2 =
            ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).snd ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[B',toR'] l)

declarations.name: MilnorPatching.finite_rightAdjoint_obj_of_finite_components
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2H.** Let `B' = B ×_A A'`, with `A' → A` surjective.
For the compatible-pairs right adjoint of Tag 07RU, if both component modules are finite,
then their compatible-pairs module is finite over `B'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_rightAdjoint_obj_of_finite_components
    {A A' B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B]
    (toBase : B →+* A) (surjection : A' →+* A) (I : Ideal A')
    (s : RingFibreProduct.Situation toBase surjection I) :
    let toB : s.fibreProduct →+* B := s.pullbackCone.fst.hom
    let toA' : s.fibreProduct →+* A' := s.pullbackCone.snd.hom
    let comm : toBase.comp toB = surjection.comp toA' := by
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom s.pullbackCone.condition
    ∀ (F : CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} toBase)
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} surjection) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct)
        (adj : extensionOfScalarsToPullback toB toA' toBase surjection comm ⊣ F)
        (_ : IsIso adj.counit)
        (X : CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} toBase)
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} surjection)),
      Module.Finite B X.fst → Module.Finite A' X.snd →
        Module.Finite s.fibreProduct (F.obj X)

declarations.name: MilnorPatching.flatModulesEquivalenceOverFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2I.** Over a fibre product `B' = B ×_A A'` with `A' → A`
surjective, compatible pairs of flat modules are flat, every flat `B'`-module is canonically
reconstructed from its scalar extensions, and these operations induce an equivalence between
the full subcategory of flat `B'`-modules and the full subcategory of compatible pairs whose
two components are flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flatModulesEquivalenceOverFibreProduct
    {A A' B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B]
    (toBase : B →+* A) (surjection : A' →+* A) (I : Ideal A')
    (s : RingFibreProduct.Situation toBase surjection I) :
    let toB : s.fibreProduct →+* B := s.pullbackCone.fst.hom
    let toA' : s.fibreProduct →+* A' := s.pullbackCone.snd.hom
    let comm : toBase.comp toB = surjection.comp toA' := by
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom s.pullbackCone.condition
    let E := extensionOfScalarsToPullback toB toA' toBase surjection comm
    let flatSource : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct) :=
      fun L ↦ Module.Flat s.fibreProduct L
    let flatTarget : ObjectProperty
        (CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} toBase)
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} surjection)) :=
      fun X ↦ Module.Flat B X.fst ∧ Module.Flat A' X.snd
    ∃ (F : CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} toBase)
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} surjection) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct)
      (e : ∀ X, F.obj X ≃ CompatiblePairs toBase surjection X)
      (adj : E ⊣ F),
      (∀ (L : ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct) (X) (h : L ⟶ F.obj X) (l : L),
          (e X (h l)).1.1 =
              ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).fst
                ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[s.fibreProduct,toB] l) ∧
            (e X (h l)).1.2 =
              ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).snd
                ((1 : A') ⊗ₜ[s.fibreProduct,toA'] l)) ∧
        IsIso adj.counit ∧
        (∀ X, flatTarget X → flatSource (F.obj X)) ∧
        (∀ L, flatSource L → IsIso (adj.unit.app L)) ∧
        ∃ q : flatSource.FullSubcategory ≌ flatTarget.FullSubcategory,
          Nonempty (flatSource.ι ⋙ E ≅ q.functor ⋙ flatTarget.ι) ∧
            Nonempty (flatTarget.ι ⋙ F ≅ q.inverse ⋙ flatSource.ι)

declarations.name: MilnorPatching.finiteProjectiveModulesEquivalenceOverFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2J.** Over a fibre product `B' = B ×_A A'` with `A' → A`
surjective, extension of scalars gives an equivalence from finite projective `B'`-modules to
compatible pairs whose `B`- and `A'`-components are finite projective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteProjectiveModulesEquivalenceOverFibreProduct
    {A A' B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B]
    (toBase : B →+* A) (surjection : A' →+* A) (I : Ideal A')
    (s : RingFibreProduct.Situation toBase surjection I) :
    let toB : s.fibreProduct →+* B := s.pullbackCone.fst.hom
    let toA' : s.fibreProduct →+* A' := s.pullbackCone.snd.hom
    let comm : toBase.comp toB = surjection.comp toA' := by
      change toBase.comp s.pullbackCone.fst.hom =
        surjection.comp s.pullbackCone.snd.hom
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom s.pullbackCone.condition
    let E := extensionOfScalarsToPullback toB toA' toBase surjection comm
    let finiteProjectiveSource : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct) :=
      fun L ↦ Module.Finite s.fibreProduct L ∧ Module.Projective s.fibreProduct L
    let finiteProjectiveTarget : ObjectProperty
        (CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} toBase)
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} surjection)) :=
      fun X ↦ (Module.Finite B X.fst ∧ Module.Projective B X.fst) ∧
        (Module.Finite A' X.snd ∧ Module.Projective A' X.snd)
    ∃ q : finiteProjectiveSource.FullSubcategory ≌
        finiteProjectiveTarget.FullSubcategory,
      Nonempty (finiteProjectiveSource.ι ⋙ E ≅ q.functor ⋙ finiteProjectiveTarget.ι)

declarations.name: Stacks.PseudoCoherent.DerivedInverseLimit.derivedLimit_tensor_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2L.** Let `K` be pseudo-coherent and `(Mₙ)` an inverse
system of modules. If `L` and `L'` are derived inverse limits of `(Mₙ)` and
`(K ⊗ᴸ Mₙ)`, respectively, then the canonical comparison
`L' ⟶ K ⊗ᴸ L` is an isomorphism. Its displayed equation characterizes it as the
comparison induced by the two Milnor triangles.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLimit_tensor_iso
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{u, v, w} R)
    (P : DerivedProducts.{u, v, w} R)
    (K : D.{u, v, w} R) (hK : IsPseudoCoherent K)
    (M : ℕ → ModuleCat.{max v w} (SmallRing.{u, v, w} R))
    (t : ∀ n, M (n + 1) ⟶ M n) :
    letI := hasProductsOfShapeNat R P
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v w} (SmallRing.{u, v, w} R)) 0
    ∀ (L : D.{u, v, w} R) (ι : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n => S.obj (M n))
      (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n => S.obj (M n)) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (_ : IsMilnorTriangle (A := SmallRing.{u, v, w} R) (fun n => S.obj (M n))
        (fun n => S.map (t n)) L ι δ)
      (L' : D.{u, v, w} R)
      (ι' : L' ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n => (T.tensor.obj K).obj (S.obj (M n)))
      (δ' : (∏ᶜ fun n => (T.tensor.obj K).obj (S.obj (M n))) ⟶ L'⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (_ : IsMilnorTriangle (A := SmallRing.{u, v, w} R)
        (fun n => (T.tensor.obj K).obj (S.obj (M n)))
        (fun n => (T.tensor.obj K).map (S.map (t n))) L' ι' δ'),
      ∃ e : L' ≅ (T.tensor.obj K).obj L,
        e.hom ≫ (T.tensor.obj K).map ι ≫
          derivedTensorProductComparison R T K (fun n => S.obj (M n)) = ι'

declarations.name: Stacks.FormalFunctions.exists_isZero_stalk_rightDerived_and_surjective_fiberTwist
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2M].**

Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of schemes with `Y` Noetherian, let `ℒ` be an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module, let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `y ∈ Y` be a point such that
`ℒ_y` is ample on the fibre `X_y`. Then there exists a `d₀` such that for all `d ≥ d₀`

1. `R ᵖ f_*(ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℒ ^⊗ d)_y = 0` for `p > 0`, and
2. the map `f_*(ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℒ ^⊗ d)_y ⟶ H ⁰(X_y, ℱ_y ⊗_{𝒪_{X_y}} ℒ_y ^⊗ d)` is surjective.

Here `X_y` is `f.fiber y` with its morphism `f.fiberι y` to `X`, `ℱ_y` and `ℒ_y` are the
restrictions of `ℱ` and `ℒ` to it, `R ᵖ f_*` is the `p`-th right derived functor of
`Scheme.Modules.pushforward f`, and `H ⁰(X_y, -)` is the module of global sections. The map in
the second clause is `Stacks.FormalFunctions.fiberTwistSectionsStalkHom`: the germ at `y` of a
section over `f ⁻¹ U` goes to its restriction to the fibre. The proof is
`exists_isZero_stalk_rightDerived_and_surjective_twistModule` together with the identification
`(f.fiberι y) ^* (ℱ ⊗ ℒ ^⊗ d) ≅ ℱ_y ⊗ ℒ_y ^⊗ d` of [Stacks, Tag 0EGK].
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isZero_stalk_rightDerived_and_surjective_fiberTwist (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian Y] (y : Y) (F L : X.Modules)
    [IsInvertibleModule X L] [F.IsCoherent]
    (hL : IsAmple (f.fiber y) (pullbackModule (f.fiberι y) L)) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ, d₀ ≤ d →
      (∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
          IsZero ((((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerived p).obj
            (twistModule X L F d)).presheaf.stalk y)) ∧
        Function.Surjective (fiberTwistSectionsStalkHom f y F L d)

declarations.name: Stacks.AmpleFibreNeighbourhood.exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_of_isAmple_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2N.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of schemes with `Y`
Noetherian, let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and let `y` be a point of `Y` such that `ℒ_y`
is ample on the fibre `X_y`.  Then there is an open neighbourhood `V` of `y` such that
`ℒ|_{f⁻¹V}` is ample relative to `f⁻¹V / V`.

Invertibility of `ℒ_y` is not a hypothesis: it is an instance, the pullback of an invertible
module being invertible (`Stacks.InvertiblePullback.isInvertibleModule_pullback`).

The two halves are
`Stacks.AmpleFibreNeighbourhood.exists_mem_pullbackSection_fiberι_eq` — the lifting of sections
from the fibre, which is where [Stacks, Tag 0D2M] and the reduction to `Spec 𝒪_{Y, y}` live — and
`Stacks.AmpleFibreNeighbourhood.exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_of_exists_lift`, which is the rest
of the source's argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_of_isAmple_fibre {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsProper f] [IsNoetherian S] (L : X.Modules) [IsInvertibleModule X L] (y : S)
    (hL : IsAmple (f.fiber y) (pullbackModule (f.fiberι y) L)) :
    ∃ V : S.Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple (f ∣_ V) (pullbackModule (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι L)

declarations.name: Stacks.Descent.isRelativelyAmple_pullbackModule_of_fpqcCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0D2P, clause (1) implies clause (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes,
`L` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `{g i : S' i ⟶ S}` an fpqc covering of `S`. Let `f' i` be the
base change of `f` along `g i`, presented by a cartesian square with the other projection
`p i : X' i ⟶ X`. If `L` is ample relative to `f`, then `(p i)^* L` is ample relative to `f' i`
for every `i`.

This is [Stacks, Tag 0893] for a cartesian square,
`Stacks.AmpleBridge.isRelativelyAmple_pullbackModule_of_isPullback`, applied one index at a time;
no property of the covering enters, and the fpqc hypothesis is carried only so that the statement
is literally the implication of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_pullbackModule_of_fpqcCover {S : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v}
    {S' : I → Scheme.{u}} (g : ∀ i, S' i ⟶ S)
    (_hg : Presieve.ofArrows S' g ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S) {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) [IsInvertibleModule X L] {X' : I → Scheme.{u}} {p : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ X}
    {f' : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ S' i} (hsq : ∀ i, IsPullback (p i) (f' i) f (g i))
    (hL : Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple f L) :
    ∀ i, Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple (f' i) (pullbackModule (p i) L)
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Descent.isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_of_fpqcCover_of_iso_unitModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0D2P, both directions, for an invertible module isomorphic to `𝒪_X`.** With
`{g i : S' i ⟶ S}` an fpqc covering of `S` and each square with sides `p i`, `f' i`, `f` and
`g i` cartesian, a module `L` isomorphic to the structure sheaf is ample relative to `f` if and
only if `(p i)^* L` is ample relative to `f' i` for every `i`.

Both sides are quasi-affineness: on the left by
`Stacks.AmplePullback.isRelativelyAmple_iff_isQuasiAffineHom_of_iso_unitModule`, which is
[Stacks, Tag 0891] for a module merely isomorphic to `𝒪_X`, and on the right by the same lemma
applied to the isomorphism `Stacks.AmplePullback.modulePullbackIsoUnitModule` of `(p i)^* L` with
`𝒪_{X' i}`. The equivalence between them is then [Stacks, Tag 02L7], that quasi-affine morphisms
are fpqc local on the base.
declarations.comment: the full equivalence for an invertible module isomorphic to the structure sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Descent.isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_of_fpqcCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0D2P.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes, `L` an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module and `{g i : S' i ⟶ S}_{i ∈ I}` an fpqc covering of `S`. Let `f' i : X' i ⟶ S' i` be
the base change of `f` along `g i`, presented by a cartesian square with other projection
`p i : X' i ⟶ X`, and let `(p i)^* L` be the pullback of `L`. The following are equivalent:

1. `L` is ample on `X / S`;
2. `(p i)^* L` is ample on `X' i / S' i` for every `i ∈ I`.

Clause (1) implies clause (2) by [Stacks, Tag 0893] applied to each square,
`Stacks.Descent.isRelativelyAmple_pullbackModule_of_fpqcCover`. Clause (2) implies clause (1) is
`Stacks.Descent.isRelativelyAmple_of_forall_of_fpqcCover`.

declarations.name: Stacks.ProperFlatPullbackLimit.bijective_comp_singleFunctor_map_limitPost
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2Q**, in the form the source's proof unfolds it. Let `R` be a ring,
`f : X ⟶ Spec R` proper, flat and of finite presentation, and `(Mₙ)` an inverse system of
`R`-modules with surjective transition maps. Then for every object `E` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` the
canonical map `O_X ⊗_R (lim Mₙ) ⟶ lim (O_X ⊗_R Mₙ)` induces a bijection

`Hom(E, O_X ⊗_R (lim Mₙ)) ⟶ Hom(E, lim O_X ⊗_R Mₙ)`.

Here `O_X ⊗_R M` is `f^*M^~`, both modules are placed in degree zero, the limit on the right is
the limit in `𝒪_X`-modules and the canonical map is `limit.post`. The statement is made at an
arbitrary model of the derived category of `𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_comp_singleFunctor_map_limitPost (R : CommRingCat.{u}) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec R) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (M : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} R) (hsurj : ∀ n : ℕ, Epi (M.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.Modules] (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hE : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules)
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) E) :
    Function.Bijective (fun φ : E ⟶ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj
        ((tilde.functor R ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (limit M)) =>
      φ ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).map
        (limit.post M (tilde.functor R ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f)))
declarations.comment: the canonical map O_X ⊗_R lim M_n --> lim O_X ⊗_R M_n induces bijections Hom(E, source) --> Hom(E, target) for every E in D_QCoh(O_X), which is what the source's proof says the statement means; at every model of the derived category

declarations.name: Stacks.ProperFlatPullbackLimit.isIso_homEquiv_singleFunctor_map_limitPost
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D2Q.** Let `R` be a ring, `f : X ⟶ Spec R` proper, flat and of finite
presentation, and `(Mₙ)` an inverse system of `R`-modules with surjective transition maps. Then
the canonical map `O_X ⊗_R (lim Mₙ) ⟶ lim (O_X ⊗_R Mₙ)` induces an isomorphism from the source to
`DQ_X` applied to the target: for every right adjoint `DQ` of the inclusion
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` (one exists by [Stacks, Tag 0CR0]), the morphism
`O_X ⊗_R (lim Mₙ) ⟶ DQ(lim O_X ⊗_R Mₙ)` adjoint to the canonical map is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homEquiv_singleFunctor_map_limitPost (R : CommRingCat.{u}) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec R) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (M : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} R) (hsurj : ∀ n : ℕ, Epi (M.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
    {DQ : DerivedCategory X.Modules ⥤ Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X}
    (adj : Stacks.Duality.Coherator.quasiCoherentι X ⊣ DQ) :
    IsIso (adj.homEquiv (pullbackTildeLimitQCoh f M) _
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).map
        (limit.post M (tilde.functor R ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f))))

declarations.name: Stacks.AmpleThickeningAscent.isRelativelyAmple_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2R].** Let `(f, f') : (X ⊆ X') → (S ⊆ S')` be a morphism of thickenings —
a commutative square `i ≫ f' = f ≫ j` in which `i : X ⟶ X'` and `j : S ⟶ S'` are thickenings —
and let `𝓛'` be an invertible `𝒪_{X'}`-module, with restriction `𝓛 = i^* 𝓛'` to `X`. Then `𝓛'`
is `f'`-ample if and only if `𝓛` is `f`-ample.

This is `Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.isRelativelyAmple_iff` with its hypothesis
`Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.AmpleReflectedByThickening` discharged by
`Stacks.AmpleThickeningAscent.ampleReflectedByThickening`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}} {i : X ⟶ X'} {j : S ⟶ S'} {f : X ⟶ S}
    {f' : X' ⟶ S'} (hi : IsThickening i) (hj : IsThickening j) (hsq : i ≫ f' = f ≫ j)
    (L' : X'.Modules) [IsInvertibleModule X' L'] :
    IsRelativelyAmple f' L' ↔ IsRelativelyAmple f (pullbackModule i L')

declarations.name: Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.isRelativelyAmple_pullback
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2R], the implication `ℒ'` is `f'`-ample `⟹` `ℒ` is `f`-ample.** For a
morphism of thickenings `(f, f') : (X ⊆ X') → (S ⊆ S')` and an invertible `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℒ'`
with restriction `ℒ = i^* ℒ'` to `X`, relative ampleness of `ℒ'` over `f'` gives relative
ampleness of `ℒ` over `f`.

**Nothing is carried.** The source checks relative ampleness at every affine open of `S` and
gets the correspondence with the affine opens of `S'` from [Stacks, Tag 06AD]; here the opens
`j^{-1}V'`, for `V'` an affine open of `S'`, are an affine open covering of `S` — affine because
`j` is a closed immersion, covering because `j` is surjective — and that is enough by
[Stacks, Tag 01VJ]. Over each member the implication is the closed-immersion case of
[Stacks, Tag 0B3E] applied to `i ∣_ (f'^{-1}V')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_pullback (hi : IsThickening i) (hj : IsThickening j)
    (hsq : i ≫ f' = f ≫ j) (hL' : IsRelativelyAmple f' L') :
    IsRelativelyAmple f (pullbackModule i L')
declarations.comment: the implication `ℒ'` is `f'`-ample ⟹ `ℒ` is `f`-ample, nothing carried

declarations.name: Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.isRelativelyAmple_of_isRelativelyAmple_pullback
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2R], the implication `ℒ` is `f`-ample `⟹` `ℒ'` is `f'`-ample**, granted
[Stacks, Tag 09MW]. For a morphism of thickenings `(f, f') : (X ⊆ X') → (S ⊆ S')` and an
invertible `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℒ'` with restriction `ℒ = i^* ℒ'` to `X`, relative ampleness of `ℒ`
over `f` gives relative ampleness of `ℒ'` over `f'`.

**One hypothesis is carried**, `href : Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.AmpleReflectedByThickening`,
which is the implication `k^* M` ample `⟹` `M` ample of [Stacks, Tag 09MW] with the source's own
hypotheses. The source's proof of [Stacks, Tag 0D2R] cites [Stacks, Tag 09MW] at exactly this
point. Everything else is proved: an affine open `V'` of `S'` has `j^{-1}V'` affine because `j`
is a closed immersion, the commutative square identifies `f^{-1}(j^{-1}V')` with
`i^{-1}(f'^{-1}V')`, and the restricted morphism `i ∣_ (f'^{-1}V')` is again a thickening.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_of_isRelativelyAmple_pullback (href : AmpleReflectedByThickening.{u})
    (hi : IsThickening i) (hj : IsThickening j) (hsq : i ≫ f' = f ≫ j)
    (hL : IsRelativelyAmple f (pullbackModule i L')) :
    IsRelativelyAmple f' L'
declarations.comment: the implication `ℒ` is `f`-ample ⟹ `ℒ'` is `f'`-ample, carrying `href` = [Tag 09MW] mp

declarations.name: Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.isRelativelyAmple_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2R]**, granted [Stacks, Tag 09MW]. For a morphism of thickenings
`(f, f') : (X ⊆ X') → (S ⊆ S')` and an invertible `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℒ'` with restriction
`ℒ = i^* ℒ'` to `X`, the module `ℒ'` is `f'`-ample if and only if `ℒ` is `f`-ample.

The `mp` half is `Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.isRelativelyAmple_pullback` and uses no hypothesis
beyond the source's; the `mpr` half is
`Stacks.ThickeningInvertible.isRelativelyAmple_of_isRelativelyAmple_pullback` and carries
`href`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff (href : AmpleReflectedByThickening.{u}) (hi : IsThickening i)
    (hj : IsThickening j) (hsq : i ≫ f' = f ≫ j) :
    IsRelativelyAmple f' L' ↔ IsRelativelyAmple f (pullbackModule i L')
declarations.comment: the biconditional, carrying `href` = the `mp` half of [Tag 09MW]

declarations.name: Stacks.AmpleFibreLimit.exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_of_isAmple_fibre
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2S].**  Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a proper morphism of schemes, let `ℒ` be an
invertible `𝒪_X`-module and let `y` be a point of `S` such that `ℒ_y` is ample on the fibre `X_y`.
Then `y` has an open neighbourhood `V ⊆ S` such that `ℒ|_{f⁻¹V}` is ample relative to `f⁻¹V / V`.

**No hypothesis on `S`**:  this is [Stacks, Tag 0D2N],
`Stacks.AmpleFibreNeighbourhood.exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_of_isAmple_fibre`, with its
Noetherian hypothesis removed by the limit argument described in the module documentation.  The
statement is otherwise the same, down to the spelling of the hypothesis and of the conclusion, and
invertibility of `ℒ_y` is an instance rather than a hypothesis for the same reason as there.

The base is replaced by an affine — hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated — open neighbourhood
`A` of `y`, which is legitimate in both directions: the hypothesis transfers by
`Stacks.AmpleFibreLimit.isAmple_fibre_morphismRestrict`, and the conclusion transfers back along
the isomorphism of arrows `AlgebraicGeometry.morphismRestrictRestrict` by
`Stacks.AmpleFibreLimit.isRelativelyAmple_pullbackModule_of_commSq`, whose two horizontal
morphisms are in this instance isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_of_isAmple_fibre {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsProper f] (L : X.Modules) [IsInvertibleModule X L] (y : S)
    (hL : IsAmple (f.fiber y) (pullbackModule (f.fiberι y) L)) :
    ∃ V : S.Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple (f ∣_ V) (pullbackModule (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cohomologyCollapseIsoOfIsAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D2U.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and `𝓕`
a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then for every `i ≥ 0` the cohomology of `𝓕` on `X`, as the
`i`-th derived functor of `Γ(Y, f_* −) = Γ(X, −)` at `𝓕`, is the cohomology `H^i(Y, f_*𝓕)`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyCollapseIsoOfIsAffineHom (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (i : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    have := enoughInjectives_modules B S hS Y.1 Y.2
    (((modulePushforward B S hS f ⋙ globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u}
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
            (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).O))).rightDerived i).obj F ≅
      ((globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u}
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
            (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).O))).rightDerived i).obj
        ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F))
declarations.comment: the Leray collapse R^i Γ(Y, f_* -)(F) ≅ H^i(Y, f_*F), as modules over the global sections of Y, every degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cohomologyUliftIsoOfIsAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D2U.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and `𝓕`
a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then `Hⁱ(X, 𝓕) = Hⁱ(Y, f_*𝓕)` for every `i ≥ 0`.

The cohomology is that of the universe lifts of the two modules to the universe of the small
étale sites, the universe in which `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eulerCharacteristic` (Stacks 0DN1)
is taken; the isomorphism is one of abelian groups, and of `A`-modules for any ring maps to the
global functions compatible with `f`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cohomologyUliftOverRingIsoOfIsAffineHom`).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAmple_of_forall_isCoherent_isZero_rightDerived_one_twistStep
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D2W.**  Let `S` be a scheme, `X` a Noetherian algebraic space over `S` and `𝓛` an
invertible `𝒪_X`-module.  If every coherent `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` has some `n ≥ 1` with
`H¹(X, 𝓕 ⊗ 𝓛^{⊗ n}) = 0`, then `X` is a scheme and `𝓛` is ample on it: there are an object `U`
of the site and an isomorphism `yoneda.obj U ≅ X` for which the restriction of `𝓛` to the scheme
underlying `U` is an invertible and ample module.  See the module docstring.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAmple_of_forall_isCoherent_isZero_rightDerived_one_twistStep
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hN : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ X.1) (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O).property L]
    (h : have := enoughInjectives_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
      ∀ F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2, IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F →
        ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ IsZero (((globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u}
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
            (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).rightDerived 1).obj
            (twistStep B S hS X.1 X.2 L n F))) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (eX : yoneda.obj U ≅ X.1)
      (_ : Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)
        (baseChangeModule B S hS L U eX.hom)),
      Stacks.Ample.IsAmple ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)
        (baseChangeModule B S hS L U eX.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_stage_model
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D2X, part (1).** Let `X = lim Xᵢ` be the limit of a cofiltered system of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms, as
in Stacks 07SK.  Every finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module is the pullback of a finite locally free
`𝒪_{Xᵢ}`-module for some `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_stage_model
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS
      (limitAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine).1
      (limitAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine).2)
    (hF : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite F) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Fᵢ : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).1
        (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).2),
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite Fᵢ ∧
        Nonempty (F ≅ (modulePullback B S hS
          (limitProjection B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine i)).obj Fᵢ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isInvertibleModule_stage_model
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D2X, part (2).** Let `X = lim Xᵢ` be the limit of a cofiltered system of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms, as
in Stacks 07SK.  Every invertible `𝒪_X`-module is the pullback of an invertible
`𝒪_{Xᵢ}`-module for some `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isInvertibleModule_stage_model
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS
      (limitAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine).1
      (limitAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine).2)
    (hL : IsInvertibleModule (limitAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine) L) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Lᵢ : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).1
        (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).2),
      IsInvertibleModule (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i) Lᵢ ∧
        Nonempty (L ≅ (modulePullback B S hS
          (limitProjection B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine i)).obj Lᵢ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.comap
declarations.doc:
**The pullback `(g^*ℒ, g^*ψ)` of `(ℒ, ψ)` along a morphism `g : X' ⟶ X`**, a pair over
`f ∘ g : X' ⟶ Y`.  A scheme point `x' : T ⟶ X'` is the scheme point `g ∘ x'` of `X`, and the
restrictions of `g^*ℒ` and `g^*ψ` to `x'` are those of `ℒ` and `ψ` to `g ∘ x'`, with the same
identifications along morphisms of test schemes.
declarations.statement: def comap : s.InvertibleTwistingRestriction (g ≫ f)
declarations.comment: the pullback (g^*L, g^*psi) of the data along a morphism of algebraic spaces g : X' -> X, a pair over f o g : X' -> Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.locus_comap
declarations.doc:
**Formation of `U(ψ) ⊆ X` commutes with pullback by any morphism `g : X' ⟶ X`**
([Stacks, Tag 0D2Y]): the open subspace `U(g^*ψ)` of `X'` is the preimage `g^{-1}(U(ψ))`, that
is `X' ×_X U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement: theorem locus_comap : (R.comap g).locus = R.locus.preimage g
declarations.comment: formation of U(psi) commutes with pullback by any morphism g : X' -> X: U(g^*psi) = g^{-1}(U(psi)) as subspaces of X'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.tag0D2Y
declarations.statement:
theorem tag0D2Y (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace s.site s.base s.containsBase X) :
    IsOpenSubspace s.site s.base s.containsBase R.locus ∧
    (∀ (T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase) (x : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X),
      R.locus.preimage x = subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase T (R.locusOpen T x)) ∧
    (∀ (T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase) (x : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
      (y : (BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).obj T),
      y ∈ R.locusOpen T x ↔
        ∃ (V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).obj T).Opens) (k : ℕ),
          0 < k ∧ y ∈ V ∧ Epi (((R.twisting T x).pullback V.ι).app (k : ℤ))) ∧
    (∀ {X' : (BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (g : X' ⟶ X),
      (R.comap g).locus = R.locus.preimage g)
declarations.comment: the open subspace U(psi) of X: it is open, its preimage along a scheme point x : T -> X is U(x^*psi), its points are those near which some f^*A_d -> L^d with d >= 1 is surjective, and U(g^*psi) = g^{-1}(U(psi)) for every morphism g : X' -> X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**  In Situation 0849 let `Y` be the algebraic space `s.space`, `𝒜` the
quasi-coherent graded `𝒪_Y`-algebra `s.algebra` and `π : Proj_Y(𝒜) ⟶ Y` its relative homogeneous
spectrum of Stacks 084B (`s.relativeProjFunctor`, `s.relativeProjπ`).  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` with `X` a
scheme, `ℒ` invertible on `X` and `ψ : f^*𝒜 ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}` a homomorphism of graded algebras, and
let `U(ψ) ⊆ X` be the open subspace of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Y].  Then `ψ` induces the morphism
`r_{ℒ,ψ} = s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` and the map of graded
algebras `θ = (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta : r^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}` (the twists of
`Proj_Y(𝒜)` read at the scheme point `f`, where they are those of `Proj_X(f^*𝒜)`, Stacks 084D (3)),
such that:

1. `r_{ℒ,ψ}` is a morphism over `Y`, and `θ` preserves the unit and the products;
2. **clause (1)**: for every scheme `v : V ⟶ Y` (in particular every `V ⟶ Y` étale), every scheme
   `W` over `V ×_Y X`, every open `O` of `V`, `d ≥ 0` and section `a` of `v^*𝒜_d` over `O`, the
   pullback of `θ` to `V ×_Y U(ψ)` carries the inverse image of `ψ_{Proj}(a)` to the restriction of
   `ψ(a)` (`clauseOne`);
3. **clause (2)(a)**: a scheme `W ⟶ X` over which `ψ` is surjective in some degree `k ≥ 1`
   factors through `U(ψ)`;
4. **clause (2)(b)**: the composite `W ⟶ U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` is the point of `Proj_Y(𝒜)` which the
   construction of the relative Proj attaches to the quadruple `(k, W ⟶ Y, ℒ^{⊗ k}|_W, ψ|_W)`;
5. **the characterization**: `r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the only morphism over `Y` with clause (2)(b);
6. **clause (3)**: for every commutative square `g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` with `X'` and `Y'` schemes,
   with `ψ' = clauseThreeTwisting ψ g f' g' hsq` the pullback of `ψ`:
   `U(ψ') = g'^{-1}(U(ψ))`; `r_{ℒ',ψ'}` is the base change of `r_{ℒ,ψ}` through
   `Proj_{Y'}(g^*𝒜) = Y' ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜)`; and `θ'` is the pullback of `θ` along
   `j : U(ψ') ⟶ U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tag0D2Z :
    s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ ≫ s.relativeProjπ =
        (subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).ι ≫ f ∧
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta).app 0)
        (Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
            ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)))
            (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra
              (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)).algebra).one =
      (laurentOn L (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).one ∧
    (∀ (n e : ℕ) (U : (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.toScheme.Opens)
        (x :
            ((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism
                  (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)))
                (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra
                  (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)).algebra).piece
              (n : ℤ)).val.obj
            (op U))
        (y :
            ((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism
                  (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)))
                (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra
                  (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)).algebra).piece
              (e : ℤ)).val.obj
            (op U)),
        (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app ((n : ℤ) + (e : ℤ))).val.app (op U)
            (((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
                    ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism
                      (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)))
                    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra
                      (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra X f)).algebra).mul
                  n e).app
                (op U) x y)) =
          ((laurentOn L (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).mul n e).app (op U)
            (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app n).val.app (op U) x)
            (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app e).val.app (op U) y)) ∧
    (∀ {V W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (v : yoneda.obj V ⟶ s.space.1) (p : W ⟶ V)
        (q : W ⟶ X)
        (hpq : yoneda.map p ≫ v = yoneda.map q ≫ f)
        (O : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).obj V).Opens) (n : ℕ)
        (a : Γ((s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v).piece (n : ℤ), O)),
      ((toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).powK n).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom ((toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).toBase_preimage_eq O)).op
        ((((clauseThreeSourceIso ψ v p q hpq).inv ≫
            pullbackGradedAlgebraMap (clauseThreeRestrict ψ v p q hpq).toLRSHom.toShHom
              (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta ≫
            (clauseThreeTargetIso ψ v p q hpq).hom).app n).val.app
          (op
              ((toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).globalMorphism
                (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v)) ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v)).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ O)))
          (pullbackUnit ((toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).globalMorphism
              (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v))).toLRSHom.toShHom
            (Otw (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v) n)
                (op ((relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v)).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ O))
                (psiU (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra V v) n O a))) =
        (tensorPowerModule ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).obj W)
            (toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).L n).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
                ((toGradedPowerMap
                  (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).coveringOpen.ι.image_preimage_le
              ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map p ⁻¹ᵁ O))).op
          ((powCompare (toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq)).L n).hom.app
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map p ⁻¹ᵁ O)
            (valueSec (clauseThreeTwisting ψ v p q hpq) n O a))) ∧
    (∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ} (_ : 0 < k)
        [Epi
              ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map w)).app
                (k : ℤ))],
            w ∈
            (subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).obj
              (op W)) ∧
    (∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
        [Epi
            ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map w)).app (k : ℤ))],
        s.relativeProjPoints.locusFactor ψ w
            (s.relativeProjPoints.mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi ψ w hk) ≫
            s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ =
                s.relativeProjPoints.quadruplePoint ψ w hk) ∧
    (∀ Φ :
        (subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).toFunctor ⟶
          s.relativeProjFunctor,
      Φ ≫ s.relativeProjπ =
      (subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).ι ≫ f →
      (∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
        [Epi
            ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map w)).app (k : ℤ))],
        s.relativeProjPoints.locusFactor ψ w
          (s.relativeProjPoints.mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi ψ w hk) ≫
          Φ = s.relativeProjPoints.quadruplePoint ψ w hk) →
      Φ = s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ) ∧
    (∀ {Y' X' : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (g : yoneda.obj Y' ⟶ s.space.1)
        (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
        (hsq : yoneda.map f' ≫ g = yoneda.map g' ≫ f),
      (toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ g f' g' hsq)).coveringOpen =
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map g' ⁻¹ᵁ
          (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen ∧
      (∀ {T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (t : T ⟶ X')
        (ht : t ≫ g' ∈
          (subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).obj
            (op T)),
        (s.relativeProjPoints.pointEquivProjOver Y' g (t ≫ f')
            ⟨s.relativeProjPoints.locusFactor ψ (t ≫ g') ht ≫
              s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ,
              locusFactor_invertibleMorphism_comp_π ψ g f' g' hsq t ht⟩).1 =
          liftOfPreimageEqTop _ _ (preimage_clauseThree_coveringOpen_eq_top ψ g f' g' hsq t ht) ≫
            (toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ g f' g' hsq)).globalMorphism
              (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra Y' g))) ∧
      (toGradedPowerMap (clauseThreeTwisting ψ g f' g' hsq)).theta =
        (clauseThreeSourceIso ψ g f' g' hsq).inv ≫
          pullbackGradedAlgebraMap (clauseThreeRestrict ψ g f' g' hsq).toLRSHom.toShHom
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta ≫
          (clauseThreeTargetIso ψ g f' g' hsq).hom)
declarations.comment: variant: X a scheme; the whole lemma, in Situation 0849 with Proj_Y(A) the relative Proj of Stacks 084B and X a scheme over the algebraic space Y: the morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) over Y; theta : r^*((+)_d O(d)) -> (+)_d L^d|_{U(psi)} a unital multiplicative map; clause (1) for every scheme V -> Y (in particular every etale one) and every scheme over V x_Y X; clauses (2)(a) and (2)(b) for every scheme W -> X and every degree d >= 1; the characterization of r_{L,psi} by (2)(b); and clause (3) for every square with X', Y' schemes and Y' -> Y arbitrary: U(psi') = (g')^{-1}(U(psi)), r_{L',psi'} is the base change of r_{L,psi} through Proj_{Y'}(A') = Y' x_Y Proj_Y(A), and theta' is the pullback of theta

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)`, the morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z]**, as the transformation of
functors the source's proof builds: on a test scheme `ρ : T ⟶ X` of `U(ψ)` it is
`invertiblePoint`, and its naturality is the naturality of the identification
`X ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜) = Proj_X(f^*𝒜)`.
declarations.statement:
def invertibleMorphism :
    (subspaceOfOpens B S hS X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).toFunctor ⟶ Proj
declarations.comment: variant: the morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) for a presentation of Proj_Y(A) by its base changes to the scheme points of Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism_comp_π
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is a morphism over `Y`**, as [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z] asserts: `π ∘ r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the
restriction of `f` to `U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_comp_π :
    d.invertibleMorphism ψ ≫ π
      = (subspaceOfOpens B S hS X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).ι ≫ f
declarations.comment: variant: r_{L,psi} lies over Y, for a presentation of Proj_Y(A) by its base changes to the scheme points of Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(a) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**  For `k ≥ 1` and a scheme `w : W ⟶ X` such that
`ψ|_W : (f ∘ w)^*𝒜_k ⟶ (w^*ℒ)^{⊗ k}` is surjective, `w` factors through `U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi {W : BigFppfOver B S hS} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    [Epi ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map w)).app (k : ℤ))] :
    w ∈ (subspaceOfOpens B S hS X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).obj (op W)
declarations.comment: variant: clause (2)(a), for a presentation of Proj_Y(A) by its base changes to the scheme points of Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.locusFactor_invertibleMorphism_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(b) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**  For `k ≥ 1` and a scheme `w : W ⟶ X` such that
`ψ|_W` is surjective in degree `k`, the composite of the factorisation `W ⟶ U(ψ)` with
`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the morphism `W ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` which the construction of the relative Proj attaches to
the quadruple `(k, W ⟶ Y, ℒ^{⊗ k}|_W, ψ|_W)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem locusFactor_invertibleMorphism_of_epi {W : BigFppfOver B S hS} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < k) [Epi ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map w)).app (k : ℤ))] :
    d.locusFactor ψ w (d.mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi ψ w hk) ≫ d.invertibleMorphism ψ
      = d.quadruplePoint ψ w hk
declarations.comment: variant: clause (2)(b), for a presentation of Proj_Y(A) by its base changes to the scheme points of Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.eq_invertibleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is characterized by clause (2)**: a morphism `U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` over `Y` which, on
every test scheme `W ⟶ X` over which `ψ` is surjective in some positive degree, is the morphism
attached to the quadruple of clause (2)(b), is `r_{ℒ,ψ}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_invertibleMorphism
    (Φ : (subspaceOfOpens B S hS X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).toFunctor ⟶ Proj)
    (hΦπ : Φ ≫ π = (subspaceOfOpens B S hS X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).ι ≫ f)
    (hΦ : ∀ {W : BigFppfOver B S hS} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
      [Epi ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map w)).app (k : ℤ))],
      d.locusFactor ψ w (d.mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi ψ w hk) ≫ Φ = d.quadruplePoint ψ w hk) :
    Φ = d.invertibleMorphism ψ
declarations.comment: variant: the characterization of r_{L,psi} by clause (2)(b), for a presentation of Proj_Y(A) by its base changes to the scheme points of Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z], for the morphism, when `Y' ⟶ Y` is the point `f`.**
Consider the square with `Y' = X`, `g = f : Y' ⟶ Y`, a scheme `g' : X' ⟶ X` and `f' = g'`, so that
`𝒜' = f^*𝒜`, `ℒ' = g'^*ℒ` and `ψ' = g'^*ψ`.  Then `U(ψ') = g'^{-1}(U(ψ))`
(`…RelativeProjInvertibleMorphism.coveringOpen_pullback`), and `r_{ℒ',ψ'}` of
[Stacks, Tag 01O9] agrees with the base change of `r_{ℒ,ψ}` through
`Proj_X(f^*𝒜) = X ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜)`: on every test scheme `t : T ⟶ X'` of `U(ψ')`, the point
`(f' ∘ t, r_{ℒ,ψ}(g' ∘ t))` of `X ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜)` is `r_{ℒ',ψ'} ∘ t`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_baseChange {X' T : BigFppfOver B S hS} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (t : T ⟶ X')
    (ht : t ≫ g' ∈ (subspaceOfOpens B S hS X (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).obj (op T)) :
    (d.pointEquivProjOver X f (t ≫ g')
        ⟨d.locusFactor ψ (t ≫ g') ht ≫ d.invertibleMorphism ψ, by
          rw [Category.assoc, invertibleMorphism_comp_π, ← Category.assoc, locusFactor_ι]⟩).1
      = liftOfPreimageEqTop _ _ (d.preimage_coveringOpen_pullback_eq_top ψ g' t ht)
        ≫ (toGradedPowerMap (ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g'))).globalMorphism
          (relativeProj (d.algebra X f))
declarations.comment: variant: clause (3) for the morphism, for the squares in which Y' -> Y is the scheme point f : X -> Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.invertibleTheta_clauseOne
declarations.doc:
**`θ` and clause (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z], after base change to the scheme point
`f : X ⟶ Y`.**  The twists of `Proj_Y(𝒜)` are given at the scheme points of `Y`
([Stacks, Tag 084D]); at `f` they are the twists of `Proj_X(f^*𝒜)`, so
`r^*(⨁ 𝒪(d))` is the inverse image along `U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_X(f^*𝒜)` of those twists, and `θ` is the
map of [Stacks, Tag 01O9].  It preserves the unit and is multiplicative, and for every open `V`
of `X`, `d ≥ 0` and `a ∈ (f^*𝒜)_d(V)` it carries the inverse image of `ψ_P(a)` to the restriction
of `ψ(a)` to `U(ψ) ∩ V`: the square of clause (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleTheta_clauseOne :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta).app 0)
        (Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
          ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)))
          (twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra).one
      = (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedTriple.laurentOn L
          (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).one
    ∧ (∀ (n e : ℕ) (U : (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.toScheme.Opens)
        (x : ((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
          ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)))
          (twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra).piece (n : ℤ)).val.obj (op U))
        (y : ((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
          ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)))
          (twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra).piece (e : ℤ)).val.obj (op U)),
        (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app ((n : ℤ) + (e : ℤ))).val.app (op U)
            (((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
              ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)))
              (twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra).mul n e).app (op U) x y))
          = ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedTriple.laurentOn L
              (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).mul n e).app (op U)
              (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app n).val.app (op U) x)
              (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app e).val.app (op U) y))
    ∧ (∀ (V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj X).Opens) (n : ℕ)
        (a : Γ((d.algebra X f).piece (n : ℤ), V)),
        ((Stacks.AmpleProjectiveImmersion.tensorPowerModule _ L (n : ℤ)).restrict
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι).presheaf.map
            (eqToHom ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).toBase_preimage_eq V)).op
            (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app n).val.app
              (op ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)) ⁻¹ᵁ
                ((relativeProj (d.algebra X f)).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
              (Stacks.RingedSpace.pullbackUnit
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism
                  (relativeProj (d.algebra X f))).toLRSHom.toShHom
                ((twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra.piece (n : ℤ))
                (op ((relativeProj (d.algebra X f)).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V))
                (((twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).ψ n).app V a)))
          = (Stacks.AmpleProjectiveImmersion.tensorPowerModule _ L (n : ℤ)).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι.image_preimage_le
                (𝟙 ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj X) ⁻¹ᵁ V))).op
              ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentMulSections.powCompare L n).hom.app
                (𝟙 ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj X) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).value n V a)))
declarations.comment: variant: theta and clause (1) after base change to the scheme point f : X -> Y, for the opens of X; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.quadrupleSpaceEquiv_invertibleMorphism_val
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(b) of Stacks 0D2Z on the constructed relative Proj, for an arbitrary scheme
`W ⟶ X`.**

Let `F = Proj_Y(𝒜)` be the functor of quadruples of Stacks 084A of Situation 0849, constructed as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeProjFunctor`, and let
`r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶ F` be the morphism of Stacks 0D2Z for a homomorphism of graded algebras
`ψ : f^*𝒜 ⟶ ⨁_{d ≥ 0} ℒ^{⊗ d}` on a scheme `f : X ⟶ Y`. For `k ≥ 1` and a scheme `w : W ⟶ X`
over which `ψ|_W` is surjective in degree `k`, the composite `W ⟶ U(ψ) ⟶ F` is the morphism given
by the construction of `F`: the point of `F(W)` it defines records, at every quasi-compact test
object `v : W' ⟶ W`, the point of `F(W')` over `f ∘ w ∘ v` given by the class of the pullback
along `v` of the quadruple `(k, w, (w^*ℒ)^{⊗ k}, ψ^{(k)}|_W)`, transported from the algebra
`(w ∘ v)^*(f^*𝒜)` to the algebra `(f ∘ w ∘ v)^*𝒜` along the comparison of the restriction datum
of the situation.
declarations.statement:
theorem quadrupleSpaceEquiv_invertibleMorphism_val
    {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    [Epi ((ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map w)).app (k : ℤ))]
    (W' : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase)
    (hW' : CompactSpace ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).obj W'))
    (v : W' ⟶ W) :
    (s.quadrupleRestriction.quadrupleSpaceEquiv s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
        s.space.property.isSheaf W
        (yonedaEquiv (s.relativeProjPoints.locusFactor ψ w
          (s.relativeProjPoints.mem_subspaceOfOpens_of_epi ψ w hk) ≫
            s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ))).val W' hW' v =
      ⟨yoneda.map (v ≫ w) ≫ f,
        s.quadrupleRestriction.fibreOfF f (v ≫ w) (yoneda.map (v ≫ w) ≫ f) rfl
          (F.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map v)
            (clauseTwoClass ψ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map w) hk))
          ((pullback_clauseTwoClass_fst ψ _ _ hk).trans
            ((congrArg (_ ≫ ·) (Category.comp_id _)).trans (Functor.map_comp _ _ _).symm))⟩
declarations.comment: variant: clause (2)(b) read on the functor of quadruples of Tag 084A at every quasi-compact W' -> W; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.InvertibleQuotientLocus.morphism
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)`, the morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**

Its value on a test scheme `W ⟶ X` of `U(ψ)` is the morphism `W ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` that the
construction of the relative Proj attaches to `ψ|_W`, and its naturality is the compatibility of
the restrictions of `ψ` with base change: this is the transformation of functors the source's
proof produces.
declarations.statement: public def morphism : L.locus.toFunctor ⟶ Proj
declarations.comment: variant: the morphism r_{L,psi} built from a family of degree-one restrictions of psi to the test schemes of U(psi); the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.InvertibleQuotientLocus.morphism_comp_toBase
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is a morphism over `Y`**, as [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z] asserts: composing it with the
structure morphism `π : Proj_Y(𝒜) ⟶ Y` gives the restriction of `f : X ⟶ Y` to `U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement: public theorem morphism_comp_toBase : L.morphism hgen rep ≫ π = L.locus.ι ≫ f
declarations.comment: variant: the morphism of `morphism` lies over Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.InvertibleQuotientLocus.factor_comp_morphism
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(b) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**  For a scheme `W ⟶ X` lying in `U(ψ)`, the composite
of the factorisation `W ⟶ U(ψ)` with `r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the morphism `W ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` that the
construction of the relative Proj attaches to `ψ|_W` — in this library, the morphism the
representing bijection of [Stacks, Tag 085D] attaches to it.
declarations.comment: variant: clause (2)(b) for the morphism of `morphism`, at the test schemes of U(psi); the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.InvertibleQuotientLocus.eq_morphism
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the only morphism with clause (2)(b).**  Together with `factor_comp_morphism`
this is the "characterized by" of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z] for clause (2)(b): every test scheme of
`U(ψ)` carries a restriction of `ψ`, so clause (2)(b) prescribes the morphism on every point of
`U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_morphism (Φ : L.locus.toFunctor ⟶ Proj)
    (hΦ : ∀ {W : BigFppfOver B S hS} (w : W ⟶ X) (hw : w ∈ L.locus.obj (op W)),
      L.factor w hw ≫ Φ = d.pointOfPair TA i hgen rep X f w (L.pair hw)) :
    Φ = L.morphism hgen rep
declarations.comment: variant: the uniqueness of the morphism of `morphism` given clause (2)(b); the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.isOpenSubspace_locus
declarations.doc:
**`U(ψ)` is an open subspace of the algebraic space `X`.**  Its points are those near which
some `f^*𝒜_d ⟶ ℒ^{⊗ d}`, `d ≥ 1`, is surjective (`…mem_locusOpen_iff_exists_epi`), and its
preimage along a scheme point `x` is `U(x^*ψ)` (`…preimage_locus`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_locus (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace s.site s.base s.containsBase X) :
    IsOpenSubspace s.site s.base s.containsBase R.locus
declarations.comment: the source U(psi) of r_{L,psi}, for an algebraic space X, is an open subspace of X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.invertibleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)`, the morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z], for a morphism of
algebraic spaces `f : X ⟶ Y`**, as the transformation of functors on the big fppf site that the
source's proof builds: its value on a scheme point `x : T ⟶ U(ψ)` is the morphism of
[Stacks, Tag 01O9] for the restriction `x^*ψ` (`point`), read in `Proj_Y(𝒜)` through
`T ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜) = Proj_T((f ∘ x)^*𝒜)`; its naturality is clause (3) of the scheme case.
declarations.statement: def invertibleMorphism : R.locus.toFunctor ⟶ s.relativeProjFunctor
declarations.comment: the canonical morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y, an invertible O_X-module L and a homomorphism of graded algebras psi : f^*A -> (+)_d L^d, given on X by their restrictions to the scheme points of X; U(psi) is the open subspace of the algebraic space X of Tag 0D2Y and Proj_Y(A) the relative Proj of Tag 084A/084B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.invertibleMorphism_comp_π
declarations.doc: **`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is a morphism over `Y`**: `π ∘ r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the restriction of `f` to `U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_comp_π :
    R.invertibleMorphism ≫ s.relativeProjπ = R.locus.ι ≫ f
declarations.comment: r_{L,psi} is a morphism of algebraic spaces over Y, for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.mem_locus_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(a) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**  For `k ≥ 1` and a scheme `w : W ⟶ X` such that
`ψ|_W : (f ∘ w)^*𝒜_k ⟶ (w^*ℒ)^{⊗ k}` is surjective, `w` factors through `U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_locus_of_epi {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) [hw : Epi ((R.twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))] :
    yonedaEquiv w ∈ R.locus.obj (op W)
declarations.comment: clause (2)(a), for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y: a scheme W -> X over which psi is surjective in some degree d >= 1 factors through the open subspace U(psi) of the algebraic space X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.factor_invertibleMorphism_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(b) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z].**  For `k ≥ 1` and a scheme `w : W ⟶ X` such that
`ψ|_W` is surjective in degree `k`, the composite of the factorisation `W ⟶ U(ψ)` with
`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is the morphism `W ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` which the construction of the relative Proj attaches to
the quadruple `(k, W ⟶ Y, ℒ^{⊗ k}|_W, ψ|_W)`.
declarations.comment: clause (2)(b), for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y: for a scheme W -> X over which psi is surjective in degree k >= 1, W -> U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) is the morphism the construction of the relative Proj attaches to the quadruple (k, W -> Y, L^k|_W, psi|_W)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.eq_invertibleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is characterized by clause (2)**: a morphism `U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` over `Y` which,
on every scheme `W ⟶ X` over which `ψ` is surjective in some positive degree, is the morphism
attached to the quadruple of clause (2)(b), is `r_{ℒ,ψ}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_invertibleMorphism (Φ : R.locus.toFunctor ⟶ s.relativeProjFunctor)
    (hΦπ : Φ ≫ s.relativeProjπ = R.locus.ι ≫ f)
    (hΦ : ∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X) {k : ℕ}
      (hk : 0 < k) [Epi ((R.twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))],
      R.factor w (R.mem_locus_of_epi w hk) ≫ Φ = R.quadruplePoint w hk) :
    Φ = R.invertibleMorphism
declarations.comment: r_{L,psi} is characterized by property (2), for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y: it is the only morphism U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) over Y with clause (2)(b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z], for a morphism of algebraic spaces `f : X ⟶ Y`.**
Consider a commutative square `g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` with `g' : X' ⟶ X`, `f' : X' ⟶ Y'`,
`g : Y' ⟶ Y` and `X'`, `Y'` schemes, `𝒜' = g^*𝒜`, `ℒ' = (g')^*ℒ`, and let `ψ'` be the pullback
of `ψ` (`squarePsi`).  Then

* `U(ψ') = (g')^{-1}(U(ψ))`: the preimage of the open subspace `U(ψ) ⊆ X` along `g'` is the open
  subscheme `U(ψ')` of `X'` of [Stacks, Tag 01O9]; and
* `r_{ψ',ℒ'} : U(ψ') ⟶ Proj_{Y'}(𝒜')` of [Stacks, Tag 01O9] agrees with the base change of
  `r_{ψ,ℒ}` through the identification `Proj_{Y'}(𝒜') = Y' ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜)` of Stacks 084B: for
  every test scheme `t : T ⟶ X'` of `U(ψ')`, the `T`-point of `Y' ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜)` with components
  `f' ∘ t` and `r_{ψ,ℒ} ∘ g' ∘ t` is, in `Proj_{Y'}(𝒜')`, the composite
  `T ⟶ U(ψ') ⟶ Proj_{Y'}(𝒜')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square {X' Y' : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase}
    (g' : yoneda.obj X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : yoneda.obj Y' ⟶ s.space.1)
    (hsq : yoneda.map f' ≫ g = g' ≫ f) :
    R.locus.preimage g' = subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X'
        (toGradedPowerMap (R.squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).coveringOpen ∧
    ∀ {T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (t : T ⟶ X')
      (ht : yonedaEquiv (yoneda.map t ≫ g') ∈ R.locus.obj (op T)),
      (s.relativeProjPoints.pointEquivProjOver Y' g (t ≫ f')
          ⟨R.factor (yoneda.map t ≫ g') ht ≫ R.invertibleMorphism,
            R.factor_invertibleMorphism_comp_π g' f' g hsq t ht⟩).1 =
        liftOfPreimageEqTop _ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map t)
            (R.preimage_coveringOpen_squarePsi_eq_top g' f' g hsq t ht) ≫
          (toGradedPowerMap (R.squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).globalMorphism
            (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra Y' g))
declarations.comment: clause (3), the open and the morphism, for a morphism of algebraic spaces f : X -> Y and an ARBITRARY commutative square g o f' = f o g' with X', Y' schemes: with psi' the pullback of psi, U(psi') = (g')^{-1}(U(psi)) as open subspaces, and r_{psi',L'} : U(psi') -> Proj_{Y'}(g^*A) of Tag 01O9 is the base change of r_{L,psi} through the identification Proj_{Y'}(g^*A) = Y' x_Y Proj_Y(A) of Tag 084B, tested on every scheme T -> U(psi')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.isOpenSubspace_locus_ofUnitalHom
declarations.doc: **`U(ψ)` is an open subspace of the algebraic space `X`**, for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_locus_ofUnitalHom :
    IsOpenSubspace s.site s.base s.containsBase (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus
declarations.comment: the source U(psi) of r_{L,psi}, for an algebraic space X with an invertible O_X-module L on its small etale site and a homomorphism of graded algebras psi : f^*A -> (+)_n L^n on X: an open subspace of X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.invertibleMorphism_comp_π_ofUnitalHom
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` is a morphism over `Y`**, for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on the algebraic
space `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_comp_π_ofUnitalHom :
    (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism ≫ s.relativeProjπ =
      (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.ι ≫ f.hom
declarations.comment: the canonical morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) over Y, for an algebraic space X with an invertible O_X-module L on its small etale site and a homomorphism of graded algebras psi : f^*A -> (+)_n L^n on X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.mem_locus_ofUnitalHom_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(a) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z]** for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on the algebraic space `X`: a
scheme `w : W ⟶ X` over which `ψ|_W : (f ∘ w)^*𝒜_k ⟶ (w^*ℒ)^{⊗ k}` is surjective for some
`k ≥ 1` factors through `U(ψ)`. Here `ψ|_W` is the restriction `(ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w`
of `ψ` to `W` (`pointTwisting`, the map of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointPsi`).
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_locus_ofUnitalHom_of_epi {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase}
    (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    [Epi (((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))] :
    yonedaEquiv w ∈ (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.obj (op W)
declarations.comment: clause (2)(a), for a pair (L, psi) on an algebraic space X: a scheme W -> X over which psi|_W is surjective in some degree k >= 1 factors through U(psi)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.factor_invertibleMorphism_ofUnitalHom_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2)(b) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z]** for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on the algebraic space `X`: for a
scheme `w : W ⟶ X` over which `ψ|_W` is surjective in degree `k ≥ 1`, the composite
`W ⟶ U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` is the morphism which the construction of the relative Proj attaches to
the quadruple `(k, W ⟶ Y, ℒ^{⊗ k}|_W, ψ|_W)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factor_invertibleMorphism_ofUnitalHom_of_epi {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase}
    (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    [Epi (((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))] :
    (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor w (mem_locus_ofUnitalHom_of_epi s f L ψ w hk) ≫
        (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism =
      (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).quadruplePoint w hk
declarations.comment: clause (2)(b), for a pair (L, psi) on an algebraic space X: for a scheme W -> X over which psi|_W is surjective in degree k >= 1, W -> U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) is the morphism attached to the quadruple (k, W -> Y, L^k|_W, psi|_W)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.eq_invertibleMorphism_ofUnitalHom
declarations.doc:
**`r_{ℒ,ψ}` is characterized by clause (2)**, for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on the algebraic space `X`:
a morphism `U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_Y(𝒜)` over `Y` which, on every scheme `W ⟶ X` over which `ψ|_W` is
surjective in some degree `k ≥ 1`, is the morphism attached to the quadruple of clause (2)(b), is
`r_{ℒ,ψ}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_invertibleMorphism_ofUnitalHom
    (Φ : (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.toFunctor ⟶ s.relativeProjFunctor)
    (hΦπ : Φ ≫ s.relativeProjπ = (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.ι ≫ f.hom)
    (hΦ : ∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.1) {k : ℕ}
      (hk : 0 < k) [Epi (((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))],
      (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor w (mem_locus_ofUnitalHom_of_epi s f L ψ w hk) ≫ Φ =
        (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).quadruplePoint w hk) :
    Φ = (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism
declarations.comment: r_{L,psi} is characterized by property (2), for a pair (L, psi) on an algebraic space X: it is the only morphism U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) over Y with clause (2)(b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square_ofUnitalHom
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z]** for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on the algebraic space `X`: for a
commutative square `g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` with `X'`, `Y'` schemes and `ψ'` the pullback of `ψ`,
`U(ψ') = (g')^{-1}(U(ψ))` and `r_{ψ',ℒ'}` of Tag 01O9 is the base change of `r_{ℒ,ψ}` through
`Proj_{Y'}(g^*𝒜) = Y' ×_Y Proj_Y(𝒜)`, tested on every scheme `T ⟶ U(ψ')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square_ofUnitalHom
    {X' Y' : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (g' : yoneda.obj X' ⟶ X.1)
    (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : yoneda.obj Y' ⟶ s.space.1) (hsq : yoneda.map f' ≫ g = g' ≫ f.hom) :
    (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.preimage g' = subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X'
        (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).coveringOpen ∧
    ∀ {T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (t : T ⟶ X')
      (ht : yonedaEquiv (yoneda.map t ≫ g') ∈ (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.obj (op T)),
      (s.relativeProjPoints.pointEquivProjOver Y' g (t ≫ f')
          ⟨(ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor (yoneda.map t ≫ g') ht ≫
              (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism,
            (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor_invertibleMorphism_comp_π g' f' g hsq t ht⟩).1 =
        liftOfPreimageEqTop _ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map t)
            ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).preimage_coveringOpen_squarePsi_eq_top g' f' g hsq t ht) ≫
          (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).globalMorphism
            (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra Y' g))
declarations.comment: clause (3), the open and the morphism, for a pair (L, psi) on an algebraic space X and an arbitrary commutative square g o f' = f o g' with X', Y' schemes: U(psi') = (g')^{-1}(U(psi)) and r_{psi',L'} is the base change of r_{L,psi}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.tag0D2Z_space
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0D2Z] for `X` an algebraic space.**  In Situation 0849 let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of algebraic spaces, `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `ψ : f^*𝒜 ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}` a
homomorphism of graded algebras.  Then `U(ψ)` is an open subspace of `X`, `r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶
Proj_Y(𝒜)` is a morphism over `Y` with clauses (2)(a), (2)(b), characterized by (2)(b), and
satisfying clause (3); and there is a map `θ : r^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}` of graded
algebras with clause (1), whose restriction to every scheme point `w : W ⟶ U(ψ)` is `θ` of
[Stacks, Tag 01O9] for `w^*ψ`, which for every square `g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` with `X'`, `Y'` schemes
restricts to the map `θ'` of the pullback `ψ'` on every scheme over `U(ψ') = (g')^{-1}(U(ψ))`
(clause (3)), and which is the only map with these restrictions.
declarations.statement:
theorem tag0D2Z_space :
    IsOpenSubspace s.site s.base s.containsBase (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus ∧
    (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism ≫ s.relativeProjπ =
      (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.ι ≫ f.hom ∧
    (∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.1) {k : ℕ}
      (_ : 0 < k) [Epi (((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))],
      yonedaEquiv w ∈ (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.obj (Opposite.op W)) ∧
    (∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.1) {k : ℕ}
      (hk : 0 < k) [Epi (((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))],
      (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor w (mem_locus_ofUnitalHom_of_epi s f L ψ w hk) ≫
          (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism =
        (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).quadruplePoint w hk) ∧
    (∀ Φ : (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.toFunctor ⟶ s.relativeProjFunctor,
      Φ ≫ s.relativeProjπ = (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.ι ≫ f.hom →
      (∀ {W : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.1) {k : ℕ}
        (hk : 0 < k) [Epi (((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting W w).app (k : ℤ))],
        (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor w (mem_locus_ofUnitalHom_of_epi s f L ψ w hk) ≫ Φ =
          (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).quadruplePoint w hk) →
      Φ = (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism) ∧
    (∀ {X' Y' : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (g' : yoneda.obj X' ⟶ X.1)
      (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : yoneda.obj Y' ⟶ s.space.1) (hsq : yoneda.map f' ≫ g = g' ≫ f.hom),
      (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.preimage g' = subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X'
          (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).coveringOpen ∧
      ∀ {T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (t : T ⟶ X')
        (ht : yonedaEquiv (yoneda.map t ≫ g') ∈ (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).locus.obj (Opposite.op T)),
        (s.relativeProjPoints.pointEquivProjOver Y' g (t ≫ f')
            ⟨(ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor (yoneda.map t ≫ g') ht ≫
                (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).invertibleMorphism,
              (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).factor_invertibleMorphism_comp_π g' f' g hsq t ht⟩).1 =
          Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjInvertibleMorphism.liftOfPreimageEqTop _
              ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map t)
              ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).preimage_coveringOpen_squarePsi_eq_top g' f' g hsq t ht) ≫
            (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).globalMorphism
              (relativeProj
                (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra Y' g))) ∧
    ∃ θ : ∀ d : ℤ,
        (thetaSourceOfUnitalHom s f L ψ (basePresentation s) d).obj ⟶ (thetaTarget s f L ψ d).obj,
      (∀ i j : ℤ,
        thetaSourceMul (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ) X.property (basePresentation s) i j ≫ θ (i + j) =
          (θ i ⊗ₘ θ j) ≫ thetaTargetMul s f L ψ i j) ∧
      thetaSourceUnit (ofUnitalHom s f L ψ) X.property (basePresentation s) ≫ θ 0 =
        thetaTargetUnit s f L ψ ∧
      ClauseOneSections s f L ψ (basePresentation s) θ ∧
      (∀ (d : ℤ) {T : BigFppfOver s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase}
        (w : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (locusSpaceOfUnitalHom s f L ψ).obj),
        (modulePullback s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase (pointHom w)).map
            (θ d) =
          (chartSourceIso (basePresentation s) w (locusOpen_locusPoint w) d).hom ≫
            ((representedQuasicoherentSchemeEquivalence s.shrink.site s.shrink.base
                s.shrink.containsBase T).functor.map
              (chartSchemeTheta s f L ψ (locusPoint w) (locusOpen_locusPoint w) d)).hom ≫
            (chartTargetIso w d).hom) ∧
      (∀ {X' Y' : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (g' : yoneda.obj X' ⟶ X.1)
        (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : yoneda.obj Y' ⟶ s.space.1) (hsq : yoneda.map f' ≫ g = g' ≫ f.hom)
        (d : ℤ) {T : BigFppfOver s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase} (t : T ⟶ X')
        (w : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (locusSpaceOfUnitalHom s f L ψ).obj)
        (hw : yoneda.map t ≫ g' = locusPoint w)
        (k : (BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).obj T ⟶
          (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).coveringOpen.toScheme)
        (hk : k ≫ (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).squarePsi g' f' g hsq)).coveringOpen.ι =
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map t),
        (modulePullback s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase (pointHom w)).map
            (θ d) =
          (chartSourceIso (basePresentation s) w (locusOpen_locusPoint w) d).hom ≫
            ((representedQuasicoherentSchemeEquivalence s.shrink.site s.shrink.base
                s.shrink.containsBase T).functor.map
              (eqToHom (chartSchemeThetaSource_congr s f L ψ hw
                  (locusOpen_comp_eq_top_of_eq g' t w hw) (locusOpen_locusPoint w) d).symm ≫
                squarePointChartTheta s f L ψ g' f' g hsq t
                  (locusOpen_comp_eq_top_of_eq g' t w hw) k hk d ≫
                eqToHom (congrArg (fun z => pointLaurentPieceQcoh L T z d) hw))).hom ≫
            (chartTargetIso w d).hom) ∧
      (∀ θ' : ∀ d : ℤ,
          (thetaSourceOfUnitalHom s f L ψ (basePresentation s) d).obj ⟶ (thetaTarget s f L ψ d).obj,
        (∀ (d : ℤ) {T : BigFppfOver s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase}
          (w : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (locusSpaceOfUnitalHom s f L ψ).obj),
          (modulePullback s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase (pointHom w)).map
              (θ' d) =
            (chartSourceIso (basePresentation s) w (locusOpen_locusPoint w) d).hom ≫
              ((representedQuasicoherentSchemeEquivalence s.shrink.site s.shrink.base
                  s.shrink.containsBase T).functor.map
                (chartSchemeTheta s f L ψ (locusPoint w) (locusOpen_locusPoint w) d)).hom ≫
              (chartTargetIso w d).hom) →
        θ' = θ)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, in Situation 0849 with Proj_Y(A) the relative Proj of Stacks 084B and X an algebraic space over the algebraic space Y: U(psi) an open subspace of X; the morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj_Y(A) over Y with clauses (2)(a), (2)(b) and characterized by (2)(b); clause (3) for the open and the morphism; theta : r^*((+)_d O(d)) -> (+)_d L^d|_{U(psi)} a unital multiplicative map with clause (1), restricting at every scheme point of U(psi) to theta of Tag 01O9 and along every square with X', Y' schemes to the theta of the pulled-back psi (clause (3)), and the only map with these restrictions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.theta_map_eq_pullback
declarations.doc:
**The restriction of `θ` to the scheme point `x ∘ τ` is the pullback along `τ` of its
restriction to `x`** (Stacks 0D2Z for an algebraic space `X`, on the scheme points of `U(ψ)`):
`θ_{x ∘ τ}` is `j^*θ_x` for the restriction `j : U((x ∘ τ)^*ψ) ⟶ U(x^*ψ)` of `τ`, read through the
identification of the sources (`…GradedAlgebraRestriction.squareThetaSourceIso`, then
`…GradedPowerMap.thetaTransportSourceIso`) and of the targets
(`…GradedAlgebraRestriction.squareThetaTargetIso`, then
`…GradedPowerMap.thetaTransportTargetIso` for `τ^*(x^*ℒ) ≅ (x ∘ τ)^*ℒ`).
declarations.statement:
theorem theta_map_eq_pullback :
    (toGradedPowerMap (R.twisting T' (yoneda.map τ ≫ x))).theta =
      ((toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
          s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf (R.twisting T
            x)
          ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f) (𝟙 T') τ
          (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f τ x))).thetaTransportSourceIso
        (R.coveringOpen_twisting_map_le τ x)
        (homOfLE_globalMorphism_of_eq_congrBase_congrModule (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ T') _
          (R.lineIso τ x) _ (R.twisting_map τ x))).inv ≫
        pullbackGradedAlgebraMap
          (Scheme.homOfLE
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase).obj T')
            (R.coveringOpen_twisting_map_le τ x)).toLRSHom.toShHom
          ((s.quadrupleRestriction.squareThetaSourceIso s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
              s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf (R.twisting T x) ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f) (𝟙 T') τ
              (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f τ x)).inv ≫
            pullbackGradedAlgebraMap
              (Scheme.Hom.resLE
                ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase).map τ)
                (toGradedPowerMap (R.twisting T x)).coveringOpen
                (toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
                  s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
                  (R.twisting T x) ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f) (𝟙 T') τ
                  (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f τ x))).coveringOpen
                (s.quadrupleRestriction.coveringOpen_squareTwisting
                  s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
                  (R.twisting T x) ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f) (𝟙 T') τ
                  (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f τ x)).le).toLRSHom.toShHom
              (toGradedPowerMap (R.twisting T x)).theta ≫
            (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareThetaTargetIso s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
              s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf (R.twisting T x) ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f) (𝟙 T') τ
              (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f τ x)).hom) ≫
        ((toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
          s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf (R.twisting T
            x)
          ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f) (𝟙 T') τ
