          (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f τ x))).thetaTransportTargetIso
          (R.lineIso τ x) (R.coveringOpen_twisting_map_le τ x)).hom
declarations.comment: theta for X an algebraic space, on the scheme points of U(psi): for scheme points x : T -> X and x o tau, tau : T' -> T, the map theta_{x o tau} of Tag 01O9 for (x o tau)^*psi is the pullback along tau of theta_x, through the canonical isomorphisms of the sources r'^*((+)_d O(d)) and of the targets (+)_d ((x o tau)^*L)^d. This is the last assertion of clause (3) for the square with Y' = X' = T' and f' = id, that is, the compatibility of the restrictions of theta between scheme points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.InvertibleTwistingRestriction.theta_map_eq_pullback_ofUnitalHom
declarations.doc:
**The restriction of `θ` to the scheme point `x ∘ τ` is the pullback along `τ` of its
restriction to `x`**, for a pair `(ℒ, ψ)` on the small étale site of the algebraic space `X`:
`theta_map_eq_pullback` for the restriction datum `ofUnitalHom s f L ψ` of `(ℒ, ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem theta_map_eq_pullback_ofUnitalHom :
    (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T' (yoneda.map τ ≫ x))).theta =
      ((toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
          s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
          ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x)
          ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f.hom) (𝟙 T') τ
          (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f.hom τ x))).thetaTransportSourceIso
        ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).coveringOpen_twisting_map_le τ x)
        (homOfLE_globalMorphism_of_eq_congrBase_congrModule (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ T') _
          ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).lineIso τ x) _ ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting_map τ x))).inv ≫
        pullbackGradedAlgebraMap
          (Scheme.homOfLE
            ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase).obj T')
            ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).coveringOpen_twisting_map_le τ x)).toLRSHom.toShHom
          ((s.quadrupleRestriction.squareThetaSourceIso s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
              s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x)
              ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f.hom) (𝟙 T') τ
              (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f.hom τ x)).inv ≫
            pullbackGradedAlgebraMap
              (Scheme.Hom.resLE
                ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.shrink.site s.shrink.base s.shrink.containsBase).map τ)
                (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x)).coveringOpen
                (toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
                  s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
                  ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x) ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f.hom) (𝟙 T') τ
                  (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f.hom τ x))).coveringOpen
                (s.quadrupleRestriction.coveringOpen_squareTwisting
                  s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
                  ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x) ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f.hom) (𝟙 T') τ
                  (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f.hom τ x)).le).toLRSHom.toShHom
              (toGradedPowerMap ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x)).theta ≫
            (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareThetaTargetIso s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
              s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x)
              ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f.hom) (𝟙 T') τ
              (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f.hom τ x)).hom) ≫
        ((toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
          s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
          ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).twisting T x)
          ((yoneda.map τ ≫ x) ≫ f.hom) (𝟙 T') τ
          (yoneda_map_id_comp_assoc s f.hom τ x))).thetaTransportTargetIso
          ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).lineIso τ x)
          ((ofUnitalHom s f L ψ).coveringOpen_twisting_map_le τ x)).hom
declarations.comment: theta for an algebraic space X with an invertible O_X-module L on its small etale site and a homomorphism of graded algebras psi : f^*A -> (+)_n L^n, on the scheme points of U(psi): theta_{x o tau} is the pullback along tau of theta_x, through the canonical isomorphisms of the sources and of the targets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square
declarations.doc:
**Clause (3) of Stacks 0D2Z, for the open and the morphism, for an arbitrary commutative
square, on the constructed relative Proj.**

Let `F = Proj_Y(𝒜)` be the relative Proj of Situation 0849, constructed as the functor of
quadruples of Stacks 084A (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeProjFunctor`),
`f : X ⟶ Y` a scheme point of the algebraic space `Y`, `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module,
`ψ : f^*𝒜 ⟶ ⨁_{d ≥ 0} ℒ^{⊗ d}` a homomorphism of graded algebras and
`r_{ℒ,ψ} : U(ψ) ⟶ F` the morphism of Stacks 0D2Z.  Consider a commutative square
`g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` with `f' : X' ⟶ Y'`, `g' : X' ⟶ X` and `g : Y' ⟶ Y`, `X'` and `Y'` schemes; put
`𝒜' = g^*𝒜`, `ℒ' = (g')^*ℒ` and let `ψ' : (f')^*𝒜' ⟶ ⨁_d (ℒ')^{⊗ d}` be the pullback of `ψ`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GradedAlgebraRestriction.squareTwisting`).  Then

* `U(ψ') = (g')^{-1}(U(ψ))`, `U(ψ')` being the open of Tag 01O9 for `ψ'` over `Y'`; and
* `r_{ψ',ℒ'} : U(ψ') ⟶ Proj_{Y'}(𝒜')` of Tag 01O9 agrees with the base change of `r_{ψ,ℒ}`
  through the identification `Proj_{Y'}(𝒜') = Y' ×_Y F` of Stacks 084B: for every test scheme
  `t : T ⟶ X'` of `U(ψ')`, the `T`-point of `Y' ×_Y F` with components `f' ∘ t` and
  `r_{ψ,ℒ} ∘ g' ∘ t` is, in `Proj_{Y'}(𝒜')`, the composite `T ⟶ U(ψ') ⟶ Proj_{Y'}(𝒜')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square :
    (toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
        s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
          ψ g f' g' hsq)).coveringOpen =
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map g' ⁻¹ᵁ
        (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen ∧
    ∀ {T : BigFppfOver s.site s.base s.containsBase} (t : T ⟶ X')
      (ht : t ≫ g' ∈ (subspaceOfOpens s.site s.base s.containsBase X
        (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).obj (op T)),
      (s.relativeProjPoints.pointEquivProjOver Y' g (t ≫ f')
          ⟨s.relativeProjPoints.locusFactor ψ (t ≫ g') ht ≫
            s.relativeProjPoints.invertibleMorphism ψ,
            s.quadrupleRestriction.locusFactor_invertibleMorphism_comp_π
              s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ψ g f' g'
                hsq t
              ht⟩).1 =
        liftOfPreimageEqTop _ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map t)
            (s.quadrupleRestriction.preimage_coveringOpen_squareTwisting_eq_top
              s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ψ g f' g'
                hsq t
              ht) ≫
          (toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
            s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ψ g f' g'
              hsq)).globalMorphism (relativeProj (s.relativeProjPoints.algebra Y' g))
declarations.comment: clause (3), the open and the morphism, at a scheme point f : X -> Y of the base (X a scheme), for an ARBITRARY commutative square g o f' = f o g' with X', Y' schemes, on the relative Proj constructed as the functor of quadruples of Tag 084A: with psi' the pullback of psi to (f')^*(g^*A) (through the comparisons (f')^*(g^*A) = (g o f')^*A = (f o g')^*A = (g')^*(f^*A)), U(psi') = (g')^{-1}(U(psi)), and r_{psi',L'} : U(psi') -> Proj_{Y'}(g^*A) of Tag 01O9 is the base change of r_{psi,L} through the identification Proj_{Y'}(g^*A) = Y' x_Y Proj_Y(A) of Tag 084B, tested on every scheme T -> U(psi')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.invertibleTheta_baseChange_square
declarations.doc:
**The last assertion of clause (3) of Stacks 0D2Z, `θ'` is the pullback of `θ`, for an
arbitrary commutative square, on the constructed relative Proj.**

In the situation of `invertibleMorphism_baseChange_square` (a commutative square
`g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` with `X'`, `Y'` schemes, `𝒜' = g^*𝒜`, `ℒ' = (g')^*ℒ` and `ψ'` the pullback of
`ψ`), let `θ : r_{ℒ,ψ}^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}` and
`θ' : r_{ℒ',ψ'}^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d (ℒ')^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ')}` be the homomorphisms of graded algebras of
Tag 01O9, for `ψ` at the point `f` and for `ψ'` over `Y'`.  Then `θ'` is the inverse image `j^*θ`
of `θ` along the restriction `j : U(ψ') = (g')^{-1}(U(ψ)) ⟶ U(ψ)` of `g'`, read through the
canonical identifications of sheaves of graded algebras
`j^*r_{ℒ,ψ}^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ≅ r_{ℒ',ψ'}^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d))`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GradedAlgebraRestriction.squareThetaSourceIso`: pseudofunctoriality of
the inverse image and the comparison of the twists of Tag 01NR along the morphisms of relative
Proj's over the point `g ∘ f' = f ∘ g'` of `X'`, Stacks 084B (3)) and
`j^*(⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}) ≅ ⨁_d (ℒ')^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ')}`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GradedAlgebraRestriction.squareThetaTargetIso`).
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleTheta_baseChange_square :
    (toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
        s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
          ψ g f' g' hsq)).theta =
      (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareThetaSourceIso s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
          s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ψ g f' g' hsq).inv ≫
        pullbackGradedAlgebraMap
          (Scheme.Hom.resLE ((BigFppfOver.toScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase).map g')
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen
            (toGradedPowerMap (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareTwisting
              s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
              ψ g f' g' hsq)).coveringOpen
            (s.quadrupleRestriction.coveringOpen_squareTwisting
              s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf
              ψ g f' g' hsq).le).toLRSHom.toShHom
          (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta ≫
        (s.quadrupleRestriction.squareThetaTargetIso s.shrink.contains_relativeProj_pointAlgebra
          s.shrink.space.property.isSheaf ψ g f' g' hsq).hom
declarations.comment: clause (3), theta: at a scheme point f : X -> Y of the base (X a scheme), for an ARBITRARY commutative square g o f' = f o g' with X', Y' schemes, on the relative Proj constructed as the functor of quadruples of Tag 084A, the map theta' : r'^*((+)_d O(d)) -> (+)_d (L')^d|_{U(psi')} of Tag 01O9 for the pullback psi' of psi is the pullback j^*theta of theta along the restriction j : U(psi') -> U(psi) of g', through the canonical isomorphisms of graded algebras j^*r^*((+)_d O(d)) = r'^*((+)_d O(d)) and j^*((+)_d L^d|_{U(psi)}) = (+)_d (L')^d|_{U(psi')}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.invertibleTheta_unique
declarations.doc:
**`θ` is characterized by clause (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z], after base change to the scheme
point `f : X ⟶ Y`.**  With the twists of `Proj_Y(𝒜)` at `f` those of `Proj_X(f^*𝒜)`, as in
`invertibleTheta_clauseOne`: a homomorphism of graded algebras
`θ' : r^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}` which, for every open `V` of `X`, `d ≥ 0` and
`a ∈ (f^*𝒜)_d(V)`, carries the inverse image of `ψ_P(a)` to the restriction of `ψ(a)` to
`U(ψ) ∩ V` is `θ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleTheta_unique
    (θ' : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.Hom
      (Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
        ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)))
        (twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra)
      (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedTriple.laurentOn L
        (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen))
    (h : ∀ (V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj X).Opens) (n : ℕ)
        (a : Γ((d.algebra X f).piece (n : ℤ), V)),
        ((Stacks.AmpleProjectiveImmersion.tensorPowerModule _ L (n : ℤ)).restrict
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι).presheaf.map
            (eqToHom ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).toBase_preimage_eq V)).op
            ((θ'.app n).val.app
              (op ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj (d.algebra X f)) ⁻¹ᵁ
                ((relativeProj (d.algebra X f)).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
              (Stacks.RingedSpace.pullbackUnit
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism
                  (relativeProj (d.algebra X f))).toLRSHom.toShHom
                ((twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).algebra.piece (n : ℤ))
                (op ((relativeProj (d.algebra X f)).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V))
                (((twistDataOfGradedAlgebra (d.algebra X f)).ψ n).app V a)))
          = (Stacks.AmpleProjectiveImmersion.tensorPowerModule _ L (n : ℤ)).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι.image_preimage_le
                (𝟙 ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj X) ⁻¹ᵁ V))).op
              ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentMulSections.powCompare L n).hom.app
                (𝟙 ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj X) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).value n V a))) :
    θ' = (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta
declarations.comment: theta is characterized by clause (1), at the scheme point f : X -> Y: a homomorphism of graded algebras theta' : r^*((+)_d O(d)) -> (+)_d L^d|_{U(psi)} which for every open V of X, d >= 0 and a in (f^*A)_d(V) carries the pullback of psi_P(a) to the restriction of psi(a) is theta

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.invertibleTheta_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**The last sentence of clause (3) of [Stacks, Tag 0D2Z]: `θ'` is the pullback of `θ`**, for
the squares in which `Y' ⟶ Y` is the scheme point `f : X ⟶ Y`.  Consider the square with
`Y' = X`, `g = f`, a scheme `g' : X' ⟶ X` and `f' = g'`, so that `𝒜' = f^*𝒜` (the algebra
`d.algebra X f` of the presentation of `Proj_Y(𝒜)` at `f`), `ℒ' = g'^*ℒ` and `ψ' = g'^*ψ`; at the
point `f` the twists `𝒪(d)` of `Proj_Y(𝒜)` are those of `Proj_X(f^*𝒜)`, as in
`invertibleTheta_clauseOne`.  Then the map
`θ' : r_{ℒ',ψ'}^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d (ℒ')^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ')}` is the inverse image of
`θ : r_{ℒ,ψ}^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}` along the restriction
`j : U(ψ') = g'^{-1}(U(ψ)) ⟶ U(ψ)` of `g'`, read through the canonical identifications
`j^*r_{ℒ,ψ}^*(⨁ 𝒪(d)) ≅ r_{ℒ',ψ'}^*(⨁ 𝒪(d))` (pseudofunctoriality of the inverse image, along
`j ≫ r_{ℒ,ψ} = r_{ℒ',ψ'}`, which is `invertibleMorphism_baseChange`) and
`j^*(⨁ ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}) ≅ ⨁ (g'^*ℒ)^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ')}` of sheaves of graded algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleTheta_baseChange {X' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (g' : X' ⟶ X) :
    (toGradedPowerMap (ψ.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g'))).theta =
      (thetaSourceIso ψ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g')).inv ≫
        pullbackGradedAlgebraMap
          (coveringOpenPullback ψ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g')).toLRSHom.toShHom
          (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta ≫
        (thetaTargetIso ψ ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g')).hom
declarations.comment: variant: clause (3), last sentence, for the squares in which Y' -> Y is the scheme point f : X -> Y; the tag is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.tag0D2Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyAmple
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D31.** A module `L` on an algebraic space `X` is *ample relative to*
`f : X ⟶ Y`, or *`f`-ample*, when `f` is representable and, for every scheme `T` over the base
with a morphism to `Y` and every cartesian square identifying the fibre product with a scheme
`U`, the pullback of `L` to `U` is invertible and ample relative to `U ⟶ T` in the sense of
Stacks 01VH.
declarations.statement:
def IsRelativelyAmple {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyAmple.isRepresentable
declarations.doc:
If a module is ample relative to `f : X ⟶ Y` and the algebraic space `Y` is a scheme, then
the algebraic space `X` is a scheme.
declarations.comment: the source is a scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_iff_exists_scheme
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over the base, let `L` be
an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and assume that the algebraic space `Y` is the scheme `V`. The
following are equivalent:

1. `L` is ample relative to `f` in the sense of algebraic spaces, Stacks 0D31;
2. `X` is a scheme `U` and the restriction of `L` to `U` is invertible and ample relative to the
   morphism `U ⟶ V` induced by `f`, in the sense of schemes, Stacks 01VH.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff_exists_scheme {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hLinv : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L)
    (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (eY : Y.1 ≅ yoneda.obj V) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L ↔
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (eX : yoneda.obj U ≅ X.1)
        (hL : Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)
          (baseChangeModule B S hS L U eX.hom)),
        @Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple _ _
          ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (yoneda.preimage (eX.hom ≫ f.hom ≫ eY.hom)))
          (baseChangeModule B S hS L U eX.hom) hL

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D33.** Relative ampleness is stable under arbitrary base change of algebraic
spaces: if `L` is `f`-ample and `f' : X' ⟶ Y'` is the base change of `f : X ⟶ Y` along
`Y' ⟶ Y`, then the pullback of `L` to `X'` is `f'`-ample.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_baseChange {X Y X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {p : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} (hsq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hL : IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f' ((modulePullback B S hS p).obj L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyAmple.relativelyRepresentable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D34, representability.** A relatively ample module is ample relative to a
representable morphism.
declarations.comment: representable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyAmple.isQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D34, quasi-compactness.** A morphism of algebraic spaces admitting a relatively
ample module is quasi-compact.

Relative ampleness on a scheme contains quasi-compactness of the morphism, so every scheme base
change of `f` is quasi-compact; for a representable morphism that is quasi-compactness of `f`
itself, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_quasiCompact_iff_isQuasiCompact` (Stacks 03HD).
declarations.comment: quasi-compact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyAmple.isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D34, separatedness.** A morphism of algebraic spaces admitting a relatively ample
module is separated.

Every scheme base change of `f` carries a relatively ample invertible module, hence is a
separated morphism of schemes by Stacks 01VI
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsRelativelyAmple.isSeparated`); for a representable
morphism that is separatedness of `f` itself, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_iff_presheaf`
(Stacks 03KY).
declarations.comment: separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_of_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D35, (2) implies (1).** Let `g : V ⟶ U` be a morphism of algebraic spaces which
are the affine schemes `V₀` and `U₀`, induced by a surjective étale `h₀ : V₀ ⟶ U₀`, let
`f : X ⟶ U` be a morphism of algebraic spaces, let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and let
`pr : Y ⟶ X`, `f' : Y ⟶ V` present `Y` as `V ×_U X`. If the pullback of `L` to `Y` is ample on
`Y/V`, then `L` is ample on `X/U`.

The source `X` is a scheme by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_etale`, and then
ampleness descends along `V₀ ⟶ U₀` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_of_baseChange_etale_of_isRepresentable`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_of_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_etale (hsq : IsPullback pr f' f g)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hLinv : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L)
    (U₀ V₀ : BigFppfOver B S hS) (hU₀ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U₀))
    (hV₀ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V₀))
    (eU : U.1 ≅ yoneda.obj U₀) (eV : V.1 ≅ yoneda.obj V₀)
    (h₀ : V₀ ⟶ U₀) (hg : g.hom ≫ eU.hom = eV.hom ≫ yoneda.map h₀)
    (hsurj : Surjective ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map h₀))
    (hetale : Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map h₀))
    (hN : IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f' ((modulePullback B S hS pr).obj L)) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L
declarations.comment: (2) implies (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_iff_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D35.** Let `g : V ⟶ U` be a morphism of algebraic spaces which are the affine
schemes `V₀` and `U₀`, induced by a surjective étale morphism `h₀ : V₀ ⟶ U₀`, let `f : X ⟶ U` be
a morphism of algebraic spaces, let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and let `pr : Y ⟶ X`,
`f' : Y ⟶ V` present `Y` as `V ×_U X`. The following are equivalent:

1. `L` is ample on `X/U`;
2. the pullback of `L` to `Y` is ample on `Y/V`.

Clause (1) implies clause (2) by [Stacks, Tag 0D33],
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_baseChange`, and the converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_of_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_etale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_etale (hsq : IsPullback pr f' f g)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hLinv : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L)
    (U₀ V₀ : BigFppfOver B S hS) (hU₀ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U₀))
    (hV₀ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V₀))
    (eU : U.1 ≅ yoneda.obj U₀) (eV : V.1 ≅ yoneda.obj V₀)
    (h₀ : V₀ ⟶ U₀) (hg : g.hom ≫ eU.hom = eV.hom ≫ yoneda.map h₀)
    (hsurj : Surjective ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map h₀))
    (hetale : Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map h₀)) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L ↔
      IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f' ((modulePullback B S hS pr).obj L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isAmpleOnBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D36, parts (1) and (2).** A module is ample relative to `f : X ⟶ Y` precisely when
every base change of `f` along a scheme of the site is represented by a scheme carrying a
relatively ample pullback of the module.

The two conditions are the same after unfolding: relative representability of `f` is the
existence of the cartesian squares, and the ampleness clause is imposed on the same squares by
both sides.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isAmpleOnBaseChange {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L ↔
      ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.1),
        IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L T g
declarations.comment:
parts (1) and (2), which the source calls equivalent by definition and which
the library's Tag 0D31 predicate makes so here too

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_isRelativelyAmple
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D36, part (1) implies part (3).** For a relatively ample module the base change of
`f` along any scheme of the site is a scheme carrying a relatively ample pullback; part (3) of
Stacks 0D36 is this restricted to the affine objects of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_isRelativelyAmple {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2} (h : IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.1) :
    IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L T g
declarations.comment:
part (1) implies part (2) at a single base change, hence part (1) implies part
(3) by restriction to affine Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleChart_isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_isRelativelyAmple
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D36, part (1) implies part (4).** A module ample relative to `f : X ⟶ Y` admits a
scheme `V` of the site and a surjective étale morphism `yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y` over which the base
change of `f` is a scheme carrying a relatively ample pullback of the module: any atlas of `Y`
(Stacks 025Y) will do.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleChart_isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_isRelativelyAmple
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y} {L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2}
    (h : IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L) :
    ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y.1),
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
      IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L V g
declarations.comment:
part (1) implies part (4): a surjective etale chart of the base over which the
pullback is a scheme with ample pullback

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_of_forall_affine_isAmpleOnBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D36, the schematic half of part (3) implies part (2).** If the base change of
`f : X ⟶ Y` along every affine object of the site is a scheme, then the base change of `f` along
every object of the site is a scheme.

Relative representability may be tested on the affine objects of the site, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.presheaf_of_affineBaseChange` for the property `⊤` of morphisms of
schemes; this is the half of the implication that the source takes from Stacks 03JH.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_of_forall_affine_isAmpleOnBaseChange
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
      ∀ g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.1, IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L T g) :
    yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom
declarations.comment:
part (3) implies the REPRESENTABILITY clause of part (2) — every base change
to a scheme is a scheme — unconditionally. The ampleness clause of that implication is not
proved here; see `isRelativelyAmple_tfae_of_isInvertible`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_tfae_of_isInvertible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D36.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and `L` an
invertible `𝒪_X`-module. The following are equivalent:

1. `L` is ample on `X/Y`;
2. for every scheme `T` of the site and every morphism `T ⟶ Y` the algebraic space
   `X_T = T ×_Y X` is a scheme and the pullback `L_T` is ample on `X_T/T`;
3. for every affine scheme `T` of the site and every morphism `T ⟶ Y` the algebraic space `X_T`
   is a scheme and `L_T` is ample on `X_T/T`;
4. there are a scheme `V` of the site and a surjective étale morphism `V ⟶ Y` such that `X_V` is
   a scheme and `L_V` is ample on `X_V/V`.

Clause (2) at `T ⟶ Y` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAmpleOnBaseChange`; see
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/RelativeAmpleBaseChangeCriteria.lean` for that spelling.
Clause (3) implies clause (2) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_forall_affine` (Stacks 03JH and 01VJ), and
clause (4) implies clause (3) is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_exists_etaleChart`
(Stacks 0D35).
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_tfae_of_isInvertible {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hLinv : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L,
        ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.1),
          IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L T g,
        ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
          ∀ g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.1, IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L T g,
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y.1),
          (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
          (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) g ∧
          IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L V g]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isCoherent_exists_isZero_rightDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D38.**  Let `R` be a Noetherian ring — here an affine object `V` of the site with
`Γ(V, 𝒪_V) = R` Noetherian — let `X` be an algebraic space over `R` whose structure morphism
`f : X ⟶ h_V` is proper, and let `𝓛` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `𝓛` is ample on `X/R`
(Stacks 0D31) if and only if for every coherent `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` there is an `n₀ ≥ 0` with
`H ᵖ(X, 𝓕 ⊗ 𝓛^{⊗ n}) = 0` for all `n ≥ n₀` and all `p > 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isCoherent_exists_isZero_rightDerived
    (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) [IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V)]
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V, ⊤)]
    {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace V) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O).property L] :
    have := enoughInjectives_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L ↔
      ∀ F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2, IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F →
        ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
          IsZero (((globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u}
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).rightDerived p).obj
              (twistStep B S hS X.1 X.2 L n F))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_ampleSchemeFibreTwistConclusion_tensorPow
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D39.**  Let `Y` be a Noetherian scheme of the site, `f : X ⟶ h_Y` a proper morphism
from an algebraic space, `ℒ` an invertible and `ℱ` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module, and `y ∈ Y` a point
such that the fibre `X_y` is a scheme (the cartesian square `hsq` of `f` along `Spec κ(y) ⟶ Y`)
on which the restriction of `ℒ` is ample.  Then there is a `d₀` such that for every `d ≥ d₀`,
`R^p f_*(ℱ ⊗ ℒ^{⊗ d})_y = 0` for `p > 0` and every section of `ℱ ⊗ ℒ^{⊗ d}` over `X_y` comes
from `f_*(ℱ ⊗ ℒ^{⊗ d})_y` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.AmpleSchemeFibreTwistConclusion`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_ampleSchemeFibreTwistConclusion_tensorPow (Y : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y)]
    {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structureSheaf B S hS X.1 X.2).obj
      (structureRingPresheaf_isSheaf B S hS X.1 X.2) L]
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F)
    (y : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y) (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.1)
    (q : U ⟶ residuePointObject Y y)
    (hsq : IsPullback p (yoneda.map q) f.hom (yoneda.map (residuePointHom Y y)))
    (hL : ∃ hL : Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)
      (baseChangeModule B S hS L U p), @Stacks.Ample.IsAmple _ _ hL) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      AmpleSchemeFibreTwistConclusion f y U p (F ⊗ tensorPow B S hS L d)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_openSub_of_isAmple_baseChangeModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D3A.**  Let `Y` be a Noetherian scheme of the site, `f : X ⟶ h_Y` a proper morphism
from an algebraic space, `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and `y ∈ Y` a point such that the fibre
`X_y` is a scheme (the cartesian square `hsq` of `f` along `Spec κ(y) ⟶ Y`) on which the
restriction of `ℒ` is ample.  Then there is an open neighbourhood `V` of `y` such that the
pullback of `ℒ` to `f⁻¹(V)` is ample on `f⁻¹(V)/V` (Stacks 0D31), for every base change of `f`
along `V ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_openSub_of_isAmple_baseChangeModule
    {Y : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y)]
    {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structureSheaf B S hS X.1 X.2).obj
      (structureRingPresheaf_isSheaf B S hS X.1 X.2) L]
    (y : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y) (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.1)
    (q : U ⟶ residuePointObject Y y)
    (hsq : IsPullback p (yoneda.map q) f.hom (yoneda.map (residuePointHom Y y)))
    (hamp : ∃ hL : Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)
      (baseChangeModule B S hS L U p), @Stacks.Ample.IsAmple _ _ hL) :
    ∃ V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y).Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      ∀ ⦃X₁ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (p₁ : X₁ ⟶ X)
        (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS (openSub Y V)),
        IsPullback p₁ f₁ f (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map (openSubHom Y V))) →
        IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f₁ ((modulePullback B S hS p₁).obj L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_openSub_of_forall_isRelativelyAmple_residueField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D3A, the fibre read through Stacks 0D31.**  Let `Y` be a Noetherian scheme of the
site, `f : X ⟶ h_Y` a proper morphism from an algebraic space, `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and
`y ∈ Y` a point such that the pullback of `ℒ` is ample on every base change of `f` along
`Spec κ(y) ⟶ Y` (so `X_y` is a scheme on which `ℒ_y` is ample).  Then there is an open
neighbourhood `V` of `y` such that the pullback of `ℒ` is ample on every base change of `f` along
`V ⟶ Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_isRelativelyAmple_openSub_of_forall_isRelativelyAmple_residueField
    {Y : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y)]
    {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property
        L)
    (y : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y)
    (hy : ∀ ⦃X₀ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ X)
      (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS
        (residueFieldObject B S hS Y y (B.residueField_spec_contains Y.left.property y))),
      IsPullback p₀ f₀ f (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map
        (residueFieldMap B S hS Y y (B.residueField_spec_contains Y.left.property y)))) →
      IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f₀ ((modulePullback B S hS p₀).obj L)) :
    ∃ V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y).Opens, y ∈ V ∧
      ∀ ⦃X₁ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (p₁ : X₁ ⟶ X)
        (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS (openSub Y V)),
        IsPullback p₁ f₁ f (ObjectProperty.homMk (yoneda.map (openSubHom Y V))) →
        IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f₁ ((modulePullback B S hS p₁).obj L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isRelativelyAmple_of_isFpqcCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D3C.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, `𝓛` an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module and `{gᵢ : Yᵢ ⟶ Y}` an fpqc covering, with base changes `fᵢ : Xᵢ ⟶ Yᵢ` of `f` and
pullbacks `𝓛ᵢ` of `𝓛` to `Xᵢ`. Then `𝓛` is ample on `X/Y` if and only if `𝓛ᵢ` is ample on
`Xᵢ/Yᵢ` for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isRelativelyAmple_of_isFpqcCovering
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y} {I : Type v}
    {Yᵢ Xᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {gᵢ : ∀ i, Yᵢ i ⟶ Y} {fᵢ : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ Yᵢ i}
    {pᵢ : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X} (hsq : ∀ i, IsPullback (pᵢ i) (fᵢ i) f (gᵢ i))
    (L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L)
    (hfpqc : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i => (gᵢ i).hom) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L ↔
      ∀ i, IsRelativelyAmple B S hS (fᵢ i) ((modulePullback B S hS (pᵢ i)).obj L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_of_isRelativelyAmple
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D3C, (1) implies (2).** If `L` is ample on `X/Y` then the pullback of `L` to the
base change of `f` along any member of the family is ample on that base change: this is the
base-change stability of Stacks 0D33, and nothing is asked of the family.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange_of_isRelativelyAmple
    (hL : IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L) (i : I) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS (fᵢ i) ((modulePullback B S hS (pᵢ i)).obj L)
declarations.comment:
(1) implies (2), unconditionally; the fpqc hypothesis on the family is not
needed for this direction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affineFpqcRefinement_isAmpleOnBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**The reduction of Stacks 0D3C, (2) implies (1), to the scheme level.** Assume the pullback
of `L` to each base change `Xᵢ` is ample on `Xᵢ/Yᵢ`. Then every affine scheme `T` over `Y`
admits a finite family of affine schemes over `T` which covers `T` in the fpqc topology of
schemes and on each of whose members the base-change clause of Stacks 0D36 for `(f, L)` holds.

The fpqc condition of Stacks 03MQ supplies the family together with a factorisation of each
member through some `Yᵢ`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAmpleOnBaseChange_of_isPullback` turns the clause for `(fᵢ, Lᵢ)` at
that factorisation into the clause for `(f, L)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affineFpqcRefinement_isAmpleOnBaseChange
    (hfpqc : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i => (gᵢ i).hom)
    (h : ∀ i, IsRelativelyAmple B S hS (fᵢ i) ((modulePullback B S hS (pᵢ i)).obj L))
    (T : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
    (g : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj T) ⟶ Y.1) :
    ∃ U : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T, Finite U.I₀ ∧
      Presieve.map (BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS) U.presieve₀ ∈
        Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).obj T) ∧
      ∀ j : U.I₀, IsAmpleOnBaseChange B S hS f L
        ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj (U.X j))
        (yoneda.map ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).map (U.f j)) ≫ g)
declarations.comment:
the unconditional half of (2) implies (1): the clause of Tag 0D36 on a finite
affine fpqc covering of each affine scheme over Y. Descending it to the scheme itself is
carried by `isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D3C.** Let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, let `{gᵢ : Yᵢ ⟶ Y}` be an fpqc
covering, let `fᵢ : Xᵢ ⟶ Yᵢ` be the base change of `f : X ⟶ Y` and `Lᵢ` the pullback of `L`.
Then `L` is ample on `X/Y` if and only if `Lᵢ` is ample on `Xᵢ/Yᵢ` for every `i`.

The forward direction is base change. For the converse, `f` is quasi-compact and separated
(Stacks 0D34, 041L, 0421), the clause of Stacks 0D36 may be tested at the affine schemes over `Y`,
and at such a scheme it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affineFpqcRefinement_isAmpleOnBaseChange` followed by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isPullback_of_affineFpqcFamily` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isRelativelyAmple_of_fpqcFamily`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_iff_forall_isRelativelyAmple_baseChange
    (hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L)
    (hfpqc : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i => (gᵢ i).hom) :
    IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f L ↔
      ∀ i, IsRelativelyAmple B S hS (fᵢ i) ((modulePullback B S hS (pᵢ i)).obj L)
declarations.comment:
full equivalence, with the hypotheses of the source: L invertible and the
family an fpqc covering

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isOpenSubspace_factors_iff_isRelativelyAmple_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, `f : X ⟶ Y` a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and `L` an
invertible `𝒪_X`-module. There is an open subspace `V ⊆ Y` such that a morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces factors through `V` if and only if the pullback of `L` to `X' = Y' ×_Y X` is ample
on `X'/Y'` (Stacks 0D31).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpenSubspace_factors_iff_isRelativelyAmple_of_isProper
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    {L : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2}
    (hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (structurePresheaf B S hS X.1)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).property L) :
    ∃ V : Subfunctor Y.1, IsOpenSubspace B S hS V ∧
      ∀ ⦃X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (p : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y'),
        IsPullback p f' f g →
          ((∃ l : Y'.1 ⟶ V.toFunctor, l ≫ V.ι = g.hom) ↔
            IsRelativelyAmple B S hS f' ((modulePullback B S hS p).obj L))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLimit_cohomology_of_isDerivedLimit_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D3E, clause (1).** Let `S` be a scheme, let `X` be an algebraic space
over `S` and let `(K_n)` be an inverse system in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` whose transition maps
`H^q(K_{n+1}) ⟶ H^q(K_n)` on cohomology sheaves are surjective.  If `L` is a derived inverse
limit of the system then `H^q(L) = lim H^q(K_n)`: the cone on the degree-`q` cohomology sheaves
whose legs are induced by the projections of a derived-limit triangle for `L` is a limit cone.

This is Tag 0A09 —
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLimitAcyclic.LargeSite.isLimit_cohomology_of_isDerivedLimit`, its
content with Tag 0BKZ supplied on a site whose objects live above its morphisms — on the small
étale site of `X`, with the source's two checks on the
affine objects of that site discharged: the affine étale charts cover it, and a quasi-coherent
module both is acyclic on an affine chart and receives surjections on its sections there, which
makes each tower of sections Mittag-Leffler and kills its first derived inverse limit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimit_cohomology_of_isDerivedLimit_of_epi
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF))
    (hqc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).obj (K.obj ⟨n⟩)).IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hsurj : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).map (K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF))
    (hL : IsDerivedLimit K L) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩,
      (∃ δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
        Triangle.mk p (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
            Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
              K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
          distTriang (DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF))) ∧
      ∃ τ : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).obj L) ⟶
          K ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q,
        (∀ n : ℕ, τ.app ⟨n⟩ =
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).map
            (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n)) ∧
        Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk _ τ))
declarations.comment: clause (1): H^q(R lim K_n) = lim H^q(K_n), as the canonical limiting cone; the source's citation 0A09 is applied with its hypotheses on the affine étale charts of the space discharged (they cover the small étale site; a quasi-coherent module is acyclic on one; a surjection of quasi-coherent modules is surjective on its sections there). The module universe is the universe of the structure rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDerivedLimit_single_limit_homology_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D3E, clause (2).** Under the same hypotheses,
`R lim H^q(K_n) = lim H^q(K_n)`: the ordinary inverse limit of the degree-`q` cohomology
sheaves, placed in degree zero, is a derived inverse limit of the system of those sheaves.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDerivedLimit_single_limit_homology` with its three named
hypotheses supplied: `hcover` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasEnoughObjects_isAffineChart`, `h03DWab` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_rightDerived_sectionsFunctor_of_isAffineChart` and `h03DWepi` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_sectionsFunctor_map_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimit_single_limit_homology_unconditional
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF))
    (hqc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).obj (K.obj ⟨n⟩)).IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hsurj : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).map (K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)))
    (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ h : HasProduct (fun n : ℕ =>
        ((K ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) 0).obj ⟨n⟩),
      @IsDerivedLimit (DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF)) _ _ _ _ _ _
        ((K ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) 0) h
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) 0).obj
          (limit (K ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q)))
declarations.comment: clause (2): R lim H^q(K_n) = lim H^q(K_n); the source's citations are applied with their hypotheses on the affine étale charts of the space discharged (they cover the small étale site; a quasi-coherent module is acyclic on one; a surjection of quasi-coherent modules is surjective on its sections there). The module universe is the universe of the structure rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_cohomology_limit_homology_of_isAffineChart_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D3E, clause (3).** Under the same hypotheses, for every affine étale
chart `U` of `X` and every `p > 0` we have `H^p(U, lim H^q(K_n)) = 0`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_cohomology_limit_homology_of_isAffineChart` with its
three named hypotheses supplied, exactly as in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDerivedLimit_single_limit_homology_unconditional`.  The source states
the vanishing for an affine open of `X`; every affine open is an affine object of the small
étale site, and the statement is given for all of them, as the source's own proof is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_limit_homology_of_isAffineChart_unconditional
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF))

      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) q).map (K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)))
    (q : ℤ) (U : SmallEtale B S hS F) (hU : IsAffineChart B S hS F U)

      (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF) U).rightDerived p).obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_homEquiv_single_limitComparison_baseRingTensorModule_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ T` be proper, flat and of finite presentation, with `T` affine and
`R = Γ(T, 𝒪_T)`, and let `(M_n)` be an inverse system of `R`-modules with surjective transition
maps. Then the canonical map `𝒪_X ⊗_R lim M_n ⟶ lim 𝒪_X ⊗_R M_n` induces an isomorphism from
the source, an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, to `DQ_X` applied to the target: the morphism
`𝒪_X ⊗_R lim M_n ⟶ DQ_X(lim 𝒪_X ⊗_R M_n)` corresponding to it under the adjunction
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⇄ D(𝒪_X)` of Stacks 0CR4 (both modules placed in degree zero) is an isomorphism.

The source's `Spec(R)` is the affine object `T` of the site with `R = Γ(T, 𝒪_T)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homEquiv_single_limitComparison_baseRingTensorModule_of_isProper
    (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace T) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (hT : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (Msys : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} (baseRing B S hS T))
    (hsurj : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Surjective (Msys.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) :
    letI : ∀ (C : Type (u + 1)) [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C], HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} C :=
      fun C _ _ => HasDerivedCategory.standard C
    letI := quasicoherentDerivedInclusion_isLeftAdjoint_of_qcqs B S hS B.contains_terminal X.1 X.2
      (qcqs_of_isFinitePresentation_schemeSpace B.contains_terminal f hT hfp).1
      (qcqs_of_isFinitePresentation_schemeSpace B.contains_terminal f hT hfp).2
    IsIso ((Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint (qcohDerivedProp B S hS X).ι).homEquiv
      ⟨(DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).obj
          ((baseRingTensorModule B S hS X (baseRingHomOfMap f)).obj (limit Msys)),
        qcohDerivedProp_singleFunctor_obj B S hS _
          (isQuasicoherentOnSite_baseRingTensorModule B S hS X _ _)⟩
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).obj
        (limit (Msys ⋙ baseRingTensorModule B S hS X (baseRingHomOfMap f))))
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).map
        (limit.post Msys (baseRingTensorModule B S hS X (baseRingHomOfMap f)))))
declarations.comment: `Spec(R)` is an affine object `T` of the site, with `R = Γ(T, 𝒪_T)`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.isIso_homEquiv_baseRingTensorLimitComparison_iff
declarations.doc:
**The two readings of the headline of Stacks 0D3F agree.**  Let `DQ_X` be a right adjoint of
the inclusion `D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` — on the small étale site of a quasi-compact
quasi-separated algebraic space one exists by Stacks 0CR4,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedInclusion_isLeftAdjoint`, and on a general site it
is the hypothesis `adj` — and suppose the source `𝒪_X ⊗_R (lim M_n)` of the canonical map of
Stacks 0D3F lies in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.  Then:

the canonical map `𝒪_X ⊗_R (lim M_n) ⟶ lim (𝒪_X ⊗_R M_n)` induces an isomorphism from its source
onto `DQ_X` applied to its target **if and only if** composition with it is bijective on
morphisms out of every object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.

This is the source's own rereading of its headline.  **Neither side is proved**: the statement is
an equivalence of the two framings, and its proof is
`CategoryTheory.Adjunction.bijective_comp_map_iff_isIso_homEquiv`, that is the adjunction alone.
No properness, flatness or finite-presentation hypothesis appears, and the transition maps of
`(M_n)` are not assumed surjective, because the equivalence needs none of them.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homEquiv_baseRingTensorLimitComparison_iff
    {DQ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u r w} (ringSheafOfSite O)) ⥤
      (quasicoherentDerivedOnSite.{u, v, r, w} O).FullSubcategory}
    (adj : (quasicoherentDerivedOnSite.{u, v, r, w} O).ι ⊣ DQ)
    (hsrc : quasicoherentDerivedOnSite.{u, v, r, w} O
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((baseRingTensorFunctor φ).obj c.pt))) :
    IsIso (adj.homEquiv ⟨_, hsrc⟩ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj d.pt)
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          (baseRingTensorLimitComparison φ Msys c d hd))) ↔
      ∀ E : (quasicoherentDerivedOnSite.{u, v, r, w} O).FullSubcategory,
        Function.Bijective
          (fun a : E.obj ⟶
              (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((baseRingTensorFunctor φ).obj c.pt) =>
            a ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
              (baseRingTensorLimitComparison φ Msys c d hd))
declarations.comment: the source's rereading of the headline, proved as an equivalence: the canonical map induces an isomorphism from its source onto DQ_X of its target iff composition with it is bijective on morphisms out of every object of D_QCoh(𝒪_X). Neither side is proved; the bijectivity asserted by the headline under properness, flatness and finite presentation is NOT proved here, and is not assumed. The existence of DQ_X is a named hypothesis, which is Stacks 0CR4 on the small étale site of a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_versalFormalObject_of_schlessingerConditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D3G.** A set-valued predeformation functor on `𝒞_Λ` satisfying
Schlessinger's conditions (H1) and (H2) — that is, (S1) and (S2) in the elementary form of
Stacks 06HY — and his condition (H3), the finite-dimensionality of the tangent space, has a
versal formal object.

This is Stacks 06IW read through the identifications of Stacks 06GT and 06HY: the category of
elements of `F` is a predeformation category satisfying (S1) and (S2), and its functor of
isomorphism classes is a copy of `F` by `Deformation.elementsIsomorphismClassesEquiv`, so the
tangent space whose dimension is bounded is `TF`.

Condition (H3) is stated about `TF = F(k[ε])` itself, for the canonical `k`-vector-space
structure of Stacks 06IH transported to it by
`Deformation.setValuedTangentSpaceLinearEquiv`; the form Stacks 06IW consumes is obtained
inside the proof by `Deformation.finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_isomorphismClasses_of_setValued`.
The predeformation and (S2) properties that structure needs are the images of `hpre` and `hH2`
under Stacks 06GT and 06HY, the latter followed by
`Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses`, so the statement installs them
itself rather than assuming them.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_versalFormalObject_of_schlessingerConditions
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t)
    (hpre : IsPredeformationFunctor.{u, v, w, t} F)
    (hH1 : ∀ ⦃A₁ A₂ A A₁₂ : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄
      (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A), Function.Surjective f₂.hom →
        ∀ (g₁ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₁) (g₂ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₂) (hPB : IsPullback g₂ g₁ f₂ f₁),
          Function.Surjective (fibreProductComparison F g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ hPB.w))
    (hH2 : ∀ ⦃A A₀ Aε B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄
      (d : A ⟶ A₀) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀), IsDualNumberProjection e →
        ∀ (g : B ⟶ A) (gε : B ⟶ Aε) (hPB : IsPullback gε g e d),
          Function.Bijective (fibreProductComparison F g gε d e hPB.w))
    (hH3 :
      letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w}
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Elements.π F)).p) :=
        ⟨(isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre⟩
      letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Elements.π
          (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Elements.π F))
            ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered))) :=
        ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Elements.π F))
          ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered
          ((schlessingerConditionS2_elements_iff F).2 hH2)
          (Or.inl ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre))⟩
      letI := setValuedTangentSpaceAddCommGroup.{u, v, w, t} F
        ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre)
      letI := setValuedTangentSpaceModule.{u, v, w, t} F
        ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre)
      FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k F)) :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject (Elements.π F),
      IsVersal ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered ξ
declarations.comment: (H1) + (H2) + (H3) implies a versal formal object exists

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEquivalence_of_isPushoutFunctor_of_isIso_coherator_map_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0D3P].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces with `X`
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be a morphism of `𝒪_X`-modules such that
`DQ_X(ℱ) ⟶ DQ_X(𝒢)` is an isomorphism, where `DQ_X` is the right adjoint of
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CR4], and let `F` be pushout along `φ`, from
extensions `0 ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ 0` of `f⁻¹𝒪_Y`-algebras on `X_étale` to extensions by `𝒢`
(characterised by the universal property of the pushout). Then `F` is an equivalence of
categories.

The quasi-coherence of `NL_{X/Y}` which the source's proof uses is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcohDerivedProp_modelNaiveCotangentComplex`, from
[Stacks Project, Tag 0D0Y].
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_of_isPushoutFunctor_of_isIso_coherator_map_of_qcqs
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (hXc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1) (hXs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj (structureSheaf B S hS X.1 X.2))}
    (φ : M ⟶ N)
    {F : AlgebraExtension (J := SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (inverseImageBaseMap B S hS f) M ⥤
      AlgebraExtension (J := SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (inverseImageBaseMap B S hS f) N}
    (hF : IsPushoutFunctor.{u, u + 1, u} (a := inverseImageBaseMap B S hS f) φ F)
    (hDQ : letI := quasicoherentDerivedInclusion_isLeftAdjoint_of_qcqs B S hS hZ X.1 X.2 hXc hXs
      IsIso ((qcohDerivedProp B S hS X).ι.rightAdjoint.map
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).map φ))) :
    F.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEquivalence_of_isKernelPushoutFunctor_of_isIso_coherator_map_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0D3Q].** Let `f : X ⟶ D` be a morphism of algebraic spaces with `X`
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and `i : D ⟶ D'` a closed immersion (for instance a first order
thickening). Let `P` be a square-zero extension problem (91.13.0.1) of the small étale ringed
topoi over `f` whose thickened base is `i⁻¹𝒪_{D'}`, its reduction being `i♯`, with prescribed
ideal module `ℱ`. Let `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be a morphism of `𝒪_X`-modules with `DQ_X(ℱ) ⟶ DQ_X(𝒢)` an
isomorphism, `DQ_X` the right adjoint of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CR4],
and let `FT` be pushout along `φ` from the solutions of `P` to those of the problem with ideal
module `𝒢` (characterised by the universal property of the pushout). Then `FT` is an equivalence
of categories.

The source asks `D ⊂ D'` to be a first order thickening; the argument only uses that `i` is a
closed immersion, the square-zero condition being part of the problem `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_of_isKernelPushoutFunctor_of_isIso_coherator_map_of_qcqs
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (hXc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1) (hXs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (f : X ⟶ D) (i : D ⟶ D') (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom)
    (P : RingedToposExtensionProblem (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X)
      (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS D))
    (hPf : P.f = smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f)
    (eBase : P.baseExtension ≅
      (smallEtaleInverseImageRing B S hS i).obj (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS D').O)
    (heBase : eBase.hom ≫ (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS i).fSharpInverseImage =
      P.baseReduction)
    {N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj (structureSheaf B S hS X.1 X.2))}
    (φ : P.G ⟶ N)
    {FT : P.CompatibleFirstOrderThickening ⥤
      (RingedToposExtensionProblem.changeKernel P φ).CompatibleFirstOrderThickening}
    (hFT : RingedToposExtensionProblem.IsKernelPushoutFunctor.{u, u + 1, u, u, u + 1, u}
      (S := P) φ FT)
    (hDQ : letI := quasicoherentDerivedInclusion_isLeftAdjoint_of_qcqs B S hS hZ X.1 X.2 hXc hXs
      IsIso ((qcohDerivedProp B S hS X).ι.rightAdjoint.map
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).map φ))) :
    FT.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRepresentableDiagonal_of_isAlgebraicMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D3R.** An algebraic 1-morphism of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site of
