declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardCompositionOfToposHom.isIso_derivedPushforwardComparison_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6E for a morphism of ringed topoi.**  For composable morphisms of ringed topoi
`f : (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪_𝒞) ⟶ (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_𝒟)` and `g : (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_𝒟) ⟶ (Sh(ℰ), 𝒪_ℰ)`, the canonical
comparison from a derived direct image along `g ∘ f` to the composite of the derived direct
images along `f` and `g` is an isomorphism, so `Rg_* ∘ Rf_* = R(g ∘ f)_*` as functors
`D(𝒪_𝒞) ⟶ D(𝒪_ℰ)`.

There is **no hypothesis on either morphism**: the geometric datum is the two-field morphism of
ringed topoi of Stacks 01D3, part (2), with no continuous functor between the underlying sites,
and the condition that
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPushforwardComparison_isIso` carries — Stacks 093Y for
`f`, which at module coefficients Stacks 075L records as false in general — is discharged by
`isIso_app_pushforwardMapHomotopy_of_isKInjective`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPushforwardComparison_unconditional
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso Y.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rh.IsRightDerivedFunctor αh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    IsIso (derivedPushforwardComparison f g Rf Rg Rh αf αg αh)
declarations.comment:
for a morphism of ringed topoi in the two-field sense of Tag 01D3, part (2) --
a morphism of the underlying topoi together with the structure map, with no continuous functor
between the underlying sites -- and with no hypothesis on either morphism; the three universes
of each of the three ringed topoi are free and unrelated

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardCompositionOnTopoi.isIso_derivedPushforwardComparison_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6E.**  For composable morphisms of ringed topoi `f : (Sh(𝒞), 𝒪_𝒞) ⟶ (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_𝒟)`
and `g : (Sh(𝒟), 𝒪_𝒟) ⟶ (Sh(ℰ), 𝒪_ℰ)`, the canonical comparison from a derived pushforward along
`g ∘ f` to the composite of derived pushforwards along `f` and `g` is an isomorphism, so
`Rg_* ∘ Rf_* = R(g ∘ f)_*` as functors `D(𝒪_𝒞) ⟶ D(𝒪_ℰ)`.

No hypothesis beyond the two morphisms and the three presentations of the derived pushforwards:
the condition `PushforwardComputesDerived`, which `isIso_derivedPushforwardComparison_iff` shows
to be equivalent to this statement, is discharged by `pushforwardComputesDerived`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPushforwardComparison_unconditional
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rh.IsRightDerivedFunctor αh
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    IsIso (derivedPushforwardComparison f g Rf Rg Rh αf αg αh)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardCompositionOnTopoi.derivedPushforwardCompIsoUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6E as a natural isomorphism** `Rf_* ⋙ Rg_* ≅ R(g ∘ f)_*`, obtained by inverting
the canonical comparison.  This is the source's equality of composite functors, in the only form
in which it can hold: the two functors are total derived functors of different functors on the
homotopy category, so they agree up to the canonical isomorphism and not on the nose.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedPushforwardCompIsoUnconditional
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rh.IsRightDerivedFunctor αh
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Rf ⋙ Rg ≅ Rh
declarations.comment: as a natural isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.cohomologyOverObjectIsoRestriction
declarations.doc:
Cohomology over `U` agrees naturally with cohomology of the restricted
derived module on the slice site `C/U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologyOverObjectIsoRestriction
    (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u}) (U : X.C)
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over U))]
    [HasDerivedCategory AddCommGrpCat.{u}] (p : ℤ) :
    derivedSectionsOverObject X U ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} p ≅
    derivedRestriction X U ⋙ derivedSectionsOnSlice X U ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} p

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedPushforwardOverFunctorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6G.** For a morphism of ringed sites `f : (C, O_C) ⟶ (D, O_D)` given by the
continuous functor `u : D ⥤ C`, an object `V` of `D` and `U = u(V)`, restricting the unbounded
derived direct image `Rf_*` to the localized site `D/V` is the derived direct image `Rg_*` along
the localized morphism `g : (C/U, O_U) ⟶ (D/V, O_V)` of Stacks 04J0 of the restriction to
`C/U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedPushforwardOverFunctorIso :
    derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedRestriction Y V ≅
      derivedRestriction X (f.u.obj V) ⋙ derivedLocalizedPushforward f V

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedGlobalSectionsPushforwardIsoGeneral
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6H, the global-sections clause, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed sites.** Let
`f : (C, O_C) ⟶ (D, O_D)` be a morphism of ringed sites given by the continuous functor
`u : D ⥤ C`. Then `RΓ(D, -) ∘ Rf_* = RΓ(C, -)` as functors `D(O_C) ⟶ D(Γ(O_D))`, the right hand
side being the derived global sections on `C` with scalars restricted along the induced ring map
`Γ(O_D) ⟶ Γ(O_C)`.

No flatness: this is `derivedGlobalSectionsPushforwardIso` with its hypothesis discharged by
`computesSecond_pushforwardTopos_globalSections`. The source's other clause, the one on sections
over an object of `D`, is
`Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIsoGeneral`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedGlobalSectionsPushforwardIsoGeneral :
    derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedGlobalSections Y ≅
      derivedGlobalSectionsRestricted f
declarations.comment:
the clause on global sections, as functors into the derived category of modules
over the global sections of the structure sheaf of the target, for an arbitrary morphism of
ringed sites; the clause on sections over an object of the target site is
derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIsoGeneral

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIsoGeneral
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6H, the clause on sections over an object, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed
sites.** Let `f : (C, O_C) ⟶ (D, O_D)` be a morphism of ringed sites given by the continuous
functor `u : D ⥤ C`, let `V` be an object of `D` and put `U = u(V)`. Then
`RΓ(V, -) ∘ Rf_* = RΓ(U, -)` as functors `D(O_C) ⟶ D(Ab)`.

No flatness: this is `derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIso` with its hypothesis discharged by
`computesSecond_pushforwardTopos_sectionsOverObject`. The source's other clause, the one about
global sections into `D(Γ(O_D))`, is
`Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedGlobalSectionsPushforwardIsoGeneral`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIsoGeneral :
    derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedSectionsOverObject Y V ≅
      derivedSectionsOverObject X (f.u.obj V)
declarations.comment:
the clause on sections over an object of the target site, for an arbitrary
morphism of ringed sites; the clause on global sections into the derived category of modules
over the global sections of the structure sheaf of the target is
derivedGlobalSectionsPushforwardIsoGeneral

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedGlobalSectionsOverPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6H for the slice morphism, on abelian sheaves.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of a
site `C`, the unbounded derived global sections on `C/Y` of the unbounded derived direct image
along `f` are the unbounded derived global sections on `C/X`:
`RΓ(Y, -) ∘ Rf_* ≅ RΓ(X, -)`.

Both sides are total right derived functors of one and the same functor on the unbounded homotopy
category of abelian sheaves on `C/X`, by `overPushforwardGlobalSectionsIso`; the comparison for
`Rf_*` is invertible on a K-injective complex, and the comparison for `RΓ(Y, -)` is invertible at
`f_*I`, which is again K-injective by `overPushforward_map_isKInjective`. Uniqueness of right
derived functors then identifies the two, which is
`Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedCompIso`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedGlobalSectionsOverPushforwardIso {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasPullbacksAlong f] :
    DerivedFunctor.totalRightDerived (overPushforward J f) ⋙
        DerivedFunctor.totalRightDerived
          ((sheafSections (J.over Y) Ab.{max u v}).obj (op (Over.mk (𝟙 Y)))) ≅
      DerivedFunctor.totalRightDerived
        ((sheafSections (J.over X) Ab.{max u v}).obj (op (Over.mk (𝟙 X))))
declarations.comment: the clause `RGamma(V, -) . Rf_* = RGamma(U, -)` on sections over an object, for ABELIAN sheaves and for the SLICE morphism of topoi `Sh(C/X) -> Sh(C/Y)` of a morphism `f : X -> Y` of the site, at the final object `V = id Y` of `C/Y`, where `u = Over.pullback f` and `u(V) = id X`. Unconditional: no analogue of the `h093Y` K-injectivity hypothesis, nor of the flatness, of `Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIso` and `...IsoOfFlat`, which carry this tag for sheaves of MODULES on ringed sites. Assumed instead is `Limits.HasPullbacksAlong f`, base change of the single morphism `f`, used only to present `f_*` as restriction along `Over.pullback f`. NOT covered: the clause on global sections into `D(Gamma(O_D))` for a general morphism of ringed sites, and sections over a non-final object of `C/Y`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.UnboundedHigherDirectImageOnSites.cohomologySheavesOfTheDerivedDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6I.** Let `f : (C, O_C) ⟶ (D, O_D)` be a morphism of ringed sites corresponding to
the continuous functor `u : D ⥤ C` and let `i : ℤ`. Then the `i`-th cohomology sheaf of `Rf_* K`
is the sheaf associated to the presheaf

`V ↦ H^i(u(V), K) = H^i(V, Rf_* K)`,

naturally in the object `K` of `D(O_C)`.

The presheaf is `derivedPushforwardCohomologyPresheaf`, which carries its restriction maps, and
the three components are the three assertions the source makes about it: that its sheafification
is the cohomology sheaf of `Rf_* K`, and that its value on `V` is `H^i(u(V), K)` and is
`H^i(V, Rf_* K)` — the two sides of the source's displayed equality, whose composite
`H^i(u(V), K) ≅ H^i(V, Rf_* K)` is `cohomologyOverObjectPushforwardIsoGeneral`.

Everything is stated as an isomorphism of functors on `D(O_C)`, so the naturality in `K` that
the source leaves implicit is part of the statement. There is no hypothesis beyond the source's:
the sheafification clause is Stacks 0BKV on the target site composed with `Rf_*`, and the
displayed equality is `H^i` of the clause of Stacks 0D6H on sections over an object, which
`Stacks.Cohomology.LerayUnbounded.derivedSectionsOverObjectPushforwardIsoGeneral` proves for an
arbitrary morphism of ringed sites.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologySheavesOfTheDerivedDirectImage (i : ℤ) :
    (derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) i ≅
        derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedSectionsPresheaf Y ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (PresheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj) i ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj)) ×
      (∀ V : Y.C,
          derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedSectionsPresheaf Y ⋙
              DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (PresheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj) i ⋙
              PresheafOfModules.evaluation (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj
                (Opposite.op V) ⋙
              forget₂
                (ModuleCat.{u}
                  ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj.obj (Opposite.op V)))
                AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
            derivedSectionsOverObject X (f.u.obj V) ⋙
              DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} i) ×
      (∀ V : Y.C,
          derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedSectionsPresheaf Y ⋙
              DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (PresheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj) i ⋙
              PresheafOfModules.evaluation (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj
                (Opposite.op V) ⋙
              forget₂
                (ModuleCat.{u}
                  ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj.obj (Opposite.op V)))
                AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
            derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom ⋙ derivedSectionsOverObject Y V ⋙
              DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} i)
declarations.comment:
the i-th cohomology sheaf of Rf_*K is the sheaf associated to the presheaf
V ↦ H^i(u(V), K) = H^i(V, Rf_*K), naturally in K, for an arbitrary morphism of ringed sites:
the associated-sheaf clause and both readings of the value of the presheaf on an object

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ForgetModule.pushforwardForgetComparison_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6J, part (3).** Let `f : (C, O_C) ⟶ (D, O_D)` be a morphism of ringed sites. For
`K` in the unbounded derived category `D(O_C)` the canonical map `Rf_*K ⟶ Rf_*(K_ab)` from the
image in `D(Z_D)` of the unbounded derived direct image of `K` to the unbounded derived direct
image of the underlying abelian complex of `K` is an isomorphism, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement: theorem pushforwardForgetComparison_isIso : IsIso (pushforwardForgetComparison f)
declarations.comment: part (3): the unbounded derived direct image along a morphism of ringed sites

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ForgetModule.sectionsForgetComparison_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6J, part (2).** For every object `U` of the site, the canonical map
`RΓ(U, K) ⟶ RΓ(U, K_ab)` from unbounded derived sections of a sheaf of modules to derived
sections of the underlying abelian sheaf is an isomorphism, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionsForgetComparison_isIso (U : X.C) :
    IsIso (sectionsForgetComparison X U)
declarations.comment: part (2): sections over an object of the site

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ForgetModule.globalSectionsForgetComparison_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6J, part (1).** The canonical map `RΓ(C, K) ⟶ RΓ(C, K_ab)` from unbounded
derived global sections of a sheaf of modules to derived global sections of the underlying
abelian sheaf is an isomorphism, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem globalSectionsForgetComparison_isIso :
    IsIso (globalSectionsForgetComparison X)
declarations.comment: part (1): global sections of the site

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedGlobalSections.isDerivedLimit_map_derivedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6K.** `RΓ(C, -)` commutes with `Rlim`: global derived sections of
a ringed site carry a derived inverse limit to a derived inverse limit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDerivedLimit_map_derivedGlobalSections
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩]
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (hL : IsDerivedLimit K L) :
    ∃ h : HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ (derivedGlobalSections.{u, v, w, z} X).obj (K.obj ⟨n⟩)),
      @IsDerivedLimit
        (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w z}
          (RingCat.sectionsSubring (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj)))
        _ _ _ _ _ _ (K ⋙ derivedGlobalSections.{u, v, w, z} X) h
        ((derivedGlobalSections.{u, v, w, z} X).obj L)
declarations.comment: global derived sections commute with derived limits

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedGlobalSections.exists_shortExact_limOne_cohomology_derivedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6K.** The canonical Milnor short exact sequence for the cohomology
of the whole ringed site: the first derived inverse limit of the degree-`m - 1` cohomologies
includes into the degree-`m` cohomology of `RΓ(C, Rlim Kₙ)`, with quotient the inverse limit
of the degree-`m` cohomologies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_shortExact_limOne_cohomology_derivedGlobalSections
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩]
    (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hL : ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk p (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (m : ℤ) :
    let RGamma := derivedGlobalSections.{u, v, w, z} X
    let A := ModuleCat.{max u v w z}
      (RingCat.sectionsSubring (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj)
    let Hprev := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A (m - 1)
    let Hcur := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A m
    let Fprev := K ⋙ RGamma ⋙ Hprev
    let Fcur := K ⋙ RGamma ⋙ Hcur
    let E := K ⋙ RGamma
    let dprev : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶
        (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
          Fprev.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    ∃ (h : HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩),
      letI := h
      ∃ (a : RGamma.obj L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩)
        (b : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ (RGamma.obj L)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      let T := Triangle.mk a (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            E.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) b
      T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, a ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        RGamma.map (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n)) ∧
      ∃ (ePrev : Hprev.obj (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ≅
          ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩)
        (i : cokernel dprev ⟶ Hcur.obj (RGamma.obj L))
      (q : Hcur.obj (RGamma.obj L) ⟶ limit Fcur)
      (zero : i ≫ q = 0),
      (ePrev.hom = piComparison Hprev (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ∧
        cokernel.π dprev ≫ i =
          ePrev.inv ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).homologySequenceδ
            T (m - 1) m (by omega) ∧
        (ShortComplex.mk i q zero).ShortExact ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π Fcur ⟨n⟩ =
          Hcur.map (RGamma.map (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n)))
declarations.comment: short exact sequence over the whole site

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedGlobalSections.exists_shortExact_limOne_cohomology_derivedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6K.** The canonical Milnor short exact sequence for the cohomology
over an object `U` of a ringed site: the first derived inverse limit of the degree-`m - 1`
cohomologies includes into the degree-`m` cohomology of `RΓ(U, Rlim Kₙ)`, with quotient the
inverse limit of the degree-`m` cohomologies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_shortExact_limOne_cohomology_derivedSections
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩]
    (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hL : ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk p (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{max u v w z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (m : ℤ) :
    let RGamma := derivedSections.{u, v, w, z} X U
    let A := ModuleCat.{max u v w z} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj.obj U)
    let Hprev := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A (m - 1)
    let Hcur := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A m
    let Fprev := K ⋙ RGamma ⋙ Hprev
    let Fcur := K ⋙ RGamma ⋙ Hcur
    let E := K ⋙ RGamma
    let dprev : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶
        (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
          Fprev.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    ∃ (h : HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩),
      letI := h
      ∃ (a : RGamma.obj L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩)
        (b : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ (RGamma.obj L)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      let T := Triangle.mk a (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            E.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) b
      T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, a ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        RGamma.map (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n)) ∧
      ∃ (ePrev : Hprev.obj (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ≅
          ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩)
        (i : cokernel dprev ⟶ Hcur.obj (RGamma.obj L))
      (q : Hcur.obj (RGamma.obj L) ⟶ limit Fcur)
      (zero : i ≫ q = 0),
      (ePrev.hom = piComparison Hprev (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ∧
        cokernel.π dprev ≫ i =
          ePrev.inv ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).homologySequenceδ
            T (m - 1) m (by omega) ∧
        (ShortComplex.mk i q zero).ShortExact ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π Fcur ⟨n⟩ =
          Hcur.map (RGamma.map (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n)))
declarations.comment: short exact sequence over an object

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedSectionsMilnor.isDerivedLimit_map_derivedSectionsOverObject
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project Tag 0D6K.** Derived sections over an object of a ringed site carry a
derived inverse limit to a derived inverse limit.

Sections over an object are additive and preserve countable products, so Tag 08U1 applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimit_map_derivedSectionsOverObject (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u}) (U : X.C)
    [HasSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{g} (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedSectionsMilnor.exists_shortExact_limOne_cohomology_derivedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project Tag 0D6K.** The canonical Milnor short exact sequence for cohomology over
an object of a ringed site: the first derived inverse limit of the degree-`m - 1` cohomologies
includes into the degree-`m` cohomology of derived sections of the derived limit, with quotient
the inverse limit of the degree-`m` cohomologies.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_limOne_cohomology_derivedSections (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u}) (U : X.C)
    [HasSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{g} (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hL : ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk p (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang
          (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (m : ℤ) :
    let RG := derivedSectionsOverObject X U
    let Hprev := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (m - 1)
    let Hcur := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} m
    let E := K ⋙ RG
    let Fprev := E ⋙ Hprev
    let Fcur := E ⋙ Hcur
    let dprev : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) :=
      Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            Fprev.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    ∃ h : HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩,
      letI := h
      ∃ (a : RG.obj L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩)
        (b : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ (RG.obj L)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        let T := Triangle.mk a (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
            Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
              E.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) b
        T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, a ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) n =
          RG.map (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n)) ∧
        ∃ (ePrev : Hprev.obj (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ≅ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ Fprev.obj ⟨n⟩)
          (i : cokernel dprev ⟶ Hcur.obj (RG.obj L))
          (q : Hcur.obj (RG.obj L) ⟶ limit Fcur)
          (zero : i ≫ q = 0),
          ePrev.hom = piComparison Hprev (fun n : ℕ ↦ E.obj ⟨n⟩) ∧
            cokernel.π dprev ≫ i =
              ePrev.inv ≫ DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ T (m - 1) m ∧
            (ShortComplex.mk i q zero).ShortExact ∧
            ∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π Fcur ⟨n⟩ =
              Hcur.map (RG.map (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n))
declarations.comment: short exact sequence over an object

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLimitSections.cohomology_derivedLimit_projection_mono_on_sections_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6L.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site, let `(Kₙ)` be an inverse system
in `D(O)` with derived limit `L`, let `V` be an object of `C` and let `m` be an integer.  Suppose
there are an index `N` and a cofinal system of coverings of `V` such that over every member
`Vᵢ` of every covering in the system

* `R¹ lim Hᵐ⁻¹(Vᵢ, Kₙ) = 0`, and
* `Hᵐ(Vᵢ, Kₙ) ⟶ Hᵐ(Vᵢ, K_N)` is injective for `n ≥ N`.

Then `Hᵐ(L)(V) ⟶ Hᵐ(K_N)(V)` is injective.

Nothing is assumed: sheafification, local bijectivity, Grothendieck abelianness, the right
derived functor presenting cohomology and the countable product presenting the derived limit are
all theorems at this module universe, and are supplied above.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomology_derivedLimit_projection_mono_on_sections_unconditional
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hL : ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk p (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
            K.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (V : X.C) (m : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (Cov : CofinalCoveringSystem X.J V)
    (hlimOne : ∀ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V, Cov.cov 𝒰 →
      ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
        let F := K ⋙ derivedSectionsPresheafMax.{u, v, r, w} X ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (PresheafOfModules.{max u v r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj)
              (m - 1) ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.evaluation
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj (.op (𝒰.X i))
        IsZero (cokernel (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ F.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
            Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ F.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
              F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)))
    (hinj : ∀ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V, Cov.cov 𝒰 →
      ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
        let F := K ⋙ derivedSectionsPresheafMax.{u, v, r, w} X ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (PresheafOfModules.{max u v r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj) m ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.evaluation
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj (.op (𝒰.X i))
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n), Mono (F.map (homOfLE hn).op)) :
    Mono ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O) (.op V)).map
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) m).map
        (p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) N)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncationGETower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6M.** Under local, eventually vanishing cohomology bounds, the
canonical map from a derived object to any derived limit of its truncations from below is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncationGETower
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J RingCat.{wRing})
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{wModule}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{wModule}]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O)]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O))
    (B : Set C)
    (basisCover : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U,
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (degreeBound : ∀ V : C, B V → ℤ → ℤ)
    (Cov : ∀ V : C, B V → Set (PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V))
    (Cov_isCover : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V)
    (Cov_cofinal : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V →
        ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V, Cov V hV 𝒱 ∧ Nonempty (𝒱.Hom 𝒰))
    (vanishing : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (p : ℕ) (m : ℤ),
        degreeBound V hV m < (p : ℤ) →
          IsZero (moduleCohomology O (𝒰.X i) p
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O)
              (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O))
    (c : E ⟶ L)
    (q : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
    (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hL : Triangle.mk q (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n -
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O)))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ q ≫
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E) :
    IsIso c

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncGETower_of_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6M.** Let `O` be a sheaf of rings on a site `C`, let `E` be an
object of the derived category of sheaves of `O`-modules, and let `B` be a set of objects of
`C` large enough that every object is covered by members of `B`.  Suppose each `V ∈ B` carries
a degree bound `p(V, -) : ℤ → ℤ` and a cofinal system of coverings of `V` on whose members
`Hᵖ(Vᵢ, H^{m - p}(E)) = 0` whenever `p > p(V, m)`.  Then the canonical map from `E` to the
derived limit of the truncation tower `n ↦ τ_{≥ -n} E` is an isomorphism.

Nothing is assumed: sheafification, enough injectives and the countable products presenting the
derived limit are all theorems at this module universe, and are supplied as instances above.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncGETower_of_vanishing
    (O : Sheaf J RingCat.{r})
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O))
    (B : Set C)
    (basisCover : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U,
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (degreeBound : ∀ V : C, B V → ℤ → ℤ)
    (Cov : ∀ V : C, B V → Set (PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V))
    (Cov_isCover : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V)
    (Cov_cofinal : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V →
        ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V, Cov V hV 𝒱 ∧ Nonempty (𝒱.Hom 𝒰))
    (vanishing : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (p : ℕ) (m : ℤ),
        degreeBound V hV m < (p : ℤ) →
          IsZero (@moduleCohomology C instC J O hasSheafifyMax.{u, v, r, w}
            wEqualsLocallyBijectiveMax.{u, v, r, w}
            (SiteModules.moduleSheavesEnoughInjectives.{u, v, r, w} O)
            (𝒰.X i) p
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O)
              (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O))
    (c : E ⟶ L)
    (q : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
    (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶
        L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hL : Triangle.mk q (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncationGETower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6M.** Under local, eventually vanishing cohomology bounds, the
canonical map from a derived object to any derived limit of its truncations from below is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncationGETower
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J RingCat.{wRing})
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{wModule}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{wModule}]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O)]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O))
    (B : Set C)
    (basisCover : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U,
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (degreeBound : ∀ V : C, B V → ℤ → ℤ)
    (Cov : ∀ V : C, B V → Set (PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V))
    (Cov_isCover : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V)
    (Cov_cofinal : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V →
        ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V, Cov V hV 𝒱 ∧ Nonempty (𝒱.Hom 𝒰))
    (vanishing : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (p : ℕ) (m : ℤ),
        degreeBound V hV m < (p : ℤ) →
          IsZero (moduleCohomology O (𝒰.X i) p
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O)
              (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O))
    (c : E ⟶ L)
    (q : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
    (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hL : Triangle.mk q (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n -
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O)))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ q ≫
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E) :
    IsIso c
declarations.comment: the constant-bound case, by taking the degree bound at V to be max d_V m

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncGETower_of_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6M.** Let `O` be a sheaf of rings on a site `C`, let `E` be an
object of the derived category of sheaves of `O`-modules, and let `B` be a set of objects of
`C` large enough that every object is covered by members of `B`.  Suppose each `V ∈ B` carries
a degree bound `p(V, -) : ℤ → ℤ` and a cofinal system of coverings of `V` on whose members
`Hᵖ(Vᵢ, H^{m - p}(E)) = 0` whenever `p > p(V, m)`.  Then the canonical map from `E` to the
derived limit of the truncation tower `n ↦ τ_{≥ -n} E` is an isomorphism.

Nothing is assumed: sheafification, enough injectives and the countable products presenting the
derived limit are all theorems at this module universe, and are supplied as instances above.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncGETower_of_vanishing
    (O : Sheaf J RingCat.{r})
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O))
    (B : Set C)
    (basisCover : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U,
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (degreeBound : ∀ V : C, B V → ℤ → ℤ)
    (Cov : ∀ V : C, B V → Set (PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V))
    (Cov_isCover : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V)
    (Cov_cofinal : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J V →
        ∃ 𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V, Cov V hV 𝒱 ∧ Nonempty (𝒱.Hom 𝒰))
    (vanishing : ∀ (V : C) (hV : B V) (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} V),
      Cov V hV 𝒰 → ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (p : ℕ) (m : ℤ),
        degreeBound V hV m < (p : ℤ) →
          IsZero (@moduleCohomology C instC J O hasSheafifyMax.{u, v, r, w}
            wEqualsLocallyBijectiveMax.{u, v, r, w}
            (SiteModules.moduleSheavesEnoughInjectives.{u, v, r, w} O)
            (𝒰.X i) p
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O)
              (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O))
    (c : E ⟶ L)
    (q : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
    (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶
        L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hL : Triangle.mk q (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n -
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
            (n + 1) ≫
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O)))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ q ≫
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E) :
    IsIso c
declarations.comment: the constant-bound case, by taking the degree bound at V to be max d_V m

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.UniformBound.isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncGETower_of_vanishing_uniform
declarations.doc:
Let `O` be a sheaf of rings on a site `C` and let `E` be an object of the derived category of
sheaves of `O`-modules.  Suppose there are an integer `d ≥ 0` and a set `B` of objects of `C`
such that every object of `C` has a covering whose members are elements of `B`, and such that
`H^p(V, H^q(E)) = 0` for all `p > d`, all `q < 0` and all `V ∈ B`.  Then the canonical map
`E ⟶ R lim τ_{≥ -n} E` is an isomorphism.

Here `R lim τ_{≥ -n} E` is an object `L` with a distinguished triangle
`L ⟶ ∏ τ_{≥ -n} E ⟶ ∏ τ_{≥ -n} E ⟶ L[1]`, and `c : E ⟶ L` is the map whose composites with
the product projections are the truncation maps `E ⟶ τ_{≥ -n} E`.

theorem isIso_to_isDerivedLimit_truncGETower_of_vanishing_uniform
    (O : Sheaf J RingCat.{r})
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O))
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (B : Set C)
    (basisCover : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U,
      𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (vanishing : ∀ (V : C), B V → ∀ (p : ℕ), d < (p : ℤ) → ∀ (q : ℤ), q < 0 →
      IsZero (@moduleCohomology C instC J O hasSheafifyMax.{u, v, r, w}
        wEqualsLocallyBijectiveMax.{u, v, r, w}
        (SiteModules.moduleSheavesEnoughInjectives.{u, v, r, w} O) V p
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) q).obj E)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O))
    (c : E ⟶ L)
    (q : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hL : ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶
          L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk q (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
            (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩)
              (n + 1) ≫
            (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).map
              (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O)))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ q ≫
      Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{max u v r w} O) E).obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E) :
    IsIso c

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.OlssonLaszloSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6R.** The standing Olsson--Laszlo situation: a weak Serre subcategory of
modules on a site, together with a locally covering class of objects admitting cofinal
systems of coverings on whose members higher cohomology vanishes uniformly in the module.
declarations.statement: structure OlssonLaszloSituation

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.OlssonLaszlo.truncGETower_presentation
declarations.doc:
In the Olsson--Laszlo situation, the tower of truncations from below of an object of
`D_A(O)` has a derived limit, presented by its defining distinguished triangle, and the
canonical map from the object to that derived limit is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem truncGETower_presentation
    (S : OlssonLaszloSituation.{v, u, wRing, wModule})
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB S.A K) :
    ∃ (_hprod : HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).obj ⟨n⟩)
      (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O))
      (c : K ⟶ L)
      (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).obj ⟨n⟩)
      (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).obj ⟨n⟩) ⟶
          L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk p (Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).obj ⟨n⟩) n -
        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower
            (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).map
          (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, c ≫ p ≫ Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (Stacks.DerivedLimit.truncGETower (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) K).obj ⟨n⟩) n =
        (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app K) ∧ IsIso c
declarations.comment: the conclusion with the derived limit, its defining distinguished triangle and the canonical map of Remark 0H72 constructed: for `K` in `D_A(O)` (hK) the truncation tower has a product and a presented derived limit, and the canonical map to it is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isIso_cohomologyToEventuallyConstantValue
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6T.** If an inverse system in `D^+_A` has eventually
constant cohomology sheaves with values `ℋʲ`, then the canonical map from the cohomology
of any presented derived inverse limit to `ℋʲ` is an isomorphism, for every `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_cohomologyToEventuallyConstantValue
    (S : OlssonLaszloSituation.{v, u, wRing, wModule})
    (K : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O))
    (hK : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus S.A (K.obj ⟨n⟩))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O))
    (p : L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩)

        Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) n -
          Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ K.obj ⟨n⟩) (n + 1) ≫

    (ℋ : ℤ → SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O)
    (e : ∀ j : ℤ, EventuallyConstantValue
      (K ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{wModule} S.O) j) (ℋ j)) :
    ∀ j : ℤ, IsIso (cohomologyToEventuallyConstantValue S K L p j (ℋ j) (e j))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.OlssonLaszlo.derivedCategoryB_derivedPushforward_obj_of_ringedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6U, part (a).** Let `f : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(C'), O')` be a morphism
of ringed topoi and let `A ⊂ Mod(O)`, `A' ⊂ Mod(O')` be weak Serre subcategories such that
`C, O, A` and `C', O', A'` satisfy the assumption of the Olsson--Laszlo situation (Stacks 0D6R),
`Rᵖf_*F` lies in `A'` for `p ≥ 0` and `F` in `A`, and `Rᵖf_*F = 0` for `p > N` and `F` in `A`.
Then `Rf_*K` lies in `D_{A'}(O')` for every `K` in `D_A(O)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedPushforward_obj_of_ringedToposHom

declarations.comment: part (a)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.OlssonLaszlo.isIso_homology_derivedPushforward_truncGEπ_of_ringedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6U, part (b).** In the situation of part (a)
(`derivedCategoryB_derivedPushforward_obj_of_ringedToposHom`), for every `K` in `D_A(O)` the

declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homology_derivedPushforward_truncGEπ_of_ringedToposHom
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A K)
    (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (hj : N - (n : ℤ) ≤ j) :

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.OlssonLaszloPrimeSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6V.** The relative Olsson--Laszlo situation for a morphism of ringed sites:
the target has a locally covering collection of objects carrying cofinal systems of
coverings on whose members the cohomology, on the source site, of the modules of the chosen
weak Serre subcategory vanishes above an object-dependent integer bound.
declarations.statement: public structure OlssonLaszloPrimeSituation

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.OlssonLaszlo.isIso_homology_derivedPushforward_truncGEπ_of_relativeSituation_general
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6W.** Let `f : (C, O) ⟶ (C', O')` be a morphism of ringed sites, let
`A ⊂ Mod(O)` be a weak Serre subcategory and let `N` be an integer such that

* `C, O, A` satisfy the standing hypothesis of Stacks 0D6R: a class `B` of objects covering every
  object of `C`, each `V ∈ B` carrying an integer bound `d_V` and a cofinal system of coverings of
  `V` on whose members the cohomology of every module of `A` vanishes above `d_V`;
* `f` and `A` satisfy the standing hypothesis of Stacks 0D6V: a class `B'` of objects covering
  every object of `C'`, each `V' ∈ B'` carrying an integer bound `d_{V'}` and a cofinal system of
  coverings of `V'` on the images under `f` of whose members the cohomology, computed on `C`, of
  every module of `A` vanishes above `d_{V'}`;
* `Rᵖf_*F = 0` for every `p > N` and every `F` of `A`.

Then for every `K` of `D_A(O)` the canonical map `Hʲ(Rf_*K) ⟶ Hʲ(Rf_*(τ_{≥ -n}K))` induced by the
truncation `K ⟶ τ_{≥ -n}K` is an isomorphism for every integer `n` and every `j ≥ N - n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homology_derivedPushforward_truncGEπ_of_relativeSituation_general
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A K)
    (n : ℤ) (j : ℤ) (hj : N - n ≤ j) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) j).map
      ((derivedPushforward.{u} f.toRingedToposSiteHom).map
        ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-n)).app K)))
declarations.comment:
for a morphism of ringed sites, with Rᵖf_*F read as Hᵖ(Rf_*(F[0])) and the
identification Hʲ(V', Rf_*K) = Hʲ(u(V'), K) taken from Stacks 0D6I

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.subsiteSliceCohomology_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D6X for a slice of the inclusion of a full subsite.** Let `P` cut out a full
subcategory of the objects of a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf category of `S`,

declarations.name: Stacks.CechSite.injective_module_subsingleton_ext_of_continuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6X.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous functor of sites and let
`g : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi, so that `g⁻¹` is restriction along
`u` (Sites, Lemma 00XR). Let `O_D` be a sheaf of rings on `D` and let `I` be an injective
`O_D`-module. Then `H^p(U, g⁻¹I) = 0` for all `p > 0` and all objects `U` of `C`.

Continuity of `u` (Sites, Definition 00WV) is `CategoryTheory.Functor.IsContinuous` together
with its covering-pullback clause `Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks`, and the
identification of Čech complexes `Ȟ^p(𝒰, g⁻¹I) = Ȟ^p(u(𝒰), I)` of the source's proof is
derived from it, by `isIso_cechProductMapOfFunctor_of_continuityCovering`. Cohomology over `U`
is `Ext` out of the free abelian sheaf on the (lifted) representable presheaf of `U`, and the
cohomology of a module is that of its underlying abelian sheaf. Cocontinuity of `u`, which
makes `g` a morphism of topoi, is not needed. Neither site is assumed small; the universes of
the two sites, of the sections of `O_D` and of `Ext` are free.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_module_subsingleton_ext_of_continuous
    (I : SheafOfModules.{max a u v u₂ v₂ r} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    [Injective I] (U : C) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Subsingleton (Ext ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max a u v u₂ v₂ r}).obj
      (uliftYoneda.{max a u v u₂ v₂ r}.obj U ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free))
      ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max a u v u₂ v₂ r} J Y.J).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)).obj I)) p)
declarations.comment: the Čech comparison derived from continuity; cocontinuity is not needed, neither site is small, and cohomology over `U` is `Ext` out of the free abelian sheaf on the lifted representable

declarations.doc:

theorem injective_module_sheafCohomology_isZero_of_functor
    (hCovObjects : ∀ {U : C}
      (E : { E : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U // E.sieve₀ ∈ J U }) (hE : E ∈ Cov U),
      U ∈ B ∧ (∀ i, E.1.X i ∈ B) ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + 1) → E.1.I₀),
          letI : ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : Fin (q + 1) → E.1.I₀),
            HasProduct (fun a ↦ Over.mk (E.1.f (j a))) := hProducts E hE
          (∏ᶜ (fun a ↦ Over.mk (E.1.f (i a)))).left ∈ B)
    (hCovCofinal : ∀ U ∈ B, ∀ R ∈ J U,
      ∃ (E : { E : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U // E.sieve₀ ∈ J U }),
        E ∈ Cov U ∧ E.1.sieve₀ ≤ R)
    (hComparison : ∀ {U : C}
      (E : { E : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U // E.sieve₀ ∈ J U }) (hE : E ∈ Cov U)
      (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + 1) → E.1.I₀),
        letI : ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : Fin (q + 1) → E.1.I₀),
          HasProduct (fun a ↦ Over.mk (E.1.f (j a))) := hProducts E hE
        letI : ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : Fin (q + 1) → (E.1.map u).I₀),

    (I : SheafOfModules.{max a u₂ v₂ r w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    [Injective I]
    (U : C) (hU : U ∈ B) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (Sheaf.H' ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max a u₂ v₂ r w} J Y.J).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)).obj I)) p U)

declarations.name: Stacks.CechSite.injective_sheaf_subsingleton_sheafH_of_functor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6X for the global cohomology of the source site.** Let
`u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous functor of sites, let `g : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` be the corresponding
morphism of topoi and let `e` be a terminal object of `C` belonging to the cofinal system of
coverings. If `I` is an injective abelian sheaf on `D` then the global cohomology
`H^p(C, g⁻¹I)` vanishes for `p > 0`.

This is the form in which the acyclicity hypothesis of Stacks 07AK is stated: the cohomology
over an object of a site is the global cohomology of the slice at that object, and the slice
has a terminal object.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_sheaf_subsingleton_sheafH_of_functor
    (hCovObjects : ∀ {U : C}
      (E : { E : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U // E.sieve₀ ∈ J U }) (hE : E ∈ Cov U),
      U ∈ B ∧ (∀ i, E.1.X i ∈ B) ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + 1) → E.1.I₀),
          letI : ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : Fin (q + 1) → E.1.I₀),
            HasProduct (fun a ↦ Over.mk (E.1.f (j a))) := hProducts E hE
          (∏ᶜ (fun a ↦ Over.mk (E.1.f (i a)))).left ∈ B)
    (hCovCofinal : ∀ U ∈ B, ∀ R ∈ J U,
      ∃ (E : { E : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U // E.sieve₀ ∈ J U }),
        E ∈ Cov U ∧ E.1.sieve₀ ≤ R)
    (hComparison : ∀ {U : C}
      (E : { E : PreZeroHypercover.{w} U // E.sieve₀ ∈ J U }) (hE : E ∈ Cov U)
      (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + 1) → E.1.I₀),
        letI : ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : Fin (q + 1) → E.1.I₀),
          HasProduct (fun a ↦ Over.mk (E.1.f (j a))) := hProducts E hE
        letI : ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : Fin (q + 1) → (E.1.map u).I₀),
          HasProduct (fun a ↦ Over.mk ((E.1.map u).f (j a))) := hImageProducts E hE
        IsIso (cechProductMapOfFunctor u E.1 p i))
    (I : Sheaf K AddCommGrpCat.{max a u v u₂ v₂ w}) [Injective I]
    {e : C} (he : IsTerminal e) (heB : e ∈ B) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max a u v u₂ v₂ w} J K).obj I) p)
declarations.comment: global cohomology of the source site, at a terminal object; the morphism universes of the two sites are free and the sites are not assumed small

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.isTotallyAcyclic_inverseImage_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6Y.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous functor of
sites and let `g : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi, so that `g^{-1}` is
restriction along `u` by Sites, Lemma 00XR. Let `O_D` be a sheaf of rings on `D` and let `I` be
an injective `O_D`-module. If `g_!^{Sh} : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` commutes with fibre products, then
`g^{-1}I` is totally acyclic: its cohomology over every sheaf of sets on `C` vanishes in every
positive degree.

As in the source, total acyclicity of a module is that of its underlying abelian sheaf; the
abelian sheaf underlying `g^{-1}I` is the restriction along `u` of the abelian sheaf underlying
`I`, which is how the conclusion is phrased.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTotallyAcyclic_inverseImage_of_injective
    [∀ n : ℕ, PreservesLimitsOfShape (WidePullbackShape (Fin (n + 1)))
      (u.sheafPullback (Type w) J Y.J)]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) [Injective I] :
    IsTotallyAcyclic.{w} J
      ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J Y.J).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)).obj I))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.isTotallyAcyclic_inverseImage_of_injective_of_pullbacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6Y, under the sufficient condition of its footnote.** If `C` has
fibre products and equalizers — equivalently, all finite connected limits — and `u` preserves
them, then `g_!^{Sh}` commutes with fibre products by Sites, Lemma 00XS, and the inverse image
of an injective `O_D`-module is totally acyclic.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTotallyAcyclic_inverseImage_of_injective_of_pullbacks [HasPullbacks C] [HasEqualizers C]
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan u] [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair u]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) [Injective I] :
    IsTotallyAcyclic.{w} J
      ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J Y.J).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)).obj I))
declarations.comment:
the case of the footnote's sufficient condition: `C` has finite connected limits
  and `u` commutes with them

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.isTotallyAcyclic_pushforwardModule_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6Y, read on the inverse image module.** The abelian sheaf underlying
the inverse image `g^{-1}I` of an injective `O_D`-module — restriction along `u`, as a module
over the inverse image `g^{-1}O_D` of the structure sheaf — is totally acyclic.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTotallyAcyclic_pushforwardModule_of_injective
    [∀ n : ℕ, PreservesLimitsOfShape (WidePullbackShape (Fin (n + 1)))
      (u.sheafPullback (Type w) J Y.J)]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) [Injective I] :
    IsTotallyAcyclic.{w} J
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := u)
          (𝟙 ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{w} J Y.J).obj
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)))).obj I))
declarations.comment:
the conclusion read on the inverse image module rather than on the restriction of
  the underlying abelian sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.isTotallyAcyclic_inverseImage_of_injective_of_cospans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0D6Y, with the hypothesis the source states.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a
continuous and cocontinuous functor of sites and let `g : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` be the corresponding
morphism of topoi. Let `O_D` be a sheaf of rings on `D` and let `I` be an injective
`O_D`-module. If `g_!^{Sh} : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` commutes with binary fibre products, then `g^{-1}I`
is totally acyclic.

The complex of Stacks 07A1 is built from the iterated fibre powers of a surjection of sheaves of
sets, so it is commutation with those that the proof uses. Commutation with binary fibre
products supplies it: an iterated fibre power is a fibre product of one fewer of its factors
against the remaining one, and `Sh(C)` has fibre products, so
`CategoryTheory.Limits.preservesLimitsOfShape_widePullbackShape` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTotallyAcyclic_inverseImage_of_injective_of_cospans
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (u.sheafPullback (Type w) J Y.J)]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) [Injective I] :
    IsTotallyAcyclic.{w} J
      ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w} J Y.J).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)).obj I))
declarations.comment:
the tag at the source's own hypothesis, that `g_!^{Sh}` commute with binary
  fibre products; the iterated fibre powers the proof uses follow from it
