Stacks 09X8. Then on the total site of the associated simplicial semi-representable object,
carried to the small model, the sheaves of sets which are inverse images along the augmentation
are exactly the cartesian ones.

This is the statement the smallness reconciliation buys. Its hypothesis is a datum on `LC_qc`,
which is where Stacks 0DAF's diagram lives; its conclusion is about the total site of the small
model, which is where the apparatus of Stacks 09WE exists at all; and
`smallSheafEquiv` identifies the base topos of the two.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_iff_isCartesianSheaf_qcAugmentation {Y : S.category}
    (U : SimplicialObject S.category)
    (a : U ⟶ (SimplicialObject.const S.category).obj Y)
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation S.pretopology U a)
    (E : Sheaf (situation (S.smallOverTopology Y)
      (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).totalTopology (Type u)) :
    (totalLocalizationMorphism (S.smallOverTopology Y)
        (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).inverseImage.essImage E ↔
      (situation (S.smallOverTopology Y)
        (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).IsCartesianSheaf E
declarations.comment: part (1) for a hypercovering augmentation of the quasi-compact site LC_qc

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactQcSite.mem_essImage_iff_isCartesianAbSheaf_qcAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (2) for a hypercovering augmentation of `LC_qc`.** The same for sheaves of
abelian groups: on the total site of the associated simplicial semi-representable object carried
to the small model, the abelian sheaves which are inverse images along the augmentation are
exactly the cartesian ones.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_iff_isCartesianAbSheaf_qcAugmentation {Y : S.category}
    (U : SimplicialObject S.category)
    (a : U ⟶ (SimplicialObject.const S.category).obj Y)
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation S.pretopology U a)
    (G : Sheaf (situation (S.smallOverTopology Y)
      (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).totalTopology Ab.{u}) :
    ((totalForget (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
        ((situation (S.smallOverTopology Y)
          (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).totalTopology)
        (S.smallOverTopology Y)).essImage G ↔
      (situation (S.smallOverTopology Y)
        (S.smallAssociatedSimplicialObject U a)).IsCartesianAbSheaf G
declarations.comment: part (2) for a hypercovering augmentation of the quasi-compact site LC_qc

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.faithful_inverseImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the faithfulness half.** For a hypercovering `K` of `X` the inverse image
`a^{-1} : Sh(C/X) ⥤ Sh((C/K)_total)` of the augmentation is faithful.

The inverse image is restriction along `j_total`, which is continuous and cover dense, and
restriction along such a functor is faithful by Stacks 04D9.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_inverseImage_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    (totalLocalizationMorphism (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).inverseImage.Faithful
declarations.comment: part (1): a^{-1} on sheaves of sets is faithful

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.faithful_totalInverseImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the faithfulness half**, for the inverse image of the morphism of topoi
which Stacks 0D70 attaches to the augmentation. By Stacks 0D8B that functor is isomorphic to
restriction along `j_total`, and faithfulness is invariant under isomorphism of functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_totalInverseImage_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    Functor.Faithful
      (augmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalMorphismOfTopoi.inverseImage
declarations.comment: part (1): a^{-1} of Stacks 0D70 on sheaves of sets is faithful

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.faithful_abelianInverseImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (2), the faithfulness half.** For a hypercovering `K` of `X` the inverse image
`a^{-1} : Ab(C/X) ⥤ Ab((C/K)_total)` of the augmentation — restriction along `j_total` on abelian
sheaves, as in Stacks 09WM (2) — is faithful.

Cover density of `j_total` is a statement about the site, so the argument of
`faithful_inverseImage_over` applies at any coefficient category.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_abelianInverseImage_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    ((totalForget K).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
      ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology)
      (P.toGrothendieck.over X)).Faithful
declarations.comment: part (2): a^{-1} on abelian sheaves is faithful

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.full_inverseImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the fullness half.** For a hypercovering `K` of `X` the inverse image
`a^{-1} : Sh(C/X) ⥤ Sh((C/K)_total)` of the augmentation is full.

The inverse image is restriction along `j_total`, which is continuous, cover dense by the
degree-zero clause of Stacks 01G5 and locally full by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isLocallyFull_totalForget_over`; restriction along
such a functor is full.
declarations.statement:
theorem full_inverseImage_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    (totalLocalizationMorphism (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).inverseImage.Full
declarations.comment: part (1): a^{-1} on sheaves of sets is full

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_unit_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the degree-zero identification `E = a_* a^{-1} E`.** For a hypercovering
`K` of `X` and every sheaf of sets `E` on `C/X` the canonical map `E ⟶ a_* a^{-1} E` is an
isomorphism, `a^{-1}` being restriction along `j_total`.

The unit of an adjunction with fully faithful left adjoint is invertible, and `a^{-1}` is fully
faithful by `fullyFaithfulInverseImageOver`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_unit_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    IsIso (totalLocalizationMorphism (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).adj.unit
declarations.comment: part (1): the unit E = a_*a⁻¹E on sheaves of sets is an isomorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.full_abelianInverseImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (2), the fullness half.** The inverse image
`a^{-1} : Ab(C/X) ⥤ Ab((C/K)_total)` of the augmentation is full.

Cover density and local fullness of `j_total` are statements about the site, so the argument of
`full_inverseImage_over` applies at any coefficient category.
declarations.statement:
theorem full_abelianInverseImage_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    ((totalForget K).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
      ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology)
      (P.toGrothendieck.over X)).Full
declarations.comment: part (2): a^{-1} on abelian sheaves is full

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_abelianUnit_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (2), the degree-zero identification `M = a_* a^{-1} M`** on sheaves of abelian
groups: for a hypercovering `K` of `X` and every sheaf of abelian groups `M` on `C/X` the
canonical map `M ⟶ a_* a^{-1} M` is an isomorphism, `a^{-1}` being restriction along
`j_total`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_abelianUnit_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    IsIso (abelianTotalAdjunction (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).unit
declarations.comment: part (2): the unit M = a_*a⁻¹M on abelian sheaves is an isomorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isCartesianSheaf_of_mem_essImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the inclusion of the essential image in the cartesian sheaves.** Every
sheaf of sets on the total site `(C/K)_total` isomorphic to an inverse image along the
augmentation towards `C/X` is cartesian.

This is Stacks 0D7H (1) together with invariance of cartesianness under isomorphism, and uses no
condition on the simplicial semi-representable object `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCartesianSheaf_of_mem_essImage_over (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    {F : Sheaf (situation (J.over X) K).totalTopology (Type u)}
    (hF : (totalLocalizationMorphism (J.over X) K).inverseImage.essImage F) :
    (situation (J.over X) K).IsCartesianSheaf F
declarations.comment: part (1): the essential image of a^{-1} consists of cartesian sheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isCartesianAbSheaf_of_mem_essImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (2), the inclusion of the essential image in the cartesian sheaves.** Every
sheaf of abelian groups on the total site `(C/K)_total` isomorphic to an inverse image along the
augmentation towards `C/X` is cartesian.

Cartesianness of an abelian sheaf is cartesianness of its underlying sheaf of sets, and the
underlying sheaf of the restriction of `𝒢` along `j_total` is the restriction of the underlying
sheaf of `𝒢`, both being a composition of functors.
declarations.comment: part (2): the essential image of a^{-1} consists of cartesian abelian sheaves

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.essImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), essential surjectivity onto the cartesian sheaves of sets**, for
restriction along the localization functor `j_total` of a hypercovering `K` of an object `X`:
every cartesian sheaf of sets on the total site is isomorphic to a restriction of a sheaf on
`C/X`.

A hypercovering of `X` in `C` is a hypercovering of the final presheaf of the localized site
`C/X` with the same simplicial object, by
`Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_over_of_isHypercovering`, and
hence has the same total site, total topology and localization morphism; so this is Stacks
0D8E (1) read over `C/X`. The hypercovering that identification produces is one for the
pretopology of covering families of `C/X`, which generates the localized topology
`P.toGrothendieck.over X` itself by the Galois insertion between pretopologies and topologies;
the sheaf is quantified inside the statement because its category depends on that topology.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    ∀ E : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology (Type u),
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsCartesianSheaf E →
        (totalLocalizationMorphism (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).inverseImage.essImage E
declarations.comment: part (1): every cartesian sheaf of sets on the total site is an a^{-1}E

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.mem_essImage_inverseImage_iff_isCartesianSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the essential image is exactly the cartesian sheaves of sets**, for
restriction along `j_total` for a hypercovering of an object `X`. One inclusion is
`isCartesianSheaf_of_mem_essImage_over`, which is Stacks 0D7H (1) and uses no condition on `K`;
the other is `essImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_inverseImage_iff_isCartesianSheaf_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology (Type u)) :
    (totalLocalizationMorphism (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).inverseImage.essImage E ↔
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsCartesianSheaf E
declarations.comment: part (1): the essential image of a^{-1} on sheaves of sets is exactly the cartesian sheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_counit_app_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on the cartesian sheaves of sets.** For a
cartesian sheaf of sets `F` on the total site of a hypercovering of an object `X` the counit
`a⁻¹ a_* F ⟶ F` is an isomorphism.

`a⁻¹` is fully faithful, so its counit is invertible at exactly the objects of its essential
image, and `essImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over` puts `F` there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_counit_app_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology (Type u))
    (hE : (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsCartesianSheaf E) :
    IsIso ((totalLocalizationMorphism (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).adj.counit.app E)
declarations.comment: part (1): a^{-1} a_* F = F for cartesian F on sheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.essImage_situationTotalInverseImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), essential surjectivity onto the cartesian sheaves of sets**, for the
inverse image of the total augmentation as Stacks 0D70 constructs it from the simplicial-site
situation of `C/X`.

By Stacks 0D8B that inverse image is restriction along `j_total`, for which every cartesian
sheaf of sets is an inverse image by `essImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over`; the essential image is
invariant under isomorphism of functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_situationTotalInverseImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology (Type u))
    (hE : (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsCartesianSheaf E) :
    (Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K) (Cat.of (Over X)) (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
      (situationAugmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K)).inverseImage.essImage E
declarations.comment: part (1): every cartesian sheaf of sets is an a^{-1}E for the a of Stacks 0D70 at the simplicial-site situation of C/X

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.mem_essImage_situationTotalInverseImage_iff_isCartesianSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the essential image is exactly the cartesian sheaves of sets**, for the
inverse image of the morphism of topoi of Stacks 0D70 at the simplicial-site situation of `C/X`.
One inclusion is `mem_essImage_inverseImage_iff_isCartesianSheaf_over` carried across
Stacks 0D8B, the other is `essImage_situationTotalInverseImage_of_isCartesianSheaf_over`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_situationTotalInverseImage_iff_isCartesianSheaf_over
    (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology (Type u)) :
    (Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi
        (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K) (Cat.of (Over X)) (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
        (situationAugmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K)).inverseImage.essImage E ↔
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsCartesianSheaf E
declarations.comment: part (1): the essential image of the a^{-1} of Stacks 0D70 at the simplicial-site situation of C/X is exactly the cartesian sheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.essImage_of_isCartesianAbSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
For a hypercovering `L` of an object `X`, every cartesian sheaf of abelian groups on the
total site is isomorphic to the restriction along the localization functor `j_total` of a sheaf of
abelian groups on `C/X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_of_isCartesianAbSheaf_over (hL : IsHypercovering P L) :
    ∀ G : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology Ab.{u},
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).IsCartesianAbSheaf G →
        ((totalForget L).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
          ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology)
          (P.toGrothendieck.over X)).essImage G
declarations.comment: part (2): every cartesian abelian sheaf on the total site is an a^{-1}G

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.mem_essImage_abelianInverseImage_iff_isCartesianAbSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
For a hypercovering `L` of an object `X`, the essential image of restriction of abelian
sheaves along `j_total` is exactly the cartesian abelian sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_abelianInverseImage_iff_isCartesianAbSheaf_over (hL : IsHypercovering P L)
    (G : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology Ab.{u}) :
    ((totalForget L).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u}
        ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology)
        (P.toGrothendieck.over X)).essImage G ↔
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).IsCartesianAbSheaf G
declarations.comment: part (2): the essential image of a^{-1} on abelian sheaves is exactly the cartesian abelian sheaves

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_abelianCounit_app_over
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian sheaf of abelian groups `ℱ` on the total site of a hypercovering of an
object `X`, the counit `a⁻¹ a_* ℱ ⟶ ℱ` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_abelianCounit_app_over (hL : IsHypercovering P L)
    (G : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology Ab.{u})
    (hG : (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).IsCartesianAbSheaf G) :
    IsIso ((abelianTotalAdjunction (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).counit.app G)
declarations.comment: part (2): a^{-1} a_* F = F for cartesian F on abelian sheaves

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.essImage_situationTotalInverseImageAb_of_isCartesianAbSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
For a hypercovering `L` of an object `X`, every cartesian abelian sheaf on the total site
lies in the essential image of the abelian inverse image of the total augmentation which
Stacks 0D70 constructs from the simplicial-site situation of `C/X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_situationTotalInverseImageAb_of_isCartesianAbSheaf_over
    (hL : IsHypercovering P L)
    (G : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology Ab.{u})
    (hG : (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).IsCartesianAbSheaf G) :
    (Augmentation.totalInverseImageAb (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L)
      (Cat.of (Over X)) (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
      (situationAugmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L)).essImage G
declarations.comment: part (2): every cartesian abelian sheaf is an a^{-1}G for the a of Stacks 0D70 at the simplicial-site situation of C/X

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.mem_essImage_situationTotalInverseImageAb_iff_isCartesianAbSheaf_over
declarations.doc:
For a hypercovering `L` of an object `X`, the essential image of the abelian inverse image of
the morphism of topoi of Stacks 0D70 at the simplicial-site situation of `C/X` is exactly the
cartesian abelian sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_situationTotalInverseImageAb_iff_isCartesianAbSheaf_over
    (hL : IsHypercovering P L)
    (G : Sheaf (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).totalTopology Ab.{u}) :
    (Augmentation.totalInverseImageAb (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L)
        (Cat.of (Over X)) (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
        (situationAugmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L)).essImage G ↔
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) L).IsCartesianAbSheaf G
declarations.comment: part (2): the essential image of the a^{-1} of Stacks 0D70 at the simplicial-site situation of C/X is exactly the cartesian abelian sheaves

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_situationTotalAdjunctionUnit_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (1), the degree-zero identification `E = a_* a^{-1} E`**, for the morphism of
topoi which Stacks 0D70 attaches to the *simplicial-site situation* of a hypercovering `K` of an
object `X`: for every sheaf of sets `E` on `C/X` the canonical map `E ⟶ a_* a^{-1} E` is an
isomorphism, with no condition carried beyond `K` being a hypercovering of `X`.

This is the comparison `isIso_situationTotalAdjunctionUnit_of_isIso_unit` at the site `C/X`,
applied to `isIso_unit_over`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_situationTotalAdjunctionUnit_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    IsIso (SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K) (Cat.of (Over X)) (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
      (situationAugmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K)).adj.unit
declarations.comment: part (1): the unit E = a_*a⁻¹E of the morphism of topoi of Stacks 0D70 on sheaves of sets is an isomorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_situationAbelianTotalAdjunctionUnit_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D8K (2), the degree-zero identification `M = a_* a^{-1} M`** on sheaves of abelian
groups, for the morphism of topoi which Stacks 0D70 attaches to the *simplicial-site situation*
of a hypercovering `K` of an object `X`: for every sheaf of abelian groups `M` on `C/X` the
canonical map `M ⟶ a_* a^{-1} M` is an isomorphism, with no condition carried beyond `K` being a
hypercovering of `X`.

This is the spelling of the unit which the derived statements of Stacks 0D8L consume, and it
discharges the clause those statements would otherwise carry as a hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_situationAbelianTotalAdjunctionUnit_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    IsIso (SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.abelianTotalAdjunction
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K) (Cat.of (Over X)) (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
      (situationAugmentation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K)).unit
declarations.comment: part (2): the unit M = a_*a⁻¹M of the morphism of topoi of Stacks 0D70 on abelian sheaves is an isomorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_derivedAugmentationUnitOver_app_of_isHypercovering_unconditional
declarations.doc:
For a hypercovering `K` of an object `X` of a site `C` with fibre products, the canonical map
`E ⟶ Ra_* a⁻¹ E` is invertible at every object `E` of the unbounded derived category of abelian
sheaves on `C/X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedAugmentationUnitOver_app_of_isHypercovering_unconditional
    (P : Pretopology C) {X : C} (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{u} (Over X)))
    (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : DerivedCategory (AbelianSheavesOver P.toGrothendieck X)) :
    IsIso ((derivedAugmentationUnitOver P.toGrothendieck X K).app E)
declarations.comment:
for a hypercovering K of X, the map E → Ra_*a⁻¹E is an isomorphism for every
E in D(C/X)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site with fibre products, `X` an object of `C`, `K` a hypercovering of `X`, `a`
the augmentation of the simplicial family of sites `n ↦ (C/X)/K_n`, and `𝒜 ⊂ Ab((C/K)_total)` the
weak Serre subcategory of cartesian abelian sheaves. The derived inverse image is an equivalence

`a⁻¹ : D⁺(C/X) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜((C/K)_total)`

with quasi-inverse `Ra_*`. The hypercovering condition enters through the two inputs of
Stacks 0D8L (`isIso_situationAbelianTotalAdjunctionUnit_over`,
`inverseImageComputesDerivedPushforward_over_of_isHypercovering`) and the essential surjectivity
clause of Stacks 0D8K (2) (`essImage_situationTotalInverseImageAb_of_isCartesianAbSheaf_over`),
all proved from `hK`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
        (⊤ : ObjectProperty
          (Sheaf (P.toGrothendieck.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))).FullSubcategory ≌
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
        ((situationOver P K).IsCartesianAbSheaf)).FullSubcategory

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering_functor
declarations.doc:
The forward functor of `derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering` is the
restriction of the derived inverse image `a⁻¹` to the bounded below subcategories.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering_functor :
    (derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering P K hK).functor =
      Augmentation.derivedTotalInverseImagePlus (situationOver P K) (Cat.of (Over X))
        (P.toGrothendieck.over X) (augmentationOver P K)
declarations.comment: the forward functor of the equivalence is a⁻¹

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering_inverse
declarations.doc:
The quasi-inverse of `derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering` is the
restriction of the derived direct image `Ra_*` to the bounded below subcategories.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering_inverse :
    (derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceOverOfHypercovering P K hK).inverse =
      Augmentation.derivedTotalPushforwardPlus (situationOver P K) (Cat.of (Over X))
        (P.toGrothendieck.over X) (augmentationOver P K)
declarations.comment: the quasi-inverse of the equivalence is Ra_*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_derivedAugmentationUnitAugmented_app_unconditional
declarations.doc:
For a site `C` with fibre products given by a pretopology `P`, an object `X` of `C` and a
hypercovering `a : U ⟶ X` of `X` in `C` by a simplicial object `U` of `C`, in the sense of
Stacks 09X8, the canonical map `E ⟶ Ra_* a⁻¹ E` is invertible at every object `E` of the
unbounded derived category `D(C/X)` of abelian sheaves on `C/X`.

As in the source, this is Stacks 0D8L for the associated simplicial semi-representable object
`n ↦ {U_n ⟶ X}` over `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedAugmentationUnitAugmented_app_unconditional (P : Pretopology C) {X : C}
    (U : SimplicialObject C) (a : U ⟶ (SimplicialObject.const C).obj X)
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a)
    (E : DerivedCategory (AbelianSheavesOver P.toGrothendieck X)) :
    IsIso ((derivedAugmentationUnitAugmented P U a).app E)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.ProperBaseChange.isIso_properBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Proper base change for sheaves of sets, Stacks 0D90.** Let

```
X ×_Y Z --- g' ---> X
   |                |
   f'               f
   v                v
   Z  --- g ----->  Y
```

be a cartesian square of topological spaces with `f` proper in the sense of Stacks 005O (5).
Then for every sheaf of sets `F` on `X` the canonical base-change map
`g⁻¹(f_*F) ⟶ f'_*((g')⁻¹F)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_properBaseChangeMap (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (F : X.Sheaf (Type u))
    (hf : StacksDraft.Topology.IsProperMap.{u, u, u} (⇑f)) :
    IsIso (properBaseChangeMap f g F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactZariskiSituation.isIso_qcTopologicalDerivedUnit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D91**: cohomological descent for the quasi-compact site. For `X` an object of
`LC_qc` and `K` in `D⁺(X)` the canonical map `K ⟶ Ra_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_qcTopologicalDerivedUnit_app
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.obj) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})) :
    IsIso ((qcTopologicalDerivedUnit.{u, w, v} S X).app K)
declarations.comment:
cohomological descent for LC_qc: for X in LC_qc and K in D^+(X), the canonical map
K -> Ra_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactZariskiSituation.topologyChangeSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D92, the change-of-topology square.** The change-of-topology morphisms commute
with the morphisms of slice topoi induced by `f`:
`ε_X^{-1} ∘ f_{Zar}^{-1} ≅ f_{qc}^{-1} ∘ ε_Y^{-1}`.

On direct images the square commutes strictly, because the change-of-topology direct image
leaves the underlying presheaf unchanged; both sides of the square on inverse images are left
adjoints of the two sides of that identity, so the isomorphism is the one supplied by uniqueness
of left adjoints.
declarations.comment: change-of-topology square

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactZariskiSituation.qcTopologicalComparisonSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D92, the topological comparison square.** The comparison morphisms
`a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X` to sheaves on the underlying spaces commute with the morphisms of slice topoi
induced by `f`: `a_X^{-1} ∘ g^{-1} ≅ f_{qc}^{-1} ∘ a_Y^{-1}`, where `g` is the underlying
continuous map of `f`.

It is the Zariski square of Stacks 0DCU followed by the change-of-topology square.
declarations.statement:
def qcTopologicalComparisonSquareIso :
    (Opens.map ((S.qcSite.inclusion ⋙ locallyQuasiCompactHausdorffToTop).map f)).sheafPullback
        (Type (max u t))
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology
          ((S.qcSite.inclusion ⋙ locallyQuasiCompactHausdorffToTop).obj Y))
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology
          ((S.qcSite.inclusion ⋙ locallyQuasiCompactHausdorffToTop).obj X)) ⋙
      qcTopologicalInverseImage.{u, w, t} S X ≅
    qcTopologicalInverseImage.{u, w, t} S Y ⋙ qcSliceInverseImage.{u, w, t} S f
declarations.comment: topological comparison square

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactZariskiSituation.qcTopologicalProperDirectImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D92, the proper direct image clause.** If the underlying continuous map of
`f : X ⟶ Y` is proper, then direct image of sheaves of sets along it commutes with inverse image
along the comparison morphisms `a_X`, `a_Y` to sheaves on the underlying spaces:
`a_Y^{-1} ∘ f_* = f_{qc,*} ∘ a_X^{-1}`.

This is `qcTopologicalBaseChangeMap` with its invertibility supplied by
`isIso_qcTopologicalBaseChangeMap`.
declarations.statement:
def qcTopologicalProperDirectImageIso
    (hf : StacksDraft.Topology.IsProperMap.{u, u, u} ⇑((siteToTop S).map f)) :
    spaceDirectImage S f (Type u) ⋙ qcTopologicalInverseImage.{u, w, u} S Y ≅
      qcTopologicalInverseImage.{u, w, u} S X ⋙ qcSliceDirectImage.{u, w, u} S f
declarations.comment: proper direct image

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D95.** A morphism between simplicial sites: degreewise morphisms of sites commuting
with the transitions in case (A), or degreewise cocontinuous functors commuting with the
transitions in case (B).
declarations.statement:
inductive SimplicialSiteMorphism :
    SimplicialSiteSituation.{u} → SimplicialSiteSituation.{u} → Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: morphism_between_simplicial_sites

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.transitionPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D95.** The component morphisms of a morphism between simplicial sites commute, up to
the canonical comparison, with every simplicial transition morphism of topoi.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def transitionPushforwardIso
    {S S' : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}}
    (h : SimplicialSiteMorphism S S')
    {m n : SimplexCategory} (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    (h.componentMorphism n).pushforward ⋙ (S'.transitionMorphism φ).pushforward ≅
      (S.transitionMorphism φ).pushforward ⋙ (h.componentMorphism m).pushforward

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.totalFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor between the total categories attached to a morphism between simplicial sites in
the continuous case: in each simplicial degree it is the given functor.
declarations.statement:
def totalFunctor (h : SimplicialSite.Morphism C C') :
    CoGrothendieck C'.totalPseudofunctor ⥤ CoGrothendieck C.totalPseudofunctor
declarations.comment: case (A), the functor of total sites

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.totalFunctor_isContinuous
declarations.doc: The functor between the total categories is continuous.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalFunctor_isContinuous (h : SimplicialSite.Morphism C C') :
    h.totalFunctor.IsContinuous C'.totalTopology C.totalTopology
declarations.comment: case (A), continuity of the functor of total sites

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.totalMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism between the total topoi induced by a morphism between simplicial sites in the
cocontinuous case.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalMorphism (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C') :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}).totalTopology (Type u))
      (Sheaf (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}).totalTopology (Type u))
declarations.comment: case (B), the morphism of total topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.totalComponentPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
The square formed by the total morphism of topoi, the morphism of topoi in simplicial degree
`n`, and the two component morphisms of that degree commutes, as witnessed by a natural
isomorphism of direct-image functors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalComponentPushforwardIso
    (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C') (n : SimplexCategory) :
    ((SimplicialSiteMorphism.ofCocontinuous h).componentMorphism n).pushforward ⋙
        (SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
          (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).pushforward ≅
      (SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
          (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).pushforward ⋙
        h.totalMorphism.pushforward
declarations.comment: case (B), the commutative square

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.totalInverseImageRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D96**, case (B). Inverse image to the component of simplicial degree `n`, applied
to the inverse image along the total morphism, is the inverse image in degree `n` applied to the
inverse image to the component of that degree: `h_total^{-1}` is degreewise `h_n^{-1}`.

The two composites of inverse images are the left adjoints of the two composites of direct
images compared by `totalComponentPushforwardIso`, so this is that comparison conjugated by
uniqueness of left adjoints.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalInverseImageRestrictIso
    (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C') (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.totalMorphism.inverseImage ⋙
        (SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
          (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).inverseImage ≅
      (SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
          (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).inverseImage ⋙
        ((SimplicialSiteMorphism.ofCocontinuous h).componentMorphism n).inverseImage
declarations.comment: case (B), restriction of the inverse image

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.totalPushforwardRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
Inverse image to the component of simplicial degree `n`, applied to the direct image along
the total morphism, is the direct image in degree `n` applied to the inverse image to the
component of that degree.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalPushforwardRestrictIso
    (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C') (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.totalMorphism.pushforward ⋙
        (SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
          (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).inverseImage ≅
      (SimplicialSiteSituation.componentMorphism
          (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).inverseImage ⋙
        ((SimplicialSiteMorphism.ofCocontinuous h).componentMorphism n).pushforward
declarations.comment: case (B), restriction of the direct image

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.totalInverseImageRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D96**, case (A). Restriction to the component of simplicial degree `n`, applied to
the inverse image along the total morphism, is the inverse image in degree `n` applied to
restriction to the component of that degree: `h_total^{-1}` is degreewise `h_n^{-1}`.
declarations.comment: case (A), restriction of the inverse image

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.totalMorphismSquares
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D96.** A morphism `h` between simplicial sites, in either case of Stacks 0D95,
induces a morphism of topoi `h_total : Sh(C_total) → Sh(C'_total)` (`h.totalMorphism`) such that
for every `n` the square formed by `h_total`, the morphism of topoi `h_n` of degree `n` and the
morphisms of topoi `g_n`, `g'_n` of the component inclusions commutes, and
`(g'_n)^{-1} ∘ h_{total,*} = h_{n,*} ∘ g_n^{-1}`.
declarations.statement: def totalMorphismSquares : (h : SimplicialSiteMorphism S S') → h.TotalMorphismSquares
declarations.comment: the morphism of total topoi, its commutative squares with the component morphisms, and the restriction of its direct image, in both cases

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
For a morphism between simplicial sites built from morphisms of sites (case (A)), and `K` in
the unbounded derived category of abelian sheaves on the total site,
`(g'_n)^{-1} Rh_{total,*} K = Rh_{n,*} g_n^{-1} K`, as a natural isomorphism of functors on the
derived categories.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictIso (h : SimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.derivedAbelianTotalPushforward ⋙
        (abelianComponent (⟨Sum.inl C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (abelianComponent (⟨Sum.inl C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        h.derivedAbelianComponentPushforward n
declarations.comment: case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
In case (B), with notation and hypotheses as in Stacks 0D96: the natural isomorphism
`(g'_n)^{-1} Rh_{total,*} K ≅ Rh_{n,*} g_n^{-1} K` for `K` in the unbounded derived category of
abelian sheaves on the total site.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictIso (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.derivedAbelianTotalPushforward ⋙
        (abelianComponent (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (abelianComponent (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        h.derivedAbelianComponentPushforward n
declarations.comment: case (B)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictIso'
declarations.doc:
In case (B), with notation and hypotheses as in Stacks 0D96: the natural isomorphism
`(g'_n)^{-1} Rh_{total,*} K ≅ Rh_{n,*} g_n^{-1} K` for `K` in the unbounded derived category of
abelian sheaves on the total site, with restriction written as
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.restrictAb`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictIso' (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.derivedAbelianTotalPushforward ⋙
        (restrictAb (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (restrictAb (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) n).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        h.derivedAbelianComponentPushforward n
declarations.comment: case (B)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.CompatibleWithAugmentations
declarations.doc:
Compatibility of a morphism of topoi between augmentation sites with a morphism of simplicial
sites and the two augmentations.
declarations.comment: compatibility_with_augmentations

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.augmentationPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
The degree-zero square of a morphism of augmented simplicial sites commutes, as witnessed by a
natural isomorphism of direct-image functors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def augmentationPushforwardIso
    {S S' : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}}
    {D D' : Cat.{u, u}} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {K' : GrothendieckTopology D'}
    (h : SimplicialSiteMorphism S S')
    (a : SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation S D K)
    (a' : SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation S' D' K')
    (g : MorphismOfTopoi (Sheaf K (Type u)) (Sheaf K' (Type u)))
    (hg : CompatibleWithAugmentations h a a' g) :
    (h.componentMorphism (SimplexCategory.mk 0)).pushforward ⋙
        (SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.morphismOfTopoi S' D' K' a').pushforward ≅
      (SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.morphismOfTopoi S D K a).pushforward ⋙
        g.pushforward

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.totalAugmentationPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D99.** Let `h` be a morphism between simplicial sites (Stacks 0D95), in either case
of Stacks 09WE, let `a`, `a'` be augmentations of its source and target towards sites `D`, `D'`
(Stacks 0D6Z), and let `g : Sh(D) → Sh(D')` be a morphism of topoi compatible with `h`, `a`, `a'`
(Stacks 0D98). Then the square formed by the morphism of total topoi `h_total` (Stacks 0D96), the
morphisms of topoi `a : Sh(C_total) → Sh(D)` and `a' : Sh(C'_total) → Sh(D')` of the total
augmentations (Stacks 0D70) and `g` commutes: `a' ∘ h_total = g ∘ a`, as witnessed by a natural
isomorphism of direct-image functors.
declarations.statement:
def totalAugmentationPushforwardIso {S S' : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}}
    {D D' : Cat.{u, u}} {K : GrothendieckTopology D} {K' : GrothendieckTopology D'}
    (h : SimplicialSiteMorphism S S')
    (a : SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation S D K)
    (a' : SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation S' D' K')
    (g : MorphismOfTopoi (Sheaf K (Type u)) (Sheaf K' (Type u)))
    (hg : h.CompatibleWithAugmentations a a' g) :
    h.totalMorphism.pushforward ⋙
        (SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi S' D' K' a').pushforward ≅
      (SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi S D K a).pushforward ⋙
        g.pushforward

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.totalAugmentationPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D99.** Let a morphism between simplicial sites, augmentations of its source and its
target, and a morphism of the augmentation topoi compatible with them be given. Then the square
formed by the total topoi, the augmentation topoi, the total morphism of the simplicial sites and
that morphism of the augmentation topoi commutes, as witnessed by a natural isomorphism of
direct-image functors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalAugmentationPushforwardIso
    (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (a : C.Augmentation D K) (a' : C'.Augmentation D' K')
    (g : MorphismOfTopoi (Sheaf K (Type u)) (Sheaf K' (Type u)))
    (hg : SimplicialSiteMorphism.CompatibleWithAugmentations
      (SimplicialSiteMorphism.ofCocontinuous h) a a' g) :
    h.totalMorphism.pushforward ⋙ (Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi a').pushforward ≅
      (Augmentation.totalMorphismOfTopoi a).pushforward ⋙ g.pushforward

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.nonempty_simplicialModuleResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9B.** There is a complex of modules over the structure sheaf of the total
simplicial site whose term in degree `n` is the lower-shriek image `g_{n!}𝒪_n` of the `n`-th
component structure sheaf, whose differentials are the canonical alternating face maps, and
which is a resolution of the structure sheaf.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialModuleResolution.sectionsComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9C.** The canonical complex

`0 → Γ(C_total, F) → Γ(C_0, F_0) → Γ(C_1, F_1) → …`

obtained by applying `Hom(-, F)` to the resolution `… → g_{1!} O_1 → g_{0!} O_0 → O`. Its term in
index `0` is `Hom(O, F) = Γ(C_total, F)` and its term in index `n + 1` is `Γ(C_n, F_n)`.
declarations.statement: public def sectionsComplex : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u} ℕ
declarations.comment: the complex

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialModuleResolution.sectionsComplex_exactAt_le_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9C.** The complex `0 → Γ(C_total, F) → Γ(C_0, F_0) → …` is exact in degrees `-1`
and `0`, i.e. in indices `0` and `1`, for every sheaf of `O`-modules `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sectionsComplex_exactAt_le_one (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ 1) :
    (D.sectionsComplex F).ExactAt i
declarations.comment: exactness in degrees -1 and 0

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialModuleResolution.sectionsComplex_acyclic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9C.** The complex `0 → Γ(C_total, F) → Γ(C_0, F_0) → …` is exact in every degree
when `F` is an injective `O`-module.
declarations.statement: public theorem sectionsComplex_acyclic [Injective F] : (D.sectionsComplex F).Acyclic
declarations.comment: exactness in all degrees for an injective module

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9D.** The data of a ringed augmentation of a simplicial site: a sheaf of
commutative rings `O` on the total site, a sheaf of commutative rings `O_D` on the augmentation
site, and a map `a^♯ : O_D ⟶ a_*O` into the direct image of `O` along the total augmentation.
declarations.statement:
structure RingedAugmentation (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (D : Cat.{u, u})
    (K : GrothendieckTopology D) (a : Augmentation S D K)
declarations.comment: the data `O`, `O_D` and `a^♯` of a ringed augmentation

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.totalRingedHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9D.** The morphism of ringed topoi
`a : (Sh(C_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)` determined by the total augmentation of Stacks 0D70 and
the structure map `a^♯`.
declarations.statement:
def totalRingedHom :
    RingedToposHom (S.totalRingedTopos A.O) A.augmentationRingedTopos
declarations.comment: the morphism of ringed topoi `a : (Sh(C_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.componentRingedHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9D.** The morphism of ringed topoi
`a_n = a ∘ g_n : (Sh(C_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(D), O_D)`, the composite of the component inclusion of
Stacks 0D72 with the ringed augmentation.
declarations.statement:
def componentRingedHom (n : SimplexCategory) :
    RingedToposHom (S.componentRingedTopos A.O n) A.augmentationRingedTopos
declarations.comment: the morphisms of ringed topoi `a_n = a ∘ g_n`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.transitionComponentPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9D.** The identification `a_m ∘ f_φ = a_n` on direct images of sheaves of sets:
the direct image of the simplicial transition followed by that of `a_m` is the direct image of
`a_n`, for every simplex map `φ : m ⟶ n`.
declarations.comment: `a_m ∘ f_φ = a_n`, on direct images of sheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.componentRingedTwoIso
declarations.doc:
**`a_m ∘ f_φ = a_n`, as a 2-isomorphism of morphisms of ringed topoi.** For every simplex map
`φ : [m] ⟶ [n]` the canonical 2-morphism `a_n ⟶ a_m ∘ f_φ` is invertible. This is the identity
the source's proof of Stacks 0D7H appeals to, read for morphisms of ringed topoi.

It is `componentRingedTwoIsoAux` followed by the reassociation of `a ∘ (g_m ∘ f_φ)` into
`(a ∘ g_m) ∘ f_φ = a_m ∘ f_φ`; the source `a ∘ g_n` is `a_n` on the nose.
declarations.comment: `a_m ∘ f_φ = a_n`, as a 2-isomorphism of the morphisms of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isCartesianDerivedModule_iff_forall_isIso_moduleProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9E (2).** In a simplicial-site situation (Stacks 09WE, either case) let `O` be a
sheaf of rings on the total site such that the structure-sheaf transitions `f_φ^{-1}O_n ⟶ O_m`
are flat for every simplex map `φ : [n] ⟶ [m]`. Then an object `K` of `D(O)` is cartesian if and
only if the canonical map `g_{n!}K_n ⟶ g_{n!}O_n ⊗^L_O K` is an isomorphism for every `n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCartesianDerivedModule_iff_forall_isIso_moduleProjection
    (hflat : ∀ (n m : SimplexCategory) (φ : n ⟶ m), (S.transitionRingedToposHom O φ).IsFlat)
    (K : DerivedCategory (S.totalRingedTopos O).Modules) :
    S.IsCartesianDerivedModule O K ↔
      ∀ n : SimplexCategory, IsIso (S.moduleProjection O n (hflat n) K)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isCartesianDerived_iff_isIso_integerProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9E (1).** An object `K` of `D(𝒞_total)` is cartesian if and only if the canonical
map `g_{n!}K_n ⟶ g_{n!}ℤ ⊗^L_ℤ K` is an isomorphism for every simplicial degree `n`.

Since `K` is cartesian exactly when all of its cohomology sheaves are (Stacks 0D7L), this is the
sheaf-level statement `isCartesianAbSheaf_iff_isIso_componentLowerShriekMap` read through
`isIso_integerProjection_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCartesianDerived_iff_isIso_integerProjection
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})) :
    S.IsCartesianDerived K ↔ ∀ n : SimplexCategory, IsIso (S.integerProjection K n)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialDerivedSystem
declarations.doc:
A simplicial system of the derived category for `S`: an object `K_n` of the derived category
of abelian sheaves on each component site, and for every simplex map `φ : [m] ⟶ [n]` a map
`K_φ : f_φ⁻¹K_m ⟶ K_n` from the derived inverse image, such that `K_{φ ∘ ψ}` is
`K_φ ∘ f_φ⁻¹K_ψ` under the canonical identification `f_{φ ∘ ψ}⁻¹ ≅ f_φ⁻¹ ∘ f_ψ⁻¹`. As in the
source, no condition is imposed at identities.
declarations.statement: structure SimplicialDerivedSystem
declarations.comment: the simplicial system

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialDerivedSystem.Cartesian
declarations.doc: A system is cartesian if all its transition maps are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement: abbrev Cartesian (K : SimplicialDerivedSystem S) : Prop
declarations.comment: cartesian systems

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialDerivedSystem.Hom
declarations.doc: A morphism is a degreewise morphism commuting with every transition map.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (K L : SimplicialDerivedSystem S)
declarations.comment: morphisms of simplicial systems

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialDerivedSystem.cartesianInclusion
declarations.doc:
Simplicial systems of the derived category: the category whose objects are the systems
`(K_n, K_φ)` of `SimplicialDerivedSystem S` and whose morphisms are the degreewise maps commuting
with the transitions (`SimplicialDerivedSystem.Hom`), together with its full subcategory of
cartesian systems, those whose transitions `K_φ` are all isomorphisms.
declarations.statement: def cartesianInclusion : (cartesian S).FullSubcategory ⥤ SimplicialDerivedSystem S

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.associatedDerivedSystemData
declarations.doc:
The canonical simplicial system of the derived category attached to an object `K` of the
derived category of abelian sheaves on the total site, together with the equations stating that
its object in degree `n` is the derived restriction of `K` and its transition along a simplex map
is the canonical derived transition at `K`.
declarations.comment: associated simplicial system

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.associatedDerivedSystem_cartesian
declarations.doc: The simplicial system of derived restrictions of a cartesian object is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedDerivedSystem_cartesian
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})) (hK : S.IsCartesianDerived K) :
    (associatedDerivedSystem S K).Cartesian
declarations.comment: cartesian objects give cartesian systems

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.derivedTensorIntegerResolutionPostnikovSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9I(1) for `- ⊗^L_ℤ K`.** For each length `N`, the images under `- ⊗^L_ℤ K` of
the brutal-truncation triangles `Yₙ₊₁ ⟶ Xₙ₊₁ ⟶ Yₙ ⟶ Yₙ₊₁[1]` of the integral resolution are a
Postnikov system (Derived Categories, Definition 0D7Z) for `X_N ⟶ ⋯ ⟶ X₁ ⟶ X₀`, where
`Xₙ = g_{n!}ℤ ⊗^L_ℤ K` by `derivedTensorIntegerResolutionTermIso`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTensorIntegerResolutionPostnikovSystem (N : ℕ) :
    Triangulated.PostnikovSystem
      (fun i : Fin (N + 1) =>
        (integerDerivedTensorRight S K).obj (integerResolutionTerm S (i : ℕ)))
      (fun i : Fin N =>
        (integerDerivedTensorRight S K).map
          (termDiff (integerResolutionComplex S) (i : ℕ)))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isHomotopyColimit_derivedTensorIntegerResolutionSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9I(2) for `- ⊗^L_ℤ K`.** The object `K` is the derived colimit of the system
`Yₙ[n] = (g_{n!}ℤ → … → g_{0!}ℤ) ⊗^L_ℤ K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomotopyColimit_derivedTensorIntegerResolutionSystem :
    IsHomotopyColimit (integerResolutionSystem S ⋙ integerDerivedTensorRight S K) K

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.map_integerResolutionPostnikovSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9I(1).** For an exact functor `T` of `D(𝒞_total)` — such as `- ⊗^L_ℤ K` for an
object `K` of `D(𝒞_total)` — the images under `T` of the brutal-truncation triangles of the
integral resolution are a Postnikov system for `T(X_N) ⟶ ⋯ ⟶ T(X₁) ⟶ T(X₀)`.
declarations.statement:
def map_integerResolutionPostnikovSystem
    (T : DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})) [T.CommShift ℤ] [T.IsTriangulated]
    (N : ℕ) :
    Triangulated.PostnikovSystem
      (fun i : Fin (N + 1) => T.obj (integerResolutionTerm S (i : ℕ)))
      (fun i : Fin N => T.map (termDiff (integerResolutionComplex S) (i : ℕ)))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isHomotopyColimit_map_integerResolutionSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9I(2).** For an exact functor `T` of `D(𝒞_total)` commuting with countable
direct sums — such as `- ⊗^L_ℤ K` for an object `K` of `D(𝒞_total)` — the object `T(ℤ)` is the
derived colimit of the system `T(Yₙ[n])`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomotopyColimit_map_integerResolutionSystem
    (T : DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})) [T.CommShift ℤ] [T.IsTriangulated]
    [PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor (integerResolutionSystem S).obj) T] :
    IsHomotopyColimit (integerResolutionSystem S ⋙ T)
      (T.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (integerResolutionComplex S)))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.eq_zero_of_derivedComponent_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9J.** In the simplicial-site situation of Stacks 09WE, let `K` and `K'` be objects
of `D(𝒞_total)` with `K` cartesian, and suppose that every morphism `Kᵢ[i] ⟶ K'ᵢ` vanishes for
`i > 0` and that every morphism `Kᵢ[i + 1] ⟶ K'ᵢ` vanishes for `i ≥ 0`. Then a map `K ⟶ K'`
inducing the zero map `K₀ ⟶ K'₀` is zero.

The proof is the source's. Stacks 0D9I presents `K` as the derived colimit of the system
`Yₙ[n]`, whose successive quotients are the shifted terms `Xₙ[n]`; Stacks 0D9E identifies `Xₙ`
with `g_{n!}Kₙ`, which turns the two vanishing hypotheses into the vanishing of the groups
`Hom(Xᵢ[t], K')` the induction consumes.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_derivedComponent_zero
    (hK : IsCartesianDerived S K)
    (hHom : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
      ∀ g : ((derivedComponent S ⦋i⦌).obj K)⟦(i : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ (derivedComponent S ⦋i⦌).obj K', g = 0)
    (hHomSucc : ∀ i : ℕ, ∀ g : ((derivedComponent S ⦋i⦌).obj K)⟦((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)⟧ ⟶
      (derivedComponent S ⦋i⦌).obj K', g = 0)
    (f : K ⟶ K') (hf : (derivedComponent S ⦋0⦌).map f = 0) :
    f = 0

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.exists_hom_of_isCartesianDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9K.** In the simplicial-site situation of Stacks 09WE, let `K` and `K'` be objects
of the derived category of abelian sheaves on the total site. If `K` is cartesian in the sense of
Stacks 07TF (3) and `Hom(K_i[i - 1], K'_i) = 0` for `i > 1`, then every morphism of the
associated simplicial systems of Stacks 0D9H is induced by a morphism `K ⟶ K'`: there is a
`γ : K ⟶ K'` whose derived restriction to every simplicial degree is the given component.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hom_of_isCartesianDerived
    (K K' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}))
    (hK : S.IsCartesianDerived K)
    (hHom : S.ShiftedComponentHomVanishing K K')
    (f : SimplicialDerivedSystem.Hom (S.associatedDerivedSystem K)
      (S.associatedDerivedSystem K')) :
    ∃ γ : K ⟶ K', ∀ n : SimplexCategory, (derivedComponent S n).map γ = f.app n
declarations.comment: a morphism of simplicial systems comes from the total site, at the source's hypotheses (1) and (2): the degree-zero lift is `CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.exists_hom_derivedComponent_zero_eq`, which makes the source's two omitted computations -- the vanishing of `X_1 ⟶ X_0 ⟶ K'` against the transition of the realization, and the reading of the structural map `X_0 ⟶ K` as the counit -- and the passage from degree zero to all degrees is `CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.exists_hom_iff_exists_hom_zero`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.exists_isCartesianDerived_of_simplicialDerivedSystem
declarations.doc:
A cartesian simplicial system of the derived categories of the components, whose objects have
no positively shifted self-maps, is the system associated with a cartesian object of the derived
category of the total site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isCartesianDerived_of_simplicialDerivedSystem (T : SimplicialDerivedSystem S)
    (hT : SimplicialDerivedSystem.Cartesian T)
    (hHom : ∀ (k : SimplexCategory) (t : ℕ), 0 < t →
      ∀ f : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (S.componentTopology k) Ab.{u}))
        (t : ℤ)).obj (T.obj k) ⟶ T.obj k, f = 0) :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}),
      S.IsCartesianDerived K ∧
        ∃ γ : ∀ n, T.obj n ≅ (S.associatedDerivedSystem K).obj n,
          ∀ ⦃m n : SimplexCategory⦄ (φ : m ⟶ n),
            T.map φ ≫ (γ n).hom =
              (derivedInverseImage S φ).map ((γ m).hom) ≫
                (S.associatedDerivedSystem K).map φ

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.nonempty_sequentialPostnikovSystem_realizationComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9L, the Postnikov system of the realization.**  The complex whose term in degree
`n` is the extension by lower shriek of the object of the system in degree `n`, and whose
differential is the alternating sum of the transitions along the face maps, carries a sequential
Postnikov system: its differentials compose to zero, and all positively shifted morphisms between
its terms vanish.

This is the construction step of Stacks 0D9L.  The totalization of this Postnikov system, the
identification of its restriction to each simplicial degree with the object of the system in that
degree, and the cartesianness of the result are in
`StacksFrontier.CategoryTheory.Sites.Simplicial.CartesianDerivedOfSystem`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_sequentialPostnikovSystem_realizationComplex (T : SimplicialDerivedSystem S)
    (hT : SimplicialDerivedSystem.Cartesian T)
    (hHom : ∀ (k : SimplexCategory) (t : ℕ), 0 < t →
      ∀ f : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (S.componentTopology k) Ab.{u}))
        (t : ℤ)).obj (T.obj k) ⟶ T.obj k, f = 0) :
    Nonempty (Triangulated.SequentialPostnikovSystem
      (fun n : ℕ => realizationTerm S T ⦋n⦌)
      (fun n : ℕ => (realizationComplex T hT).d (n + 1) n))
declarations.comment: the Postnikov system of the realization complex

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9N.** A simplicial system of the derived category of modules for a sheaf of
commutative rings `O` on the total site of a simplicial-site situation: an object `K_n` of the
derived category of `O_n`-modules in every simplicial degree `n`, a map
`K_φ : Lf_φ^* K_m ⟶ K_n` for every simplex map `φ : m ⟶ n`, and the cocycle condition
`K_{ψ ≫ φ} = K_φ ∘ Lf_φ^* K_ψ` under the canonical identification of `Lf_{ψ ≫ φ}^*` with
`Lf_ψ^* ⋙ Lf_φ^*`.
declarations.statement: structure SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem
declarations.comment: the data of a simplicial system and its cocycle condition

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem.Cartesian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9N.** A simplicial system of the derived category of modules is *cartesian* if
all of its transition maps `K_φ` are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement: abbrev Cartesian (K : SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem S O) : Prop
declarations.comment: cartesian systems

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem.Hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9N.** A morphism of simplicial systems of the derived category of modules: a
morphism in every simplicial degree commuting with all of the transition maps.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (K L : SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem S O)
declarations.comment: morphisms of simplicial systems

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.derivedModuleSystemData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9P.** The restrictions `K_n` of an object `K` of the derived category of
`O`-modules on the total site, together with the derived transitions `K(φ)`, form a simplicial
system of the derived category of modules in the sense of Stacks 0D9N. The two equations are
part of the datum, so no unrelated family of transitions can satisfy the cocycle condition in
its place.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedModuleSystemData
    (K : DerivedCategory (S.totalRingedTopos O).Modules) :
    { T : SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem S O //
      (∀ n, T.obj n = (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O n).obj K) ∧
      (∀ ⦃m n : SimplexCategory⦄ (φ : m ⟶ n),
        HEq (T.map φ) ((S.derivedComponentModuleTransition O φ).app K)) }
declarations.comment: the system (K_n, K(φ)) is a simplicial system of the derived category of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.derivedModuleSystem_cartesian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9P.** The simplicial system of a cartesian object of the derived category of
`O`-modules is cartesian: its transitions are the derived transitions, which are isomorphisms by
hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedModuleSystem_cartesian (K : DerivedCategory (S.totalRingedTopos O).Modules)
    (hK : S.IsCartesianDerivedModule O K) : (S.derivedModuleSystem O K).Cartesian
declarations.comment: if K is cartesian then so is the system

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.moduleResolutionTensorPostnikovSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Q(1).** For each length `N`, the triangles
`Yₙ₊₁ ⟶ Xₙ₊₁ ⟶ Yₙ ⟶ Yₙ₊₁[1]` with `Xₙ = (g_{n!}Oₙ) ⊗^L_O K` and
`Yₙ = (g_{n!}Oₙ → … → g_{0!}O₀)[-n] ⊗^L_O K` form a Postnikov system (Derived Categories,
Definition 0D7Z) for `X_N ⟶ ⋯ ⟶ X₁ ⟶ X₀`.

The triangles are the images under `- ⊗^L_O K` of the brutal-truncation triangles of the
resolution of Stacks 0D9B, and `- ⊗^L_O K` is exact by `isTriangulated_derivedTensorRight`;
the terms are the source's `Xₙ` by `moduleResolutionTensorTermIso`.
declarations.statement:
def moduleResolutionTensorPostnikovSystem (N : ℕ) :
    Triangulated.PostnikovSystem
      (fun i : Fin (N + 1) => (derivedTensorRight R T K).obj (moduleResolutionTerm D (i : ℕ)))
      (fun i : Fin N => (derivedTensorRight R T K).map (moduleResolutionTermDiff D (i : ℕ)))
declarations.comment: part (1), the Postnikov system of - ⊗^L_O K

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isHomotopyColimit_moduleResolutionTensorSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Q(2).** `K = hocolim Yₙ[n]` in `D(O)`, where
`Yₙ = (g_{n!}Oₙ → … → g_{0!}O₀)[-n] ⊗^L_O K`.

The system `Yₙ[n]` is the image under `- ⊗^L_O K` of the tower of brutal truncations of the
resolution of Stacks 0D9B, whose derived colimit is the structure sheaf
(`isHomotopyColimit_moduleResolutionSystem`, Stacks 0D9Q(2) for `O`); the functor `- ⊗^L_O K` is
exact and commutes with countable direct sums, so it carries that derived colimit to the derived
colimit of the images, and it sends `O` to `K` by `derivedTensorRightUnitIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomotopyColimit_moduleResolutionTensorSystem :
    IsHomotopyColimit (moduleResolutionSystem D ⋙ derivedTensorRight R T K) K
declarations.comment: part (2), the homotopy colimit, K = hocolim Yₙ[n] for Yₙ = (…)[-n] ⊗^L_O K

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.map_moduleResolutionPostnikovSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Q(1).** For an exact functor `T` of `D(O)` — such as `- ⊗^L_O K` for an object
`K` of `D(O)` — the images under `T` of the brutal-truncation triangles of the module
resolution are a Postnikov system for `T(X_N) ⟶ ⋯ ⟶ T(X₁) ⟶ T(X₀)`, where `Xₙ = g_{n!}Oₙ`.
declarations.statement:
def map_moduleResolutionPostnikovSystem
    (T : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} O) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} O))
    [T.CommShift ℤ] [T.IsTriangulated] (N : ℕ) :
    Triangulated.PostnikovSystem
      (fun i : Fin (N + 1) => T.obj (moduleResolutionTerm D (i : ℕ)))
      (fun i : Fin N => T.map (moduleResolutionTermDiff D (i : ℕ)))
declarations.comment: part (1), the Postnikov system, for an exact functor in place of - ⊗^L_O K

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.isHomotopyColimit_map_moduleResolutionSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Q(2).** For an exact functor `T` of `D(O)` commuting with countable direct
sums — such as `- ⊗^L_O K` for an object `K` of `D(O)`, for which `T(O) = K` — the object
`T(O)` is the derived colimit of the system `T(Yₙ[n])`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomotopyColimit_map_moduleResolutionSystem
    (T : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} O) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} O))
    [T.CommShift ℤ] [T.IsTriangulated]
    [PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor (moduleResolutionSystem D).obj) T] :
    IsHomotopyColimit (moduleResolutionSystem D ⋙ T)
      (T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} O) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit O)))
declarations.comment: part (2), the homotopy colimit, for an exact functor in place of - ⊗^L_O K

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.eq_zero_of_derivedComponentModuleRestriction_map_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9R.** In a simplicial-site situation (Stacks 09WE, either case) let `O` be a sheaf
of rings on the total site and `K, K'` objects of `D(O)`. Assume

1. `f_φ^{-1}O_n ⟶ O_m` is flat for every simplex map `φ`,
2. `K` is cartesian,
3. `Hom(K_i[i], K'_i) = 0` for `i > 0`, and
4. `Hom(K_i[i + 1], K'_i) = 0` for `i ≥ 0`.

Then a map `K ⟶ K'` inducing the zero map `K_0 ⟶ K'_0` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_derivedComponentModuleRestriction_map_eq_zero
    (K K' : DerivedCategory (S.totalRingedTopos O).Modules)
    (hflat : ∀ ⦃m n : SimplexCategory⦄ (φ : m ⟶ n), (S.transitionRingedToposHom O φ).IsFlat)
    (hK : S.IsCartesianDerivedModule O K)
    (hHom : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
      ∀ g : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory ((S.componentRingedTopos O ⦋i⦌).Modules)) (i : ℤ)).obj
          ((S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋i⦌).obj K) ⟶
        (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋i⦌).obj K', g = 0)
    (hHomSucc : ∀ i : ℕ,
      ∀ g : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory ((S.componentRingedTopos O ⦋i⦌).Modules))
            ((i : ℤ) + 1)).obj ((S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋i⦌).obj K) ⟶
        (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋i⦌).obj K', g = 0)
    (f : K ⟶ K')
    (hf : (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋0⦌).map f = 0) :
    f = 0

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.exists_hom_of_cartesian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9S.** In Situation 09WE, let `O` be a sheaf of rings on the total site and let
`K`, `K'` be objects of `D(O)`. Assume

1. the structure-sheaf transitions `f_φ^{-1}O_n ⟶ O_m` are flat,
2. `K` is cartesian, and
3. `Hom(K_i[i - 1], K'_i) = 0` for `i > 1`.

Then any morphism `{K_n ⟶ K'_n}` between the associated simplicial systems of the derived
category of modules comes from a morphism `K ⟶ K'` in `D(O)`.

The situation `S` is an arbitrary term of `CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation`, so both cases
of Situation 09WE are covered. The proof is the source's: the Postnikov system of Stacks 0D9Q
produces a morphism agreeing with the given one in degree zero
(`exists_hom_derivedComponentModuleRestriction_zero_eq`), and cartesianness of `K` makes it agree
in every degree (`SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem.Hom.app_eq_of_cartesian`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hom_of_cartesian
    (K K' : DerivedCategory (S.totalRingedTopos O).Modules)
    (hflat : ∀ (m n : SimplexCategory) (φ : m ⟶ n), (S.transitionRingedToposHom O φ).IsFlat)
    (hK : S.IsCartesianDerivedModule O K)
    (hHom : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 < i →
      ∀ g : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory ((S.componentRingedTopos O ⦋i⦌).Modules))
          ((i : ℤ) - 1)).obj ((S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋i⦌).obj K) ⟶
          (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O ⦋i⦌).obj K', g = 0)
    (f : SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem.Hom (S.derivedModuleSystem O K)
      (S.derivedModuleSystem O K')) :
    ∃ γ : K ⟶ K', ∀ i : SimplexCategory,
      (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O i).map γ = f.app i

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.exists_isCartesianDerivedModule_of_moduleSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9T.** In a simplicial-site situation (Stacks 09WE, either case) let `O` be a sheaf
of rings on the total site and let `(K_n, K_φ)` be a simplicial system of the derived category of
modules. Assume

1. `f_φ^{-1}O_n ⟶ O_m` is flat for every simplex map `φ`,
2. `(K_n, K_φ)` is cartesian, and
3. `Hom(K_i[t], K_i) = 0` for all `i` and all `t > 0`.

Then there exists a cartesian object `K` of `D(O)` whose associated simplicial system is
isomorphic to `(K_n, K_φ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isCartesianDerivedModule_of_moduleSystem
    (hflat : ∀ (n m : SimplexCategory) (φ : n ⟶ m), (S.transitionRingedToposHom O φ).IsFlat)
    (T : SimplicialDerivedModuleSystem S O) (hT : T.Cartesian)
    (hHom : ∀ (k : SimplexCategory) (t : ℕ), 0 < t →
      ∀ f : (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (S.componentRingedTopos O k).Modules)
        (t : ℤ)).obj (T.obj k) ⟶ T.obj k, f = 0) :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (S.totalRingedTopos O).Modules,
      S.IsCartesianDerivedModule O K ∧ Nonempty (T ≅ S.derivedModuleSystem O K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyLowerShriek_iso_directSum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U, part (3): the direct-sum formula.** In terms of the product decomposition of
part (2), `j_!` sends a family `(F i)` to `⨁ i, j_{i,!} F i`: both are left adjoint to `j^*`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def familyLowerShriek_iso_directSum :
    familyLowerShriek X K ≅ familyDirectSumLowerShriek X K
declarations.comment: part (3): j_! is the direct sum of the j_{i,!}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyLowerShriek_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U, part (3).** The lower shriek `j_!` is exact: it preserves finite colimits
because it is a left adjoint, and finite limits because it is the direct sum of the exact
functors `j_{i,!}`.
declarations.statement: theorem familyLowerShriek_exact : exactFunctor _ _ (familyLowerShriek X K)
declarations.comment: part (3): j_! is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.lowerShriekModules_iso_familyLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U, part (3).** The lower shriek of the morphism of ringed topoi `j` — the left
adjoint of the pullback `j^*` of sheaves of modules, which is what the source means by `j_!` —
is `familyLowerShriek` up to the equivalence by which `j^*` differs from restriction.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def lowerShriekModules_iso_familyLowerShriek :
    (familyLocalizationMorphism X K).lowerShriekModules ≅
      (familyPullbackScalarsEquivalence X K).inverse ⋙ familyLowerShriek X K
declarations.comment: part (3): j_! is the left adjoint of the pullback of modules along j

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.lowerShriekModules_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U, part (3).** The lower shriek of the morphism of ringed topoi `j`, the left
adjoint of `j^*`, is exact: it is `familyLowerShriek`, which is exact, composed with an
equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerShriekModules_exact (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u}) (K : FormalCoproduct.{u} X.C) :
    exactFunctor _ _ ((familyLocalizationMorphism X K).lowerShriekModules)
declarations.comment: part (3): the left adjoint of j^* is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.morphismRestr_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0D9U.** `f^*` has a left adjoint `f_!`.
declarations.statement: instance morphismRestr_isRightAdjoint : (morphismRestr X f).IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: f^* has a left adjoint f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.morphismLowerShriek_iso_directSum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** In terms of the product decomposition of part (2), `f_!` sends a family
`(F i)` to `⨁ i, f_{i,!} F i`: both are left adjoint to `f^*`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def morphismLowerShriek_iso_directSum :
    (morphismRestr X f).leftAdjoint ≅
      (componentwiseModuleRestrictionEquivalence X K).functor ⋙
        piCoproduct (morphismComponentLowerShriek X f)
declarations.comment: f_! is the direct sum of the componentwise lower shrieks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.morphismLowerShriek_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** The lower shriek `f_!` is exact: it preserves finite colimits because it
is a left adjoint, and finite limits because it is the direct sum of the exact functors
`f_{i,!}`, coproducts of sheaves of modules being exact.
declarations.statement: theorem morphismLowerShriek_exact : exactFunctor _ _ (morphismRestr X f).leftAdjoint
declarations.comment: f_! is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphism_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** The morphism of ringed topoi induced by a morphism of semi-representable
objects is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyMorphism_isFlat (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w r})
    {K L : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{max u v w, max u v w,
        max u v w r, max u v w, max u v w, max u v w r}
      (familyMorphism.{w, v, u, r} X f).val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyLocalizationMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U, part (3).** The localization morphism
`j : (Sh(C / K), O_K) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_X)` of ringed topoi attached to a semi-representable object
`K`: its geometric morphism is restriction along the componentwise localization functor and its
structure map is the canonical identity comparison of structure sheaves.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def familyLocalizationMorphism (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w})
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C) :
    RingedToposHom (localizationRingedTopos X K) (ringedTopos.{u, v, w} X)
declarations.comment: part (3): the localization morphism j of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyLocalizationMorphism_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** The localization morphism `j` is flat: its inverse-image structure map is
an isomorphism, and an isomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyLocalizationMorphism_isFlat (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w})
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlatMapULift
      (familyLocalizationMorphism X K).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: part (3): j is flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyLocalizationMorphism_pullback_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the localization morphism is exact,
the morphism being flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyLocalizationMorphism_pullback_exact (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w})
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C) :
    exactFunctor _ _ (Stacks.Sheaves.RingedToposModules.RingedToposHom.pullbackModules
      (X := localizationRingedTopos X K) (Y := ringedTopos.{u, v, w} X)
      (familyLocalizationMorphism X K).toRingedToposModulesHom)
declarations.comment: part (3): j^* is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyLocalizationMorphism_pullback_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the localization morphism has a left
adjoint `j_!`, namely `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.lowerShriekModules` of that morphism:
the structure map is an isomorphism, and the inverse image of sheaves of modules is restriction
along the componentwise localization functor, which has a left adjoint because `C / K` is
essentially small.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyLocalizationMorphism_pullback_isRightAdjoint (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w})
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C) :
    (familyLocalizationMorphism X K).toModulesHom.pullbackModules.IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (3): j^* has a left adjoint j_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphism_pullback_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the morphism of ringed topoi attached
to a morphism `f : K ⟶ L` of semi-representable objects has a left adjoint `f_!`, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.lowerShriekModules` of that morphism: the structure map is an
isomorphism and the inverse image of sheaves of modules is restriction along the componentwise
relocalization functor, which has a left adjoint because `C / K` is essentially small.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyMorphism_pullback_isRightAdjoint (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w})
    {K L : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    (familyMorphism.{w, v, u, u} X f).val.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (3): f^* has a left adjoint f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyComponentInclLowerShriek_comp_familyLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U, part (3).** On the `i`-th summand of the decomposition
`Mod(O_K) = ∏ Mod(O_{U i})` the lower shriek `j_!` is the extension by zero `j_{i,!}` of that
component: the inclusion of the `i`-th component followed by the componentwise localization
functor is the localization functor of `U i`, so the two left adjoints agree. This is the
sentence of the source that `j_!` sends `(F i)` to `⨁ j_{i,!} F i`, read one summand at a
time.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def familyComponentInclLowerShriek_comp_familyLowerShriek
    (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C) (i : K.I) :
    familyComponentInclLowerShriek X K i ⋙ familyLowerShriek X K ≅
      familyComponentLowerShriek X K i
declarations.comment: part (3): j_! is j_{i,!} on the i-th summand
