declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** A morphism of semi-representable objects induces a morphism of the ringed
topoi of their componentwise localizations: its inverse image on sheaves of sets is restriction
along the componentwise relocalization functor, and its structure map is the canonical identity
comparison, which is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def familyMorphism (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w r})
    {K L : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    let S : LocalizationSites.{w} X.C X.J := ⟨K, L, f⟩
    { g : RingedToposHom (localizationRingedTopos X K) (localizationRingedTopos X L) //
      (g.toToposHom.inverseImage ⋙
          sheafToPresheaf S.sourceTopology (Type (max u v w r)) =
        sheafToPresheaf S.targetTopology (Type (max u v w r)) ⋙
          (CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj S.relocalizationFunctor.op) ∧
      (∃ h : (localizationRingedTopos X K).forgetRing.obj
          ((inverseImageCommRingFunctor g.toToposHom).obj
            (localizationRingedTopos X L).O) =
          (localizationRingedTopos X K).forgetRing.obj (localizationRingedTopos X K).O,
        (localizationRingedTopos X K).forgetRing.map g.fSharpInverseImage =
          eqToHom h) ∧
      IsIso g.fSharpInverseImage }
declarations.comment: family_morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphism_pullback_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9U.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the morphism of ringed topoi induced
by a morphism of semi-representable objects is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyMorphism_pullback_exact (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w r})
    {K L : FormalCoproduct.{w} X.C} (f : K ⟶ L)
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J K).HasSheafCompose
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v w r} RingCat.{max u v w r})]
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J L).HasSheafCompose
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v w r} RingCat.{max u v w r})]
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J K).HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{max u v w r})]
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J L).HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{max u v w r})]
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J K).HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w r})]
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J L).HasSheafCompose (forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w r})]
    [HasWeakSheafify (componentwiseTopology X.J K) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w r}]
    [(componentwiseTopology X.J K).WEqualsLocallyBijective
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w r}] :
    exactFunctor _ _
      ((familyMorphism.{w, v, u, r} X f).val.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules)
declarations.comment: f_flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationToposMorphismOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V, part (3).** The geometric morphism `Sh(C / K) ⟶ Sh(C / Y)` underlying the
localization morphism of a semi-representable object `K` over `Y`: its inverse image is
restriction along the componentwise localization functor `C / K ⥤ C / Y` and its direct image is
the right adjoint of that restriction.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def localizationToposMorphismOver (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C}
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (componentwiseTopology X.J (underlyingFormalCoproduct X K)) (Type (max u v w)))
      (Sheaf (X.J.over Y) (Type (max u v w)))
declarations.comment: part (3): the geometric morphism underlying the localization over Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationStructureIsoOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V, part (3).** The structure map of the localization morphism over `Y`, in
inverse-image form: the inverse image of `O_Y` along restriction is the restriction of `O_Y`,
and that restriction is `O_K` because the composite of the componentwise localization functor
with the slice projection is the componentwise localization functor to `C`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def localizationStructureIsoOver (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C}
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)) :
    (inverseImageCommRingFunctor (localizationToposMorphismOver X K)).obj
        (ringedTopos.{max u v, v, w} (X.over Y)).O ≅
      (localizationRingedTopos X (underlyingFormalCoproduct X K)).O
declarations.comment: part (3): the structure map of the localization over Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationMorphismOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V, part (3).** The localization morphism
`j : (Sh(C / K), O_K) ⟶ (Sh(C / Y), O_Y)` of ringed topoi attached to a semi-representable
object `K` over `Y`: its geometric morphism is restriction along the componentwise localization
functor and its structure map is the canonical identity comparison of structure sheaves.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def localizationMorphismOver (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C}
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)) :
    RingedToposHom (localizationRingedTopos X (underlyingFormalCoproduct X K))
      (ringedTopos.{max u v, v, w} (X.over Y))
declarations.comment: part (3): the localization morphism of ringed topoi over Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.forgetRing_localizationMorphismOver_fSharpInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V, part (3).** The structure map of the localization morphism over `Y` is the
canonical identity comparison: on underlying sheaves of sets it is the identification
`forgetRing_inverseImage_structureSheaf_over` and nothing more.
declarations.statement:
theorem forgetRing_localizationMorphismOver_fSharpInverseImage
    (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C} (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)) :
    (localizationRingedTopos X (underlyingFormalCoproduct X K)).forgetRing.map
        (localizationMorphismOver X K).fSharpInverseImage =
      eqToHom (forgetRing_inverseImage_structureSheaf_over X K)
declarations.comment: part (3): the structure map of the localization over Y is the identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationMorphismOver_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V.** The localization morphism over `Y` is flat: its inverse-image structure map
is an isomorphism, and an isomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizationMorphismOver_isFlat (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C}
    (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlatMapULift
      (localizationMorphismOver X K).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: flatness of the localization morphism over Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationMorphismOver_pullback_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the localization morphism over `Y` is
exact, the morphism being flat.
declarations.comment: exactness of the pullback of modules along the localization over Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationMorphismOver_pullback_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the localization morphism over `Y`
has a left adjoint `j_!`, namely `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.lowerShriekModules` of that
morphism: the structure map is an isomorphism, and the inverse image of sheaves of modules is
restriction along the componentwise localization functor, which has a left adjoint because
`C / K` is essentially small.
declarations.statement:
theorem localizationMorphismOver_pullback_isRightAdjoint (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w})
    {Y : X.C} (K : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)) :
    (localizationMorphismOver X K).toModulesHom.pullbackModules.IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: the left adjoint of the pullback of modules along the localization over Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphismOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V, part (4).** The morphism of ringed topoi
`(Sh(C / K), O_K) ⟶ (Sh(C / L), O_L)` attached to a morphism `K ⟶ L` of semi-representable
objects over `Y`: it is the morphism of Stacks 0D9U attached to the induced morphism of the
underlying semi-representable objects of `C`, since neither the two localization sites nor their
structure sheaves see the structural maps to `Y`. Its inverse image and its structure map are
specified by `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphism`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def familyMorphismOver (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C}
    {K L : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    RingedToposHom (localizationRingedTopos X (underlyingFormalCoproduct X K))
      (localizationRingedTopos X (underlyingFormalCoproduct X L))
declarations.comment: part (4): the morphism of ringed topoi attached to a morphism of SR(C, Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphismOver_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V.** The morphism attached to a morphism of `SR(C, Y)` is flat. This is the
corresponding clause of Stacks 0D9U for the induced morphism of underlying semi-representable
objects of `C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyMorphismOver_isFlat (X : RingedSite.{u, v, max u v w}) {Y : X.C}
    {K L : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlatMapULift
      (familyMorphismOver X f).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: flatness of the morphism attached to a morphism of SR(C, Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphismOver_pullback_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the morphism attached to a morphism of
`SR(C, Y)` is exact, that morphism being flat.
declarations.comment: exactness of the pullback of modules along a morphism of SR(C, Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.familyMorphismOver_pullback_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9V.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along the morphism attached to a morphism of
`SR(C, Y)` has a left adjoint `f_!`, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.lowerShriekModules` of that morphism: the structure map is an
isomorphism and the inverse image of sheaves of modules is restriction along the componentwise
relocalization functor, which has a left adjoint because `C / K` is essentially small.
declarations.comment: the left adjoint of the pullback of modules along a morphism of SR(C, Y)

registrations.comment: part (1): the structure sheaf O_K

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, total ringed site.** The total localization of a simplicial
semi-representable object `K` of the underlying site of a ringed site `X`, equipped with the
pulled-back structure sheaf `a⁻¹O_C`.
declarations.statement:
def totalRingedSite (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C)) : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite
declarations.comment: total_ringed_site

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.degreewiseRingedAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, degreewise ringed augmentations.** For a simplicial semi-representable
object `K` of the underlying site of a ringed site `X`, each simplicial degree carries a
morphism of ringed topoi `a_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)` from the localization at the
degree-`n` term to the ambient ringed topos.
declarations.statement:
def degreewiseRingedAugmentation (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, max x u v w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C)) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom
      (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationRingedTopos X (K.obj (op n)))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.ringedTopos.{u, v, max x w} X)
declarations.comment: degreewise_ringed_augmentations

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, ringed augmentation.** For a simplicial semi-representable object `K` of the
underlying site of a ringed site `X`, the total ringed site is augmented over `X` by a morphism
of ringed topoi `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)`.
declarations.comment: ringed_augmentation

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.ringedTransitionMorphism_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, flat transition morphisms.** For a simplicial semi-representable object `K`
of the underlying site of a ringed site `X`, the morphism of ringed topoi attached to a simplex
map `φ : [m] ⟶ [n]` is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedTransitionMorphism_isFlat
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, max x u v w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C))
    {m n : SimplexCategory} (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{max u v x, max u v x,
        max x u v w, max u v x, max u v x, max x u v w}
      (ringedTransitionMorphism.{x, u, v, w} X K φ).val
declarations.comment: flat_transition_morphisms

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.degreewiseRingedAugmentation_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, flat degreewise augmentations.** For a simplicial semi-representable object
`K` of the underlying site of a ringed site `X`, the morphism of ringed topoi
`a_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)` is flat in every simplicial degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem degreewiseRingedAugmentation_isFlat
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, max x u v w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C)) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{max u v x, max u v x,
        max x u v w, v, u, max x u v w}
      (degreewiseRingedAugmentation.{x, u, v, w} X K n)
declarations.comment: flat_degreewise_augmentations

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedAugmentation_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, flat augmentation.** For a simplicial semi-representable object `K` of the
underlying site of a ringed site `X`, the augmentation
`a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)` of the total ringed site is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalRingedAugmentation_isFlat (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C)) :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{v, max u v x,
        max x u v w, v, u, max x u v w}
      (totalRingedAugmentation.{x, u, v, w} X K)
declarations.comment: flat_augmentation

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalLowerShriekAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, item (4).** For a simplicial semi-representable object `K` of the underlying
site of a ringed site `X`, the inverse image `a^*` of sheaves of modules along the augmentation of
the total ringed site has a left adjoint `a_! : Mod(O) ⥤ Mod(O_C)`.
declarations.statement:
def totalLowerShriekAdjunction :
    totalLowerShriek.{x, u, v, w} X K ⊣ totalInverseImageModules.{x, u, v, w} X K
declarations.comment: lower_shriek

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.degreewiseLowerShriekAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, the degreewise lower shriek.** The inverse image `a_n^*` of sheaves of modules
along the degreewise augmentation `a_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)` has a left adjoint
`a_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_C)`.

Exactness of `a_{n!}`, which the source asserts as well, is
`CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_degreewiseLowerShriek`.
declarations.comment: degreewise_lower_shriek_adjunction

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_degreewiseLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, exactness of the degreewise lower shriek.** The functor
`a_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_C)` left adjoint to the inverse image `a_n^*` of the degreewise
augmentation is exact.

Right exactness is formal, `a_{n!}` being a left adjoint. Left exactness is the direct-sum
formula: the sections of `a_{n!}G` over `V` are the sum, over the pairs `(i, V ⟶ K_{n,i})`, of
the sections of `G` at the corresponding object of the slice site, so `a_{n!}` is injective on
sections as soon as `G ⟶ G'` is. That is the content of
`Stacks.Sites.ReducedLowerShriek.lowerShriek_exact` at the reduction data
`CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.localizationReduction`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exactFunctor_degreewiseLowerShriek :
    exactFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{max x u v w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationRingedTopos X (K.obj (op n))).O))
      (SheafOfModules.{max x u v w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
      (degreewiseLowerShriek.{x, u, v, w} X K n)
declarations.comment: degreewise_lower_shriek_exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.transitionLowerShriekAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, the lower shriek of a transition morphism.** For a simplex map
`φ : [m] ⟶ [n]`, the inverse image `f_φ^*` of sheaves of modules along the transition morphism of
ringed topoi `f_φ : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C/K_m), O_m)` has a left adjoint
`f_{φ!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_m)`.

Exactness of `f_{φ!}`, which the source asserts as well, is
`CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_transitionLowerShriek`.
declarations.statement:
def transitionLowerShriekAdjunction (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    transitionLowerShriek.{x, u, v, w} X K φ ⊣ transitionInverseImageModules.{x, u, v, w} X K φ
declarations.comment: transition_lower_shriek_adjunction

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_transitionLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, exactness of the lower shriek of a transition morphism.** For a simplex map
`φ : [m] ⟶ [n]`, the functor `f_{φ!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_m)` left adjoint to the inverse image
`f_φ^*` is exact.

Right exactness is formal, `f_{φ!}` being a left adjoint. Left exactness is the direct-sum
formula: the sections of `f_{φ!}G` over an object `W` of the degree-`m` localization are the sum,
over the components `i` of `K_n` and the arrows `W.left ⟶ K_{n,i}` under `K(φ)`, of the sections
of `G` at the corresponding object of the slice site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exactFunctor_transitionLowerShriek (φ : m ⟶ n) :
    exactFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{max x u v w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImageRing
        (componentwiseTopology X.J (K.obj (op n))) (componentwiseTopology X.J (K.obj (op m)))
        (⟨K.obj (op n), K.obj (op m), K.map φ.op⟩ :
          LocalizationSites.{x} X.C X.J).relocalizationFunctor
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
          (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationRingedTopos X (K.obj (op m))).O)))
      (SheafOfModules.{max x u v w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.localizationRingedTopos X (K.obj (op m))).O))
      (transitionLowerShriek.{x, u, v, w} X K φ)
declarations.comment: transition_lower_shriek_exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.componentRingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, the morphism of a simplicial degree into the total ringed site.** For a
simplicial semi-representable object `K` of the underlying site of a ringed site `X`, the
degree-`n` componentwise localization is a ringed topos over the total ringed site by a morphism
of ringed topoi `g_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh((C/K)_total), O)`.
declarations.comment: component_morphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.componentRingedMorphism_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, flat component morphism.** The morphism of ringed topoi
`g_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh((C/K)_total), O)` is flat: its structure map in inverse-image form
is the identification of `g_n⁻¹O` with `O_n`, hence an isomorphism, and an isomorphism of sheaves
of commutative rings is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedMorphism_isFlat :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{max x u v, max x u v,
        max x u v w, v, max u v x, max x u v w}
      (componentRingedMorphism.{x, u, v, w} X K n)
declarations.comment: flat_component_morphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.componentLowerShriekAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, the lower shriek of a component morphism.** The inverse image `g_n^*` of
sheaves of modules along `g_n` has a left adjoint `g_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O)`.

Exactness of `g_{n!}`, which the source asserts as well, is
`CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_componentLowerShriek`.
declarations.statement:
def componentLowerShriekAdjunction :
    componentLowerShriek.{x, u, v, w} X K n ⊣ componentInverseImageModules.{x, u, v, w} X K n
declarations.comment: component_lower_shriek_adjunction

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_componentLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, exactness of the lower shriek of a component morphism.** The functor
`g_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O)` left adjoint to the inverse image `g_n^*` is exact.

This is Stacks 0D74 for the `Comma`-category model of the total site: right exactness is formal,
`g_{n!}` being a left adjoint, and left exactness is the direct-sum formula, whose index set at
an object `Z` of the total site is `componentFibre` — a component of `K_n`, a simplex map
`Z.right ⟶ [n]` and an arrow of the ambient site into that component. The simplex maps are the
`φ : [n] ⟶ [m]` of the direct-sum formula of Tag 0D72. The flatness hypothesis of 0D74 is not
needed here: the structure sheaf of the total site is pulled back from the ambient site, so it
does not see the arrow along which a summand is taken.
declarations.statement:
theorem exactFunctor_componentLowerShriek :
    exactFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{max x u v w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImageRing
        (componentwiseTopology X.J (K.obj (op n))) (totalLocalizationTopology K X.J)
        (componentInclusion K n) (pulledBackRingSheaf X K)))
      (SheafOfModules.{max x u v w} (pulledBackRingSheaf X K))
      (componentLowerShriek.{x, u, v, w} X K n)
declarations.comment: component_lower_shriek_exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.pulledBackStructureSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, pulled-back structure sheaf.** For the canonical localization
augmentation attached to `K`, set `O = a⁻¹ O_C`. This is restriction along `j_total`,
viewed as a sheaf valued in commutative rings.
declarations.comment: pulled_back_structure_sheaf

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedSiteOver
declarations.doc:
For a ringed site `(C, O_C)`, an object `U` of `C` and a simplicial object `K` of
`SR(C, U) = SR(C/U)`, the total localization site `(C/K)_total` of `K` over the slice site `C/U`,
with the structure sheaf `O = a⁻¹O_U` pulled back from `O_U = O_C|_{C/U}`.
declarations.statement: abbrev totalRingedSiteOver : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite
declarations.comment: item (1): the ringed site ((C/K)_total, O)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedAugmentationOver

The augmentation `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/U), O_U)` of the total ringed site of a
simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, as a morphism of ringed topoi.
declarations.comment: item (2): the morphism of ringed topoi a

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.degreewiseRingedAugmentationOver
declarations.doc:
The degreewise augmentations `a_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C/U), O_U)` of a simplicial
object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, as morphisms of ringed topoi.
declarations.comment: item (3): the morphisms of ringed topoi a_n

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalLowerShriekOverAdjunction
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, the functor `a_! : Mod(O) ⥤ Mod(O_U)` is left
adjoint to the pullback `a^*` of sheaves of modules along the augmentation
`a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/U), O_U)`.
declarations.comment: item (4): a_! is left adjoint to a^*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedAugmentationOver_isFlat
declarations.doc:
The augmentation `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/U), O_U)` of a simplicial object `K` of
`SR(C, U)` is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem totalRingedAugmentationOver_isFlat :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{v, max u v x,
        max x u v w, v, max u v, max x u v w}
      (totalRingedAugmentationOver.{x, u, v, w} X U K)
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: a is flat

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.degreewiseRingedAugmentationOver_isFlat
declarations.doc:
Every degreewise augmentation `a_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C/U), O_U)` of a simplicial
object `K` of `SR(C, U)` is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem degreewiseRingedAugmentationOver_isFlat (n : SimplexCategory) :
    Stacks.Sheaf.RingedToposFlat.RingedToposHom.IsFlat.{max u v x, max u v x,
        max x u v w, v, max u v, max x u v w}
      (degreewiseRingedAugmentationOver.{x, u, v, w} X U K n)
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: a_n is flat

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.degreewiseLowerShriekOverAdjunction
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, the inverse image `a_n^*` of sheaves of modules
along the degreewise augmentation `a_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C/U), O_U)` has the left adjoint
`a_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_U)`.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: a_{n!} is left adjoint to a_n^*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_degreewiseLowerShriekOver
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, the functor `a_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_U)` is
exact.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: a_{n!} is exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.ringedTransitionMorphismOver_isFlat
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)` and a simplex map `φ : [m] ⟶ [n]`, the morphism of
ringed topoi `f_φ : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh(C/K_m), O_m)` is flat.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: f_φ is flat

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.transitionLowerShriekOverAdjunction
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)` and a simplex map `φ : [m] ⟶ [n]`, the inverse image
`f_φ^*` of sheaves of modules has the left adjoint `f_{φ!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_m)`.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: f_{φ!} is left adjoint to f_φ^*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_transitionLowerShriekOver
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)` and a simplex map `φ : [m] ⟶ [n]`, the functor
`f_{φ!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O_m)` is exact.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: f_{φ!} is exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.componentRingedMorphismOver_isFlat
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, the morphism of ringed topoi
`g_n : (Sh(C/K_n), O_n) ⟶ (Sh((C/K)_total), O)` is flat.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: g_n is flat

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.componentLowerShriekOverAdjunction
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, the inverse image `g_n^*` of sheaves of modules
along `g_n` has the left adjoint `g_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O)`.
declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: g_{n!} is left adjoint to g_n^*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.exactFunctor_componentLowerShriekOver
declarations.doc:
For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C, U)`, the functor `g_{n!} : Mod(O_n) ⥤ Mod(O)` is

declarations.comment: the results of 0D9W: g_{n!} is exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedSite
declarations.doc:
The total localization of a simplicial semi-representable object over a ringed site, together
with its pulled-back structure sheaf, is a ringed site.
declarations.statement:
def totalRingedSite (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C)) : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite
declarations.comment: ringed_total_site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.ringedAugmentation
declarations.doc:
The total localization of a simplicial semi-representable object over a ringed site has a
canonical augmentation to the base as a morphism of ringed topoi.
declarations.comment: ringed_augmentation

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SemiRepresentable.Simplicial.totalRingedSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9W, total ringed site.** The total localization of a simplicial
semi-representable object `K` of the underlying site of a ringed site `X`, equipped with the
pulled-back structure sheaf `a⁻¹O_C`.
declarations.statement:
def totalRingedSite (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.{u, v, w})
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{x} X.C)) : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite
declarations.comment: ringed_total_site

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, the inclusion of the essential image in the cartesian modules.** Every sheaf
of `O`-modules on the total site isomorphic to a pullback `a^*F` along the ringed augmentation is
a cartesian `O`-module.

This is Stacks 0D7H (3) together with invariance of the cartesian condition under isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf A.O)}
    (hF : A.totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F) :
    S.IsModuleFiberTransitionIso A.O F
declarations.comment: the essential image of a^* consists of cartesian O-modules. Faithfulness of a^* is `faithful_pullbackModules`; fullness of a^*, and essential surjectivity onto the cartesian O-modules making a_* a quasi-inverse, are not proved

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.faithful_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, the faithfulness half.** Let `C` be a site with equalizers and fibre products,
`K` a hypercovering of its final presheaf, and `a` the augmentation of the total site of `K`
towards `C`. For a ringed augmentation along `a` whose structure map is the identification
`O = a^{-1}O_C` of Stacks 0D9W, the pullback `a^* : Mod(O_C) ⥤ Mod(O)` of sheaves of modules is
faithful.

Because the structure map is that identification, the underlying sheaf of sets of `a^*M` is the
inverse image of the underlying sheaf of `M`; faithfulness then descends from Stacks 0D8E (1),
faithfulness of `a^{-1}` on sheaves of sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_pullbackModules [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage] :
    A.totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.Faithful
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is faithful, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C. The essential-image inclusion is `isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage`; fullness of a^*, and essential surjectivity onto the cartesian O-modules making a_* a quasi-inverse, are not proved

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.full_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, the fullness half.** For a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose
structure map is the identification `O = a^{-1}O_C` of Stacks 0D9W, the pullback
`a^* : Mod(O_C) ⥤ Mod(O)` of sheaves of modules is full.

Because the structure map is that identification, the pullback of modules is the Stacks 03D2
inverse image of modules followed by an equivalence; fullness then descends from Stacks 0D8E (1),
full faithfulness of `a^{-1}` on sheaves of sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem full_pullbackModules [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage] :
    A.totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.Full
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is full, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.fullyFaithfulPullbackModules
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0D9Z, full faithfulness of `a^*` on sheaves of modules.**
declarations.statement:
def fullyFaithfulPullbackModules [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage] :
    A.totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is fully faithful, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.essImage_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, essential surjectivity onto the cartesian `O`-modules.** For a ringed
augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification `O = a^{-1}O_C` of
Stacks 0D9W, every cartesian sheaf of `O`-modules on the total site is a pullback `a^*M`.

The underlying sheaf of sets of a cartesian sheaf of modules is cartesian, hence an inverse image
by Stacks 0D8E (1); and a sheaf of modules whose underlying sheaf of sets is an inverse image is a
pullback.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_pullbackModules [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage]
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation P.toGrothendieck H.toSimplicialObject).totalTopology) A.O))}
    (hF : (situation P.toGrothendieck H.toSimplicialObject).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso A.O F) :
    A.totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F
declarations.comment: every cartesian O-module is an a^*M, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.mem_essImage_pullbackModules_iff_isCartesianModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, the essential image of `a^*` is exactly the cartesian `O`-modules.** One
inclusion is `isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage`, which is Stacks 0D7H (3); the other is
`essImage_pullbackModules`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_pullbackModules_iff_isCartesianModule
    [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation P.toGrothendieck H.toSimplicialObject).totalTopology) A.O))) :
    A.totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F ↔
      (situation P.toGrothendieck H.toSimplicialObject).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso A.O F
declarations.comment: the essential image of a^* on sheaves of modules is exactly the cartesian O-modules, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on `Mod(O_C)`.** The unit `M ⟶ a_*a^*M` of the
adjunction of Stacks 03D7 is an isomorphism for every sheaf of `O_C`-modules: a fully faithful
left adjoint has invertible unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit
    [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage] :
    IsIso (RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules A.totalRingedHom).unit
declarations.comment: M = a_* a^* M on sheaves of modules, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedAugmentation.isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_counit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0D9Z, `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on the cartesian `O`-modules.** The counit
`a^*a_*F ⟶ F` of the adjunction of Stacks 03D7 is an isomorphism at every cartesian sheaf of
`O`-modules: a fully faithful left adjoint has invertible counit exactly on its essential image,
which by `mem_essImage_pullbackModules_iff_isCartesianModule` is the cartesian `O`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_counit_app
    [IsIso A.totalRingedHom.fSharpInverseImage]
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation P.toGrothendieck H.toSimplicialObject).totalTopology) A.O))}
    (hF : (situation P.toGrothendieck H.toSimplicialObject).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso A.O F) :
    IsIso ((RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules A.totalRingedHom).counit.app F)
declarations.comment: a^* a_* F = F for a cartesian O-module F, for a ringed augmentation of a hypercovering whose structure map is the identification O = a^{-1}O_C

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_of_hypercoveringOfTerminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA0, as an invertible natural transformation.** For a site `C` with equalizers
and fibre products, a sheaf of commutative rings `O_C` on it and a hypercovering `K` of `C`, the
canonical map `E ⟶ Ra_*La^*E` along the ringed augmentation of Stacks 0D9W is an isomorphism,
naturally in `E` in the unbounded derived category `D(O_C)`. Nothing is assumed beyond the
hypercovering conditions on `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_of_hypercoveringOfTerminal :
    IsIso (RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit
      (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation P H OC).totalRingedHom)

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA1.** Let `C` be a site with equalizers and fibre products, let `O_C` be a sheaf of
commutative rings on it and let `K` be a hypercovering of `C`. With `O = a⁻¹O_C` on the total
site and `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)` the ringed augmentation of Stacks 0D9W, there
is a canonical isomorphism

`RΓ(C, E) = RΓ((C/K)_total, La^*E)`

naturally in `E` in the unbounded derived category `D(O_C)`. Here `RΓ(C, -)` takes values in
`D(Γ(C, O_C))`, and the right hand side, which lives in `D(Γ((C/K)_total, O))`, is read in
`D(Γ(C, O_C))` through restriction of scalars along the ring map `Γ(C, O_C) ⟶ Γ((C/K)_total, O)`
induced by `a`. Nothing is assumed beyond the hypercovering conditions on `K`. The forward map is
pinned to the canonical one by `derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering_hom_app`.

This is the complete statement of the tag, and it supersedes the conditional
`derivedGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering` of `HypercoveringModuleDerivedGlobalSections`,
which no longer carries the tag: that isomorphism is read only in `D(Ab)` and takes as
hypotheses `hunit` (the module form of Stacks 0D8E), `hacyclic` (`a^*` of a K-injective complex
computes `Ra_*`) and `hΓ` (the underived identity `Γ(C, a_*F) = Γ((C/K)_total, F)`). All three
are theorems, and `derivedGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercoveringOfTerminal` below is that
isomorphism with them supplied.
declarations.statement:
def derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering :
    RingedTopos.derivedLinearGlobalSections
        (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos ≅
      (RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
          (X := (hypercoveringSituation J H).totalRingedTopos
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).O)
          (Y := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos)
          (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom).functor ⋙
        RingedTopos.derivedLinearGlobalSections
          ((hypercoveringSituation J H).totalRingedTopos
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).O) ⋙
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (globalSectionsRingHom
          (X := (hypercoveringSituation J H).totalRingedTopos
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).O)
          (Y := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos)
          (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom)).mapDerivedCategory

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering_hom_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA1, the isomorphism is the canonical one.** At every `E` of `D(O_C)` its forward
map is `RΓ(C, -)` of the derived unit `E ⟶ Ra_*La^*E` of the ringed augmentation, followed by the
factorisation `RΓ(C, Ra_*-) = RΓ((C/K)_total, -)` of Stacks 08J6.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering_hom_app
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos.J))
      (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos.O))) :
    (derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPullbackIsoOfHypercovering J H OC).hom.app E =
      (RingedTopos.derivedLinearGlobalSections
          (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos).map
          ((RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom).app E) ≫
        (RingedToposHom.derivedLinearGlobalSectionsPushforwardIso
          (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom).hom.app
          ((RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
            (X := (hypercoveringSituation J H).totalRingedTopos
              (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).O)
            (Y := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos)
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom).functor.obj E)
declarations.comment: the forward map of the isomorphism is the canonical one: RΓ(C, -) of the derived unit E ⟶ Ra_*La^*E, followed by the factorisation of Tag 08J6

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_derivedPullbackEquivalence_hypercoveringOfTerminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA2.** Let `C` be a site with equalizers and fibre products, let `O_C` be a sheaf
of commutative rings on it and let `K` be a hypercovering of `C`; let
`a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C), O_C)` be the ringed augmentation of Stacks 0D9W, so
`O = a⁻¹O_C`. Then the cartesian `O`-modules `𝒜 ⊂ Mod(O)` form a weak Serre subcategory, and the
functor `La^*` defines an equivalence

`D⁺(O_C) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜(O)`

with quasi-inverse `R a_*`: there is an equivalence of categories whose functor is the restriction
of the derived pullback `La^*` to the bounded below subcategories and whose inverse is the
restriction of the derived direct image `R a_*`. Here `D⁺(O_C)` is the full subcategory of
bounded below objects of `D(O_C)`, and `D⁺_𝒜(O)` that of bounded below objects of `D(O)` all of
whose cohomology modules are cartesian. Nothing is assumed beyond the hypotheses of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedPullbackEquivalence_hypercoveringOfTerminal :
    (hypercoveringCartesianModules J H OC).IsWeakSerreClass ∧
      ∃ e : (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget
          (Y := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos)).FullSubcategory ≌
        (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty
          (hypercoveringCartesianModules J H OC)).FullSubcategory,
        e.functor = AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPlus
          (X := (hypercoveringSituation J H).totalRingedTopos
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).O)
          (Y := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos)
          (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom
          (hypercoveringCartesianModules J H OC)
          (isCartesianModule_pullbackModules_hypercovering J H OC) ∧
        e.inverse = AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPushforwardPlus
          (X := (hypercoveringSituation J H).totalRingedTopos
            (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).O)
          (Y := (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).augmentationRingedTopos)
          (hypercoveringRingedAugmentation J H OC).totalRingedHom
          (hypercoveringCartesianModules J H OC)
declarations.comment: cartesian O-modules are weak Serre; La^* : D⁺(O_C) ≌ D⁺_𝒜(O), inverse Ra_*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.faithful_pullbackModules_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, the faithfulness half.** Let `C` be a site with fibre products, `X` an object
of it, `O_C` a sheaf of commutative rings on `C` and `K` a hypercovering of `X`. With
`O_X = O_C|_{C/X}` and `O = a⁻¹O_X`, the pullback `a^* : Mod(O_X) ⥤ Mod(O)` of sheaves of
modules along the augmentation of the total site of `K` over `C/X` is faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_pullbackModules_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.Faithful
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is faithful. The essential-image inclusion is `isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_over`; fullness of a^*, and essential surjectivity onto the cartesian O-modules making a_* a quasi-inverse, are not proved

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, the inclusion of the essential image in the cartesian modules.** In the
situation above, every sheaf of `O`-modules on the total site isomorphic to a pullback `a^*F` is
a cartesian `O`-module.

This is Stacks 0D7H (3) together with invariance of the cartesian condition under
isomorphism, and uses no condition on `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_over
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology))
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O)}
    (hF : (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F) :
    (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O F
declarations.comment: the essential image of a^* consists of cartesian O-modules. Faithfulness of a^* is `faithful_pullbackModules_over`; fullness of a^*, and essential surjectivity onto the cartesian O-modules making a_* a quasi-inverse, are not proved

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.full_pullbackModules_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, the fullness half.** In the situation above, the pullback
`a^* : Mod(O_X) ⥤ Mod(O)` of sheaves of modules is full.

Because the structure map of `a` is the identification `O = a⁻¹O_X`, the pullback of modules is
the Stacks 03D2 inverse image of modules followed by an equivalence; fullness then descends from
Stacks 0D8K (1), full faithfulness of `a⁻¹` on sheaves of sets over `C/X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem full_pullbackModules_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.Full
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is full

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.fullyFaithfulPullbackModulesOver
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0DA4, full faithfulness of `a^*` on sheaves of modules.**
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is fully faithful

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.essImage_pullbackModules_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, essential surjectivity onto the cartesian `O`-modules.** In the situation
above, every cartesian sheaf of `O`-modules on the total site is a pullback `a^*M`.

The underlying sheaf of sets of a cartesian sheaf of modules is cartesian — the structure sheaf
itself being cartesian because it is `a⁻¹O_X` — hence an inverse image by Stacks 0D8K (1); and a
sheaf of modules whose underlying sheaf of sets is an inverse image is a pullback.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_pullbackModules_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology)
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O))}
    (hF : (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O F) :
    (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F
declarations.comment: every cartesian O-module is an a^*M

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.mem_essImage_pullbackModules_iff_isCartesianModule_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, the essential image of `a^*` is exactly the cartesian `O`-modules.** One
inclusion is `isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_over`, which is Stacks 0D7H (3); the other is
`essImage_pullbackModules_over`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essImage_pullbackModules_iff_isCartesianModule_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology)
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O))) :
    (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F ↔
      (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
        (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O F
declarations.comment: the essential image of a^* on sheaves of modules is exactly the cartesian O-modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on `Mod(O_X)`.** The unit `M ⟶ a_*a^*M` of the
adjunction of Stacks 03D7 is an isomorphism for every sheaf of `O_X`-modules: a fully faithful
left adjoint has invertible unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    IsIso (RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).totalRingedHom).unit
declarations.comment: M = a_* a^* M on sheaves of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_counit_app_over
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA4, `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on the cartesian `O`-modules.** The counit
`a^*a_*F ⟶ F` of the adjunction of Stacks 03D7 is an isomorphism at every cartesian sheaf of
`O`-modules: a fully faithful left adjoint has invertible counit exactly on its essential image,
which by `mem_essImage_pullbackModules_iff_isCartesianModule_over` is the cartesian
`O`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_counit_app_over (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).totalTopology)
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O))}
    (hF : (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O F) :
    IsIso ((RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).totalRingedHom).counit.app F)
declarations.comment: a^* a_* F = F for a cartesian O-module F

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_app_of_isHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA5.** Let `C` be a site with fibre products, `X` an object of `C`, `O_C` a sheaf
of commutative rings on `C` and `K` a hypercovering of `X`. With `O_X = O_C|_{C/X}`,
`O = a⁻¹O_X` on the total site of `K` and `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/X), O_X)` the ringed
augmentation of Stacks 0D9X, the canonical map

`E ⟶ R a_* L a^* E`

is an isomorphism for every object `E` of the unbounded derived category `D(O_X)` of sheaves of
`O_X`-modules. Nothing is assumed beyond the hypercovering conditions on `K`: both inputs of the
reduction `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit` are proved
here from `hK`: the underived unit `M ⟶ a_*a^*M` by Stacks 0DA4
(`isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit_over`), and the acyclicity of `a^*` of a K-injective
complex by `pullbackComputesDerivedPushforward_of_isHypercovering`, which consumes the
hypercovering conditions through Stacks 0D8L and 0D8K. In particular this is not the conditional
`isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_app_of_hypercovering_over` (in the namespace
`Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering`), which takes those two inputs as hypotheses and does not
use `hK`; that declaration carries no tag.
A hypercovering of `X` is, as in the source, a simplicial semi-representable object over `X`
(`IsHypercovering`), and the rings are commutative, following the Stacks convention.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_app_of_isHypercovering (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).augmentationRingedTopos.J))
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).augmentationRingedTopos.O))) :
    IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).totalRingedHom).app E)
declarations.comment: for a site with fibre products, a sheaf of rings and a hypercovering K of an object X, the map E -> Ra_*La^*E is an isomorphism for every E in the unbounded D(O_X)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site with fibre products, given by a pretopology `P`, let `X` be an object of
`C`, let `O_C` be a sheaf of commutative rings on `C` and let `K` be a hypercovering of `X` (a
simplicial object of `SR(C, X)` whose degree-zero family covers `X` and whose matching maps
`K_{n+1} ⟶ (cosk_n sk_n K)_{n+1}` are covering). With `O_X = O_C|_{C/X}`, `O = a⁻¹O_X` on the
total site `(C/K)_total` and `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/X), O_X)` the ringed
augmentation, there is a canonical isomorphism

`RΓ(X, E) = RΓ((C/K)_total, La^*E)`

naturally in `E` in the unbounded derived category `D(O_C)`. Here `RΓ(X, -)` is the total right
derived functor of sections over `X`, with values in `D(O_C(X))`; `La^*E` is `La^*` of the
restriction of `E` to `C/X` (the target of `a` being `(Sh(C/X), O_X)`); and
`RΓ((C/K)_total, -)`, with values in `D(Γ((C/K)_total, O))`, is read in `D(O_C(X))` through the
canonical ring map `O_C(X) ⟶ Γ((C/K)_total, O)` (`totalSectionsRingHom`).
declarations.statement:
def derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    derivedModuleSectionsOverObject P X OC ≅
      Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedRestriction (ringedSite P OC) X ⋙
        (RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
          (X := totalTopos P K OC) (Y := sliceTopos P K OC) (augmentationHom P K OC)).functor ⋙
        derivedTotalGlobalSections P K OC ⋙
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (totalSectionsRingHom P K OC)).mapDerivedCategory

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering_hom_app
declarations.doc:
The forward map of `derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering` at `E` is
`RΓ(C/X, -)` of the derived unit `E|_X ⟶ Ra_*La^*(E|_X)` of the ringed augmentation, between the
comparison `RΓ(X, E) = RΓ(C/X, E|_X)` and the factorisation
`RΓ(C/X, Ra_*-) = RΓ((C/K)_total, -)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering_hom_app (hK : IsHypercovering P K)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf OC))) :
    (derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering P K OC hK).hom.app E =
      (derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoRestriction P OC).hom.app E ≫
        (derivedModuleSectionsAtId P X OC).map
          ((RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit (augmentationHom P K OC)).app
            ((Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedRestriction (ringedSite P OC) X).obj E)) ≫
        (derivedPushforwardModuleSectionsAtIdIso P K OC).hom.app
          ((RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
            (X := totalTopos P K OC) (Y := sliceTopos P K OC) (augmentationHom P K OC)).functor.obj
              ((Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedRestriction (ringedSite P OC) X).obj E))
declarations.comment: the forward map of the isomorphism is the canonical one: RΓ(C/X, -) of the derived unit E|_X ⟶ Ra_*La^*(E|_X), between RΓ(X, E) = RΓ(C/X, E|_X) and the factorisation of Tag 08J6

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.exists_derivedPullbackEquivalence_isHypercovering
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site with fibre products, given by a pretopology `P`, let `X` be an object of
`C`, let `O_C` be a sheaf of commutative rings on `C` and let `K` be a hypercovering of `X`
(Stacks 01G5: a simplicial object of `SR(C, X)` whose degree-zero family covers `X` and
whose matching maps `K_{n+1} ⟶ (cosk_n sk_n K)_{n+1}` are covering). Let `O_X = O_C|_{C/X}`, let
`O = a⁻¹O_X` on the total site `(C/K)_total` and let `a : (Sh((C/K)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/X), O_X)`
be the ringed augmentation of Remarks 0D9V and 0D9X. Then

* the cartesian `O`-modules form a weak Serre subcategory `𝒜 ⊂ Mod(O)`, and
* the functor `La^*` defines an equivalence `D⁺(O_X) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜(O)` with quasi-inverse `R a_*`:
  there is an equivalence of categories whose functor, followed by the inclusion of `D⁺_𝒜(O)`, is
  `La^*` on `D⁺(O_X)`, and whose inverse, followed by the inclusion of `D⁺(O_X)`, is `R a_*` on
  `D⁺_𝒜(O)`.

Here `D⁺(O_X)` is the full subcategory of bounded below objects of `D(O_X)`, and `D⁺_𝒜(O)` that of
bounded below objects of `D(O)` all of whose cohomology modules are cartesian. Nothing is assumed
beyond the hypotheses of the source; the equivalence is
`derivedPullbackEquivalenceOfIsHypercovering`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedPullbackEquivalence_isHypercovering (hK : IsHypercovering P K) :
    ObjectProperty.IsWeakSerreClass
        ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
          (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O) ∧
      ∃ e : (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget (Y := sliceTopos P K OC)).FullSubcategory ≌
          (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty (X := totalTopos P K OC)
            ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
              (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O)).FullSubcategory,
        e.functor ⋙ (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty (X := totalTopos P K OC)
            ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
              (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O)).ι =
          (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget (Y := sliceTopos P K OC)).ι ⋙
            (RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp (X := totalTopos P K OC)
              (Y := sliceTopos P K OC) (augmentationHom P K OC)).functor ∧
        e.inverse ⋙ (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget (Y := sliceTopos P K OC)).ι =
          (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty (X := totalTopos P K OC)
            ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X) K).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
              (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P K OC).O)).ι ⋙
            Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward (X := totalTopos P K OC)
              (Y := sliceTopos P K OC) (augmentationHom P K OC)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DA9.** For a site `C` with fibre products, an object `X` of `C`, a
hypercovering `a : U ⟶ X` of `X` in `C` by a simplicial object `U` of `C`, the augmentation
`a : Sh((C/U)_total) ⟶ Sh(C/X)` of Stacks 09X8, and the weak Serre subcategory
`𝒜 ⊂ Ab((C/U)_total)` of cartesian abelian sheaves of Stacks 0D7J, the derived inverse image is
an equivalence

`a⁻¹ : D⁺(C/X) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜((C/U)_total)`

with quasi-inverse `Ra_*`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented'
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a) :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
        (⊤ : ObjectProperty
          (Sheaf (P.toGrothendieck.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))).FullSubcategory ≌
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
        ((totalSituation P U a).IsCartesianAbSheaf)).FullSubcategory

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented_functor'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA9, the forward functor of the equivalence is `a⁻¹`:** it is the restriction of
the derived inverse image along the augmentation to the bounded below subcategories.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented_functor'
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a) :
    (derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented' P U a h).functor =
      Augmentation.derivedTotalInverseImagePlus (totalSituation P U a) (Cat.of (Over X))
        (P.toGrothendieck.over X) (augmentationAugmented P U a)
declarations.comment: the forward functor of the equivalence is a⁻¹

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented_inverse'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DA9, the quasi-inverse of the equivalence is `Ra_*`:** it is the restriction of the
derived direct image along the augmentation to the bounded below subcategories.
declarations.statement:

    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a) :
    (derivedTotalInverseImageEquivalenceAugmented' P U a h).inverse =
      Augmentation.derivedTotalPushforwardPlus (totalSituation P U a) (Cat.of (Over X))
        (P.toGrothendieck.over X) (augmentationAugmented P U a)
declarations.comment: the quasi-inverse of the equivalence is Ra_*

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.faithful_pullbackModules_simplicialObject
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAB, the faithfulness half.** Let `C` be a site with fibre products, `X` an object
of it, `O_C` a sheaf of commutative rings on `C`, and `U` a simplicial object of `C` augmented
to `X` which is a hypercovering of `X` in the sense of Stacks, Section 85.21: the degree-zero
augmentation, the canonical map `U_1 ⟶ U_0 ×_X U_0`, and every higher matching map generate
covering presieves. With `O_X = O_C|_{C/X}` and `O = a⁻¹O_X`, the pullback
`a^* : Mod(O_X) ⥤ Mod(O)` of sheaves of modules along the augmentation of the total site of `U`
over `C/X` is faithful.

This is Stacks 0DA4 for the associated simplicial semi-representable object of Stacks 0GM9,
whose hypercovering condition is exactly the three hypotheses.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_pullbackModules_simplicialObject
    (h₀ : Presieve.singleton (a.app (op ⦋0⦌)) ∈ P X)
    (h₁ : Presieve.singleton (oneSimplexToFiberProduct U a) ∈
      P (pullback (a.app (op ⦋0⦌)) (a.app (op ⦋0⦌))))
    (hmatch : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → Presieve.singleton (matchingMap U a n) ∈
      P ((((SimplicialObject.cosk n).obj (Over.lift U a)).obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)).left)) :
    (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.Faithful
declarations.comment: a^* on sheaves of modules is faithful, for a hypercovering of X by a simplicial object of the site. The essential-image inclusion is `isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_simplicialObject`; fullness of a^*, and essential surjectivity onto the cartesian O-modules making a_* a quasi-inverse, are not proved

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_simplicialObject
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAB, the inclusion of the essential image in the cartesian modules.** In the
situation above, every sheaf of `O`-modules on the total site of a simplicial object of `C`
augmented to `X` which is isomorphic to a pullback `a^*F` is a cartesian `O`-module.

This is Stacks 0DA4 for the associated simplicial semi-representable object of Stacks 0GM9, and
uses no condition on `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCartesianModule_of_mem_essImage_simplicialObject
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
        (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)).totalTopology))
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).O)}
    (hF : (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)
      OC).totalRingedHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules.essImage F) :
    (situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
      (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
        (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).O F
declarations.comment: the essential image of a^* consists of cartesian O-modules, for a hypercovering of X by a simplicial object of the site. Faithfulness of a^* is `faithful_pullbackModules_simplicialObject`; fullness of a^*, and essential surjectivity onto the cartesian O-modules making a_* a quasi-inverse, are not proved

This is Stacks 0DA4 for the associated simplicial semi-representable object of Stacks 0GM9.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit_simplicialObject

**Stacks 0DAB, `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on `Mod(O_X)`.** The unit `M ⟶ a_*a^*M` of the

declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_unit_simplicialObject

    IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)

declarations.comment: M = a_* a^* M on sheaves of modules, for a hypercovering of X by a simplicial object of the site

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_counit_app_simplicialObject
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAB, `a_*` is a quasi-inverse on the cartesian `O`-modules.** The counit
`a^*a_*F ⟶ F` of the adjunction of Stacks 03D7 is an isomorphism at every cartesian sheaf of
`O`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackAdjPushforwardModules_counit_app_simplicialObject

      P ((((SimplicialObject.cosk n).obj (Over.lift U a)).obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)).left))
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
