declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_app_of_isHypercoveringAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAC.** Let `C` be a site with fibre products, `X` an object of `C`, `O_C` a sheaf
of commutative rings on `C` and `a : U ⟶ X` a hypercovering of `X` in `C` by a simplicial
object `U` of `C` (Stacks, Section 85.21). With `O_X = O_C|_{C/X}`, `O = a⁻¹O_X` on the total
site of `U` and `a : (Sh((C/U)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/X), O_X)` the ringed augmentation of
Stacks 0D9X, the canonical map

`E ⟶ R a_* L a^* E`

is an isomorphism for every object `E` of the unbounded derived category `D(O_X)` of sheaves of
`O_X`-modules.

As in the source this is Stacks 0DA5 for the hypercovering of `X` by semi-representable objects
with one summand in each degree that `a` determines
(`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.IsHypercoveringAugmentation.isHypercovering`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit_app_of_isHypercoveringAugmentation
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)
        OC).augmentationRingedTopos.J))
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)
        OC).augmentationRingedTopos.O))) :
    IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit
      (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)
        OC).totalRingedHom).app E)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site with fibre products, `X` an object of `C`, `O_C` a sheaf of commutative rings
on `C` and `a : U ⟶ X` a hypercovering of `X` in `C` by a simplicial object `U` of `C`. With
`O_X = O_C|_{C/X}`, `O = a⁻¹O_X` on the total site `(C/U)_total` and
`a : (Sh((C/U)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/X), O_X)` the ringed augmentation, there is a canonical
isomorphism

`RΓ(X, E) = RΓ((C/U)_total, La^*E)`

naturally in `E` in the unbounded derived category `D(O_C)`. Here `RΓ(X, -)` takes values in
`D(O_C(X))`, `La^*E` is `La^*` of the restriction of `E` to `C/X`, and the right hand side, which
lives in `D(Γ((C/U)_total, O))`, is read in `D(O_C(X))` through the canonical ring map
`O_C(X) ⟶ Γ((C/U)_total, O)` (`totalSectionsRingHom`).

This is `derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercovering` for the hypercovering of `X` by
semi-representable objects with one summand in each degree that `a` determines
(`IsHypercoveringAugmentation.isHypercovering`).
declarations.statement:
def derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a) :
    derivedModuleSectionsOverObject P X OC ≅
      Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedRestriction (ringedSite P OC) X ⋙
        (RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
          (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          (augmentationHom P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).functor ⋙
        derivedTotalGlobalSections P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC ⋙
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (totalSectionsRingHom P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).mapDerivedCategory

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation_hom_app
declarations.doc:
At every `E` of `D(O_C)` the forward map of
`derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation` is `RΓ(C/X, -)` of the derived
unit `E|_X ⟶ Ra_*La^*(E|_X)` of the ringed augmentation, preceded by the comparison
`RΓ(X, E) = RΓ(C/X, E|_X)` and followed by the factorisation
`RΓ(C/X, Ra_*-) = RΓ((C/U)_total, -)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation_hom_app
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf OC))) :
    (derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation P OC U a h).hom.app E =
      (derivedModuleSectionsOverObjectIsoRestriction P OC).hom.app E ≫
        (derivedModuleSectionsAtId P X OC).map
          ((RingedToposHom.derivedPullbackPushforwardUnit
            (augmentationHom P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).app
            ((Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedRestriction (ringedSite P OC) X).obj E)) ≫
        (derivedPushforwardModuleSectionsAtIdIso P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).hom.app
          ((RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
            (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
            (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
            (augmentationHom P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).functor.obj
              ((Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedRestriction (ringedSite P OC) X).obj E))
declarations.comment: the forward map of the isomorphism is the canonical one: RΓ(C/X, -) of the derived unit E|_X ⟶ Ra_*La^*(E|_X), between RΓ(X, E) = RΓ(C/X, E|_X) and the factorisation of Tag 08J6

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSemiRepresentable.exists_derivedPullbackEquivalence_isHypercoveringAugmentation
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site with fibre products, given by a pretopology `P`, let `X` be an object of
`C`, let `O_C` be a sheaf of commutative rings on `C` and let `a : U ⟶ X` be a hypercovering of
`X` in `C` by a simplicial object `U` of `C` (`IsHypercoveringAugmentation`). Let
`O_X = O_C|_{C/X}`, let `O = a⁻¹O_X` on the total site `(C/U)_total` and let
`a : (Sh((C/U)_total), O) ⟶ (Sh(C/X), O_X)` be the ringed augmentation of Stacks 0D9X. Then

* the cartesian `O`-modules form a weak Serre subcategory `𝒜 ⊂ Mod(O)`, and
* the functor `La^*` defines an equivalence `D⁺(O_X) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜(O)` with quasi-inverse `R a_*`:
  there is an equivalence of categories whose functor, followed by the inclusion of `D⁺_𝒜(O)`, is
  `La^*` on `D⁺(O_X)`, and whose inverse, followed by the inclusion of `D⁺(O_X)`, is `R a_*` on
  `D⁺_𝒜(O)`.

Here `D⁺(O_X)` is the full subcategory of bounded below objects of `D(O_X)`, and `D⁺_𝒜(O)` that of
bounded below objects of `D(O)` all of whose cohomology modules are cartesian. The equivalence is
`derivedPullbackEquivalenceOfIsHypercoveringAugmentation`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedPullbackEquivalence_isHypercoveringAugmentation
    (h : IsHypercoveringAugmentation P U a) :
    ObjectProperty.IsWeakSerreClass
        ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
          (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
          (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).O) ∧
      ∃ e : (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget
          (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).FullSubcategory ≌
          (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty
          (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
          (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
          (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P
            (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).O)).FullSubcategory,
        e.functor ⋙ (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty
          (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
          (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
          (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).O)).ι =
          (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget
          (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).ι ⋙
            (RingedToposHom.leftDerivedPullbackOfIsIsoFSharp
          (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          (augmentationHom P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).functor ∧
        e.inverse ⋙ (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusTarget
          (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)).ι =
          (RingedToposHom.derivedPlusProperty
          (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          ((situation (P.toGrothendieck.over X)
          (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a)).IsModuleFiberTransitionIso
          (hypercoveringObjectRingedAugmentation P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC).O)).ι ⋙
            Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward
          (X := totalTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          (Y := sliceTopos P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)
          (augmentationHom P (associatedSimplicialObject.{u} U a) OC)

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactZariskiSituation.comparisonSquarePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0DAF.** Let `U` be a simplicial object of `LC` and let `a : U → X` be an
augmentation. There is a commutative diagram of topoi

```
Sh((LC_qc/U)_total) --h--> Sh(U_Zar)
        | a_qc                 | a
Sh(LC_qc/X)       --h₋₁--> Sh(X)
```

where the left vertical arrow is the augmentation `qcAugmentation` of Stacks Section 09X8, the
right vertical arrow is the augmentation `augmentationMorphism` of Tag 09W4, the top arrow
`totalComparisonMorphism` is the morphism of topoi of the continuous functor
`U_Zar → (LC_qc/U)_total`, `V ↦ V/U_n`, and the bottom arrow `qcTopologicalMorphism` is the
comparison morphism of the continuous functor `X_Zar → LC_qc/X`, `V ↦ V/X`. Commutativity is
the natural isomorphism `a_* ∘ h_* ≅ h₋₁,* ∘ a_qc,*` of direct images.
declarations.statement:
def comparisonSquarePushforwardIso :
    (totalComparisonMorphism.{x} S U a).pushforward ⋙
        (augmentationMorphism (simplicialSpace S U) ((toTop S).obj X)
          (spaceAugmentation S U a)).pushforward ≅
      (qcAugmentation.{x} S U a).pushforward ⋙ (qcTopologicalMorphism.{u, w, 0} S X).pushforward

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.qcSmallBottomMorphism
declarations.doc:
**The bottom horizontal arrow of the diagram of Tag 0DAF**, the comparison morphism of topoi
`h₋₁ = a_X : Sh(LC_qc/X) → Sh(X)` of Section 09WY, with `Sh(LC_qc/X)` read as the sheaves on the
localization of the small model.
declarations.comment: the lower horizontal arrow h_{-1} : Sh(LC_qc/X) → Sh(X) of the diagram

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.qcComparisonSquarePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0DAF.** The diagram of topoi
```
Sh((LC_qc/U)_total) --h--> Sh(U_Zar)
        | a_qc                 | a
Sh(LC_qc/X)       --h₋₁--> Sh(X)
```
commutes: the direct image of `h₋₁ ∘ a_qc` is that of `a ∘ h`.
declarations.statement:
def qcComparisonSquarePushforwardIso :
    (qcAugmentationMorphism S X U a).pushforward ⋙ (qcSmallBottomMorphism S X).pushforward ≅
      (qcSmallComparisonMorphism S X U a).pushforward ⋙
        (qcZariskiAugmentation S X U a).pushforward
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram of topoi, on direct images

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.qcComparisonSquareInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0DAF**, on inverse images: `a_qc⁻¹ ∘ h₋₁⁻¹ ≅ h⁻¹ ∘ a⁻¹`. The inverse images are left
adjoint to the direct images, so this is the conjugate of
`qcComparisonSquarePushforwardIso`.
declarations.statement:
def qcComparisonSquareInverseImageIso :
    (qcZariskiAugmentation S X U a).inverseImage ⋙
        (qcSmallComparisonMorphism S X U a).inverseImage ≅
      qcSmallTopologicalInverseImage S X ⋙ (qcAugmentationMorphism S X U a).inverseImage
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram of topoi, on inverse images

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.exists_qcComparisonSquare
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0DAF for an arbitrary simplicial object of `LC`.** Let `U` be a simplicial object of
`LC` and let `a : U → X` be an augmentation. Then a site `LC_qc` of Tag 09X2 can be chosen
containing `X` and every `U_n`, and for it the square of topoi
`h₋₁ ∘ a_qc = a ∘ h` commutes, both on direct images and on inverse images. The right-hand
column is the augmentation of `U_Zar` towards `X` of Tag 09W4 for the underlying simplicial
space of `U` itself: the simplicial space of the lift is `U` followed by the inclusion of `LC`
into topological spaces, on the nose.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_qcComparisonSquare (Y : SimplicialObject LocallyQuasiCompactHausdorff.{u})
    (T : LocallyQuasiCompactHausdorff.{u}) (b : Y ⟶ (SimplicialObject.const _).obj T) :
    ∃ (S : LocallyQuasiCompactZariskiSituation.{u, u + 1} (Set.range Y.obj ∪ {T})
        Cardinal.stacksBound) (hY : ∀ n, S.qcSite.Contains (Y.obj n))
      (hT : S.qcSite.Contains T),
      qcSimplicialSpace S (qcLift S Y hY) = Y ⋙ locallyQuasiCompactHausdorffToTop ∧
      Nonempty ((qcAugmentationMorphism S ⟨T, hT⟩ (qcLift S Y hY)
          (qcLiftAugmentation S b hY hT)).pushforward ⋙
            (qcSmallBottomMorphism S ⟨T, hT⟩).pushforward ≅
        (qcSmallComparisonMorphism S ⟨T, hT⟩ (qcLift S Y hY)
          (qcLiftAugmentation S b hY hT)).pushforward ⋙
            (qcZariskiAugmentation S ⟨T, hT⟩ (qcLift S Y hY)
              (qcLiftAugmentation S b hY hT)).pushforward) ∧
      Nonempty ((qcZariskiAugmentation S ⟨T, hT⟩ (qcLift S Y hY)
          (qcLiftAugmentation S b hY hT)).inverseImage ⋙
            (qcSmallComparisonMorphism S ⟨T, hT⟩ (qcLift S Y hY)
              (qcLiftAugmentation S b hY hT)).inverseImage ≅
        qcSmallTopologicalInverseImage S ⟨T, hT⟩ ⋙
          (qcAugmentationMorphism S ⟨T, hT⟩ (qcLift S Y hY)
            (qcLiftAugmentation S b hY hT)).inverseImage)
declarations.comment: for an arbitrary simplicial object U of LC and augmentation a : U → X: a site LC_qc containing X and the U_n exists, and for it the diagram of topoi commutes

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.qcSmallComparisonMorphism
declarations.doc:
**The upper horizontal arrow of the diagram of Tag 0DAF**, the morphism of topoi
`h : Sh((LC_qc/U)_total) ⟶ Sh(U_Zar)` of the comparison functor, with `(LC_qc/U)_total` formed
in the small model as in Section 09X8. Its direct image is restriction along the comparison
functor.
declarations.comment: the upper horizontal arrow h : Sh((LC_qc/U)_total) → Sh(U_Zar) of the diagram

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.ProperHypercovering.inverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAG, sheaves of sets.** Let `U` be a simplicial object of `LC` and `a : U ⟶ X` an
augmentation which is a proper hypercovering of `X`. Then `a^{-1} : Sh(X) ⥤ Sh(U_Zar)` is fully
faithful, its essential image consists exactly of the cartesian sheaves, and `a_*` is a
quasi-inverse: the unit of `a^{-1} ⊣ a_*` is invertible, and so is its counit at every
cartesian sheaf. Here `a : Sh(U_Zar) ⟶ Sh(X)` is the morphism of topoi of Tag 09W4.
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isHypercovering
    (hyp : MorphismProperty.IsHypercovering properSurjective ⟨Y, X, a⟩) :
    (inverseImage Y X a).Full ∧ (inverseImage Y X a).Faithful ∧
      (∀ G, (inverseImage Y X a).essImage G ↔ IsCartesian (U Y) G) ∧
      (∀ F, IsIso ((augmentationTopoi Y X a).adj.unit.app F)) ∧
      (∀ G, IsCartesian (U Y) G → IsIso ((augmentationTopoi Y X a).adj.counit.app G))
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.ProperHypercovering.abelianInverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAG, sheaves of abelian groups.** Let `U` be a simplicial object of `LC` and
`a : U ⟶ X` an augmentation which is a proper hypercovering of `X`. Then
`a^{-1} : Ab(X) ⥤ Ab(U_Zar)` is fully faithful, its essential image consists exactly of the
cartesian abelian sheaves, and `a_*` is a quasi-inverse: the unit of `a^{-1} ⊣ a_*` is
invertible, and so is its counit at every cartesian abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem abelianInverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isHypercovering
    (hyp : MorphismProperty.IsHypercovering properSurjective ⟨Y, X, a⟩) :
    (abelianInverseImage Y X a).Full ∧ (abelianInverseImage Y X a).Faithful ∧
      (∀ G, (abelianInverseImage Y X a).essImage G ↔ IsCartesianAb (U Y) G) ∧
      (∀ F, IsIso ((abelianAdjunction Y X a).unit.app F)) ∧
      (∀ G, IsCartesianAb (U Y) G → IsIso ((abelianAdjunction Y X a).counit.app G))
declarations.comment: sheaves of abelian groups

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.Simplicial.ProperHypercovering.derivedInverseImage_equivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DAH.** Let `U` be a simplicial object of the category `LC` of Hausdorff,
locally quasi-compact spaces and let `a : U → X` be an augmentation. Let `𝒜 ⊂ Ab(U_Zar)` denote
the weak Serre subcategory of cartesian abelian sheaves. If `U` is a proper hypercovering of `X`,
then the functor `a⁻¹` defines an equivalence

`D⁺(X) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜(U_Zar)`

with quasi-inverse `R a_*`, where `a : Sh(U_Zar) → Sh(X)` is the morphism of topoi of Stacks 09W4.

Here `U = Y`; the proper hypercovering condition of Stacks Section 09XA is
`MorphismProperty.IsHypercovering properSurjective`; `𝒜` is `IsCartesianAb (U Y)`, which is a
weak Serre subcategory (the first conjunct); `D⁺_𝒜(U_Zar)` is `cartesianPlus Y`, the objects of
`D⁺(U_Zar)` all of whose cohomology sheaves are cartesian; `a⁻¹` is the exact functor
`(abelianInverseImage Y X a).mapDerivedCategoryPlus` and `R a_*` the total right derived functor
of `a_*`. The derived categories are arbitrary models.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedInverseImage_equivalence
    (hyp : MorphismProperty.IsHypercovering properSurjective ⟨Y, X, a⟩) :
    ObjectProperty.IsWeakSerreClass (IsCartesianAb (U Y)) ∧
      ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology
          (locallyQuasiCompactHausdorffToTop.obj X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≌
            (cartesianPlus Y).FullSubcategory,
        e.functor = (cartesianPlus Y).lift (abelianInverseImage Y X a).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
          (cartesianPlus_mapDerivedCategoryPlus_obj Y X a) ∧
        e.inverse = (cartesianPlus Y).ι ⋙ (abelianDirectImage Y X a).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.tfae_nonempty_subobjectSplitting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DAU**, for simplicial objects. For a simplicial object `K` of `SR(C)`,
written `K_n = {U_{n, i}}_{i ∈ I_n}`, the following are equivalent:
1. `K` is split, in the sense of Tag 017P (a splitting by subobjects);
2. for every surjection `φ : [m] → [n]` and every `i ∈ I_n`, the component
  `f_{φ, i} : U_{n, i} → U_{m, α(φ)(i)}` is an isomorphism;
3. for all `n`, `0 ≤ j ≤ n` and `i ∈ I_n`, the component of the degeneracy `σ^n_j` at `i` is an
  isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_nonempty_subobjectSplitting
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} C)) :
    List.TFAE
      [Nonempty K.SubobjectSplitting,
        ∀ {m n : SimplexCategory} (φ : m ⟶ n) [Epi φ] (i : (K.obj (op n)).I),
          IsIso ((K.map φ.op).φ i),
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (i : (K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).I),
          IsIso ((K.map (SimplexCategory.σ j).op).φ i)]
declarations.comment: simplicial objects (`r = ∞`): (1), (2) and (3) are equivalent, with (1) the splitting by subobjects of Tag 017P

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.tfae_nonempty_truncated_subobjectSplitting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DAU**, for `r`-truncated simplicial objects. For an `r`-truncated
simplicial object `K` of `SR(C)`, written `K_n = {U_{n, i}}_{i ∈ I_n}`, the following are
equivalent:
1. `K` is split, in the sense of Tag 017P for truncated simplicial objects;
2. for every surjection `φ : [m] → [n]` with `m ≤ r` and every `i ∈ I_n`, the component
  `f_{φ, i} : U_{n, i} → U_{m, α(φ)(i)}` is an isomorphism;
3. for all `0 ≤ j ≤ n < r` and `i ∈ I_n`, the component of the degeneracy `σ^n_j` at `i` is an
  isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_nonempty_truncated_subobjectSplitting (r : ℕ)
    (K : SimplicialObject.Truncated (FormalCoproduct.{w} C) r) :
    List.TFAE
      [Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Truncated.SubobjectSplitting K),
        ∀ {m n : SimplexCategory.Truncated r} (φ : m ⟶ n) [Epi φ] (i : (K.obj (op n)).I),
          IsIso ((K.map φ.op).φ i),
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n + 1 ≤ r) (j : Fin (n + 1))
          (i : (K.obj (op (⟨SimplexCategory.mk n, Nat.le_of_succ_le hn⟩ :
            SimplexCategory.Truncated r))).I),
          IsIso ((K.map (ObjectProperty.homMk (SimplexCategory.σ j) :
            (⟨SimplexCategory.mk (n + 1), hn⟩ : SimplexCategory.Truncated r) ⟶
            (⟨SimplexCategory.mk n, Nat.le_of_succ_le hn⟩ :
              SimplexCategory.Truncated r)).op).φ i)]
declarations.comment: `r`-truncated simplicial objects: (1), (2) and (3) are equivalent, with (1) the truncated splitting by subobjects of Tag 017P

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hypercovering_with_objects_in
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DAV.** If the objects in `B` cover every object of a site and adjoining
one more morphism whose source lies in `B` preserves such a covering, then every object has a
hypercovering all of whose constituent objects lie in `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hypercovering_with_objects_in
    (J : Pretopology C) (B : Set C)
    (hcover : ∀ U : C, ∃ (ι : Type w) (V : ι → C) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      (∀ i, V i ∈ B) ∧ Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U)
    (hadjoin : ∀ {ι : Type w} (V : ι → C) {U : C} (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      (∀ i, V i ∈ B) → Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U →
      ∀ {U' : C}, U' ∈ B → ∀ g : U' ⟶ U,
        (fun {_} h ↦ Presieve.ofArrows V f h ∨ Presieve.singleton g h) ∈ J U)
    (X : C) :
    ∃ K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over X)),
      IsHypercovering J K ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : (K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).I),
          ((K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).obj i).left ∈ B

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_with_objects_in
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DAX.** A covering collection of objects supplies a hypercovering of
the final presheaf all of whose terms are coproducts of objects in that collection.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hypercoveringOfTerminal_with_objects_in
    (J : Pretopology C) (B : Set C)
    (hcover : ∀ U : C, ∃ (ι : Type (max w u v)) (V : ι → C) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      (∀ i, V i ∈ B) ∧ Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U) :
    ∃ K : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{max w u v} J,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : (K.toSimplicialObject.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).I),
        (K.toSimplicialObject.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n))).obj i ∈ B

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.exists_hypercovering_of_map
declarations.doc:
The underlying functor of a morphism of sites which preserves equalizers and pullbacks
carries a hypercovering to a hypercovering.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_hypercovering_of_map
    [HasEqualizers C] [HasPullbacks C] [HasEqualizers D] [HasPullbacks D]
    (J : Pretopology C) (K : Pretopology D) (u : D ⥤ C)
    [IsMorphismOfSites.{max w vC vD uC uD} u K.toGrothendieck J.toGrothendieck]
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair u]
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan u]
    (X : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{w} K) :
    ∃ Y : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{w} J,
      Y.toSimplicialObject = X.toSimplicialObject ⋙ mapFormalCoproduct u

declarations.name: Stacks.Topology.LocallyQuasiCompactQcSite.isHypercovering_map_smallSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DAZ at the comparison with the small model.** A hypercovering of an object of
`LC_qc`, carried degreewise to the small model, is a hypercovering of the image object there.

This is the transport the simplicial-hypercovering apparatus needs: that apparatus consumes a
hypercovering of a *small* site --- `isLocallyFull_totalForget_over` and
`essImage_of_isCartesianSheaf` take an `IsHypercovering` --- and `LC_qc` is not one. The
comparison functor preserves fibre products, being an equivalence, and takes coverings to
coverings by `mapsCoveringsToCoverings_smallEquivalence`, which are exactly the two hypotheses
of Stacks 0DAZ.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHypercovering_map_smallSite {Y : S.category}
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{t₁} (Over Y)))
    (hK : IsHypercovering S.pretopology K) :
    IsHypercovering S.smallPretopology
      (K ⋙ mapFormalCoproduct.{t₁} (Over.post S.smallEquivalence.functor))
declarations.comment: a hypercovering of LC_qc transported to a small model of it

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.IsHypercovering.map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DAZ.** Let `u : D ⥤ C` be a functor between sites given by
pretopologies which takes covering families to covering families and preserves fibre products.
Then the degreewise image under `u` of a hypercovering of `Y : D` is a hypercovering of `u Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsHypercovering.map (JD : Pretopology D) (JC : Pretopology C) (u : D ⥤ C)
    (hu : MapsCoveringsToCoverings.{w} u JD JC) [PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan u] {Y : D}
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over Y)))
    (hK : IsHypercovering JD K) :
    IsHypercovering JC (K ⋙ mapFormalCoproduct.{w} (Over.post u))
declarations.comment: the hypothesis that `u` be continuous is used only through its covering clause `MapsCoveringsToCoverings`, which is Tag 00WV(1) verbatim — the same index type and the same image family — together with the preservation of fibre products that is Tag 00WV(2); the conclusion is the full statement, both the degree-zero clause and the clause in degree n + 1

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.map'
registrations.comment: the induced map ∐ U_i ⟶ ∐ V_j from α : I → J and f_i : U_i ⟶ V_{α i}

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι_comp_map'
registrations.comment: it sends the summand U_i into V_{α i} via f_i

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.degreewiseUnions
declarations.doc:
Take disjoint unions in each degree of a simplicial semi-representable object.  Only the
coproducts of the objects actually occurring are required to exist.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def degreewiseUnions (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} C))
    (hsum : ∀ n, HasCoproduct (K.obj n).obj) : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} C)
declarations.comment: the simplicial object of degreewise disjoint unions

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.hypercoveringDegreewiseUnions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DB1.** Let `K` be a hypercovering on a site with fibre products and
equalizers.  If the coproduct of the objects in each degree of `K` exists and the map from the
coproduct of their representable presheaves to the presheaf represented by that coproduct
becomes an isomorphism after sheafification, then the degreewise disjoint unions again form a
hypercovering.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def hypercoveringDegreewiseUnions (K : HypercoveringOfTerminal.{w} J)
    (hsum : ∀ n, HasCoproduct (K.toSimplicialObject.obj n).obj)
    (hinj : ∀ n, Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective J.toGrothendieck
      ((associatedPresheafFunctor.{v}).map
        ((toDegreewiseUnions K.toSimplicialObject hsum).app n)))
    (hsurj : ∀ n, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J.toGrothendieck
      ((associatedPresheafFunctor.{v}).map
        ((toDegreewiseUnions K.toSimplicialObject hsum).app n))) :
    HypercoveringOfTerminal.{w} J
declarations.comment: the degreewise disjoint unions again form a hypercovering

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.takeUnionsSimplicial
declarations.doc:
Take the disjoint unions in each degree of a simplicial formal coproduct over `X`.
Only the coproducts of its actual terms are required to exist.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def takeUnionsSimplicial
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over X)))
    (hsum : ∀ n, HasCoproduct (K.obj n).obj) :
    SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over X))
declarations.comment: the degreewise construction

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.isHypercovering_takeUnionsSimplicial
declarations.doc:
If summable semi-representable objects over `X` are closed
under finite limits, taking their coproducts commutes with those limits, and it sends coverings
to coverings, then applying it degreewise to a hypercovering again gives a hypercovering.
declarations.statement:
lemma isHypercovering_takeUnionsSimplicial
    [ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderFiniteLimits
      (fun U : FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over X) ↦ HasCoproduct U.obj)]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (takeUnions.{w, v, max u v} (C := Over X))]
    (hcover : ∀ ⦃U V : SummableFormalCoproduct.{w} (Over X)⦄ (f : U ⟶ V),
      IsCoveringOver J ((summableInclusion (C := Over X)).map f) →
        IsCoveringOver J ((takeUnions (C := Over X)).map f))
    (K : SimplicialObject (FormalCoproduct.{w} (Over X)))
    (hsum : ∀ n, HasCoproduct (K.obj n).obj)
    (hK : IsHypercovering J K) :
    IsHypercovering J (takeUnionsSimplicial K hsum)
declarations.comment: preservation of hypercoverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.StandardPHCovering
declarations.doc:
A family `fᵢ : Xᵢ ⟶ T` is a standard ph covering if its index type is finite, every
`Xᵢ` is affine, and the family is obtained from a finite affine open cover of the source of
a proper surjective morphism to the affine scheme `T`.
declarations.statement:
def StandardPHCovering {ι : Type v} {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.StandardPHCovering.pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBE.** A standard ph covering remains standard after pullback along a
morphism of affine schemes.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_bind
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DBF, part (2).** Let `T` be an affine scheme, let `E` be a standard
ph covering of `T`, and for each member `E.X i` let `F i` be a standard ph covering of it. Then
the composite family `E.bind F`, whose members are the `(F i).X j ⟶ E.X i ⟶ T`, has a
refinement by a standard ph covering of `T`.

This consumes Chow's lemma (Stacks 0202) through `AlgebraicGeometry.chowLemmaStatement`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_bind {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T]
    (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T) (hE : StandardPHCovering E.f)
    (F : ∀ i, PreZeroHypercover.{w} (E.X i))
    (hF : ∀ i, @StandardPHCovering (F i).I₀ (E.X i) (hE.isAffine i) (F i).X (F i).f) :
    ∃ G : PreZeroHypercover.{max v w} T,
      StandardPHCovering G.f ∧ Nonempty (G.Hom (E.bind F))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DBF, part (1).** Every Zariski open covering of an affine scheme has
a refinement which is a standard ph covering.

The standard ph covering is the finite affine refinement of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_affine_refinement`, presented by the identity of `T`, which is
proper and surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_of_openCover {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T]
    (U : T.OpenCover.{v}) :
    ∃ E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T,
      StandardPHCovering E.f ∧ Nonempty (E.Hom U.toPreZeroHypercover)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsPHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBG.** A family `{X i ⟶ T}` is a **ph covering** if every member is locally
of finite type and, over every affine open `U` of `T`, a standard ph covering of
`U.toScheme` refines the pullback of the family to `U`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def IsPHCovering {T : Scheme.{u}}
    {I : Type v} (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsPHCovering.of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DBH.** A Zariski open covering of a scheme is a ph covering.

Over an affine open `V` of the target, the base change of the covering is again a Zariski open
covering, so `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_of_openCover` refines it by
a standard ph covering; that covering is then reindexed into the universe of the schemes by
`AlgebraicGeometry.StandardPHCovering.reindex`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsPHCovering.of_openCover {T : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : T.OpenCover.{v}) :
    IsPHCovering 𝒰.X 𝒰.f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0DBI.** A singleton isomorphism is a ph covering of schemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPHCovering_of_isIso {T' T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T' ⟶ T) [IsIso f] :
    IsPHCovering (fun _ : Unit ↦ T') (fun _ ↦ f)
declarations.comment: isomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBI part (3).** If `{X i ⟶ T}` is a ph covering and `g : T' ⟶ T` is any morphism of
schemes, then the base change `{X i ×_T T' ⟶ T'}` is a ph covering of `T'`.

Fix an affine open `U'` of `T'`. It is a compact space, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_affineOpens_confined` covers it by finitely many affine opens
`W l`, each mapping into an affine open `V l` of `T`; the family `{W l ⟶ U'}` is a standard ph
covering of `U'` presented by the identity of `U'`. Over `V l` the given covering has a standard
ph refinement, and `W l ⟶ V l` base changes it to a standard ph covering of `W l` refining the
base changed family, by the universal property of the fibre products involved. Stacks 0DBF
part (2), `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_bind`, collapses this two-step
covering of `U'` into a single standard ph covering.
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_bind
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBI part (2).** If `E` is a ph covering of `T` and `F i` is a ph covering of the
member `E.X i` for each `i`, then the family of all composites `(F i).X j ⟶ E.X i ⟶ T`, which is
`CategoryTheory.PreZeroHypercover.bind`, is a ph covering of `T`.

Fix an affine open `U` of `T`. The outer covering has a standard ph refinement `𝒜` over `U`, say
with `𝒜.X q` mapping to `E.X (i q)` by a morphism `c q` over `U`. Each `𝒜.X q` is affine, so the
base change of the inner covering `F (i q)` along `c q`, which is a ph covering of `𝒜.X q` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_pullback`, has a standard ph refinement
`𝒞 q` by `AlgebraicGeometry.IsPHCovering.exists_standardPHCovering`. The two-step covering
`𝒜.bind 𝒞` of `U` refines the base change of `E.bind F` to `U`, and Stacks 0DBF part (2),
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_standardPHCovering_refinement_bind`, collapses it into a single standard
ph covering of `U`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPHCovering_bind {T : Scheme.{u}} (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T)
    (hE : IsPHCovering E.X E.f) (F : ∀ i, PreZeroHypercover.{w} (E.X i))
    (hF : ∀ i, IsPHCovering (F i).X (F i).f) :
    IsPHCovering (E.bind F).X (E.bind F).f
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBJ.** A *big ph site*: a site `Sch_ph` in the sense of Stacks 00VH, whose coverings
form a set, constructed as follows.

1. A set of schemes `S₀`, and a set `Cov₀` of ph coverings (Stacks 0DBG) among these schemes:
   the fields `S₀`, `Cov₀` and the conditions on them.
2. As underlying category the category `Sch_α` constructed as in Stacks 000J starting with `S₀`:
   `AlgebraicGeometry.bigSchemeCategory S₀ ordinal`, for the limit ordinal `ordinal` of
   uncountable cofinality at which the construction in the proof of Stacks 000J is stopped. Its
   objects form a set (`AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.small_objects`), and it satisfies
   (1)–(4) of Stacks 000J (`AlgebraicGeometry.bigSchemeCategory_of_mem`,
   `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bigSchemeCategory_iso_of_size_le`,
   `AlgebraicGeometry.preservesLimit_bigSchemeCategory_ι`,
   `AlgebraicGeometry.preservesColimit_bigSchemeCategory_ι`).
3. A set of coverings as in Stacks 000X starting with `Sch_α`, the class of ph coverings and
   `Cov₀`: `AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.Cov`. It is a set of ph coverings
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.small_Cov`,
   `AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.isPHCoveringIn_of_mem_Cov`) containing `Cov₀`
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.exists_mem_Cov_of_mem_Cov₀`), satisfying the axioms of a
   site (`AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.isSite_Cov`), and every ph covering of `Sch_α` is
   combinatorially equivalent to a member (`AlgebraicGeometry.StacksBigPHSite.exists_combEquiv`).

Lean's type theory has no von Neumann hierarchy in which schemes and families of morphisms live;
what the stages `V_α` provide in Stacks 000J and 000X is that the objects and the coverings form
*sets*, which is `Small.{u}` here, `u` being the universe of the sets underlying the schemes.
declarations.statement: public structure StacksBigPHSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.standardPHCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBK, part (2).** A standard ph covering is tautologically equivalent to a covering
in the big ph site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem standardPHCovering_tautologicallyEquivalent
    (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (T : B.Schemes) [IsAffine T.1]
    (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T.1) (hE : StandardPHCovering E.f) :
    ∃ F : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
      B.IsCovering ⟨T, F⟩ ∧
        PreZeroHypercover.TautologicallyEquivalent E (F.map B.inclusion)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.openCover_tautologicallyEquivalent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBK, part (3).** A Zariski open covering is tautologically equivalent to a covering
in the big ph site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem openCover_tautologicallyEquivalent
    (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (T : B.Schemes) (U : T.1.OpenCover.{v}) :
    ∃ F : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
      B.IsCovering ⟨T, F⟩ ∧
        PreZeroHypercover.TautologicallyEquivalent U.toPreZeroHypercover
          (F.map B.inclusion)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCovering_refinement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBK, part (1).** Every ph covering of an object of a big ph site is refined by one
of the site's own covering families.

The refinement is assembled from parts (2) and (3) by the site's composition axiom: the affine
opens of the target form a Zariski covering, hence by part (3) are tautologically equivalent to a
covering `G` of the site, and each member of `G` is isomorphic over the target to an affine open,
hence by the definition of a ph covering carries a standard ph covering refining the given family
there, which by part (2) is tautologically equivalent to a covering of the site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isCovering_refinement
    (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (T : B.Schemes)
    (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} T.1) (hE : IsPHCovering E.X E.f) :
    ∃ F : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
      B.IsCovering ⟨T, F⟩ ∧ Nonempty ((F.map B.inclusion).Hom E)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHOver

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBR.** Inverse image is restriction along postcomposition, naturally in
sheaves and objects.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigPHMorphismInverseImageIso :
    (bigPHMorphism B T S f).inverseImage ≅
      (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigPHMorphismPushforwardIso

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigPHMorphism_comp_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCoveringInCutoff_of_isEtaleCovering

declarations.comment: étale coverings in a cutoff category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleOverTopology_le_bigPHOverTopology
declarations.doc:
The big-site comparison from ph to étale is induced by the identity functor on the common
slice category: every étale covering of the slice is a ph covering of the slice.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigEtaleOverTopology_le_bigPHOverTopology (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    BigEtaleOver.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2 ≤ B.topology.over X
declarations.comment: étale coverings on a slice

declarations.statement:
public theorem isPHCovering_of_etale {T : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} (X : I → Scheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T) (hsurj : ∀ x : T, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (f i).base)

declarations.comment: étale coverings

    {T : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToFppf_isMorphismOfSites
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: `ε` is the morphism of sites given by the identity functor on underlying
categories.** The two sites have the one underlying category, the slice over `X` of the common
category of schemes, and the identity functor of it, read from the fppf site to the ph site,
satisfies the two conditions of Stacks 00X1: it is continuous and the functor it induces on
sheaves of sets is left exact.  So it is a morphism of sites `(Sch/S)_ph ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.phToBigFppfMorphism` is the morphism of topoi Stacks 00XC attaches to it.
declarations.comment:
the comparison is the morphism of sites given by the identity functor on
  underlying categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToBigFppf_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: `ε_*` is the identity on underlying presheaves.** Forming the direct image of
a ph sheaf and then forgetting the fppf sheaf condition gives back the presheaf one started
from, because the direct image is restriction along the identity functor of the common slice
category.  The two sides are equal, not merely isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
public theorem phToBigFppf_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf (B : BigPHSite.{u})
    (X : B.Schemes) :
    (phToBigFppfMorphism B X).pushforward ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (BigFppfOver.topology (phAssociatedBigFppfSite B) X.1 X.2)
          (Type (u + 1)) =
      sheafToPresheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: the direct image is the identity on underlying presheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToBigFppf_inverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: `ε⁻¹` associates to an fppf sheaf its ph sheafification.** The inverse image
is the functor on sheaves of sets induced by the identity functor of the common slice, and the
left Kan extension along the identity is the identity, so the inverse image is the forgetful
functor to presheaves followed by ph sheafification.

The isomorphism is the canonical one, not just some isomorphism of the right type: `ε` is by
construction the change-of-topology morphism of the identity functor, and the comparison is
`CategoryTheory.changeOfTopologyMorphism_inverseImageIso`, built from the construction of the
induced functor as a left Kan extension followed by sheafification.
declarations.statement:
public def phToBigFppf_inverseImageIso (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    (phToBigFppfMorphism B X).inverseImage ≅
      sheafToPresheaf (BigFppfOver.topology (phAssociatedBigFppfSite B) X.1 X.2)
          (Type (u + 1)) ⋙
        presheafToSheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: the inverse image is the ph sheafification of an fppf sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToZariski_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: by composition the ph topology is compared with the Zariski topology.**
`AlgebraicGeometry.phToZariskiMorphism`, the composition of `ε` with the change-of-topology
morphism from the fppf to the Zariski topology, is a comparison of the ph topology with the
Zariski topology of Stacks 03FF: it is a morphism of topoi from ph sheaves to Zariski sheaves
whose direct image is the identity on underlying presheaves, as `ε`'s own is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem phToZariski_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf (B : BigPHSite.{u})
    (X : B.Schemes) :
    (phToZariskiMorphism B X).pushforward ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf ((phAssociatedBigFppfSite B).zariskiTopology.over X) (Type (u + 1)) =
      sheafToPresheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: by composition, the comparison of the ph topology with the Zariski topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToEtale_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: by composition the ph topology is compared with the étale topology.**
`AlgebraicGeometry.phToEtaleMorphism`, the composition of `ε` with the change-of-topology
morphism from the fppf to the étale topology, is a comparison of the ph topology with the étale
topology of Stacks 03FF: it is a morphism of topoi from ph sheaves to étale sheaves whose
direct image is the identity on underlying presheaves, as `ε`'s own is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem phToEtale_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    (phToEtaleMorphism B X).pushforward ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf ((phAssociatedBigFppfSite B).etaleTopology.over X) (Type (u + 1)) =
      sheafToPresheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: by composition, the comparison of the ph topology with the étale topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToSmooth_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: by composition the ph topology is compared with the smooth topology.**
`AlgebraicGeometry.phToSmoothMorphism`, the composition of `ε` with the change-of-topology

smooth topology of Stacks 03FF: it is a morphism of topoi from ph sheaves to smooth sheaves

declarations.statement:
public theorem phToSmooth_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    (phToSmoothMorphism B X).pushforward ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf ((phAssociatedBigFppfSite B).smoothTopology.over X) (Type (u + 1)) =
      sheafToPresheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: by composition, the comparison of the ph topology with the smooth topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToSyntomic_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBU: by composition the ph topology is compared with the syntomic topology.**
`AlgebraicGeometry.phToSyntomicMorphism`, the composition of `ε` with the change-of-topology

declarations.statement:
public theorem phToSyntomic_pushforward_comp_sheafToPresheaf (B : BigPHSite.{u})

    (phToSyntomicMorphism B X).pushforward ⋙

      sheafToPresheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SimplicialComponent.cohomologyObj_iso_component
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DBZ.** Cohomology over an object of one simplicial component agrees with cohomology
over the corresponding object of the total site, with coefficients restricted to that component.

The restriction is the pullback of sheaves along the cocontinuous component inclusion. This is
Stacks 03YU statement 2 — `Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSite.cohomologyObjIso`, read at an arbitrary
`Ext` universe as `cohomologyObjIsoExtUniv` — applied to the component inclusion, whose exactness
hypothesis is Stacks 09WG (7),
`Stacks.Sites.ComponentSumFormula.preservesMonomorphisms_sheafPullback_componentFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyObj_iso_component
    (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory) (U : S.component n)
    [HasSheafify S.totalTopology Ab.{u}]
    [HasSheafify (S.componentTopology n) Ab.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) Ab.{u})]
    (F : Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}) (p : ℕ) :
    Sheaf.H'.{w, u, u} F p ((SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor S n).obj U) ≅
      Sheaf.H'.{w, u, u}
        (((SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor S n).sheafPullbackCocontinuous
          Ab.{u} (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology).obj F) p U

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SimplicialSummand.cohomologyObj_iso_summand
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DC0.** Cohomology over an object of one summand of a simplicial semi-representable
site agrees with the cohomology, with coefficients in the corresponding member of the family of
sheaves attached to the restriction of the sheaf to that simplicial degree.

This is Stacks 0DBZ (`Stacks.Cohomology.SimplicialComponent.cohomologyObj_iso_component`) for the
component inclusion, transported along the identification `hsite` of the degree-`n` site with the
disjoint union of the summand slices, followed by the same bigger-site comparison again for the
inclusion of the `i`-th summand slice.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyObj_iso_summand
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : FormalCoproduct.{u} C)
    (S : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory)
    (hsite : (⟨S.component n, S.componentTopology n⟩ :
        Σ D : Cat.{u, u}, GrothendieckTopology D) =
      ⟨Cat.of (ComponentOver K), componentwiseTopology J K⟩)
    [HasSheafify S.totalTopology Ab.{u}]
    [HasSheafify (S.componentTopology n) Ab.{u}]
    [HasSheafify (componentwiseTopology J K) Ab.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (S.componentTopology n) Ab.{u})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (componentwiseTopology J K) Ab.{u})]
    (i : K.I) (U : Over (K.obj i))
    [HasSheafify (J.over (K.obj i)) Ab.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (J.over (K.obj i)) Ab.{u})]
    (F : Sheaf S.totalTopology Ab.{u}) (p : ℕ) :
    let V : S.component n :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun T : Σ D : Cat.{u, u}, GrothendieckTopology D =>
        (T.1 : Type u)) hsite.symm) (⟨i, U⟩ : ComponentOver K)
    let Fn : Sheaf (componentwiseTopology J K) Ab.{u} :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun T : Σ D : Cat.{u, u}, GrothendieckTopology D =>
        Sheaf T.2 Ab.{u}) hsite)
        (((SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor S n).sheafPullbackCocontinuous
          Ab.{u} (S.componentTopology n) S.totalTopology).obj F)
    Sheaf.H'.{w, u, u} F p ((SimplicialSiteSituation.componentFunctor S n).obj V) ≅
      Sheaf.H'.{w, u, u}
        (((formalCoproductSliceSheavesEquivalence J K Ab.{u}).val.functor.obj Fn) i) p U

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologicalDescent.IsStableUnderRestriction
declarations.doc:
The first condition on a family of subcategories `A_U` of the categories of modules on the
localizations of a ringed site: for every morphism `f : U ⟶ V` of the site, the restriction functor
from modules on `C/V` to modules on `C/U` sends `A_V` into `A_U`.
declarations.statement: def IsStableUnderRestriction (A : SliceProperties X) : Prop
declarations.comment: condition (1): restriction along U ⟶ V sends A_V into A_U

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologicalDescent.IsLocalOnCoverings
declarations.doc:
The second condition on a family of subcategories `A_U` of the categories of modules on the
localizations of a ringed site: for every covering `{U_i ⟶ U}` of the site, a module on `C/U` lies
in `A_U` if and only if its restriction to `C/U_i` lies in `A_{U_i}` for every `i`.
declarations.statement: def IsLocalOnCoverings (A : SliceProperties X) : Prop
declarations.comment: condition (2): membership in A_U is local on coverings of U

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologicalDescent.LocalCohomologicalBound
declarations.doc:
The third condition on a family of subcategories `A_U` of the categories of modules on the
localizations of a ringed site: there is a set `B` of objects of the site such that every object
has a covering by members of `B`, and every `V` in `B` carries an integer `d_V` and a cofinal
system of coverings of `V` on whose members the cohomology of every module of `A_V` vanishes in
degrees above `d_V`. The set, the bounds and the covering systems are stored as chosen data.
declarations.statement: structure LocalCohomologicalBound (A : SliceProperties X)
declarations.comment: condition (3): a locally covering set, with coverings acyclic for A_V above d_V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isStableUnderRestriction_spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices
declarations.doc:
**Stability under restriction.**  Let `X` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S` and let
`C = X_{spaces, étale}` be the étale site on the algebraic spaces étale over `X`, with its
structure sheaf.  Then the family which assigns to an object `U` of `C` the quasi-coherent modules
on `C/U` is stable under restriction: for a morphism `f : U ⟶ V` of `C`, the restriction functor
from modules on `C/V` to modules on `C/U` sends quasi-coherent modules to quasi-coherent modules.

This is condition (1) of Tag 0DC1, i.e. the condition
`Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologicalDescent.IsStableUnderRestriction` of Tag 0DC2, for this family.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStableUnderRestriction_spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices :
    Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologicalDescent.IsStableUnderRestriction
      (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X) (spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices B S hS X)
declarations.comment: property (1), i.e. condition 0DC2 for the family A_U of quasi-coherent modules on the slices of the spaces-etale site of an algebraic space: restriction along a morphism U -> V of the site sends A_V into A_U. NOT covered by this declaration: property (2) (condition 0DC3, locality on coverings), property (3) (condition 0DC4, the set B = Ob(C) with d_V = 0 and the cofinal affine coverings), and the standing assumption that each A_U is a weak Serre subcategory; no LocalSerreFamily is assembled. See the module documentation for why each of those is unreachable in this development -- in particular the positive-degree vanishing of the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module on an affine object of the etale site, the clause of Stacks 03DW that the source's reference to Stacks 01XB and Stacks 071Y supplies, is proved nowhere here and also blocks Stacks 0720 and Stacks 08EX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesEtaleQuasicoherent_localSerre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DC5.**  Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`,
`C = X_{spaces, étale}` with its structure sheaf, and `A_U` the quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-modules on
the slice `C/U`.  Then each `A_U` is a weak Serre subcategory, and the three conditions of
Stacks 0DC1 hold: restriction along a morphism `U ⟶ V` of `C` sends `A_V` into `A_U`
(Stacks 0DC2); membership in `A_U` is local on coverings of `U` (Stacks 0DC3); and condition
(3) (Stacks 0DC4) holds with `B = Ob(C)`, `d_V = 0` and `Cov_V` the coverings `{V_i ⟶ V}` with
every `V_i` affine, that is, for such a covering, every `p > 0` and every `F` in `A_V`,
`H^p(V_i, F) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem spacesEtaleQuasicoherent_localSerre :
    (∀ U, (spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices B S hS X U).IsWeakSerreClass) ∧
      IsStableUnderRestriction (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X)
        (spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices B S hS X) ∧
      IsLocalOnCoverings (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X)
        (spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices B S hS X) ∧
      ∃ b : LocalCohomologicalBound (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X)
          (spacesEtaleQuasicoherentSlices B S hS X),
        b.B = Set.univ ∧ (∀ V hV, b.degreeBound V hV = 0) ∧
          ∀ V hV (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} V), (b.coverings V hV).cov 𝒰 ↔
            𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X).J V ∧
              ∀ i, IsAffineSpace B S hS (𝒰.X i).obj.left.1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFiniteTypeEtale.localSerre_of_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DC6, type (1): `S` the spectrum of a finite field.** Let `S ≅ Spec k` with `k` a
finite field, let `Λ` be a finite ring whose order is invertible on `S`, let `C` be the category
of schemes locally of finite type over `S` with the étale topology, ringed by the constant sheaf
`Λ` (`ringedSite S Λ`), and let `A_U` be the category of all sheaves of `Λ`-modules on `C/U`.
Then the conditions (1), (2), (3) of Stacks 0DC1 hold: each `A_U` is a weak Serre subcategory,
restriction along `U ⟶ V` sends `A_V` into `A_U` (Stacks 0DC2), membership in `A_U` is local on
coverings (Stacks 0DC3), and (Stacks 0DC4) with `B` the set of quasi-compact objects, for
`V ∈ B` the integer `d_V = 1 + 2 dim(S) + sup_{v ∈ V} (trdeg_{κ(s)} κ(v) + 2 dim 𝒪_{V, v})`, and
`Cov_V` the étale coverings `{V_i ⟶ V}` with every `V_i` quasi-compact, `H^p(V_i, F) = 0` for
every `{V_i ⟶ V}` in `Cov_V`, every `p > d_V` and every `F` in `A_V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localSerre_of_finite (k : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] (e : S ≅ Spec (.of k)) :
    ∀ (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ], IsUnit (Nat.card Λ : Γ(S, ⊤)) →
      (∀ U, (allModules S Λ U).IsWeakSerreClass) ∧
        IsStableUnderRestriction (ringedSite S Λ) (allModules S Λ) ∧
        IsLocalOnCoverings (ringedSite S Λ) (allModules S Λ) ∧
        ∃ b : LocalCohomologicalBound (ringedSite S Λ) (allModules S Λ),
          b.B = {V | IsQuasiCompact ((liftedEquiv S).inverse.obj V)} ∧
          (∀ V hV, ∃ d : ℕ, b.degreeBound V hV = d ∧
            ((liftedEquiv S).inverse.obj V).obj.hom.etaleCohomologyBound = d) ∧
          ∀ V hV (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} V),
            (b.coverings V hV).cov 𝒰 ↔ IsQuasiCompactEtaleCovering 𝒰
declarations.comment: type (1): S the spectrum of a finite field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFiniteTypeEtale.localSerre_of_isSepClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DC6, type (2): `S` the spectrum of a separably closed field.** Let `S ≅ Spec k`
with `k` a separably closed field, let `Λ` be a finite ring whose order is invertible on `S`, let
`C` be the category of schemes locally of finite type over `S` with the étale topology, ringed by
the constant sheaf `Λ` (`ringedSite S Λ`), and let `A_U` be the category of all sheaves of
`Λ`-modules on `C/U`. Then the conditions (1), (2), (3) of Stacks 0DC1 hold: each `A_U` is a weak
Serre subcategory, restriction along `U ⟶ V` sends `A_V` into `A_U` (Stacks 0DC2), membership in
`A_U` is local on coverings (Stacks 0DC3), and (Stacks 0DC4) with `B` the set of quasi-compact
objects, for `V ∈ B` the integer
`d_V = 1 + 2 dim(S) + sup_{v ∈ V} (trdeg_{κ(s)} κ(v) + 2 dim 𝒪_{V, v})`, and `Cov_V` the étale
coverings `{V_i ⟶ V}` with every `V_i` quasi-compact, `H^p(V_i, F) = 0` for every
`{V_i ⟶ V}` in `Cov_V`, every `p > d_V` and every `F` in `A_V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localSerre_of_isSepClosed (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    (e : S ≅ Spec (.of k)) :
    ∀ (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ], IsUnit (Nat.card Λ : Γ(S, ⊤)) →
      (∀ U, (allModules S Λ U).IsWeakSerreClass) ∧
        IsStableUnderRestriction (ringedSite S Λ) (allModules S Λ) ∧
        IsLocalOnCoverings (ringedSite S Λ) (allModules S Λ) ∧
        ∃ b : LocalCohomologicalBound (ringedSite S Λ) (allModules S Λ),
          b.B = {V | IsQuasiCompact ((liftedEquiv S).inverse.obj V)} ∧
          (∀ V hV, ∃ d : ℕ, b.degreeBound V hV = d ∧
            ((liftedEquiv S).inverse.obj V).obj.hom.etaleCohomologyBound = d) ∧
          ∀ V hV (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} V),
            (b.coverings V hV).cov 𝒰 ↔ IsQuasiCompactEtaleCovering 𝒰
declarations.comment: type (2): S the spectrum of a separably closed field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.etaleCohomologyBound

The degree `1 + 2 dim S + sup_v (trdeg_{κ(s)} κ(v) + 2 dim 𝒪_{X, v})` attached to a
morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, where `s` is the image of `v` under `f`.
declarations.statement: public def Hom.etaleCohomologyBound {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) : WithBot ℕ∞

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFiniteTypeEtale
declarations.doc:
The schemes locally of finite type over `S`, as a full subcategory of the schemes
over `S`.
declarations.statement: public abbrev LocallyFiniteTypeEtale (S : Scheme.{u}) : Type _
declarations.comment: the site C of schemes locally of finite type over S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFiniteTypeEtale.topology
declarations.doc:
The étale topology on the schemes locally of finite type over `S`: the coarsest topology
containing every sieve whose underlying family of schemes generates an étale covering.

declarations.comment: the étale topology on C

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFiniteTypeEtale.IsQuasiCompact
declarations.doc:
An object of the locally-finite-type étale site is quasi-compact when the scheme
underlying it is.
declarations.statement: public def IsQuasiCompact (V : LocallyFiniteTypeEtale S) : Prop
declarations.comment: the set B of quasi-compact objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFiniteTypeEtale.IsQuasiCompactCovering
declarations.doc:
A family `{U i ⟶ V}` in the locally-finite-type étale site is a distinguished covering of
`V` when every `U i` is quasi-compact and the family generates a covering sieve.
declarations.statement:
public def IsQuasiCompactCovering {V : LocallyFiniteTypeEtale S} {I : Type w}
    (U : I → LocallyFiniteTypeEtale S) (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ V) : Prop
