declarations.comment: Serre subcategory

declarations.name: Stacks.Torsion.exists_torsionDerivedEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DD7.** The derived category of torsion abelian sheaves is equivalent to the full
subcategory of the derived category of all abelian sheaves consisting of objects with torsion
cohomology.  Under this equivalence, the inclusion is the derived functor of the inclusion of
torsion sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_torsionDerivedEquivalence :
    ∃ e : DerivedCategory (TorsionSheaf J) ≌ TorsionDerivedCategory J,
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ (torsionCohomologyProperty J).ι ≅
        (torsionSheafProperty J).ι.mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment: derived equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.derivedAbelianSectionsRestrictionIso_of_continuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DD8, part (1).** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous
functor of sites and let `g : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi. For every
object `U` of `C` and every `M` in the unbounded derived category of abelian sheaves on `D`,
`RΓ(U, g⁻¹M) = RΓ(u(U), M)`, naturally in `M`.

This is `derivedAbelianSectionsRestrictionIso` with all of its inputs discharged. The
invertibility of the derived lower-shriek counit at the single complex on `j_{U!} ℤ_U` is
`isIso_derivedAbelianLowerShriekComparison_app`, which holds because that complex is cellular
for the class with which `Lg_!^{Ab}` is built; the existence of `Lg_!^{Ab}` and its
absoluteness against derived restriction are the two instances of
`AbelianAcyclicityFromContinuity.lean`. All three come from the acyclicity statement of
Stacks 0794 for lower shriek on abelian sheaves, which that file derives from Stacks 0D6X and so
from the covering-pullback clause `Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks` of continuity in the
sense of Sites, Definition 00WV.
declarations.comment: part (1); the two sites are small and the coefficients are in their universe, the library's standard one-universe convention for sites

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.derivedModuleSectionsRestrictionIso_of_continuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DD8, part (2).** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous
functor of sites, let `g : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi, let `O_D` be a
sheaf of rings on `D` and let `O_C = g⁻¹O_D`. For every object `U` of `C` and every `M` in the
unbounded derived category of `O_D`-modules, `RΓ(U, g^*M) = RΓ(u(U), M)`, naturally in `M`.

This is `derivedModuleSectionsRestrictionIso` with all of its inputs discharged. The
invertibility of the derived lower-shriek counit at the single complex on `j_{U!} O_U` is
`isIso_derivedLowerShriekComparison_app`, and the existence of `Lg_!` and its absoluteness
against derived restriction are the two instances of `ModuleDerivedLowerShriek.lean`; all three
come from `lowerShriekModules_acyclic`, the acyclicity statement of Stacks 0794 for lower shriek
on modules, which that file derives from Stacks 0D6X and so from the covering-pullback clause
`Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks` of continuity in the sense of Sites,
Definition 00WV.
declarations.statement:
def derivedModuleSectionsRestrictionIso_of_continuous (O : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u}) :
    derivedRestriction J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) ⋙
        derivedModuleSections J (inverseImageRing J K f
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) U ≅
      derivedModuleSections K (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)
        (f.obj U)
declarations.comment: part (2); the two sites are small and the module sections are in their universe, the library's standard one-universe convention for sites; the structure sheaf is a sheaf of commutative rings, which is what a sheaf of rings is in the source (Stacks 0006)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.derivedModuleSectionsRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DD8, part (2).** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous functor of
sites, let `g : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi, let `O_D` be a sheaf of
rings on `D` and let `O_C = g⁻¹O_D`. For every object `U` of `C` and every `M` in the unbounded
derived category of `O_D`-modules, `RΓ(U, g^*M) = RΓ(u(U), M)`, naturally in `M`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedModuleSectionsRestrictionIso
    (hgen : DerivedLowerShriekComputesGenerator J K f O U) :
    derivedRestriction J K f O ⋙ derivedModuleSections J (inverseImageRing J K f O) U ≅
      derivedModuleSections K O (f.obj U)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.derivedAbelianSectionsRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DD8, part (1).** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous functor of
sites and let `g : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi. For every object `U`
of `C` and every `M` in the unbounded derived category of abelian sheaves on `D`,
`RΓ(U, g⁻¹M) = RΓ(u(U), M)`, naturally in `M`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedAbelianSectionsRestrictionIso
    (hgen : DerivedAbelianLowerShriekComputesGenerator J K f U) :
    derivedAbelianRestriction.{u} J K f ⋙ derivedAbelianSections J U ≅
      derivedAbelianSections K (f.obj U)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigZariskiBaseChange_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Big-site inverse image commutes with big-site direct image around a
cartesian square, naturally in the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigZariskiBaseChange_pushforwardIso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (bigZariskiMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
        (bigZariskiMorphism B S' S g).inverseImage ≅
      (bigZariskiMorphism B T' T g').inverseImage ⋙
        (bigZariskiMorphism B T' S' f').pushforward
declarations.comment: big-site equality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallZariskiBaseChange_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Restricting a big-site direct image to the small site of `S'` agrees,
naturally, with restricting to the small site of `T'` and taking the small-site
direct image.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallZariskiBaseChange_pushforwardIso
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (bigZariskiMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
        (smallZariskiToBigZariskiMorphism B S' S g).inverseImage ≅
      (smallZariskiToBigZariskiMorphism B T' T g').inverseImage ⋙
        (smallZariskiBaseChange B f').sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallZariski.topology B S'.1 S'.property)
          (SmallZariski.topology B T'.1 T'.property)
declarations.comment: small-site equality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
On a cartesian square, restriction to the small étale site commutes canonically with
big-site direct image.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSite.{u}) {T' T S' S : B.Scheme}
    (g' : T' ⟶ T) (f' : T' ⟶ S') (f : T ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (bigEtaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
      (smallEtaleToBigEtaleMorphism B S' S g).inverseImage ≅
    (smallEtaleToBigEtaleMorphism B T' T g').inverseImage ⋙
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B f').sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (u + 1)) (SmallEtale.topology B S'.obj S'.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B T'.obj T'.property)
declarations.comment: small-site base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
On a cartesian square, big étale direct image commutes canonically with big étale inverse
image.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSite.{u}) {T' T S' S : B.Scheme}
    (g' : T' ⟶ T) (f' : T' ⟶ S') (f : T ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (bigEtaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
      (bigEtaleMorphism B S' S g).inverseImage ≅
    (bigEtaleMorphism B T' T g').inverseImage ⋙
      (bigEtaleMorphism B T' S' f').pushforward
declarations.comment: big-site base change

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleCohomology_isAddTorsion_and_derivedEtaleCohomology_isAddTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDC.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.

1. If `𝓕` is a torsion abelian sheaf on `X_étale`, then `H^n_étale(X, 𝓕)` is a torsion abelian
   group for all `n`.
2. If `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)` has torsion cohomology sheaves, then `H^n_étale(X, K)` is a torsion
   abelian group for all `n`.

Part (1) is `etaleCohomology_isAddTorsion` and part (2) is `derivedEtaleCohomology_isAddTorsion`;
both hold under exactly the source's hypotheses on `X`, so the tag's assertion is their
conjunction. Here `H^n_étale(X, -)` is the right derived functor of global sections on the small
étale site, and `H^n_étale(X, K)` the homology of its total right derived functor on `D⁺`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleCohomology_isAddTorsion_and_derivedEtaleCohomology_isAddTorsion (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}),
        Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F → ∀ n : ℕ,
        IsAddTorsion
          (((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).rightDerived n).obj F)) ∧
      ∀ (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
          (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})),
        Stacks.Torsion.torsionCohomologyProperty.{max (u + 1) v} X.smallEtaleTopology K.obj →
        ∀ n : ℤ,
        IsAddTorsion
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} n).obj
            ((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology
              AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K))
declarations.comment: parts (1) and (2), as the conjunction of the sheaf case and the `D⁺` case

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleCohomology_isAddTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDC (1).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme. If `𝓕` is a
torsion abelian sheaf on the small étale site of `X`, then `H^n_étale(X, 𝓕)` is a torsion abelian
group for every `n`. Indeed `𝓕` is the colimit of its torsion subsheaves, étale cohomology of a
quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme commutes with filtered colimits, and the cohomology of
the `d`-torsion subsheaf is annihilated by `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleCohomology_isAddTorsion (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F) (n : ℕ) :
    IsAddTorsion
      (((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}).rightDerived n).obj F)
declarations.comment:
part (1) only, with no extra hypothesis; étale cohomology is the right derived
functor of global sections on the small étale site. Part (2) is not proved here

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**The derived direct image on bounded-below derived categories of abelian étale sheaves**:
`Rf_* : D^+(X_étale) ⥤ D^+(Y_étale)`, the right derived functor of `f_*` on bounded-below derived
categories.

This definition states the first clause of part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0DDD] — that `Rf_* K` is
again an object of `D^+(Y_étale)` — which is the codomain of this functor. The remaining clause,
that its cohomology sheaves are torsion when those of `K` are, is
`torsionCohomologyProperty_smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage`.
declarations.comment:
part (2), the bounded-below clause: the derived direct image of an object of
`D^+(X_étale)` is an object of `D^+(Y_étale)`, this being the codomain of the right derived
functor of `f_*` on bounded-below derived categories

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.torsionSheafProperty_rightDerived_smallEtaleDirectImageAb
declarations.doc:
**Part (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0DDD].** For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and a torsion abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale`, the higher direct image
`R^n f_* F` is a torsion abelian sheaf on `Y_étale`, for every `n`.

Tag 072W for abelian sheaves identifies `R^n f_* F` with the sheafification of the cohomology
presheaf and identifies that presheaf's values with étale cohomology over `V ×_Y X`; affine
objects are cover dense in the small étale site of `Y`, and for `V` affine the scheme `V ×_Y X`
is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, which is where the quasi-compactness and
quasi-separatedness of `f` enter, through `compactSpace_smallEtaleBaseChange_obj` and
`quasiSeparatedSpace_smallEtaleBaseChange_obj`; Tag 0DDC (1) over that object then makes
`H^n(V ×_Y X, F)` torsion, which is where the torsion hypothesis on `F` is consumed. So the
cohomology presheaf is locally torsion, and the sheafification of a locally torsion presheaf is a
torsion abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem torsionSheafProperty_rightDerived_smallEtaleDirectImageAb
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (n : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
    (hF : torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F) :
    torsionSheafProperty Y.smallEtaleTopology
      (((smallEtaleDirectImageAb.{max (u + 1) v} f).rightDerived n).obj F)
declarations.comment:
part (1): for `f` quasi-compact and quasi-separated and `F` a torsion abelian
sheaf on `X_étale`, every higher direct image `R^n f_* F` is a torsion abelian sheaf on
`Y_étale`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.torsionCohomologyProperty_smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0DDD], the torsion clause.** For a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and an object `K` of `D^+(X_étale)` whose
cohomology sheaves are torsion, all cohomology sheaves of `Rf_* K` are torsion abelian sheaves on
`Y_étale`. That `Rf_* K` is again an object of `D^+(Y_étale)` is the codomain of
`smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage`, which states that clause of the tag.

This is dévissage from part (1). The torsion abelian sheaves on `Y_étale` form a Serre
subcategory ([Stacks, Tag 0DD7]), hence a weak Serre class; part (1) says that `R^p f_*` carries
torsion abelian sheaves on `X_étale` into it; and
`CategoryTheory.Functor.derivedCategoryBPlus_rightDerivedFunctorPlus_obj` propagates that from
the second page `E_2^{p,q} = R^p f_* H^q(K)` of the spectral sequence of a Cartan--Eilenberg
resolution to its abutment `H^{p+q}(Rf_* K)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem torsionCohomologyProperty_smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}))
    (hK : torsionCohomologyProperty.{max (u + 1) v} X.smallEtaleTopology
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K)) :
    torsionCohomologyProperty.{max (u + 1) v} Y.smallEtaleTopology
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage.{v} f).obj K))
declarations.comment:
part (2), the torsion clause: for `f` quasi-compact and quasi-separated and `K` in
`D^+(X_étale)` with torsion cohomology sheaves, every cohomology sheaf of `Rf_* K` is a torsion
abelian sheaf on `Y_étale`. The bounded-below clause is the codomain of
`smallEtaleDerivedDirectImage`

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_etaleAbelianDerivedBaseChange_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DDE.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of schemes, `g : Y' ⟶ Y`
a morphism of schemes, and `X' = Y' ×_Y X`, given as a cartesian square `sq` with projections
`f' : X' ⟶ Y'` and `g' : X' ⟶ X`. Let `E` be an object of the derived category of abelian sheaves
on `X_étale` which is bounded below and has torsion cohomology sheaves. Then the base change map
`g^{-1} Rf_* E ⟶ Rf'_* (g')^{-1} E` of Tag 0A2A is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_etaleAbelianDerivedBaseChange_of_isProper {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (n : ℤ)
    (hE : E.IsGE n)
    (hT : Stacks.Torsion.torsionCohomologyProperty.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology E) :
    IsIso ((etaleAbelianDerivedBaseChange.{u, 0} f g g' f' sq.w).app E)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleAbelianSheafFiberRightDerivedDirectImageIsoOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDF (1).** For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, a geometric point `ȳ : Spec Ω ⟶ Y`
and a torsion abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale`, the stalk of `Rⁿf_* F` at `ȳ` is the étale
cohomology `Hⁿ(X_ȳ, F_ȳ)` of the restriction of `F` to the geometric fibre `X_ȳ = X ×_Y Spec Ω`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleAbelianSheafFiberRightDerivedDirectImageIsoOfIsProper
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := hasExt_sheaf_smallEtale_succ (pullback f y)
    (((pointSmallEtale y).ulift.{u + 1}).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
      (((etaleAbelianDirectImage.{u, 0} f).rightDerived n).obj F) ≅
    AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} ((etaleAbelianInverseImage.{u, 0} (pullback.fst f y)).obj F) n)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleAbelianSheafFiberHomologyDerivedDirectImageIsoOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDF (2).** For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, a geometric point `ȳ : Spec Ω ⟶ Y`
and an object `E` of `D⁺(X_étale)` with torsion cohomology sheaves, the stalk at `ȳ` of the
`n`-th cohomology sheaf of `Rf_* E` is the `n`-th hypercohomology of the restriction of `E` to
the geometric fibre `X_ȳ = X ×_Y Spec Ω`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleAbelianSheafFiberHomologyDerivedDirectImageIsoOfIsProper
    (E : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (m : ℤ)
    (hE : E.IsGE m)
    (hT : Stacks.Torsion.torsionCohomologyProperty.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology E) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := isGrothendieckAbelian_sheaf_smallEtale_objectUniverse (pullback f y)
    (((pointSmallEtale y).ulift.{u + 1}).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        n).obj ((etaleAbelianDerivedDirectImage.{u, 0} f).obj E)) ≅
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} n).obj
      ((Stacks.DerivedFunctor.totalRightDerived
        (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f y).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((etaleAbelianDerivedInverseImage.{u, 0} (pullback.fst f y)).obj E))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.bijective_etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_scalarExtensionFst_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DDG.** Let `K/k` be an extension of separably closed fields, `X` a
proper scheme over `k` (`f : X ⟶ Spec k` proper) and `F` a torsion abelian sheaf on `X_étale`.
Then the restriction map `H^q_étale(X, F) ⟶ H^q_étale(X_K, F|_{X_K})` along the projection
`X_K = X ×_{Spec k} Spec K ⟶ X` is bijective for every `q ≥ 0`, with `Ext` computed in any
universe `w`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_scalarExtensionFst_of_isProper
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (scalarExtension k K f).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty X.smallEtaleTopology F) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (etaleCohomologyRestrictionMap.{u, 0, w} (scalarExtensionFst k K f) F q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison of big-site cohomology over `T` with small-site
cohomology of the restricted complex, natural in the unbounded derived object.
Applying degree-`n` homology gives the equality of groups in Stacks 0DDH.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [((bigEtaleSections B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh).HasRightDerivedFunctor
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [((smallEtaleRestriction B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).HasRightDerivedFunctor
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [((Sheaf.Γ (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).HasRightDerivedFunctor
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    (((bigEtaleSections B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≅
    ((((smallEtaleRestriction B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ⋙
    (((Sheaf.Γ (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: big_small_abelian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleModuleSectionsCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDH, part (6).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of a big étale site and let `M` be
an unbounded complex of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big étale site over `S`. Cohomology over
the object `T ⟶ S` agrees with cohomology on the small étale site of `T` of `i_f^*M`, naturally
in `M`:
`H^n_étale(T, M) = H^n(T_étale, i_f^*M)`.

Both sides are computed, as in the source, by the right derived functors of sections on the
derived categories of modules. The proof is the comparison on underlying abelian complexes,
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleModuleCohomologyIso`, transported by Stacks 0D6J on both sites
(`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedBigEtaleModuleSectionsIso` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedSmallEtaleModuleGlobalSectionsIso`).
declarations.statement:
public def bigSmallEtaleModuleSectionsCohomologyIso :
    derivedBigEtaleModuleSections B T S f ≅
      (smallEtaleModuleRestriction B T S f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedSmallEtaleModuleGlobalSections B T
declarations.comment: part (6)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleModuleProjectionPullbackSectionsCohomologyIsoSelf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDH, part (2).** Let `S` be an object of a big étale site and let `K` be an
unbounded complex of sheaves of `𝒪_{S_étale}`-modules. Cohomology on the big étale site of `S`
of the derived pullback `Lπ_S^*K` agrees with cohomology of `K` on the small étale site of `S`,
naturally in `K`:
`H^n_étale(S, Lπ_S^*K) = H^n(S_étale, K)`.

Both sides are computed, as in the source, by the right derived functors of sections on the
derived categories of modules. The proof is the comparison on underlying abelian complexes,
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleModuleProjectionPullbackCohomologyIsoSelf`, transported by
Stacks 0D6J on both sites.
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleModuleProjectionPullbackSectionsCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDH, part (4).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of a big étale site and let `K` be
an unbounded complex of sheaves of `𝒪_{S_étale}`-modules. Cohomology over the object `T ⟶ S` of
the big étale site of `S` of the derived pullback `Lπ_S^*K` agrees with cohomology on the small
étale site of `T` of the derived small étale pullback `Lf_small^*K`, naturally in `K`:
`H^n_étale(T, Lπ_S^*K) = H^n(T_étale, Lf_small^*K)`.

Both sides are computed, as in the source, by the right derived functors of sections on the
derived categories of modules. The proof is the comparison on underlying abelian complexes,
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleModuleProjectionPullbackCohomologyIso`, transported by
Stacks 0D6J on both sites.
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleProjectionPullbackCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDH, part (3).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of a big étale site and let `K` be
an unbounded complex of abelian sheaves on the small étale site of `S`. Cohomology over the
object `T ⟶ S` of the big étale site of `S` of the pullback `π_S^{-1}K` agrees with cohomology
on the small étale site of `T` of `f_{small}^{-1}K`, naturally in `K`:
`H^n_étale(T, π_S^{-1}K) = H^n(T_étale, f_{small}^{-1}K)`.

Both `π_S^{-1}` and `f_{small}^{-1}` are exact, so no derived functor of them intervenes: the
statement is between the two unbounded derived section functors precomposed with the functors the
two pullbacks induce on derived categories.

The proof is part (5), `AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso`, followed by
`AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRestrictionProjectionPullbackIso`: the derived functor of the exact
`i_f^{-1}` is the functor it induces on derived categories, and composing that with `π_S^{-1}`'s
gives the one induced by `f_{small}^{-1}`.
declarations.statement:
public def bigSmallEtaleProjectionPullbackCohomologyIso :
    (projectionPullback.{u, u + 1} B S.obj S.property).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((bigEtaleSections B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≅
    (smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B T S f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((Sheaf.Γ (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleProjectionPullbackCohomologyIsoSelf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDH, part (1).** For an unbounded complex `K` of abelian sheaves on the small étale
site of `S`, cohomology of the pullback `π_S^{-1}K` on the big étale site of `S` agrees with
cohomology of `K` on the small étale site of `S`, naturally in `K`:
`H^n_étale(S, π_S^{-1}K) = H^n(S_étale, K)`.

This is part (3) at the identity morphism of `S`, where `f_{small}^{-1}` is the identity functor
by `AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleSheafPullbackIdIso` (Stacks 021J).
declarations.statement:
public def bigSmallEtaleProjectionPullbackCohomologyIsoSelf :
    (projectionPullback.{u, u + 1} B S.obj S.property).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((bigEtaleSections B S S (𝟙 S)).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≅
    (((Sheaf.Γ (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleDerivedSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDH, part (5).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of a big étale site and let `M` be
an unbounded complex of abelian sheaves on the big étale site over `S`. Cohomology over the
object `T ⟶ S` of the big étale site of `S` agrees with cohomology on the small étale site of
`T` of the restriction `i_f^{-1}M`, naturally in `M`:
`H^n_étale(T, M) = H^n(T_étale, i_f^{-1}M)`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso` with nothing assumed: the three derived
functors in the statement exist, the derived functor of the exact `i_f^{-1}` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasRightDerivedFunctor_smallEtaleRestriction`, and the derived sections
functors `RΓ(T → S, -)` and `RΓ(T_étale, -)` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasRightDerivedFunctor_bigEtaleSections` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasRightDerivedFunctor_smallEtaleGlobalSections`, from the K-injective
resolutions of the two Grothendieck abelian categories of sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public def bigSmallEtaleDerivedSectionsIso :
    (((bigEtaleSections B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≅
    ((((smallEtaleRestriction B T S f).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ⋙
    (((Sheaf.Γ (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: part (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.projectionDerivedAdjunctionUnit_app_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDI.** Let `S` be a scheme. For every `K` in the unbounded derived category
`D(S_étale)` of abelian sheaves on the small étale site, the map `K ⟶ Rπ_{S,*}π_S⁻¹K` is an
isomorphism, where `π_S` is the projection from the big étale topos over `S` to the small
étale topos of `S`. Here `π_S⁻¹` and `Rπ_{S,*}` are the functors induced on unbounded derived
categories by the exact functors `π_S⁻¹` and `π_{S,*} = i_S⁻¹`; `Rπ_{S,*}` is the right derived
functor of `π_{S,*}` (`AlgebraicGeometry.projectionDerivedDirectImage_isRightDerivedFunctor`),
and the map is the image of the termwise unit of `π_S⁻¹ ⊣ π_{S,*}`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.projectionDerivedAdjunctionUnit_app_Q`). The proof is Stacks': both functors
are exact and the unit `id ⟶ π_{S,*} ∘ π_S⁻¹` on abelian sheaves is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionDerivedAdjunctionUnit_app_isIso
    (K : DerivedCategory (smallSheaves.{u, v} B S hS)) :
    IsIso ((projectionDerivedAdjunctionUnit.{u, v} B S hS).app K)
declarations.comment: the derived unit `K ⟶ Rπ_{S,*}π_S⁻¹K` is an isomorphism for every `K` in the unbounded `D(S_étale)`; `π_S⁻¹`, `Rπ_{S,*}` are the functors induced by the exact functors, `Rπ_{S,*}` being the right derived functor of `π_{S,*}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_bigSmallEtaleBaseChange_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDJ (1).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a proper morphism of a big étale site. Then
`π_S⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} = f_{big,*} ∘ π_T⁻¹` as functors from sheaves of sets on `T_étale` to sheaves
of sets on `(Sch/S)_étale`: the canonical base change map
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleBaseChange` is an isomorphism.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDJ (2).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a proper morphism of a big étale site. Then
`π_S⁻¹ Rf_{small,*} K = Rf_{big,*} π_T⁻¹ K` for every `K` in `D^+(T_étale)` whose cohomology
sheaves are torsion: the canonical base change map
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange` is invertible at `K`. Here `Rf_{small,*}` and
`Rf_{big,*}` are any right derived functors of the direct images of abelian sheaves along `f`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_of_isProper
    [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) (hK : K.IsGE n)
    (hT : Stacks.Torsion.torsionCohomologyProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) K) :
    IsIso ((bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange B f RfSmall RfBig αSmall αBig).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_toSheaf_of_isProper_zmod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDJ (3).** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a proper morphism of a big étale site and `n ≥ 1`.
Then `π_S⁻¹ Rf_{small,*} K = Rf_{big,*} π_T⁻¹ K` for every `K` in `D(T_étale, ℤ/nℤ)`, the
unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules over the constant sheaf of rings `ℤ/nℤ`: the
canonical base change map `AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange` is invertible at
the underlying abelian complex of `K`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_toSheaf_of_isProper_zmod
    [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (zmodRingSheaf.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) n))) :
    IsIso ((bigSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange B f RfSmall RfBig αSmall αBig).app
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleInverseImage_isSheaf_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDL, the fppf sheaf condition.** For a sheaf of sets `F` on the small étale site
of `S`, the presheaf underlying `π_S⁻¹F` — by the sections formula the rule
`X ↦ Γ(X_ét, f_X⁻¹F)` — is a sheaf for the big fppf topology over `S`.

By Stacks 09XN, `AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleToSmallEtale_inverseImage_isSheaf_fpqc`, it is a
sheaf for the much finer fpqc topology of the chosen slice, and every chosen fppf covering
family is an fpqc covering family.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleInverseImage_isSheaf_fppf
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1 S.property)
      (Type (u + 1))) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (B.topology.over S)
      ((bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1 S.property).inverseImage.obj
        F).obj
declarations.comment: the fppf sheaf condition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfToBigEtale_unit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDL, the canonical fppf comparison.** At `π_S⁻¹F` the unit of `ε_S⁻¹ ⊣ ε_{S,*}`
is an isomorphism. Since `ε_{S,*}` is restriction along the identity functor, this identifies
the fppf sheaf `ε_S⁻¹π_S⁻¹F` with the rule `X ↦ Γ(X_ét, f_X⁻¹F)`.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfToBigEtale_unit_app_iff` the assertion is exactly the fppf
sheaf condition `AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleInverseImage_isSheaf_fppf`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_fppfToBigEtale_unit_app
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1 S.property)
      (Type (u + 1))) :
    IsIso ((fppfToBigEtaleMorphism B S).adj.unit.app
      ((bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1
        S.property).inverseImage.obj F))
declarations.comment: the canonical fppf comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePullbackSections_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDL, the sheaf condition.** The rule `(f : X ⟶ S) ↦ Γ(X, f_small⁻¹F)` is a sheaf
for the big fppf topology over `S`, and a fortiori for the big étale topology over `S`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtalePullbackSections_isSheaf :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (B.topology.over S) (smallEtalePullbackSectionsPresheaf B S F) ∧
      Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1 S.property)
        (smallEtalePullbackSectionsPresheaf B S F)
declarations.comment: the rule X ↦ Γ(X, f_small⁻¹F) is an fppf sheaf, a fortiori an étale sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePullbackSectionsSheafIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDL, the identification.** The sheaf `X ↦ Γ(X, f_small⁻¹F)` is `π_S⁻¹F` on the
big étale site over `S` and `ε_S⁻¹π_S⁻¹F` on the big fppf site over `S`.
declarations.statement:
public def smallEtalePullbackSectionsSheafIso :
    (smallEtalePullbackSectionsEtaleSheaf B S F ≅
        (bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1 S.property).inverseImage.obj
          F) ×
      (smallEtalePullbackSectionsFppfSheaf B S F ≅
        (fppfToBigEtaleMorphism B S).inverseImage.obj
          ((bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (associatedBigEtaleSite B) S.1
            S.property).inverseImage.obj F))
declarations.comment: the rule is π_S⁻¹F on (Sch/S)_étale and ε_S⁻¹π_S⁻¹F on (Sch/S)_fppf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleOverTopology_le_fppfOverTopology
declarations.doc:
The big-site comparison from fppf to étale is induced by the identity
functor on the common slice category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigEtaleOverTopology_le_fppfOverTopology
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
      BigEtaleOver.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2 ≤
      B.topology.over X
declarations.comment: étale coverings are fppf on the slice

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fppfToBigEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism of topoi from fppf sheaves to big étale sheaves on the slice over `X`: its
pushforward and inverse image are those of the identity functor of the slice category, continuous
because every étale covering is an fppf covering.
declarations.statement:
public def fppfToBigEtaleMorphism
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B)
        X.1 X.2) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: change-of-topology morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fppfToBigEtale_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
The direct image of the change-of-topology morphism is restriction of
fppf sheaves along the identity functor on the common slice category.
declarations.statement:
public def fppfToBigEtale_pushforwardIso
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    (fppfToBigEtaleMorphism B X).pushforward ≅
      (𝟭 (Over X)).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (BigEtaleOver.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2)
        (B.topology.over X)
declarations.comment: direct image of change of topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc: The comparison from the big fppf topos to the small étale topos.
declarations.statement:
public def fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B)
        X.1 X.2) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: factorization through the big étale topos

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc: The square of big fppf and big étale topoi commutes.
declarations.statement:
public def bigFppfBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Schemes} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((bigEtaleMorphism (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X Y f).comp
      (fppfToBigEtaleMorphism B X)).pushforward ≅
      ((fppfToBigEtaleMorphism B Y).comp
        (bigFppfMorphism B X Y f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the big fppf–big étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc: The square of big fppf and small étale topoi commutes.
declarations.statement:
public def bigFppfSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Schemes} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((smallEtaleMorphism B f).comp
        (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism B X)).pushforward ≅
      ((fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism B Y).comp
        (bigFppfMorphism B X Y f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the big fppf–small étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_bigFppfSmallEtaleBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDN.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of the big fppf site. Then the base
change map `a_Y⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} ⟶ f_{big,fppf,*} ∘ a_X⁻¹` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_bigFppfSmallEtaleBaseChange [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    IsIso (bigFppfSmallEtaleBaseChange B f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
For a finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of the big fppf site and `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)`,

`a_Y⁻¹(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,fppf,*}(a_X⁻¹K)`:

the base change map `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange` is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange_of_isFinite {X Y : B.Schemes}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) Ab.{u + 1})) :
    IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange f K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDS (5).** For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of the big fppf site and `K` in
`D⁺(X_étale)` with torsion cohomology sheaves,

`a_Y⁻¹(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,fppf,*}(a_X⁻¹K)`:

the base change map `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange` is an
isomorphism. Its first factor is invertible by Stacks 0DDJ (2), proper base change, and its
second by Stacks 0EZF (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange_of_isProper {X Y : B.Schemes}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) Ab.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2)
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) :
    IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange f K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfSmallEtaleHigherDirectImageBaseChange_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDS (2).** For a finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of the big fppf site, an abelian sheaf
`F` on `X_étale` and every `i`,

`a_Y⁻¹(R^if_{small,*}F) = R^if_{big,fppf,*}(a_X⁻¹F)`:

the base change map `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleHigherDirectImageBaseChange` is an
isomorphism. It is the cohomology of the derived base change map of part (4) at `F` placed in
degree zero, read through isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfSmallEtaleHigherDirectImageBaseChange_of_isFinite {X Y : B.Schemes}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite (B.inclusion.map f)]
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) Ab.{u + 1}) (i : ℕ) :
    IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleHigherDirectImageBaseChange f F i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtale_projectionPullback_comparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDS (1).** For an object `X` of the big fppf site and an abelian sheaf `F` on
`X_étale`,

`ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹F = π_X⁻¹F` and `R^iε_{X,*}(a_X⁻¹F) = 0` for `i > 0`:

the unit `π_X⁻¹F ⟶ ε_{X,*}ε_X⁻¹π_X⁻¹F = ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹F` of `ε_X⁻¹ ⊣ ε_{X,*}` is an isomorphism, and
the higher right derived functors of `ε_{X,*}` vanish at `a_X⁻¹F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fppfSmallEtale_projectionPullback_comparison (X : B.Schemes)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) Ab.{u + 1}) :
    IsIso ((fppfBigEtaleAbelianAdjunction B X).unit.app ((fppfEtaleProjectionPullback B X).obj F)) ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i → IsZero (((fppfBigEtaleAbelianPushforward B X).rightDerived i).obj
        ((fppfSmallEtaleAbelianPullback B X).obj F))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfSmallEtaleDerivedUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDS (3).** For an object `X` of the big fppf site and `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)` the map
`π_X⁻¹K ⟶ Rε_{X,*}(a_X⁻¹K)`, `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleDerivedUnit`, is an isomorphism.
It is Stacks 0EZF (1) at `π_X⁻¹K`, which lies in `D⁺_{𝒜'_X}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfSmallEtaleDerivedUnit (X : B.Schemes) :
    IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleDerivedUnit B X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfSmallEtaleAdjunctionDerivedUnit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDT.** Let `X` be a scheme, an object of a big fppf site `B`, and
`a_X : Sh((Sch/X)_fppf) ⟶ Sh(X_étale)` the morphism of topoi to its small étale site. For `K` in
`D⁺(X_étale)` the map `K ⟶ Ra_{X,*}a_X^{-1}K`, the component at `K` of the derived unit of
`a_X^{-1} ⊣ a_{X,*}` (`AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleAdjunctionDerivedUnit`), is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfSmallEtaleAdjunctionDerivedUnit_app
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    IsIso ((fppfSmallEtaleAdjunctionDerivedUnit B X).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_fppfSmallEtaleCohomologyPullbacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDU.** Let `X` be a scheme and `a_X : Sh((Sch/X)_fppf) ⟶ Sh(X_étale)`. Then, for
every `q`:

1. `H^q(X_étale, F) = H^q_fppf(X, a_X^{-1}F)` for an abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale`, with
   `H^q = R^qΓ` (`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerivedPlus`, Stacks 015A): the canonical map
   `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleCohomologyPullback` is an isomorphism;
2. `H^q(X_étale, K) = H^q_fppf(X, a_X^{-1}K)` for `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)`: the canonical map
   `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleHypercohomologyPullback` is an isomorphism;

and, the example, `H^q_étale(X, A) = H^q_fppf(X, A)` for an abelian group `A` and its constant
sheaves: the canonical map `AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSmallEtaleConstantCohomologyPullback` is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfSmallEtaleCohomologyPullbacks :
    (∀ (q : ℤ)
      (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
        IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleCohomologyPullback B X q F)) ∧
    (∀ (q : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (associatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
        IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleHypercohomologyPullback B X q K)) ∧
    ∀ (q : ℤ) (A : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      IsIso (fppfSmallEtaleConstantCohomologyPullback B X q A)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleInverseImage_isZariskiSheaf_ph
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDW, the Zariski half of the ph sheaf condition.** For a sheaf of sets `F` on the
small étale site of `S`, the presheaf underlying `π_S⁻¹F` — by the sections formula the rule
`X ↦ Γ(X_ét, f_X⁻¹F)` of the source — satisfies descent for every family of the big ph category
over `S` whose underlying family of schemes is a Zariski covering.

A Zariski covering family is an fpqc covering family, and `π_S⁻¹F` is a sheaf for the fpqc
topology of the slice by Stacks 09XN,
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleToSmallEtale_inverseImage_isSheaf_fpqc`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleInverseImage_isZariskiSheaf_ph :
    IsZariskiSheaf B S hS
      ((bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) S hS).inverseImage.obj
        F).obj
declarations.comment: the Zariski half of the ph sheaf condition, Stacks 0DBQ; descent along a proper surjective morphism is not proved

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleInverseImage_isSheaf_ph_and_isIso_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDW.** For a sheaf of sets `F` on the small étale site of `S`, the rule
`(f : X ⟶ S) ↦ Γ(X_ét, f⁻¹F)` — the presheaf underlying `π_S⁻¹F` on the big étale category over
`S`, by the sections formula `AlgebraicGeometry.etaleInverseImageSectionsIso` and Stacks 09XN —
is a sheaf for the ph topology of the big ph category over `S`, and the unit of
`ε_S⁻¹ ⊣ ε_{S,*}` at `π_S⁻¹F` is an isomorphism, so that this ph sheaf is `ε_S⁻¹π_S⁻¹F`.

By Stacks 0DBQ the ph sheaf condition splits into its Zariski half and descent along proper
surjections; the latter follows from the proper base change theorem in degree zero, Stacks 0A3U,
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isIso_smallEtaleSetBaseChange_of_isProper`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleInverseImage_isSheaf_ph_and_isIso_unit :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (BigPHOver.topology B S hS)
        ((bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) S hS).inverseImage.obj
          F).obj ∧
      IsIso ((phToBigEtaleMorphism B (B.obj S hS)).adj.unit.app
        ((bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) S hS).inverseImage.obj F))

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleInverseImageSectionsIso
registrations.comment: the rule is the inverse image π_S⁻¹F on the big étale site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToBigEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
The comparison `ε_X` from the big ph topos to the big étale topos, induced by the identity
functor on the common slice category.
declarations.statement:
public def phToBigEtaleMorphism (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2)
        (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: change-of-topology morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phToSmallEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc: The comparison `a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X` from the big ph topos to the small étale topos.
declarations.statement:
public def phToSmallEtaleMorphism (B : BigPHSite.{u}) (X : B.Schemes) :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (B.topology.over X) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.1 X.2) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: factorization through the big étale topos

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigPHBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDX, first diagram.** The square formed by the big ph and big étale base-change
morphisms over the change-of-topology comparisons `ε_X` and `ε_Y` commutes on direct
images.
declarations.statement:
public def bigPHBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso (B : BigPHSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Schemes} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((bigEtaleMorphism (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X Y f).comp
      (phToBigEtaleMorphism B X)).pushforward ≅
      ((phToBigEtaleMorphism B Y).comp (bigPHMorphism B X Y f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the big ph–big étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigPHSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDX, second diagram.** The square formed by the big ph and small étale
base-change morphisms over the comparisons `a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X` and `a_Y = π_Y ∘ ε_Y` commutes on
direct images.
declarations.statement:
public def bigPHSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
    (B : BigPHSite.{u}) {X Y : B.Schemes} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((phSmallEtaleMorphism B f).comp (phToSmallEtaleMorphism B X)).pushforward ≅
      ((phToSmallEtaleMorphism B Y).comp (bigPHMorphism B X Y f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the big ph–small étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_bigPHSmallEtaleDirectImageBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DDY.** Let `B` be a big ph site and `f : X ⟶ Y` a proper morphism of it. Then
`a_Y⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} = f_{big,ph,*} ∘ a_X⁻¹` as functors from sheaves of sets on `X_étale` to
sheaves of sets on `(Sch/Y)_ph`: the base change map
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigPHSmallEtaleDirectImageBaseChange` of the square of topoi of Stacks 0DDX
is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_bigPHSmallEtaleDirectImageBaseChange [IsProper (B.inclusion.map f)] :
    IsIso (bigPHSmallEtaleDirectImageBaseChange B f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phEtaleTorsionComparison_smallEtaleInclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE4 (1).** For an object `X` of the big ph site and an abelian torsion sheaf `F` on
`X_étale`, `ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹F = π_X⁻¹F` — the unit `π_X⁻¹F ⟶ ε_{X,*}ε_X⁻¹π_X⁻¹F` of
`ε_X⁻¹ ⊣ ε_{X,*}` is an isomorphism, `a_X⁻¹ = ε_X⁻¹ ∘ π_X⁻¹` — and
`R^i ε_{X,*}(a_X⁻¹F) = 0` for `i > 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem phEtaleTorsionComparison_smallEtaleInclusion
    (X : (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).Scheme)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property) Ab.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property) F) :
    IsIso ((abelianComparisonAdjunction B.precoverage
        (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).precoverage
        (BigPHSite.etalePrecoverage_le_precoverage B) X).unit.app
        (((SmallEtale.inclusion (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property).sheafPullback
          Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
          ((phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).topology.over X)).obj F)) ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i → IsZero (((abelianComparisonPushforward B.precoverage
          (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).precoverage
          (BigPHSite.etalePrecoverage_le_precoverage B) X).rightDerived i).obj
        ((abelianComparisonPullback B.precoverage
          (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).precoverage X).obj
          (((SmallEtale.inclusion (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property).sheafPullback
            Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
            ((phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).topology.over X)).obj F)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_phEtaleTorsionHigherBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE4 (2).** For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of the big ph site and an abelian
torsion sheaf `F` on `X_étale`, the base change map
`a_Y⁻¹(R^i f_{small,*}F) ⟶ R^i f_{big,ph,*}(a_X⁻¹F)` is an isomorphism for every `i`. The map is
`AlgebraicGeometry.higherSmallEtaleFineBaseChange`, the degree `i` cohomology of the derived base
change map of part (4) at `F` placed in degree zero; `f_{big,ph,*}` is the direct image
`overPushforward` of the ph topology along `f`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_phEtaleTorsionHigherBaseChange
    {X Y : (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsProper ((phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).inclusion.map f))
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property) Ab.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property) F)
    (i : ℕ) :
    IsIso (higherSmallEtaleFineBaseChange (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) B.precoverage
      (BigPHSite.etalePrecoverage_le_precoverage B)
      (fun X F => (smallEtaleInverseImage_isSheaf_ph B X.1 X.2 F).1)
      (properDirectImageComparison _) (BigPHSite.exists_properRefinement B) f F i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_phEtaleTorsionDerivedComparisonUnit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE4 (3).** For an object `X` of the big ph site and `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)` with torsion
cohomology sheaves, the map `π_X⁻¹K ⟶ Rε_{X,*}(a_X⁻¹K)` is an isomorphism: it is the derived unit
of `ε_X⁻¹ ⊣ ε_{X,*}` at `π_X⁻¹K`, and `a_X⁻¹K = ε_X⁻¹π_X⁻¹K`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_phEtaleTorsionDerivedComparisonUnit_app
    (X : (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).Scheme)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property) Ab.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)) :
    IsIso ((derivedComparisonUnit (phEtaleTorsionComparison B) X).app
      (((SmallEtale.inclusion (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property).sheafPullback
        Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
        ((phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).topology.over X)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_phEtaleTorsionDerivedBaseChange
declarations.doc:

`a_Y⁻¹(Rf_{small,*}K) ⟶ Rf_{big,ph,*}(a_X⁻¹K)` is an isomorphism. The map is

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phEtaleTorsionCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE6 (1).** For an object `X` of the big ph site, a torsion abelian sheaf `F` on
`X_étale` and every `q`, `H^q(X_étale, F) = H^q_ph(X, a_X⁻¹F)`, where
`a_X⁻¹F = ε_X⁻¹π_X⁻¹F` is the pullback to the ph site over `X`. The isomorphism is the canonical
one, the pullback along `a_X` on cohomology (`AlgebraicGeometry.cohomologyFineComparisonIso`).
declarations.statement:
public def phEtaleTorsionCohomologyIso
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property) F)
    (q : ℕ) :
    (((sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (op (SmallEtale.final (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property))).rightDerived q).obj
        F ≅
      ((Stacks.globalSectionsOver (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).fineCoverage.toGrothendieck
          X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((abelianComparisonPullback (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).fineCoverage
            (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).coarseCoverage X).obj
          (((SmallEtale.inclusion (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property).sheafPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
            ((phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).topology.over X)).obj F))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phEtaleTorsionDerivedCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE6 (2).** For an object `X` of the big ph site, `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)` with torsion
cohomology sheaves and every `q`, `H^q(X_étale, K) = H^q_ph(X, a_X⁻¹K)`: the degree `q`
cohomology of the derived global sections `RΓ(X_étale, K)` and `RΓ_ph(X, a_X⁻¹K)`, with
`a_X⁻¹ = ε_X⁻¹ ∘ π_X⁻¹` on `D⁺`. The isomorphism is the canonical one, the degree `q` cohomology of
the pullback along `a_X`, `AlgebraicGeometry.derivedGlobalSectionsFineComparisonIso`.
declarations.statement:
public def phEtaleTorsionDerivedCohomologyIso
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj
      X.property) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K))
    (q : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} q).obj
        (((sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (op (SmallEtale.final (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj
            X.property))).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} q).obj
        ((Stacks.globalSectionsOver (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).fineCoverage.toGrothendieck
            X).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
          ((abelianComparisonPullback (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).fineCoverage
              (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).coarseCoverage X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
            (((SmallEtale.inclusion (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property).sheafPullback
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
              ((phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B).topology.over X)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phEtaleTorsionConstantCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE6, the example.** For an object `X` of the big ph site, a torsion abelian group `A`
and every `q`, `H^q_étale(X, A) = H^q_ph(X, A)`, the cohomology of the constant sheaves with value
`A` on `X_étale` and on the ph site over `X`. The isomorphism is part (1) at the constant sheaf,
which is torsion, followed by the identification `a_X⁻¹A = A` of constant sheaves (both are left
adjoint to global sections); see `AlgebraicGeometry.cohomologyConstantFineComparisonIso`.
declarations.statement:
public def phEtaleTorsionConstantCohomologyIso (A : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hA : IsAddTorsion A)
    (q : ℕ) :
    (((sheafSections (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (op (SmallEtale.final (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property))).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf (SmallEtale.topology (phAssociatedBigEtaleSite B) X.obj X.property)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj A) ≅
      ((Stacks.globalSectionsOver (phEtaleTorsionComparison B).fineCoverage.toGrothendieck
          X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf ((phEtaleTorsionComparison B).fineCoverage.toGrothendieck.over X)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj A)
declarations.comment: the example: H^q_et(X, A) = H^q_ph(X, A) for a torsion abelian group A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace_iff_isAffine_reduction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DE8.** Let `S` be a scheme contained in a big fppf site `B` and let `X` be a formal
algebraic space over `S` with reduction `i : X_red ⟶ X` as in Stacks 0AIN. Then `X` is an affine
formal algebraic space over `S` if and only if `X_red` is affine, that is, if and only if it is
the sheaf of an object of the site with affine underlying scheme.

Nothing is granted. The converse direction uses, for one stage of the presentation of Stacks 0AJE,
that an algebraic space receiving a surjective closed immersion from an affine scheme of the site is
affine: `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isAffineOfSurjectiveClosedImmersion`, the closed-immersion
case of Stacks 07VS, proved in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Spaces.Thickenings.AffineOfAffineThickening`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace_iff_isAffine_reduction
    {X Xred : FppfSheaf B S hS} (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    {i : Xred ⟶ X} (hi : IsReduction B S hS X Xred i) :
    IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X ↔
      ∃ T : BigFppfOver B S hS, IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) ∧
        Nonempty ((uliftYoneda.{u + 1}).obj T ≅ Xred.obj)
declarations.comment: affineness of the reduction rendered as its being the sheaf of an object of the site with affine underlying scheme, the shape Stacks 0AIN delivers in the affine case; stated for an arbitrary reduction i : X_red -> X, which generalizes the source's canonical one

      (StructuredArrow Y (canonicalReduction hX).smallEtaleToSpacesEtale.op) A] :
    Sheaf (canonicalSmallEtaleTopology hX) A ≌ Sheaf (canonicalSpacesEtaleTopology hX) A
declarations.comment:

  the Comparison Lemma

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.Reduction.spacesBaseChangeComp
declarations.doc:

the underlying functor of `(f ≫ g)_{spaces, étale}` is canonically isomorphic to the composite
of those of `g_{spaces, étale}` and `f_{spaces, étale}`, which is the composition of morphisms
of sites of Stacks 03CC.
declarations.statement:

    (RZ : Reduction B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :

(2) compatibility with composition, as a canonical isomorphism of the
  underlying functors; read against given reductions, which Stacks 0AIN supplies

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.Reduction.spacesBaseChangeComp_projection
declarations.doc:
The composition isomorphism is compatible with the cartesian
projections to the original object of `Z_{spaces, étale}`.
declarations.statement:

    (RZ : Reduction B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (V : RZ.SpacesEtale) :

        (RY.spacesBaseChange RZ g).projection.app V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.Reduction.smallToposMorphismComp
