declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (2).** The morphism of spaces-étale topoi induced by cartesian base
change along `f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtaleMorphism :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: part (2), morphism of small étale topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallToBig_comp_big_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (1).** The small-to-big morphism `i_f` agrees with the composite of
`i_Y` and the big étale morphism along `f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToBig_comp_big_pushforwardIso :
    (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T f).pushforward ≅
      (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T (𝟙 Y)).pushforward ⋙ (bigEtaleMorphism T f).pushforward
declarations.comment: part (1), factorization of the small-to-big morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallBaseChange_comp_inclusionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (3).** The inclusion of the étale objects commutes with base change in
the big slice site, up to the canonical isomorphism of cartesian squares.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallBaseChange_comp_inclusionIso :
    (Space.spacesBaseChange T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f).functor ⋙
        Space.SpacesEtale.inclusion T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y ≅
      Space.SpacesEtale.inclusion T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X ⋙ Over.pullback f
declarations.comment: part (3), commutative square of site functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallBaseChange_comp_inclusionIso_projection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (3).** The site-square comparison is the cartesian comparison: its
underlying map to the original chart is the projection defining base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_comp_inclusionIso_projection
    (U : Space.SpacesEtale T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) :
    ((smallBaseChange_comp_inclusionIso T f).hom.app U).left ≫ pullback.fst U.1.hom f =
      (Space.spacesBaseChange T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f).projection.app U
declarations.comment: part (3), cartesian projection coherence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (3).** The square of big and small étale morphisms commutes on direct
images.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso :
    ((smallEtaleMorphism T f).comp (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T Y)).pushforward ≅
      ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).comp (bigEtaleMorphism T f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: part (3), commutative square of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtale_pushforwardIsoBigFactorization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (4).** The small étale direct image factors through the big étale
topoi of both `Y` and `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtale_pushforwardIsoBigFactorization :
    (smallEtaleMorphism T f).pushforward ≅
      ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).comp
        ((bigEtaleMorphism T f).comp (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T (𝟙 Y)))).pushforward
declarations.comment: part (4), factorization through both big topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtale_pushforwardIsoDirectFactorization
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0DF6, part (4).** The small étale direct image factors directly through `i_f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtale_pushforwardIsoDirectFactorization :
    (smallEtaleMorphism T f).pushforward ≅
      ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).comp (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: part (4), direct factorization through the big topos

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtale_pushforwardIsoBigFactorization_coherence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (4).** The factorization through both big topoi is the topos square
after inserting the small/big retraction at `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtale_pushforwardIsoBigFactorization_coherence
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (smallEtaleMorphism T f).pushforward.map
        ((bigToSmall_comp_smallToBig_pushforwardIso T Y).inv.app F) ≫
      (bigSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso T f).hom.app
        ((smallToBigEtaleMorphism T (𝟙 Y)).pushforward.obj F) =
    (smallEtale_pushforwardIsoBigFactorization T f).hom.app F
declarations.comment: part (4), coherence with the topos square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtale_pushforwardIsoDirectFactorization_coherence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF6, part (4).** The direct factorization and the factorization through `i_Y`
are identified by the canonical comparison `i_f ≅ f_big ∘ i_Y` of part (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtale_pushforwardIsoDirectFactorization_coherence
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (smallEtale_pushforwardIsoDirectFactorization T f).hom.app F ≫
      (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).pushforward.map
        ((smallToBig_comp_big_pushforwardIso T f).hom.app F) =
    (smallEtale_pushforwardIsoBigFactorization T f).hom.app F
declarations.comment: part (4), coherence of the two factorizations

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
Restriction to the small étale site commutes canonically with big étale direct image across a
cartesian square of algebraic spaces.
declarations.comment: small-site base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
Big étale inverse image commutes canonically with big étale direct image across a cartesian
square of algebraic spaces.
declarations.comment: big-site base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtaleCartesianIndexIso_projection
declarations.doc:
**Projection coherence.** The comparison of the two descriptions of the small étale site of
`X'` inside the big étale site of `Y` is the cartesian comparison: its underlying map, followed by
the projection of the fibre product with `f`, is the projection defining the base change along
`f'`. This is `AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallBaseChange_comp_inclusionIso_projection`
across the whole cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleCartesianIndexIso_projection
    (U : Space.SpacesEtale T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X') :
    ((smallEtaleCartesianIndexIso T g' f' f g h).inv.app U).left ≫
        pullback.fst ((inclusionFunctor T g).obj U).hom f =
      (Space.spacesBaseChange T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f').projection.app U
declarations.comment: projection coherence of the index comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.sharpCommSqBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Structure-map coherence.** The structure maps of `i_g`, `f_big`, `i_{g'}` and `f'_small` are
compatible with the comparison of the two composite site functors over the cartesian square: both
composite structure maps are pullback of global regular functions along the cartesian projection of
the base change. This is `AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.sharpCommSq` across the whole square.
declarations.statement:
theorem sharpCommSqBaseChange :
    (restrictAlongSharp T g ≫
        ((inclusionFunctor T g).sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u + 1}
          (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X')
          (T.bigEtaleTopology X)).map (bigPullbackSharp T f)) ≫
      (Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousNatTrans
        (smallEtaleCartesianIndexIso T g' f' f g h).symm.hom RingCat.{u + 1}
        (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X')
        (T.bigEtaleTopology Y)).app (bigEtaleRingSheaf T Y) =
    smallBaseChangeSharp T f' ≫
      ((Space.spacesBaseChange T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f').functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous
        RingCat.{u + 1} (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X')
        (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y')).map
        (restrictAlongSharp T g')
declarations.comment: structure-map coherence over the cartesian square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtaleModulePushforwardBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
Restriction to the small étale site commutes canonically with big étale direct image of sheaves
of `𝒪`-modules across a cartesian square of algebraic spaces:
`i_g^*(f_{big,*}F) = f'_{small,*}(i_{g'}^*F)`.

This is the `𝒪`-module form of
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallEtalePushforwardBaseChangeIso`, which states the same
square for sheaves of sets.
declarations.comment: the sheaf-of-modules form over a cartesian square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.restrictSharp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, item (3).** The structure map of the comparison morphism `π_X`: the sections
of the direct image of the big étale structure sheaf over an algebraic space étale over `X` are
its own global regular functions, so the structure map is the identity.
declarations.statement:
def restrictSharp (X : T.Spaces) :
    spacesEtaleRingSheaf T X ⟶
      ((Space.SpacesEtale.inclusion T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        RingCat.{u + 1} (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
        (T.bigEtaleTopology X)).obj (bigEtaleRingSheaf T X)
declarations.comment: item (3), the structure map of the comparison morphism π_X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigPullbackSharp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, item (5).** The structure map of the big étale morphism `f_big`: pullback of
global regular functions along the projection of the fibre product `V ×_X Y` to `V`.
declarations.comment: item (5), the structure map of the big étale morphism f_big

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallBaseChangeSharp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, item (4).** The structure map of the small étale morphism `f_small`:
pullback of global regular functions along the cartesian projection of the base change of an
algebraic space étale over `X`.
declarations.statement:
def smallBaseChangeSharp (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    spacesEtaleRingSheaf T X ⟶
      ((Space.spacesBaseChange T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f).functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous
        RingCat.{u + 1} (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
        (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)).obj
        (spacesEtaleRingSheaf T Y)
declarations.comment: item (4), the structure map of the small étale morphism f_small

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallToBigRestrictionStructureIso
declarations.doc:
Restriction of the big étale structure sheaf of `X` along the inclusion of the spaces-étale
site of `Y` is the spaces-étale structure sheaf of `Y`: an object étale over `Y` has the same
ring of global regular functions read in either site, and the restriction maps agree.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToBigRestrictionStructureIso (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ((inclusionFunctor T f).sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1}
        (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
        (T.bigEtaleTopology X)).obj (T.structureSheaf X) ≅
      Space.SpacesEtale.structureSheaf T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y
declarations.comment: case (1): restriction along the inclusion functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallToBigEtaleStructureIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, case (1).** The canonical isomorphism from the inverse image along `i_f` of
the big étale structure sheaf of `X` to the spaces-étale structure sheaf of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToBigEtaleStructureIso (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (inverseImageCommRingFunctor (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T f)).obj
        (bigEtaleRingedTopos T X).O ≅
      (Space.spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y).O
declarations.comment: case (1): the isomorphism i_f⁻¹𝒪 ≅ 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallToBigEtaleRingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, case (1).** The morphism `i_f` from the spaces-étale topos of `Y` to the big
étale topos of `X` as a morphism of ringed topoi: the structure map is the adjunct of the
canonical isomorphism of structure sheaves.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToBigEtaleRingedMorphism (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    RingedToposHom (Space.spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
      (bigEtaleRingedTopos T X)
declarations.comment: case (1): i_f as a morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.iXEtaleRingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, case (2).** The morphism `i_X` as a morphism of ringed topoi: it is the
identity-morphism case `f = 𝟙 X` of `i_f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev iXEtaleRingedMorphism (X : T.Spaces) :
    RingedToposHom (Space.spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
      (bigEtaleRingedTopos T X)
declarations.comment: case (2): i_X as a morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmallRestrictionStructureIso
declarations.doc:
Restriction of the big étale structure sheaf of `X` along the inclusion of the spaces-étale
site of `X` is the spaces-étale structure sheaf of `X`, in the direction needed for the direct
image along `π_X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmallRestrictionStructureIso (X : T.Spaces) :
    Space.SpacesEtale.structureSheaf T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X ≅
      ((Space.SpacesEtale.inclusion T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          CommRingCat.{u + 1} (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
          (T.bigEtaleTopology X)).obj (T.structureSheaf X)
declarations.comment: case (3): restriction along the inclusion of the spaces-étale site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmallEtaleStructureIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, case (3).** The canonical isomorphism from the spaces-étale structure sheaf
of `X` to the direct image along `π_X` of the big étale structure sheaf of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmallEtaleStructureIso (X : T.Spaces) :
    (Space.spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X).O ≅
      (pushforwardCommRingFunctor (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X)).obj
        (bigEtaleRingedTopos T X).O
declarations.comment: case (3): the isomorphism 𝒪_X ≅ π_{X,*}𝒪

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmallEtaleRingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DF9, case (3).** The morphism `π_X` from the big étale topos of `X` to its
spaces-étale topos as a morphism of ringed topoi, with the canonical isomorphism
`𝒪_X ≅ π_{X,*}𝒪` as its structure map.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmallEtaleRingedMorphism (X : T.Spaces) :
    RingedToposHom (bigEtaleRingedTopos T X)
      (Space.spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
declarations.comment: case (3): π_X as a morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFppfCovering_yoneda_of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFC for an open cover of an object of the big fppf site of `S`.** The family of
representables of an open cover of an object of the site is an fppf covering of the
representable of that object: it is a Zariski covering by Stacks 041G.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFppfCovering_yoneda_of_openCover
    {I : Type v} {T : BigFppfOver B S hS} (X : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T)
    (hopen : ∀ i, _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (g i)))
    (hcov : ∀ x : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T,
      ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (g i))) :
    IsFppfCovering B S hS (fun i => yoneda.obj (X i)) (fun i => yoneda.map (g i))
declarations.comment: an open cover of an object of the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Topology.precoverage_etale_le_fppf

declarations.statement:
theorem precoverage_etale_le_fppf :
    Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .etale B S hS ≤ Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fppf B S hS
declarations.comment: étale coverings, at the precoverages

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.bigFppfMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFD.** The morphism of big fppf topoi induced by a morphism of algebraic
spaces: the functor of sites is base change along `f`, which is continuous with exact
pullback.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigFppfMorphism :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T Y) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: the morphism of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.bigFppfMorphism_inverseImageIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0DFD.** The inverse image is naturally restriction along composition with `f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigFppfMorphism_inverseImageIso :
    (bigFppfMorphism T f).inverseImage ≅
      (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T Y) (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X)
declarations.comment: inverse-image functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.bigFppfMorphism_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFD.** The direct image agrees naturally with the pushforward attached to the
cocontinuous composition functor, so the two morphisms of topoi one can attach to `f`
coincide.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigFppfMorphism_pushforwardIso :
    (bigFppfMorphism T f).pushforward ≅
      (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T Y) (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X)
declarations.comment: equality of the two induced morphisms of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.bigFppfMorphism_inverseImage_sections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFD.** The sections of the inverse image of a sheaf over an object `V` of the
big fppf site of `Y` are its sections over `V` composed with `f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigFppfMorphism_inverseImage_sections
    (G : Sheaf (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X) (Type (u + 1))) (V : Over Y) :
    ((bigFppfMorphism T f).inverseImage.obj G).obj.obj (op V) ≃
      G.obj.obj (op ((Over.map f).obj V))
declarations.comment: inverse-image sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsPHCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFG.** A family of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with common target is
a *ph covering* when every member is locally of finite type and every affine scheme-valued
point of the target admits a standard ph covering refining the pullback of the family.
declarations.statement:
structure IsPHCovering {I : Type v} {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isEtaleCovering
declarations.doc:
**The étale case of Stacks 0DFH.** An étale covering of an algebraic space over `S` is a
ph covering of it.

Each member is locally of finite type because it is étale. For an affine scheme-valued point
`a` of the target, the family is base changed along `a` and each base changed member is
replaced by a scheme atlas of it; the resulting family of morphisms of representables is still
étale and jointly surjective, so the underlying family of morphisms of schemes is an étale
covering of the affine test scheme and is refined by a standard ph covering of it by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPHCovering_of_etale`. The members of that refinement are affine and of
finite type over the test object, hence lie in the site, and the refinement morphisms compose
with the atlases and the fibre product projections to refine the original family over `a`.
declarations.comment: étale coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isFppfCovering
declarations.doc: An fppf covering of an algebraic space over `S` is a ph covering of it.
declarations.comment: fppf coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isSyntomicCovering
declarations.doc: A syntomic covering of an algebraic space over `S` is a ph covering of it.
declarations.comment: syntomic coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isSmoothCovering
declarations.doc: A smooth covering of an algebraic space over `S` is a ph covering of it.
declarations.comment: smooth coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isZariskiCovering
declarations.doc:
A Zariski covering of an algebraic space over `S` by algebraic spaces is a ph covering of
it.
declarations.comment: Zariski coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isProper_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFI.** A proper surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, regarded as a
one-member family, is a ph covering.

Over an affine object `U` of the site the pullback `Y ×_X h_U` is proper and surjective over
`h_U`, so Chow's lemma over `U` — in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_properSurjective_schemeCover_of_isProper_toAffine` — produces a
proper surjective morphism of schemes `V ⟶ U` which factors through that pullback. A finite
affine open covering of `V` is then a standard ph covering of `U`, and it refines the family
pulled back along `a` through the factorization.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPHCovering_of_isProper_isSurjective
    {X' X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X' ⟶ X)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X')
    (hp : IsProper B S hS f) (hs : IsSurjective B S hS f) :
    IsPHCovering B S hS (fun _ : Unit ↦ X') (fun _ ↦ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_comp
declarations.doc:
**Ph coverings compose.** If `{Xᵢ i ⟶ X}` is a ph covering of an algebraic space over `S`
and `{Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i}` is a ph covering for every `i`, then the family of all composites
`Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i ⟶ X`, indexed by `Σ i, J i`, is a ph covering of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPHCovering_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type v} {J : I → Type w}
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X)
    (Xᵢⱼ : ∀ i, J i → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (g : ∀ i j, Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i)
    (hf : IsPHCovering B S hS Xᵢ f)
    (hg : ∀ i, IsPHCovering B S hS (Xᵢⱼ i) (g i)) :
    IsPHCovering B S hS (fun ij : Σ i, J i ↦ Xᵢⱼ ij.1 ij.2)
      (fun ij : Σ i, J i ↦ g ij.1 ij.2 ≫ f ij.1)
declarations.comment: composition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFJ**, the isomorphism clause. An isomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
regarded as a family indexed by a point, is a ph covering: the identity of an affine test
scheme is a standard ph covering of it, and it refines the pulled-back family through the
inverse isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPHCovering_of_isIso
    {X' X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso f]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsPHCovering B S hS (fun _ : Unit ↦ X') (fun _ ↦ f)
declarations.comment: ph_covering_of_isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPHCovering_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFJ**, the base-change clause. The first projections of the fibre products of a
ph covering of an algebraic space over `S` with a morphism `g` into its target form a ph
covering of the source of `g`: a standard ph refinement of the original family over an affine
point `a` of the new base refines the pulled-back family through the universal property of the
fibre product.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPHCovering_baseChange
    {I : Type v} {X X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (Xᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsPHCovering B S hS (fun i ↦ (Xᵢ i).1) (fun i ↦ (f i).hom)) :
    IsPHCovering B S hS (fun i ↦ (AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct B S hS g (f i)).1)
      (fun i ↦ pullback.fst g.hom (f i).hom)
declarations.comment: ph_covering_base_change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFK.** A big ph site of algebraic spaces over `S`: the chosen big ph site of
schemes containing `S`, the category of algebraic spaces over `S`, and the set-sized system of
ph covering families supplied by Stacks 000X.
declarations.statement: structure BigPHSpaceSite (S : Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFL.** The category underlying the big ph site of an algebraic space `X` of the
site is the slice of the big ph category of algebraic spaces at `X`.
declarations.statement: abbrev BigPHSpaceOver
declarations.comment: underlying category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceOver.IsCovering

declarations.comment: covering families

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceOver.topology

declarations.comment: localized topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_of_etale_and_properSurjective
declarations.doc:
A presheaf of sets on the big ph site of an algebraic space `X` of a big ph site of
algebraic spaces is a sheaf as soon as it satisfies étale descent and descent along every proper
surjective morphism of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_of_etale_and_properSurjective (h₁ : IsEtaleSheafOver T X F)
    (h₂ : IsProperSurjectiveSheafOver T X F) :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X) F
declarations.comment: sufficiency: etale descent plus proper-surjective descent imply the ph sheaf condition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleSheafOver_of_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of sets on the big ph site of an algebraic space `X` of a big ph site of algebraic
spaces satisfies étale descent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleSheafOver_of_isSheaf (h : Presieve.IsSheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X) F) :
    IsEtaleSheafOver T X F
declarations.comment: necessity, etale descent: a ph sheaf satisfies etale descent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProperSurjectiveSheafOver_of_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of sets on the big ph site of an algebraic space `X` of a big ph site of algebraic

declarations.statement:

    (h : Presieve.IsSheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X) F) :
    IsProperSurjectiveSheafOver T X F
declarations.comment: necessity, proper-surjective descent: a ph sheaf satisfies descent along every proper surjective morphism of the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_iff_isEtaleSheafOver_and_isProperSurjectiveSheafOver
declarations.doc:
A presheaf of sets on the big ph site of an algebraic space `X` of a big ph site of
algebraic spaces is a sheaf if and only if it satisfies étale descent and descent along every
proper surjective morphism of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_iff_isEtaleSheafOver_and_isProperSurjectiveSheafOver :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X) F ↔
      IsEtaleSheafOver T X F ∧ IsProperSurjectiveSheafOver T X F
declarations.comment: the biconditional

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFN.** The morphism of big ph topoi induced by a morphism of algebraic spaces:
its direct image is the cocontinuous pushforward along composition with `f` and its inverse
image is the continuous pushforward along the same functor, so sections of the inverse image
are given by `CategoryTheory.Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous_obj_obj_obj`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigPHMorphism :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T Y) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: the morphism of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHMorphismInverseImageIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0DFN.** The inverse image is restriction along composition with `f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigPHMorphismInverseImageIso :
    (bigPHMorphism T f).inverseImage ≅
      (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T Y) (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X)
declarations.comment: inverse-image formula

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHMorphismPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFN.** The direct image is restriction along base change by `f`, which is the
adjoint comparison of the cocontinuous pushforward with the continuous pushforward along the
right adjoint of `Over.map f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigPHMorphismPushforwardIso :
    (bigPHMorphism T f).pushforward ≅
      (Over.pullback f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T X) (BigPHSpaceOver.topology T Y)
declarations.comment: direct-image formula and agreement of the induced morphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHMorphismLowerShriekAdjunction

declarations.comment: lower-shriek adjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleSchemeToSpaceSheafEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFV, étale case: the identification of topoi.** The inclusion of schemes into

big étale topos of the algebraic-space site.

public noncomputable def etaleSchemeToSpaceSheafEquiv {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (T : AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite S)
    (h : T.schemeSite.cutoff = T.fppfSite.cutoff) :
    Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleOver.topology T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem)
        (Type (u + 1)) ≌
      Sheaf T.topology (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: étale case, equivalence of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fppfSchemeToSpaceSheafEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFV, fppf case: the identification of topoi.** The Yoneda inclusion of schemes
into algebraic spaces induces an equivalence between the big fppf topos of the scheme site and
the big fppf topos of the algebraic-space site.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def fppfSchemeToSpaceSheafEquiv {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (T : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite S) :
    Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem)
        (Type (u + 1)) ≌
      Sheaf T.topology (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: fppf case, equivalence of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.phSchemeToSpaceSheafEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFV, ph case: the identification of topoi.** The inclusion of schemes into
algebraic spaces induces an equivalence between the big ph topos of the scheme site and the
big ph topos of the algebraic-space site.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def phSchemeToSpaceSheafEquiv {S : Scheme.{u}}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.unit_comp_smallToposDescentMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFX.** The unit of `f` followed by the restriction along `p` is the unit of
`p ≫ f`.

Applied to the two projections `p₁, p₂ : Y ×_X Y ⟶ Y` of a self-intersection, where
`p₁ ≫ f = p₂ ≫ f`, this says that the unit equalizes the two restrictions to `Y ×_X Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem unit_comp_smallToposDescentMap {P Y X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (p : P ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).adj.unit.app F ≫ smallToposDescentMap B S hS p f F =
      (smallToposMorphism B S hS (p ≫ f)).adj.unit.app F
declarations.comment: the unit equalizes the two restrictions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.unit_equalizes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFX.** The fork of Stacks 0DFX commutes: the adjunction unit
`F ⟶ f_* f⁻¹ F` has equal composites with the two restriction maps `f_* f⁻¹ F ⟶ g_* g⁻¹ F`
coming from the two projections of `Y ×_X Y`, where `g` is its structure morphism to `X`.
Neither surjectivity nor properness of `f` is needed for this.
declarations.statement:
theorem unit_equalizes {Y X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type (u + 1))) :
    let P := AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct B S hS f f
    let p₁ : P ⟶ Y := ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst f.hom f.hom)
    let p₂ : P ⟶ Y := ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd f.hom f.hom)
    let g : P ⟶ X := p₁ ≫ f
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).adj.unit.app F ≫
        descentMapOver B S hS p₁ f g rfl F =
      (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).adj.unit.app F ≫
        descentMapOver B S hS p₂ f g
          (AlgebraicSpaces.isPullback_fiberProduct B S hS f f).w.symm F
declarations.comment: the unit equalizes the two restrictions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_isLimit_unitFork_of_isProper_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DFX.** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a surjective proper morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S`, let `F` be a sheaf on `X_étale` (the spaces-étale site of `X`, Stacks 03G1), and let
`g : Y ×_X Y ⟶ X` be the structure morphism. Then `F ⟶ f_* f⁻¹ F` is injective with image the
equalizer of the two maps `f_* f⁻¹ F ⇉ g_* g⁻¹ F` induced by the two projections
`Y ×_X Y ⟶ Y`: the fork formed by the unit of `f⁻¹ ⊣ f_*` and these two maps is a limit.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_isLimit_unitFork_of_isProper_isSurjective {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hs : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom) (hp : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS X) (Type (u + 1))) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit (Fork.ofι ((spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS f).unit.app F)
      ((Pseudofunctor.unit_comp_unitForkRestriction _ f (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p)
          (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p₁ (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).hp₁ F).trans
        (Pseudofunctor.unit_comp_unitForkRestriction _ f (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p)
          (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p₂ (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).hp₂ F).symm) :
      Fork (Pseudofunctor.unitForkRestriction _ f (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p)
          (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p₁ (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).hp₁ F)
        (Pseudofunctor.unitForkRestriction _ f (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS f)
          (spacesEtalePseudofunctorAdjunction B S hS (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p)
          (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).p₂ (spacesChosenPullback B S hS f f).hp₂ F)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_globalSectionsRestriction_closedFibre_of_henselianPair
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DFY].** Let `(A, I)` be a henselian pair, let `X` be an algebraic space over
`A` whose structure morphism `f : X ⟶ Spec A` is proper, and let `i : X₀ ⟶ X` be the inclusion of
`X₀ = X ×_{Spec A} Spec (A ⧸ I)`. For every sheaf of sets `ℱ` on `X_étale`,
`Γ(X, ℱ) = Γ(X₀, i⁻¹ ℱ)`: restriction of global sections along `i`, natural in `ℱ`, is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalSectionsRestriction_closedFibre_of_henselianPair (hI : HenselianPair A I)
    (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom) :
    IsIso (globalSectionsRestriction B (Spec (.of A)) hA (closedFibreInclusion A I hA X f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_globalSectionsRestriction_closedFibre_of_henselianLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DFZ].** Let `A` be a henselian local ring, let `X` be an algebraic space over
`A` whose structure morphism `f : X ⟶ Spec A` is proper, and let `i : X₀ ⟶ X` be the inclusion of
the fibre `X₀ = X ×_{Spec A} Spec (A ⧸ 𝔪)` of `f` over the closed point (`A ⧸ 𝔪` is the residue
field of `A`). For every sheaf of sets `ℱ` on `X_étale`, `Γ(X, ℱ) = Γ(X₀, ℱ|_{X₀})`: restriction of
global sections along `i`, natural in `ℱ`, is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalSectionsRestriction_closedFibre_of_henselianLocalRing
    (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom) :
    IsIso (globalSectionsRestriction B (Spec (.of A)) hA
      (closedFibreInclusion A (maximalIdeal A) hA X f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_properBaseChangeMap_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be morphisms of algebraic spaces over
`S` with `f` proper, and let
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
v          v
Y' --g---> Y
```
be cartesian, that is `X' = Y' ×_Y X` with projections `f'` and `g'`. Then for every sheaf of
sets `ℱ` on `X_étale` the canonical map `g⁻¹ f_* ℱ ⟶ f'_* (g')⁻¹ ℱ` is an isomorphism, naturally
in `ℱ`: the base-change map `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properBaseChangeMap` of the small étale
topoi is invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_properBaseChangeMap_of_isProper (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    IsIso (properBaseChangeMap B S hS f g f' g' sq)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bijective_geometricFibreSectionsMap_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DG1].** Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` and let `x̄` be a geometric point of `X`, with geometric fibre
`Y_x̄ = Y ×_{X, x̄} Spec(k)` and projection `p : Y_x̄ ⟶ Y`. For every sheaf of sets `ℱ` on
`Y_étale` the canonical map `(f_* ℱ)_x̄ ⟶ Γ(Y_x̄, ℱ_x̄)`, `ℱ_x̄ = p⁻¹ ℱ`, is bijective.

The proof is the source's: the base-change map of the geometric fibre square is invertible by
proper base change, Stacks 0DG0
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_properBaseChangeMap_of_isProper`).
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_geometricFibreSectionsMap_of_isProper (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.obj)
    (ℱ : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.obj) (Type (u + 1))) :
    Function.Bijective ((geometricFibreSectionsMap B S hS f x).app ℱ)

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.isIso_spacesEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_singleFunctor_of_isProper
registrations.comment: proper base change for algebraic spaces: g⁻¹ R f_* F ≅ R f'_* (g')⁻¹ F for f proper and F an abelian torsion sheaf

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.isIso_spacesEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_of_isProper
registrations.comment: proper base change for algebraic spaces: g⁻¹ R f_* E ≅ R f'_* (g')⁻¹ E for f proper and E bounded below with torsion cohomology sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.abelianSheafFiberHomologyDerivedPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and `x̄ : Spec Ω ⟶ X` a geometric point, with geometric fibre `Y_x̄ = Y ×_X Spec Ω`
and projection `g' : Y_x̄ ⟶ Y`. For an object `E` of `D⁺(Y_étale)` with torsion cohomology
sheaves, `(Hⁿ(Rf_* E))_x̄ ≅ Hⁿ(RΓ(Y_x̄, E_x̄))` for every `n`, where `E_x̄ = (g')⁻¹ E`.
declarations.statement:
def abelianSheafFiberHomologyDerivedPushforwardIso
    (hf : Space.IsProper T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f.hom)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
      Ab.{u + 1})) (m : ℤ) (hE : E.IsGE m) (hT : HasTorsionCohomology T E) (n : ℤ) :
    ((spacesEtaleSitePoint x).sheafFiber (A := Ab.{u + 1})).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1}) n).obj
          ((totalRightDerived (smallEtalePushforward T f)).obj E)) ≅
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} n).obj
      ((totalRightDerived (Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem
          (pullback f (geometricPointHom x))) Ab.{u + 1})).obj
        ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
          (smallEtaleMorphism T (pullback.fst f (geometricPointHom x)))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            E))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.abelianSheafFiberRightDerivedPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and `x̄ : Spec Ω ⟶ X` a geometric point, with geometric fibre `Y_x̄ = Y ×_X Spec Ω`
and projection `g' : Y_x̄ ⟶ Y`. For a torsion abelian sheaf `F` on `Y_étale`,
`(Rⁿf_* F)_x̄ ≅ Hⁿ_étale(Y_x̄, F_x̄)` for every `n`, where `F_x̄ = (g')⁻¹ F`.
declarations.statement:
def abelianSheafFiberRightDerivedPushforwardIso
    (hf : Space.IsProper T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty
      (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) F) (n : ℕ) :
    ((spacesEtaleSitePoint x).sheafFiber (A := Ab.{u + 1})).obj
      (((smallEtalePushforward T f).rightDerived n).obj F) ≅
    AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H.{u + 1} ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
      (smallEtaleMorphism T (pullback.fst f (geometricPointHom x)))).obj F) n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.spacesEtaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_bijective_of_isSepClosed
declarations.doc:
**Étale cohomology of a proper algebraic space does not change under an extension of
separably closed ground fields**. Let `K/k` be an extension of separably closed fields and
`p : X ⟶ Spec k` a proper morphism of algebraic spaces; write `X_K = X ×_{Spec k} Spec K` with
projection `g' : X_K ⟶ X`. Then for every torsion abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale` and every
`q ≥ 0` the restriction map `H^q_étale(X, F) ⟶ H^q_étale(X_K, F|_{X_K})` is bijective.

The base change map `g⁻¹ R p_* E ⟶ R p_{K,*} (g')⁻¹ E` is invertible at every bounded below `E`
with torsion cohomology sheaves by Stacks 0DG3
(`isIso_spacesEtaleDerivedBaseChange_app_of_isProper_of_representable`, with Stacks 0A3U and
Stacks 095T for schemes supplied).
declarations.statement:
theorem spacesEtaleCohomologyRestrictionMap_bijective_of_isSepClosed {X : T.Spaces}
    (p : X ⟶ yonedaSpace T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem (BigFppfOver.mk T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem hk s))
    (hp : Space.IsProper T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem p.hom)
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem
      (pullback p (fieldExtensionSpaceHom T k K hk hK s))) Ab.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty
      (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) F) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (spacesEtaleCohomologyRestrictionMap.{u, w} T
      (pullback.fst p (fieldExtensionSpaceHom T k K hk hK s)) F q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmall_inverseImageFactorizationIso
declarations.doc:
Transitivity of inverse image for `f_small = π_X ∘ i_f`: the adjunction mate of the
direct-image factorization of Tag 0DF6, part (4).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmall_inverseImageFactorizationIso :
    (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage ⋙ (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T f).inverseImage ≅
      (smallEtaleMorphism T f).inverseImage
declarations.comment: transitivity of inverse image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmall_inverseImageFactorizationIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
The transitivity isomorphism is determined by the adjunction unit of `f_small` and the
direct-image factorization of Tag 0DF6: it is the morphism whose adjoint transpose is the unit
followed by that factorization.
declarations.statement:
theorem bigToSmall_inverseImageFactorizationIso_hom_app
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (bigToSmall_inverseImageFactorizationIso T f).hom.app F =
      (((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).comp
        (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T f)).adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((smallEtaleMorphism T f).adj.unit.app F ≫
          (smallEtale_pushforwardIsoDirectFactorization T f).hom.app
            ((smallEtaleMorphism T f).inverseImage.obj F))
declarations.comment: the components of the transitivity isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.smallToBig_inverseImageSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
Taking global sections on the spaces-étale site of `Y` after restriction along `i_f` is
evaluation at the object `f : Y ⟶ X` of the big étale site of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallToBig_inverseImageSectionsIso :
    (smallToBigEtaleMorphism T f).inverseImage ⋙
        Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) (Type (u + 1)) ≅
      (sheafSections (T.bigEtaleTopology X) (Type (u + 1))).obj (op (Over.mk f))
declarations.comment: global sections after restriction are evaluation at f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmall_inverseImageSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
The sections of the inverse image `π_X⁻¹F` of a sheaf on the spaces-étale site of `X` over the
object `f : Y ⟶ X` of the big étale site of `X` are the global sections of the small-site pullback
`f_small⁻¹F` on the spaces-étale site of `Y`, naturally in `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmall_inverseImageSectionsIso :
    (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage ⋙
        (sheafSections (T.bigEtaleTopology X) (Type (u + 1))).obj (op (Over.mk f)) ≅
      (smallEtaleMorphism T f).inverseImage ⋙
        Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) (Type (u + 1))
declarations.comment: the section rule for the pullback

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmall_inverseImageSectionsIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
The section rule is the global-sections image of the transitivity isomorphism, after
identifying evaluation at `f` with global sections of the restriction along `i_f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bigToSmall_inverseImageSectionsIso_hom_app
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (bigToSmall_inverseImageSectionsIso T f).hom.app F =
      (smallToBig_inverseImageSectionsIso T f).inv.app
          ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage.obj F) ≫
        (Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
          (Type (u + 1))).map ((bigToSmall_inverseImageFactorizationIso T f).hom.app F)
declarations.comment: the components of the section rule

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.inverseImage_isSheafFor_smooth_syntomic_fppf_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DG7, the sheaf conditions for smooth, syntomic, fppf and fpqc coverings.** Let `F`
be a sheaf on the spaces-étale site of `X`. Then `π_X⁻¹F` satisfies the sheaf condition for
every family of the slice over `X` whose underlying family of algebraic spaces is a smooth,
syntomic, fppf or fpqc covering.
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImage_isSheafFor_smooth_syntomic_fppf_fpqc :
    (∀ (U : Over X) (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} U),
      Space.IsSmoothCovering T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem
        (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).X i).obj) (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).f i).hom) →
      Presieve.IsSheafFor ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage.obj F).obj E.presieve₀) ∧
    (∀ (U : Over X) (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} U),
      Space.IsSyntomicCovering T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem
        (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).X i).obj) (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).f i).hom) →
      Presieve.IsSheafFor ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage.obj F).obj E.presieve₀) ∧
    (∀ (U : Over X) (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} U),
      Space.IsFppfCovering T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem
        (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).X i).obj) (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).f i).hom) →
      Presieve.IsSheafFor ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage.obj F).obj E.presieve₀) ∧
    (∀ (U : Over X) (E : PreZeroHypercover.{v} U),
      Space.IsFpqcCovering T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem (fun i ↦ ((E.map (Over.forget X)).f i).hom) →
      Presieve.IsSheafFor ((bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage.obj F).obj E.presieve₀)
declarations.comment: Moreover: the sheaf condition for smooth, syntomic, fppf and fpqc coverings

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.isSheaf_bigToSmallEtale_inverseImage
registrations.comment: Moreover: the sheaf condition for ph coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.exists_injective_not_injective_restrictModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DG8, the statement for modules, part (1)(b).** Over `S = Spec ℤ`
there is an injective `𝒪`-module on the big étale site of `S` whose restriction to the
spaces-étale site of `S` is not an injective `𝒪_S`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_injective_not_injective_restrictModules :
    ∃ I : BigEtaleModules.{u, u + 1} T (baseSpace T), Injective I ∧
      ¬ Injective ((restrictModules.{u, u + 1} T (baseSpace T)).obj I)
declarations.comment: the corresponding statement (1)(b) for modules does not hold

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.exists_injective_not_injective_restrictModulesAlong
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DG8, the statement for modules, part (1)(a).** Over `S = Spec ℤ`
there are a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over `S` and an injective `𝒪`-module on
the big étale site of `X` whose inverse image `i_f^*` on the spaces-étale site of `Y` is not an
injective `𝒪_Y`-module; one can take `f` the identity of `X = S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_injective_not_injective_restrictModulesAlong :
    ∃ (Y : T.Spaces) (f : Y ⟶ baseSpace T) (I : BigEtaleModules.{u, u + 1} T (baseSpace T)),
      Injective I ∧ ¬ Injective ((restrictModulesAlong T f).obj I)
declarations.comment: the corresponding statement (1)(a) for modules does not hold

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.exists_isKInjective_not_isKInjective_restrictModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DG8, the statement for modules, part (2)(b).** Over `S = Spec ℤ`
there is a K-injective complex of `𝒪`-modules on the big étale site of `S` whose restriction to
the spaces-étale site of `S` is not a K-injective complex of `𝒪_S`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isKInjective_not_isKInjective_restrictModules :
    ∃ I : CochainComplex (BigEtaleModules.{u, u + 1} T (baseSpace T)) ℤ, I.IsKInjective ∧
      ¬ CochainComplex.IsKInjective
        (((restrictModules.{u, u + 1} T (baseSpace T)).mapHomologicalComplex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.exists_isKInjective_not_isKInjective_restrictModulesAlong

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.derivedBigEtaleBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of algebraic spaces of the big étale site, the inverse image along
`g_big` of the derived big étale direct image along `f` agrees naturally with the derived big
étale direct image along `f'` of the inverse image along `g'_big`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedBigEtaleBaseChangeIso {X Y X' Y' : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (g' : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : Y' ⟶ X') (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    ((bigEtalePushforward T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
        (bigEtalePullback T g).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigEtalePullback T g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        ((bigEtalePushforward T f').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology Y') Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment: big_base_change_abelian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.derivedSmallEtaleBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of algebraic spaces of the big étale site, the restriction to the
spaces-étale site of `X'` of the derived big étale direct image along `f` agrees naturally with
the derived small étale direct image along `f'` of the restriction to the spaces-étale site of
`Y'`. Both restrictions are the inverse image `i_g^{-1}` resp. `i_{g'}^{-1}` of Tag 0DF2,
written as the inverse image along `g_big` resp. `g'_big` followed by restriction to the
spaces-étale site.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSmallEtaleBaseChangeIso {X Y X' Y' : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (g' : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : Y' ⟶ X') (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    ((bigEtalePushforward T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
        (bigEtalePullback T g).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          (spacesEtaleRestrictionAb T X').mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigEtalePullback T g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (spacesEtaleRestrictionAb T Y').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          ((smallEtalePushforward T f').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
              (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
                (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y')
                  Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment: small_base_change_abelian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.derivedBigEtaleModuleBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of algebraic spaces of the big étale site, the inverse image of
sheaves of `𝒪`-modules along `g_big` of the derived big étale direct image along `f` agrees
naturally with the derived big étale direct image along `f'` of the inverse image along
`g'_big`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedBigEtaleModuleBaseChangeIso {X Y X' Y' : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (g' : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : Y' ⟶ X') (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (homotopyToDerived (bigEtaleRelocalizationPushforward T f)).totalRightDerived
          DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((globalRingSheaf T).over Y)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
        (bigEtaleModulePullback T g).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigEtaleModulePullback T g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (homotopyToDerived (bigEtaleRelocalizationPushforward T f')).totalRightDerived
          DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((globalRingSheaf T).over Y')) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment: big_base_change_modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.derivedSmallEtaleModuleBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of algebraic spaces of the big étale site, the restriction to the
spaces-étale site of `X'` of the derived big étale direct image of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules along
`f` agrees naturally with the derived small étale direct image along `f'` of the restriction to
the spaces-étale site of `Y'`. The two restrictions are the inverse images `i_g^*` and
`i_{g'}^*` of Tag 0DF2 on sheaves of `𝒪`-modules.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSmallEtaleModuleBaseChangeIso (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X) (g' : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : Y' ⟶ X')
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    derivedPushforward.{u + 1} (bigEtaleRingedSiteHom T f) ⋙
        (spacesEtaleRestrictionAlongRingedHom T g).pushforwardTopos.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (spacesEtaleRestrictionAlongRingedHom T g').pushforwardTopos.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedPushforward.{u + 1} (smallEtaleRingedSiteHom T f')
declarations.comment: small_base_change_modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.derivedBigSmallEtalePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Derived direct image commutes with restriction to the small étale site.** Derived big-site
direct image followed by restriction to the small étale site agrees naturally with restriction
followed by derived small-site direct image.
declarations.statement:
public def derivedBigSmallEtalePushforwardIso :
    (((bigEtalePushforward T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ⋙
      ((Space.SpacesEtale.inclusion T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        Ab.{u + 1} (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
        (T.bigEtaleTopology X)).mapDerivedCategory ≅
    ((Space.SpacesEtale.inclusion T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        Ab.{u + 1} (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
        (T.bigEtaleTopology Y)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((smallEtalePushforward T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
              Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
declarations.comment: big_small_abelian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.derivedBigSmallEtaleModulePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DGA, part (2).** Derived big étale direct image of sheaves of
`𝒪`-modules followed by restriction to the small étale site of `X` agrees naturally with
restriction to the small étale site of `Y` followed by derived small étale direct image.
declarations.statement:
def derivedBigSmallEtaleModulePushforwardIso (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    derivedPushforward.{u + 1} (bigEtaleRingedSiteHom T f) ⋙
        (spacesEtaleRestrictionRingedHom T X).pushforwardTopos.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (spacesEtaleRestrictionRingedHom T Y).pushforwardTopos.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedPushforward.{u + 1} (smallEtaleRingedSiteHom T f)
declarations.comment: big_small_modules

registrations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Localization.derivedOverPushforwardBaseChangeIso
registrations.comment: big_base_change_abelian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
Étale cohomology over `Y` of a complex of abelian sheaves on the big étale site of `X` is
the cohomology on the spaces-étale site of `Y` of its restriction along `i_f`: the right-derived
sections functor at `f : Y ⟶ X` is restriction followed by derived global sections, naturally in
the derived coefficient object.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso :
    (((bigEtaleSections T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≅
    ((smallEtaleRestriction T f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
        Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: part (5), big-site cohomology over Y of a big complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt
declarations.doc:
In every degree, étale cohomology over `Y` of a complex on the big étale site of `X` agrees
with the cohomology on the spaces-étale site of `Y` of its restriction along `i_f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1})) (n : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} n).obj
      ((((bigEtaleSections T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).obj M) ≅
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} n).obj
      (((smallEtaleRestriction T f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
          Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))).obj M)
declarations.comment: part (5), in each degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.pulledSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
Étale cohomology over `Y` of a complex pulled back from the spaces-étale site of `X` to the
big étale site of `X` is the cohomology on the spaces-étale site of `Y` of its pullback along
`f_small`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pulledSmallEtaleCohomologyIso :
    ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
      (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((bigEtaleSections T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))) ≅
    ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
      (smallEtaleMorphism T f)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
        Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: part (3), cohomology of a pullback from the small site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.pulledSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt
declarations.doc:
In every degree, étale cohomology over `Y` of a complex pulled back from the spaces-étale

        (smallEtaleMorphism T f)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
          Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.overXSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt
declarations.doc:
In every degree, étale cohomology over `X` of a complex pulled back from the spaces-étale
site of `X` agrees with its small-site cohomology.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def overXSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})) (n : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} n).obj
      (((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
        (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (((bigEtaleSections T (𝟙 X)).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))).obj K) ≅
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} n).obj
      ((((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
        Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).obj K)
declarations.comment: part (1), in each degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.moduleOverXSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGB, part (2).** Étale cohomology over `X` of the derived pullback `Lπ_X^*K` to
the big étale site of `X` of a complex of sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules on the spaces-étale site of
`X` is the cohomology of `K` on that site, naturally in the derived coefficient object.
declarations.statement:
def moduleOverXSmallEtaleCohomologyIso :
    (derivedModulePullbackPi T X ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (bigEtaleRingSheaf T X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((bigEtaleSections T (𝟙 X)).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))) ≅
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (spacesEtaleRingSheaf T X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X)
          Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: part (2), cohomology over X of a derived pullback of modules from the small site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.moduleOverXSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.modulePulledSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
Étale cohomology over `Y` of the derived pullback `Lπ_X^*K` of a complex of sheaves of
`𝒪_X`-modules on the spaces-étale site of `X` is naturally isomorphic to the cohomology on the
spaces-étale site of `Y` of `Lf_small^*K`, as total right derived functors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def modulePulledSmallEtaleCohomologyIso :
    (derivedModulePullbackPi T X ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (bigEtaleRingSheaf T X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((bigEtaleSections T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))) ≅
    (derivedModulePullbackSmallEtale T f ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (spacesEtaleRingSheaf T Y)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)

              (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: part (4), cohomology over Y of a derived pullback from the small site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.modulePulledSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.moduleBigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGB, part (6).** Étale cohomology over `Y` of a complex of sheaves of
`𝒪`-modules on the big étale site of `X` is the cohomology on the spaces-étale site of `Y` of
its inverse image along `i_f`: the right-derived sections functor at `f : Y ⟶ X` is `i_f^*`
followed by derived global sections, naturally in the derived coefficient object.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleBigSmallEtaleCohomologyIso :
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (bigEtaleRingSheaf T X)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((bigEtaleSections T f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))) ≅
    ((restrictModulesAlong T f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (spacesEtaleRingSheaf T Y)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
        Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))
declarations.comment: part (6), big-site cohomology over Y of a complex of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.moduleBigSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt

sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big étale site of `X` agrees with the cohomology on the
spaces-étale site of `Y` of its inverse image along `i_f`.

noncomputable def moduleBigSmallEtaleCohomologyIsoAt

    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} n).obj

        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (spacesEtaleRingSheaf T Y)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (((Sheaf.Γ (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y)
          Ab.{u + 1}).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).totalRightDerived DerivedCategory.Qh
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))).obj M)
