declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmall_inverseImage_comp_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGC.** Restricting back to the spaces-étale site of `X` the inverse image of a
sheaf of sets along `π_X` returns that sheaf: `π_{X,*} ∘ π_X⁻¹` is the identity functor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmall_inverseImage_comp_pushforwardIso :
    (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).inverseImage ⋙ (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X).pushforward ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: the composite is the identity, for sheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmall_abelianInverseImage_comp_restrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGC.** The same composite identity for abelian sheaves: restricting the abelian
inverse image along `π_X` back to the spaces-étale site of `X` returns the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def bigToSmall_abelianInverseImage_comp_restrictionIso :
    CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage (bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X) ⋙
        bigToSmallEtaleRestriction T X ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})
declarations.comment: the composite is the identity, for abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.isIso_bigToSmallEtaleDerivedAdjunction_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGC.** For every complex `K` on the spaces-étale site of `X` the canonical map
`K ⟶ Rπ_{X,*}π_X⁻¹K` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_bigToSmallEtaleDerivedAdjunction_unit
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X) Ab.{u + 1})) :
    IsIso ((bigToSmallEtaleDerivedAdjunction T X).unit.app K)
declarations.comment: the derived unit is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.bigToSmallEtale_pushforward_baseChange_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGD.** Let `S` be a scheme and `f : Y ⟶ X` a proper morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` (objects of the big étale site `T` of algebraic spaces over `S`). Write
`π_X : Sh((Spaces/X)_étale) ⟶ Sh(X_étale)` (`bigToSmallEtaleMorphism T X`) for the comparison
of the big étale topos with the small étale topos `Sh(X_étale)` (the spaces-étale site of `X`).
Then:

1. the canonical base change map `π_X⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} ⟶ f_{big,*} ∘ π_Y⁻¹` of functors from
   sheaves of sets on `Y_étale` to sheaves of sets on `(Spaces/X)_étale`
   (`bigToSmallEtaleBaseChange T f`; its target `f_{big,*}` is restriction along
   `Y ×_X - : Spaces/X ⥤ Spaces/Y`) is an isomorphism;
2. for every `K` in `D⁺(Y_étale)` (`K.IsGE n` for some `n`) whose cohomology sheaves are torsion,
   the canonical base change map `π_X⁻¹ R f_{small,*} K ⟶ R f_{big,*} π_Y⁻¹ K` of Stacks 07A7
   (`bigToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange T f`, on the derived categories of abelian sheaves) is an
   isomorphism;
3. if `f` is finite, the canonical base change map `π_X⁻¹ R f_{small,*} K ⟶ R f_{big,*} π_Y⁻¹ K`
   is an isomorphism for every `K` in the unbounded derived category `D(Y_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bigToSmallEtale_pushforward_baseChange_of_isProper {X Y : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : Space.IsProper T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f.hom) :
    IsIso (bigToSmallEtaleBaseChange T f) ∧
      (∀ (K : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1})) (n : ℤ),
        K.IsGE n → HasTorsionCohomology T K →
          IsIso ((bigToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange T f).app K)) ∧
      (Space.IsFinite T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem f.hom →
        ∀ K : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem Y) Ab.{u + 1}),
          IsIso ((bigToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange T f).app K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_fppfToSmallEtale_units_and_isZero_rightDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGF.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S`.
(1) For a sheaf of sets `F` on `X_étale`, `ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹F = π_X⁻¹F` and `a_{X,*}a_X⁻¹F = F`: the
units `π_X⁻¹F ⟶ ε_{X,*}ε_X⁻¹π_X⁻¹F` and `F ⟶ a_{X,*}a_X⁻¹F` are isomorphisms.
(2) For an abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale`, `R^iε_{X,*}(a_X⁻¹F) = 0` for `i > 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfToSmallEtale_units_and_isZero_rightDerived (X : T.Spaces) :
    (IsIso (Functor.whiskerLeft (E.bigToSmallEtaleMorphism (etaleSpace T E h X)).inverseImage
        (fppfToBigEtaleMorphism T E h X).adj.unit) ∧
      IsIso (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h X).adj.unit) ∧
    ∀ (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace T E h X))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (i : ℕ), 0 < i →
      IsZero ((((Over.postEquiv (canonicalSpaceEquivalence T E h).1
        (X := X)).inverse.sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (E.bigEtaleTopology (etaleSpace T E h X))
        (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X)).rightDerived i).obj
          ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h X)).obj F))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_fppfToSmallEtale_derivedUnits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGG.** For `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)` the maps `π_X⁻¹K ⟶ Rε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹K` and
`K ⟶ Ra_{X,*}a_X⁻¹K` are isomorphisms: the units of the derived adjunctions `ε_X⁻¹ ⊣ Rε_{X,*}`
at `π_X⁻¹K` and `a_X⁻¹ ⊣ Ra_{X,*}` at `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfToSmallEtale_derivedUnits
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem
      (etaleSpace T E h X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    IsIso ((Stacks.ComparingTopologies.derivedPlusAdjunction
        (fppfToBigEtaleAbelianAdjunction T E h X)).unit.app
          ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
            (E.bigToSmallEtaleMorphism (etaleSpace T E h X))).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ∧
      IsIso ((Stacks.ComparingTopologies.derivedPlusAdjunction
        (fppfToSmallEtaleAbelianAdjunction T E h X)).unit.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_etaleToFppfCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGH, part (2).** For `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)`, `H^q(X_étale, K) = H^q_fppf(X, a_X⁻¹K)`
for every `q`: the map induced on `H^q` by the canonical map
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.etaleToFppfDerivedGlobalSections` is an isomorphism, naturally
in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_etaleToFppfCohomology (q : ℤ) :
    IsIso (Functor.whiskerRight (etaleToFppfDerivedGlobalSections T E h X)
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} q))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.etaleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGH, part (1).** For an abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale`,
`H^q(X_étale, F) = H^q_fppf(X, a_X⁻¹F)` for every `q`, by the canonical map
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.etaleToFppfDerivedGlobalSections` at `F[0]`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyIso (X : T.Spaces)
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace T E h X))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    ((etaleGlobalSections T E h X).rightDerived q).obj F ≅
      ((fppfGlobalSections T X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h X)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.etaleCohomologyConstantIso
declarations.doc:
**The example of Stacks 0DGH.** For an abelian group `A`,
`H^q_étale(X, A) = H^q_fppf(X, A)` for the constant sheaves.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyConstantIso (X : T.Spaces) (A : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    ((etaleGlobalSections T E h X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace T E h X))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj A) ≅
      ((fppfGlobalSections T X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj A)
declarations.comment: the example of an abelian group

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.canonicalSpaceEquivalence
declarations.doc:
The identification of the category of algebraic spaces a big fppf site of algebraic spaces is
built on with the one a big étale site of algebraic spaces over the same big fppf site of schemes
is built on, together with the facts that it is the identity on objects and on morphisms.
declarations.comment: identification of the underlying algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToBigEtale_isContinuous
declarations.doc:
The identity-on-spaces functor from the big étale slice at `X` to the big fppf slice at `X`
is continuous.
declarations.statement:
instance fppfToBigEtale_isContinuous (X : T.Spaces) :
    ((Over.postEquiv (canonicalSpaceEquivalence T E h).1 (X := X)).inverse).IsContinuous
      (E.bigEtaleTopology (etaleSpace T E h X)) (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X)
declarations.comment: continuity of the change-of-topology functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToBigEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
The change-of-topology morphism `ε_X` from the big fppf topos of `X` to its big étale topos,
induced by the identity-on-spaces functor of slice categories.
declarations.comment: the fppf-to-big-étale morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToBigEtale_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
The direct image of `ε_X` is restriction along the identity-on-spaces functor of slice
categories.
declarations.statement:
def fppfToBigEtale_pushforwardIso (X : T.Spaces) :
    (fppfToBigEtaleMorphism T E h X).pushforward ≅
      ((Over.postEquiv (canonicalSpaceEquivalence T E h).1
        (X := X)).inverse).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (E.bigEtaleTopology (etaleSpace T E h X)) (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X)
declarations.comment: direct image of the fppf-to-big-étale morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.pullbackChangeOfTopologyIso
declarations.doc:
Base change along `f` commutes with the identity-on-spaces change-of-topology functor of
slice categories.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackChangeOfTopologyIso {X Y : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    Over.pullback (etaleMap T E h f) ⋙
        (Over.postEquiv (canonicalSpaceEquivalence T E h).1 (X := Y)).inverse ≅
      (Over.postEquiv (canonicalSpaceEquivalence T E h).1 (X := X)).inverse ⋙
        Over.pullback f
declarations.comment: canonical base-change comparison on the big sites

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism `a_X` from the big fppf topos of `X` to its small étale topos: the composite of
`ε_X` with the big-to-small étale morphism `π_X` ([Stacks, Tag 0DF3]).
declarations.statement:
def fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism (X : T.Spaces) :
    MorphismOfTopoi (Sheaf (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace T E h X))
        (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: the factorization through big étale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.bigFppfBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
The big fppf–big étale square: for a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces the direct
images of `ε_X ∘ f_{big, fppf}` and of `f_{big, étale} ∘ ε_Y` are canonically isomorphic.
declarations.comment: the big fppf–big étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.bigFppfSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
The big fppf–small étale square: for a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces the direct
images of `a_X ∘ f_{big, fppf}` and of `f_{small} ∘ a_Y` are canonically isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
def bigFppfSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso {X Y : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ((E.smallEtaleMorphism (etaleMap T E h f)).comp
        (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h Y)).pushforward ≅
      ((fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h X).comp (bigFppfMorphism T f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the big fppf–small étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToSmallEtalePushforwardIsosOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, and `a = π ∘ ε` the
comparison morphisms from the big fppf topoi to the small étale topoi of Stacks 0DGI. Then
`a_X⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} = f_{big,fppf,*} ∘ a_Y⁻¹`, as functors from sheaves of sets on the small étale
site of `Y` to sheaves of sets on the big fppf site of `X`, and likewise for abelian sheaves. Both
isomorphisms are the canonical base change maps, the mates of the commutative square of Stacks
0DGI: `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToSmallEtaleBaseChange` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToSmallEtaleAbelianBaseChange`.
declarations.statement:
def fppfToSmallEtalePushforwardIsosOfIsProper
    (hf : Space.IsProper T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom) :
    ((E.smallEtaleMorphism (etaleMap T E h f)).pushforward ⋙
        (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h X).inverseImage ≅
      (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h Y).inverseImage ⋙ (bigFppfMorphism T f).pushforward) ×
    (E.smallEtalePushforward (etaleMap T E h f) ⋙
        CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h X) ≅
      CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage (fppfToSmallEtaleMorphism T E h Y) ⋙
        fppfAbelianPushforward T f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_fppfToSmallEtaleBaseChange_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Proper base change for the big fppf topos.** For a proper morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic
spaces, the canonical base change map `a_X⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} ⟶ f_{big,fppf,*} ∘ a_Y⁻¹` of functors
from sheaves on the small étale site of `Y` to sheaves on the big fppf site of `X` is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfToSmallEtaleBaseChange_of_isProper {X Y : T.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : Space.IsProper T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom) :
    IsIso (fppfToSmallEtaleBaseChange T E h f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_fppfToSmallEtaleProperDerivedBaseChange_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGJ, part (2).** For a proper morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces and `K` in
`D⁺(Y_étale)` with torsion cohomology sheaves, `a_X⁻¹(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,fppf,*}(a_Y⁻¹K)`:
the comparison map `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToSmallEtaleProperDerivedBaseChange`
is an isomorphism at `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfToSmallEtaleProperDerivedBaseChange_app
    (hf : Space.IsProper T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem
      (etaleSpace T E h Y)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : BigEtaleSpaceSite.HasTorsionCohomology E (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K)) :
    IsIso ((fppfToSmallEtaleProperDerivedBaseChange T E h f).app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_fppfToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGK.** For a finite morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces,
`a_X⁻¹(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,fppf,*}(a_Y⁻¹K)` for `K` in `D⁺(Y_étale)`: the base change map
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange`, the mate of
`Rf_{small,*} ∘ Ra_{Y,*} = Ra_{X,*} ∘ Rf_{big,fppf,*}`, is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fppfToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange
    (hf : Space.IsFinite T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom) :
    IsIso (fppfToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange T E h f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isEquivalence_fppfSmallEtaleTripleFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Fppf descent of small étale sheaves.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` which is flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective. Then the functor
`Sh(Y_étale) ⥤ {(G, H, α)}`, `F ↦ (f_small⁻¹F, a_Y⁻¹F, can)`, into the category of triples with
`G ∈ Sh(X_étale)`, `H ∈ Sh((Spaces/Y)_fppf)` and `α : a_X⁻¹G ⟶ f_{big,fppf}⁻¹H` an isomorphism,
is an equivalence of categories.

The category of triples is the two-fibre product `a_X⁻¹ ⊡ f_{big,fppf}⁻¹`
(`CategoryTheory.Limits.CategoricalPullback`), whose objects are exactly the triples, and the
functor is `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfSmallEtaleTripleFunctor`, built from the
canonical isomorphism `can = AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.fppfSmallEtaleInverseImageCommIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_fppfSmallEtaleTripleFunctor {X Y : T.Spaces} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Space.IsFlat T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom)
    (hlfp : Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom)
    (hsurj : Space.IsSurjective T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem f.hom) :
    (fppfSmallEtaleTripleFunctor T E h f).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The value of `𝓕ᵃ` at `(f : Y ⟶ X)` is `Γ(Y, f^*𝓕)`**: the morphisms `f^*𝒪_X ⟶ f^*𝓕` of
`𝒪_Y`-modules correspond to the global sections of `f^*𝓕`.

The inverse image of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackUnitIso`), and a morphism out of the structure sheaf is
a global section (`CategoryTheory.SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv`).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def associatedSectionsEquiv {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (Y : Over X) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS Y.hom).obj (SheafOfModules.unit _ :
          Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⟶
        (modulePullback B S hS Y.hom).obj F) ≃
      ((modulePullback B S hS Y.hom).obj F).sections
declarations.comment:
the value of the rule 𝓕 ↦ 𝓕ᵃ at an object (f : Y ⟶ X) of the big étale site of
an algebraic space X is Γ(Y, f^*𝓕), the global sections of the inverse image of 𝓕 along f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.associatedPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGN, the rule `𝓕ᵃ` on the big étale site of an algebraic space.**  For an
`𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` on the small étale site of an algebraic space `X` of a big étale space site of
Stacks 0DBX, the presheaf of abelian groups on the category underlying the big étale site of
`X` whose value at `(f : Y ⟶ X)` is `Γ(Y, f^*𝓕)`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedPresheaf` read on that category; the identification
of its value with `Γ(Y, f^*𝓕)` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedSectionsEquiv`.
declarations.comment:
the construction of the rule 𝓕 ↦ 𝓕ᵃ as a presheaf of abelian groups on the big
étale site of an algebraic space; none of the seven assertions the source makes about it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_of_isFpqcCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGN, clause (1): `𝓕ᵃ` is an fpqc sheaf.**  For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕`
on an algebraic space `X` over `S`, the rule `𝓕ᵃ : (f : Y ⟶ X) ↦ Γ(Y, f^*𝓕)`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.associatedPresheaf`) satisfies the sheaf condition for every family
`{Y i ⟶ Y}` of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `X` which is an fpqc covering of `Y`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_ofArrows_overMk` for the members
`(g i).left` of the family, each `Y i` being the object `Over.mk (Y i).hom` of `Over X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_of_isFpqcCovering {Y : Over X} {Yi : I → Over X}
    (g : ∀ i, Yi i ⟶ Y) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (hg : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i ↦ (g i).left.hom) :
    (Presieve.ofArrows Yi g).IsSheafFor (associatedPresheaf F ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat)
declarations.comment: (1): for 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module, 𝓕ᵃ satisfies the sheaf condition for every fpqc covering {U_i → U} of an object of (Spaces/X)_étale; the fppf and étale cases are isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_of_isFppfCovering and isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_of_isEtaleCovering

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigEtaleSpaceSite.isSheaf_associatedPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**The rule `𝓕ᵃ` is a sheaf on `(Spaces/X)_étale`** (the étale case of Stacks 0DGN,
clause (1)).  For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` on an algebraic space `X` of a big étale
site, the rule `𝓕ᵃ : (f : Y ⟶ X) ↦ Γ(Y, f^*𝓕)` is a sheaf of
abelian groups on the big étale site of `X`: it is isomorphic to the underlying presheaf of the
sheaf of modules `π_X^*𝓕` (clause (2)).
declarations.statement:
theorem BigEtaleSpaceSite.isSheaf_associatedPresheaf {S : Scheme.{u}} (T : BigEtaleSpaceSite S)
    (X : T.Spaces) (F : Space.Modules.{u, u} T.fppfSite S T.fppf_mem X.1 X.2)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (T.bigEtaleTopology X) (T.associatedPresheaf X F)
declarations.comment: (1), a fortiori for étale coverings: 𝓕ᵃ is a sheaf on (Spaces/X)_étale, for 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module; the fpqc sheaf condition is Space.isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_of_isFpqcCovering

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isSheaf_associatedPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**The rule `𝓕ᵃ` is a sheaf on `(Spaces/X)_fppf`** (the fppf case of Stacks 0DGN,
clause (1)).  For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` on an algebraic space `X` of a big fppf
site, the rule `𝓕ᵃ : (f : Y ⟶ X) ↦ Γ(Y, f^*𝓕)` is a sheaf of
abelian groups on the big fppf site of `X`: it is isomorphic to the underlying presheaf of the
sheaf of modules `a_X^*𝓕` (clause (3)).
declarations.statement:
theorem BigFppfSpaceSite.isSheaf_associatedPresheaf {S : Scheme.{u}} (T : BigFppfSpaceSite S)
    (X : T.Spaces) (F : Space.Modules.{u, u} T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem X.1 X.2)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfSpaceOver.topology T X) (Space.associatedPresheaf F)
declarations.comment: (1), a fortiori for fppf coverings: 𝓕ᵃ is a sheaf on (Spaces/X)_fppf, for 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module; the fpqc sheaf condition is Space.isSheafFor_associatedPresheaf_of_isFpqcCovering

registrations.name: BigEtaleSpaceSite.associatedPresheafIsoPullback
registrations.comment: (2): 𝓕ᵃ ≅ π_X^*𝓕 on (Spaces/X)_étale, for 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module read on the spaces-étale site through ι

registrations.name: BigFppfSpaceSite.nonempty_associatedPresheaf_iso_pullback
registrations.comment: (3): 𝓕ᵃ ≅ a_X^*𝓕 on (Spaces/X)_fppf, for 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module read on the spaces-étale site through ι

registrations.name: BigEtaleSpaceSite.quasicoherentPullbackEquivalence
registrations.comment: (4): 𝓕 ↦ 𝓕ᵃ = π_X^*𝓕 is an equivalence between quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-modules and quasi-coherent modules on ((Spaces/X)_étale, 𝒪), with quasi-inverse π_{X,*}

registrations.name: BigFppfSpaceSite.quasicoherentPullbackEquivalence
registrations.comment: (5): 𝓕 ↦ 𝓕ᵃ = a_X^*𝓕 is an equivalence between quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-modules and quasi-coherent modules on ((Spaces/X)_fppf, 𝒪), with quasi-inverse a_{X,*}

registrations.name: BigFppfSpaceSite.pushforward_pullback_of_quasicoherent
registrations.comment: (6): ε_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 ≅ π_X^*𝓕 and 𝓕 ≅ a_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 (the unit is an isomorphism) for 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module

registrations.name: BigFppfSpaceSite.isZero_rightDerived_pushforward_pullback_of_quasicoherent
registrations.comment: (7): R^i ε_{X,*}(a_X^*𝓕) = 0 and R^i a_{X,*}(a_X^*𝓕) = 0 for i > 0 and 𝓕 a quasi-coherent 𝒪_X-module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_bigEtalePullbackToPushforwardPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGP: the map `π_X^*𝓕 ⟶ Rε_{X,*}(a_X^*𝓕)` is an isomorphism** for a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `𝓕`: the canonical map `π_X^*𝓕 ⟶ ε_{X,*}(a_X^*𝓕)` is an isomorphism (Stacks 0DGN
(6)) and `a_X^*𝓕` is right acyclic for `ε_{X,*}` (Stacks 0DGN (7)), so that the canonical map
`ε_{X,*}(a_X^*𝓕) ⟶ Rε_{X,*}(a_X^*𝓕)` is an isomorphism too.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_bigEtalePullbackToPushforwardPullback
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (Space.spacesEtaleRingedSite T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem X).O))
    [hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    IsIso (bigEtalePullbackToPushforwardPullback T E h X F) ∧
      Functor.rightAcyclic.{u + 2, u + 2}
        (fppfToBigEtaleRingedHom T E h X).toRingedToposSiteHom.pushforwardTopos
        ((fppfToSpacesEtaleRingedSiteHom T X).toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.obj F)
declarations.comment: (1) the canonical map π_X^*𝓕 ⟶ ε_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 (unit of ε_X^* ⊣ ε_{X,*} and a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X) is an isomorphism, and ε_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 ⟶ Rε_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 is an isomorphism

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_derivedPushforward_pullback_of_quasicoherent
registrations.comment: both maps: π_X^*𝓕 ≅ ε_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 ⟶ Rε_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 and 𝓕 ≅ a_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕 ⟶ Ra_{X,*}a_X^*𝓕, the second map in each being the canonical (right acyclicity) isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSpaceSite.isIso_derivedUnits_of_quasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGR.** Let `S` be a scheme and `X` an algebraic space over `S`. For `K` in
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, an object of `D(X_{spaces,étale}, 𝒪_X)` all of whose cohomology sheaves are
quasi-coherent, the maps

`Lπ_X^*K ⟶ Rε_{X,*}(La_X^*K)` and `K ⟶ Ra_{X,*}(La_X^*K)`

are isomorphisms, where `a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X : ((Spaces/X)_fppf, 𝒪) ⟶ (X_{spaces,étale}, 𝒪_X)`.
The first map is the unit of `Lε_X^* ⊣ Rε_{X,*}` at `Lπ_X^*K` followed by `Rε_{X,*}` of the
comparison `Lε_X^*Lπ_X^*K ⟶ La_X^*K` of Stacks 0D6D; the second is the unit of `La_X^* ⊣ Ra_{X,*}`
at `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedUnits_of_quasicoherent
    (X : T.Spaces)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (Space.spacesEtaleRingedSite E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace T E h X)).O)))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K).IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    IsIso ((derivedAdjunction (epsilonHom T E h X)
        (fppfToBigEtaleRingedHom T E h X).isMorphismOfSites).unit.app
          ((derivedPullback (BigEtaleSpaceSite.spacesEtaleRestrictionRingedSiteHom E
            (etaleSpace T E h X)).toRingedToposSiteHom).obj K) ≫
      (derivedPushforward (epsilonHom T E h X)).map
        ((derivedPullbackCompComparison (epsilonHom T E h X)
          (BigEtaleSpaceSite.spacesEtaleRestrictionRingedSiteHom E
            (etaleSpace T E h X)).toRingedToposSiteHom).app K)) ∧
    IsIso ((derivedAdjunction ((BigEtaleSpaceSite.spacesEtaleRestrictionRingedSiteHom E
        (etaleSpace T E h X)).toRingedToposSiteHom.comp (epsilonHom T E h X))
        (RingedToposSiteHom.isMorphismOfSites_comp_u _ _
          (fppfToBigEtaleRingedHom T E h X).isMorphismOfSites
          (BigEtaleSpaceSite.spacesEtaleRestrictionRingedSiteHom E
            (etaleSpace T E h X)).isMorphismOfSites)).unit.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.isIso_phToBigEtale_unit_app_inverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGT, part (1), `ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹ℱ = π_X⁻¹ℱ`.** For a sheaf of sets `ℱ` on `X_étale` the
unit `π_X⁻¹ℱ ⟶ ε_{X,*}ε_X⁻¹π_X⁻¹ℱ = ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹ℱ` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_phToBigEtale_unit_app_inverseImage
    (X : P.Spaces)
    (ℱ : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X))
      (Type (u + 1))) :
    IsIso ((phToBigEtaleMorphism P E h X).adj.unit.app
      ((E.bigToSmallEtaleMorphism (etaleSpace P E h X)).inverseImage.obj ℱ))
declarations.comment: part (1), the equality ε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹ℱ = π_X⁻¹ℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.isIso_phToSmallEtale_unit_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGT, part (1), `a_{X,*}a_X⁻¹ℱ = ℱ`.** For a sheaf of sets `ℱ` on `X_étale` the unit
`ℱ ⟶ a_{X,*}a_X⁻¹ℱ` is an isomorphism. It is the unit of `π_X⁻¹ ⊣ π_{X,*}`, an isomorphism by
Stacks 0DF3, followed by `π_{X,*}` of the unit of `ε_X⁻¹ ⊣ ε_{X,*}` at `π_X⁻¹ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_phToSmallEtale_unit_app
    (X : P.Spaces)
    (ℱ : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X))
      (Type (u + 1))) :
    IsIso ((phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X).adj.unit.app ℱ)
declarations.comment: part (1), the equality a_{X,*}a_X⁻¹ℱ = ℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.isZero_rightDerived_phToBigEtale_abelianInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGT, part (2).** Let `X` be an algebraic space and `ℱ` a torsion abelian sheaf on
`X_étale`. Then `R^i ε_{X,*}(a_X⁻¹ℱ) = 0` for `i > 0`. Here
`ε_X : (Spaces/X)_ph ⟶ (Spaces/X)_étale` is the comparison of Stacks 0DGW, `ε_{X,*}` is
restriction of abelian sheaves along the identity-on-spaces functor of slices, `a_X⁻¹` is the
abelian inverse image (Stacks 04JC) of `a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X`, and `R^i` is the right derived
functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerived_phToBigEtale_abelianInverseImage (X : P.Spaces)
    (ℱ : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hℱ : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty
      (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X)) ℱ)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    IsZero (((phToBigEtaleAbelianPushforward P E h X).rightDerived i).obj
      ((phToSmallEtaleAbelianInverseImage P E h X).obj ℱ))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.isIso_phToSmallEtale_derivedUnits
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` and `K` an object of `D⁺(X_étale)` whose cohomology
sheaves are torsion. Then the maps `π_X⁻¹K ⟶ Rε_{X,*}a_X⁻¹K` and `K ⟶ Ra_{X,*}a_X⁻¹K` are
isomorphisms, for the comparison morphisms `ε_X` and `a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X` from the big ph topos of `X`
(Stacks 0DGW). The two maps are the units of the derived adjunctions `ε_X⁻¹ ⊣ Rε_{X,*}` at `π_X⁻¹K`
and `a_X⁻¹ ⊣ Ra_{X,*}` at `K` on bounded below derived categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_phToSmallEtale_derivedUnits
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem
      (etaleSpace P E h X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K))) :
    IsIso ((Stacks.ComparingTopologies.derivedPlusAdjunction
        (phToBigEtaleAbelianAdjunction P E h X)).unit.app
          ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
            (E.bigToSmallEtaleMorphism (etaleSpace P E h X))).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)) ∧
      IsIso ((Stacks.ComparingTopologies.derivedPlusAdjunction
        (phToSmallEtaleAbelianAdjunction P E h X)).unit.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.etaleCohomologyDerivedIsoOfTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGV, part (2).** For `K` in `D⁺(X_étale)` whose cohomology sheaves are torsion,
`H^q(X_étale, K) = H^q_ph(X, a_X⁻¹K)` for every `q`, by the canonical map
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.etaleToPhDerivedGlobalSections`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyDerivedIsoOfTorsion
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem
      (etaleSpace P E h X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K))) (q : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} q).obj
        ((etaleGlobalSections P E h X).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} q).obj
        ((phGlobalSections P X).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
          ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
            (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.etaleCohomologyIsoOfTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGV, part (1).** For a torsion abelian sheaf `F` on `X_étale`,
`H^q(X_étale, F) = H^q_ph(X, a_X⁻¹F)` for every `q`.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyIsoOfTorsion
    (F : Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _ F) (q : ℕ) :
    ((etaleGlobalSections P E h X).rightDerived q).obj F ≅
      ((phGlobalSections P X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.etaleCohomologyConstantIsoOfTorsion
declarations.doc:
**The example of Stacks 0DGV.** For a torsion abelian group `A`,
`H^q_étale(X, A) = H^q_ph(X, A)` for the constant sheaves.
declarations.statement:
def etaleCohomologyConstantIsoOfTorsion (A : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hA : IsAddTorsion A)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ((etaleGlobalSections P E h X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj A) ≅
      ((phGlobalSections P X).rightDerived q).obj
        ((constantSheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology P X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj A)
declarations.comment: the example of a torsion abelian group

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phToBigEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGW.** The change-of-topology morphism `ε_X` from the big ph topos of `X` to its
big étale topos: the identity-on-spaces functor of slice categories is a morphism of sites,
because it is continuous and representably flat.
declarations.comment: the comparison morphism ε from the big ph to the big étale topos

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phToSmallEtaleMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGW.** The morphism `a_X` from the big ph topos of `X` to its small étale topos,
defined as the composite of `ε_X` with the big-to-small étale morphism `π_X` of **Stacks 0DF3**.
The factorization `a_X = π_X ∘ ε_X` asserted by Stacks 0DGW is therefore definitional.
declarations.statement:
def phToSmallEtaleMorphism (X : P.Spaces) :
    MorphismOfTopoi (Sheaf (BigPHSpaceOver.topology P X) (Type (u + 1)))
      (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem (etaleSpace P E h X))
        (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: the comparison morphism a to the small étale topos, as the composite π ∘ ε

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGW**, the first diagram. For a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces the direct
images of `ε_X ∘ f_{big, ph}` and of `f_{big, étale} ∘ ε_Y` are canonically isomorphic.
declarations.comment: the big ph–big étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGW**, the second diagram. For a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces the
direct images of `a_X ∘ f_{big, ph}` and of `f_{small} ∘ a_Y` are canonically isomorphic.

Since `a` is the composite of `ε` with `π`, this is the big square above pasted with the
big–small étale square of **Stacks 0DF6**.
declarations.statement:
def bigPHSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso {X Y : P.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ((E.smallEtaleMorphism (etaleMap P E h f)).comp
        (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h Y)).pushforward ≅
      ((phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X).comp (bigPHMorphism P f)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the big ph–small étale square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHSmallEtaleCharts_pushforwardCommIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGW**, the second diagram, for the presentation of the small étale topos by the
site of scheme charts. For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces of the ph site the direct
images of `f_{small} ∘ a_X` and of `a_Y ∘ f_{big, ph}` are canonically isomorphic, where `a` is
restriction along the chart functor `smallEtaleToPH`. No big étale site intervenes.
declarations.statement:
def bigPHSmallEtaleCharts_pushforwardCommIso {X Y : P.Spaces} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((smallEtaleToPH P X).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (Space.SmallEtale.topology P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem X.1)
        (BigPHSpaceOver.topology P X)) ⋙
      (Space.smallToposMorphism P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem f).pushforward ≅
    (bigPHMorphism P f).pushforward ⋙
      (smallEtaleToPH P Y).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
        (Space.SmallEtale.topology P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem Y.1)
        (BigPHSpaceOver.topology P Y)
declarations.comment: the big ph–small étale square, for the small étale site of scheme charts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHBigEtale_inverseImageCommIso
declarations.doc:
The first diagram, on inverse images. For a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces the
inverse images of `ε_X ∘ f_{big, ph}` and of `f_{big, étale} ∘ ε_Y` are canonically isomorphic:
`f_{big, ph}⁻¹ ∘ ε_X⁻¹ ≅ ε_Y⁻¹ ∘ f_{big, étale}⁻¹`. It is the conjugate of the direct-image
isomorphism `bigPHBigEtale_pushforwardCommIso`.
declarations.comment: the big ph–big étale square, on inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHSmallEtale_inverseImageCommIso
declarations.doc:
The second diagram, on inverse images. For a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces the
inverse images of `a_X ∘ f_{big, ph}` and of `f_{small} ∘ a_Y` are canonically isomorphic:
`f_{big, ph}⁻¹ ∘ a_X⁻¹ ≅ a_Y⁻¹ ∘ f_{small}⁻¹`, where `a = π ∘ ε`. It is the conjugate of the
direct-image isomorphism `bigPHSmallEtale_pushforwardCommIso`.
declarations.statement:
def bigPHSmallEtale_inverseImageCommIso {X Y : P.Spaces} (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ((phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X).comp (bigPHMorphism P f)).inverseImage ≅
      ((E.smallEtaleMorphism (etaleMap P E h f)).comp
        (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h Y)).inverseImage
declarations.comment: the big ph–small étale square, on inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.bigPHSmallEtaleCharts_inverseImageCommIso
declarations.doc:
The second diagram on inverse images, for the presentation of the small étale topos by the
site of scheme charts. For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces of the ph site, with `a` the
restriction along the chart functor `smallEtaleToPH` and `a⁻¹` its left adjoint,
`f_{big, ph}⁻¹ ∘ a_Y⁻¹ ≅ a_X⁻¹ ∘ f_{small}⁻¹`. It is the conjugate of the direct-image isomorphism
`bigPHSmallEtaleCharts_pushforwardCommIso`.
declarations.statement:
def bigPHSmallEtaleCharts_inverseImageCommIso {X Y : P.Spaces} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (smallEtaleToPH P Y).sheafPullback (Type (u + 1))
        (Space.SmallEtale.topology P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem Y.1)
        (BigPHSpaceOver.topology P Y) ⋙ (bigPHMorphism P f).inverseImage ≅
      (Space.smallToposMorphism P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem f).inverseImage ⋙
        (smallEtaleToPH P X).sheafPullback (Type (u + 1))
          (Space.SmallEtale.topology P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem X.1)
          (BigPHSpaceOver.topology P X)
declarations.comment: the big ph–small étale square, for the small étale site of scheme charts, on inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phToSmallEtaleDerivedPushforwardIsoOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGX, part (2).** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`
and `K` an object of `D⁺(Y_étale)` whose cohomology sheaves are torsion. Then
`a_X⁻¹(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,ph,*}(a_Y⁻¹K)`, by the canonical comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phToSmallEtaleDerivedBaseChange`.
declarations.statement:
def phToSmallEtaleDerivedPushforwardIsoOfIsProper
    (hf : Space.IsProper P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem f.hom)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Space.SpacesEtale.topology E.fppfSite S E.fppf_mem
      (etaleSpace P E h Y)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K))) :
    (CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
        (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        ((E.smallEtalePushforward (etaleMap P E h f)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K) ≅
      (phAbelianPushforward P f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
          (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h Y)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phToSmallEtalePushforwardIsoOfIsProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGX, part (1).** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
and let `a = π ∘ ε` be the comparison morphisms from the big ph topoi to the small étale topoi of
Stacks 0DGW. Then `a_X⁻¹ ∘ f_{small,*} = f_{big,ph,*} ∘ a_Y⁻¹` as functors from sheaves on the
small étale site of `Y` to sheaves on the big ph site of `X`: the canonical base change map
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phToSmallEtaleBaseChange`, the mate of the commutative square of
Stacks 0DGW, is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def phToSmallEtalePushforwardIsoOfIsProper
    (hf : Space.IsProper P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem f.hom) :
    (E.smallEtaleMorphism (etaleMap P E h f)).pushforward ⋙
        (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h X).inverseImage ≅
      (phToSmallEtaleMorphism P E h Y).inverseImage ⋙ (bigPHMorphism P f).pushforward

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, case (B). A morphism between ringed simplicial sites: a morphism `h`
between the underlying simplicial sites, together with a homomorphism of sheaves of rings
`h♯ : h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` on the total site.
declarations.statement:
structure RingedMorphism (C C' : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.{u})
    (O : Sheaf (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}).totalTopology RingCat.{u})
    (O' : Sheaf (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}).totalTopology RingCat.{u})
declarations.comment: ringed simplicial site morphism, case (B) of Situation 09WE

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.ringHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, case (B). A homomorphism of sheaves of rings `h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` is the
same thing as a homomorphism `𝒪' ⟶ h_{total, *} 𝒪`: the two are exchanged by the adjunction
between the inverse image and the direct image of sheaves of rings along the morphism of total
topoi.
declarations.statement:
def ringHomEquiv (h : CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (O : Sheaf (⟨Sum.inr C⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}).totalTopology RingCat.{u})
    (O' : Sheaf (⟨Sum.inr C'⟩ : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u}).totalTopology RingCat.{u}) :
    (h.totalInverseImageRing O' ⟶ O) ≃ (O' ⟶ h.totalPushforwardRing O)
declarations.comment: the two equivalent forms of the ring map, case (B)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, case (A). A morphism between ringed simplicial sites: a morphism `h`
between the underlying simplicial sites, together with a homomorphism of sheaves of rings
`h♯ : h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` on the total site.
declarations.statement:
structure RingedMorphism (C C' : SimplicialSite.{u})
    (O : Sheaf C.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
    (O' : Sheaf C'.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
declarations.comment: ringed simplicial site morphism, case (A) of Situation 09WE

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.ringHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, case (A). A homomorphism of sheaves of rings `h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` is the
same thing as a homomorphism `𝒪' ⟶ h_{total, *} 𝒪`: the two are exchanged by the adjunction
between the inverse image and the direct image of sheaves of rings along the total functor.
declarations.statement:
def ringHomEquiv (h : SimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (O : Sheaf C.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
    (O' : Sheaf C'.totalTopology RingCat.{u}) :
    (h.totalInverseImageRing O' ⟶ O) ≃ (O' ⟶ h.totalPushforwardRing O)
declarations.comment: the two equivalent forms of the ring map, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.ringHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, both cases of Situation 09WE. A homomorphism of sheaves of rings
`h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` is the same thing as a homomorphism `𝒪' ⟶ h_{total, *} 𝒪`: the two are
exchanged by the adjunction between the inverse image and the direct image of sheaves of rings
along the morphism of total topoi.
declarations.comment: the two equivalent forms of the ring map, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteMorphism.ringHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, both cases of Situation 09WE. A homomorphism of sheaves of rings
`h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` is the same thing as a homomorphism `𝒪' ⟶ h_{total, *} 𝒪`: the two are
exchanged by the adjunction between the inverse image and the direct image of sheaves of rings
along the morphism of total topoi.
declarations.comment: the two equivalent forms of the ring map, case (B)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, both cases of Situation 09WE. A morphism between ringed simplicial sites: a
morphism `h` between the underlying simplicial sites, together with a homomorphism of sheaves of
rings `h♯ : h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` on the total site.
declarations.statement:
structure SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedMorphism (S S' : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (O : Sheaf S.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
    (O' : Sheaf S'.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
declarations.comment: ringed simplicial site morphism, case (A) of Situation 09WE

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DGZ**, both cases of Situation 09WE. A morphism between ringed simplicial sites: a
morphism `h` between the underlying simplicial sites, together with a homomorphism of sheaves of
rings `h♯ : h_total⁻¹ 𝒪' ⟶ 𝒪` on the total site.
declarations.statement:
structure SimplicialSiteSituation.RingedMorphism (S S' : SimplicialSiteSituation.{u})
    (O : Sheaf S.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
    (O' : Sheaf S'.totalTopology RingCat.{u})
declarations.comment: ringed simplicial site morphism, case (B) of Situation 09WE

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackUnderlyingIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** Restriction of sheaves of modules to the simplicial component of degree
`n` has the inverse image of sheaves of sets as its underlying sheaf, naturally in the module:
the component structure sheaf is itself the restriction of the total structure sheaf, so the
pullback of modules extends scalars along an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def componentPullbackUnderlyingIso :
    (componentRingedToposHom S O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        Sheaf.moduleSheafFunctor
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (componentRingedTopos S O n).J))
          (componentRingedTopos S O n).O) ≅
      Sheaf.moduleSheafFunctor
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (totalRingedTopos S O).J))
          (totalRingedTopos S O).O) ⋙
        (componentRingedToposHom S O n).toToposHom.inverseImage
declarations.comment: restriction of modules to components

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackUnderlyingIso_unit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The comparison of the previous declaration is the canonical one, not an
arbitrary isomorphism: precomposing it with the unit of extension of scalars along the
component structure map — which is what
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pullbackUnitUnderlyingIso` is, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pullbackUnitUnderlyingIso_hom_app` — returns the comparison
of Stacks 03D2 between the underlying sheaf of the inverse image of modules and the inverse
image of the underlying sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentPullbackUnderlyingIso_unit :
    RingedToposHom.pullbackUnitUnderlyingIso (componentRingedToposHom S O n) ≪≫
        componentPullbackUnderlyingIso S O n =
      inverseImageModuleSheafIso (componentRingedToposHom S O n).toToposHom
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (totalRingedTopos S O).J))
          (totalRingedTopos S O).O)
declarations.comment: the canonical restriction of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentInverseImageCommRingIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The comparison of the two inverse images of sheaves of commutative rings
around the square of simplicial degree `n`. This is the identification
`gₙ⁻¹h_{total}⁻¹𝒪' = hₙ⁻¹(g'ₙ)⁻¹𝒪'` through which the source defines the degreewise structure
map.
declarations.comment: the canonical ring comparison

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentInverseImageCommRingIso_forget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The comparison of inverse images of sheaves of commutative rings has the
comparison of inverse images of sheaves of sets as its underlying map, which determines it
uniquely by
`Stacks.Sheaves.ToposPushforward.inverseImageCommRingIsoOfToposIso_existsUnique`.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentInverseImageCommRingIso_forget (h : Morphism C C') (n : SimplexCategory)
    (O' : Sheaf C'.situation.totalTopology CommRingCat.{u}) :
    (sheafCompose (C.situation.componentTopology n) (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map
        ((componentInverseImageCommRingIso h n).hom.app O') =
      (componentInverseImageIso h n).hom.app
        ((sheafCompose C'.situation.totalTopology (forget CommRingCat.{u})).obj O')
declarations.comment: the canonical underlying comparison

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.totalRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The morphism of total ringed topoi induced by a morphism between ringed
simplicial sites.
declarations.statement:
def totalRingedToposHom
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O)) :
    RingedToposHom (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O) (C'.situation.totalRingedTopos O')
declarations.comment: the total morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The morphism of component ringed topoi in simplicial degree `n` induced by a
morphism between ringed simplicial sites.
declarations.statement:
def componentRingedToposHom
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    RingedToposHom (C.situation.componentRingedTopos O n)
      (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n)
declarations.comment: the component morphisms of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentRingedToposHom_toToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The underlying geometric morphism of the degreewise morphism of ringed
topoi is the component morphism of topoi of Stacks 0D95.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedToposHom_toToposHom
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).toToposHom =
      (SimplicialSiteMorphism.ofCocontinuous h).componentMorphism n
declarations.comment: the underlying degreewise geometric morphisms

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentRingedToposHom_commutes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The square of ringed topoi formed by the total morphism, the degreewise
morphism and the two canonical morphisms from the components of simplicial degree `n` commutes:
the comparison of inverse images identifies the two composite structure maps.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedToposHom_commutes
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.componentInverseImageCommRingIso n).hom.app O' ≫
        ((C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).comp
          ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n)).fSharpInverseImage =
      ((h.totalRingedToposHom φ).comp
        (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n)).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: the commutative squares of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPushforwardModulesForgetIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the assertion on sheaves of modules, on underlying sheaves of sets.**
Inverse image to the simplicial component of degree `n` of a direct image of sheaves of modules
along the total morphism is the degreewise direct image of the inverse image to that component.

The comparison is the one of Stacks 0D96 and nothing else: the pullback of modules along a
component inclusion is inverse image on underlying sheaves of sets, by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackUnderlyingIso`, and the direct image of
modules is direct image there on the nose.
declarations.statement:
def componentPushforwardModulesForgetIso
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
          Sheaf.moduleSheafFunctor
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (J := (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).J)
              (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).O)) ≅
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).pushforwardModules ⋙
          Sheaf.moduleSheafFunctor
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (J := (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).J)
              (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).O))
declarations.comment: the underlying restriction of the direct image of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentRingedToposHom_twoIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The degreewise square commutes as a square of *ringed* topoi, in the sense
of Stacks 04IC: the two composites `h_{total} ∘ g_n` and `g'_n ∘ h_n` are 2-isomorphic.

The comparison of the direct images is the one of Stacks 0D96, and the compatibility with the
three structure maps is `componentRingedToposHom_commutes` read on underlying sheaves of sets,
through `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.TwoIso.ofInverseImageIso`, which transposes a
compatibility of the inverse-image forms into one of the direct-image forms. The underlying
comparison of inverse images is pinned by
`CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentInverseImageCommRingIso_forget`,
so this 2-isomorphism is not an arbitrary one.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentRingedToposHom_twoIso
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶

declarations.comment: the degreewise square as a 2-isomorphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the degreewise square on direct images of sheaves of modules.** Direct image
to the total ringed topos of the target, taken through the component of degree `n` of the
source, agrees with direct image taken through the component of degree `n` of the target:

`h_{total,*} ∘ g_{n,*} ≅ g'_{n,*} ∘ h_{n,*}` on `Mod(𝒪_n)`.

This is the commuting square of ringed topoi of
`componentRingedToposHom_twoIso` read on sheaves of modules, and it is a genuine module-level
statement: the comparison is additive and linear, not merely a comparison of underlying sheaves
of sets.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).pushforwardModules ≅
      ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: the commutative squares, on direct images of sheaves of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPullbackModulesSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the degreewise square on pullbacks of sheaves of modules.** The same square,
read on pullbacks:

`g_n^* ∘ h_{total}^* ≅ h_n^* ∘ (g'_n)^*` on `Mod(𝒪')`.

Both sides are left adjoint to the two sides of `componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso`, so this
is uniqueness of left adjoints applied to that isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPullbackModulesSquareIso
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
declarations.comment: the commutative squares, on pullbacks of sheaves of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPushforwardModulesComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the comparison of the last assertion.** The canonical morphism of functors
`Mod(𝒪) ⟶ Mod(𝒪'_n)`

`(g'_n)^* ∘ h_{total,*} ⟶ h_{n,*} ∘ g_n^*`

attached to the degreewise square: the mate of `componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso` under the
two adjunctions `g_n^* ⊣ g_{n,*}` and `(g'_n)^* ⊣ (g'_n)_*` of Stacks 03D7. The source's last
assertion is that this comparison is invertible, which is the Beck–Chevalley content of the
degreewise square; see the implementation notes of this file.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPushforwardModulesComparison
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⟶
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: the comparison of the last assertion, on sheaves of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPushforwardModulesComparison_mate
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The comparison of the last assertion is pinned by the degreewise square:
its mate under the two adjunctions of Stacks 03D7 is the square of direct images of sheaves of
modules. In particular it is not an arbitrary natural transformation.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentPushforwardModulesComparison_mate
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    mateEquiv
        (RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
          (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n))
        (RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
          (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n))
        (componentPushforwardModulesComparison h φ n) =
      TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso h φ n).hom
declarations.comment: the comparison of the last assertion is the mate of the square

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPushforwardModulesIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the last assertion, on sheaves of modules.** Inverse image to the simplicial
component of degree `n` of a direct image of sheaves of modules along the total morphism is the
degreewise direct image of the inverse image to that component:

`(g'_n)^* ∘ h_{total,*} ≅ h_{n,*} ∘ g_n^*` as functors `Mod(𝒪) ⟶ Mod(𝒪'_n)`,

the isomorphism being the canonical comparison `componentPushforwardModulesComparison`
attached to the degreewise square. That comparison is invertible by
`isIso_componentPushforwardModulesComparison`, which is the Beck–Chevalley statement for the
square; so this is unconditional, as is the assertion on underlying sheaves of sets,
`componentPushforwardModulesForgetIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPushforwardModulesIso
    (h : Morphism C C') (φ : h.totalInverseImageRing
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology) O')) ⟶
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology) O))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: the last assertion, on sheaves of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.totalRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The morphism of total ringed topoi induced by a morphism between ringed
simplicial sites.
declarations.statement:
def totalRingedToposHom
    (h : RingedMorphism C C'
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology)) O)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology)) O')) :
    RingedToposHom (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O) (C'.situation.totalRingedTopos O')
declarations.comment: the total morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The morphism of component ringed topoi in simplicial degree `n` induced by a
morphism between ringed simplicial sites.
declarations.statement:
def componentRingedToposHom
    (h : RingedMorphism C C'
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology)) O)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology)) O'))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    RingedToposHom (C.situation.componentRingedTopos O n)
      (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n)
declarations.comment: the component morphisms of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentRingedToposHom_toToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The underlying geometric morphism of the degreewise morphism of ringed
topoi is the component morphism of topoi of Stacks 0D95.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedToposHom_toToposHom
    (h : RingedMorphism C C'
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology)) O)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology)) O'))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.componentRingedToposHom n).toToposHom =
      (SimplicialSiteMorphism.ofCocontinuous h.hom).componentMorphism n
declarations.comment: the underlying degreewise geometric morphisms

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentRingedToposHom_commutes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The square of ringed topoi formed by the total morphism, the degreewise
morphism and the two canonical morphisms from the components of simplicial degree `n` commutes:
the comparison of inverse images identifies the two composite structure maps.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedToposHom_commutes
    (h : RingedMorphism C C'
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology)) O)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology)) O'))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (h.hom.componentInverseImageCommRingIso n).hom.app O' ≫
        ((C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).comp
          (h.componentRingedToposHom n)).fSharpInverseImage =
      (h.totalRingedToposHom.comp
        (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n)).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: the commutative squares of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPushforwardModulesForgetIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the assertion on sheaves of modules, on underlying sheaves of sets.**
Inverse image to the simplicial component of degree `n` of a direct image of sheaves of modules
along the total morphism is the degreewise direct image of the inverse image to that component.

The comparison is the one of Stacks 0D96 and nothing else: the pullback of modules along a
component inclusion is inverse image on underlying sheaves of sets, by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackUnderlyingIso`, and the direct image of
modules is direct image there on the nose.
declarations.statement:
def componentPushforwardModulesForgetIso
    (h : RingedMorphism C C'
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology)) O)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology)) O'))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.totalRingedToposHom.pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
          Sheaf.moduleSheafFunctor
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (J := (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).J))
              (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).O) ≅
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (h.componentRingedToposHom n).pushforwardModules ⋙
          Sheaf.moduleSheafFunctor
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (J := (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).J))
              (C'.situation.componentRingedTopos O' n).O)
declarations.comment: the underlying restriction of the direct image of modules

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentRingedToposHom_twoIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0.** The degreewise square commutes as a square of *ringed* topoi, in the sense
of Stacks 04IC: the two composites `h_{total} ∘ g_n` and `g'_n ∘ h_n` are 2-isomorphic.

The comparison of the direct images is the one of Stacks 0D96, and the compatibility with the
three structure maps is `componentRingedToposHom_commutes` read on underlying sheaves of sets,
through `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.TwoIso.ofInverseImageIso`, which transposes a
compatibility of the inverse-image forms into one of the direct-image forms. The underlying
comparison of inverse images is pinned by
`CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentInverseImageCommRingIso_forget`,
so this 2-isomorphism is not an arbitrary one.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentRingedToposHom_twoIso
    (h : RingedMorphism C C'
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C.situation.totalTopology)) O)
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := C'.situation.totalTopology)) O'))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    RingedToposHom.TwoIso.{u, u, u, u, u, u}
      (viaTotalRingedToposHom h n) (viaComponentRingedToposHom h n)
declarations.comment: the degreewise square as a 2-isomorphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPushforwardModulesComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0, the comparison of the last assertion.** The canonical morphism of functors
`Mod(𝒪) ⟶ Mod(𝒪'_n)`

declarations.doc:

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.componentInverseImageCommRingIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A). The comparison of the two inverse images of sheaves of
commutative rings around the square of simplicial degree `n`: the identification
`gₙ⁻¹h_{total}⁻¹𝒪' = hₙ⁻¹(g'ₙ)⁻¹𝒪'` through which the source defines the degreewise structure
map.
declarations.comment: the canonical ring comparison, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.componentInverseImageCommRingIso_forget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A). The comparison of inverse images of sheaves of commutative rings
has the comparison of inverse images of sheaves of sets as its underlying map.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentInverseImageCommRingIso_forget (h : SimplicialSite.Morphism C C')
    (n : SimplexCategory) (O' : Sheaf C'.situation.totalTopology CommRingCat.{u}) :
    (sheafCompose (C.situation.componentTopology n) (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map
        ((componentInverseImageCommRingIso h n).hom.app O') =
      (componentInverseImageIso h n).hom.app
        ((sheafCompose C'.situation.totalTopology (forget CommRingCat.{u})).obj O')
declarations.comment: the canonical underlying comparison, case (A)
