declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A). The degreewise square commutes as a square of *ringed* topoi, in
the sense of Stacks 04IC: the two composites `h_{total} ∘ g_n` and `g'_n ∘ h_n` are
2-isomorphic, the comparison of direct images being the one of Stacks 0D96.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentRingedToposHom_twoIso
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    RingedToposHom.TwoIso.{u, u, u, u, u, u}
      (viaTotalRingedToposHom h n) (viaComponentRingedToposHom h n)
declarations.comment: the degreewise square as a 2-isomorphism of ringed topoi, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A), the degreewise square on direct images of sheaves of modules:
`h_{total,*} ∘ g_{n,*} ≅ g'_{n,*} ∘ h_{n,*}` on `Mod(𝒪_n)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).pushforwardModules ⋙
        h.totalRingedToposHom.pushforwardModules ≅
      (h.componentRingedToposHom n).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: the commutative squares, on direct images of sheaves of modules, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPullbackModulesSquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A), the degreewise square on pullbacks of sheaves of modules:
`g_n^* ∘ h_{total}^* ≅ h_n^* ∘ (g'_n)^*` on `Mod(𝒪')`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPullbackModulesSquareIso
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.totalRingedToposHom.toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (h.componentRingedToposHom n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
declarations.comment: the commutative squares, on pullbacks of sheaves of modules, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPushforwardModulesComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A), the comparison of the last assertion: the canonical morphism of
functors `Mod(𝒪) ⟶ Mod(𝒪'_n)`

`(g'_n)^* ∘ h_{total,*} ⟶ h_{n,*} ∘ g_n^*`,

the mate of `componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso` under the two adjunctions `g_n^* ⊣ g_{n,*}`
and `(g'_n)^* ⊣ (g'_n)_*` of Stacks 03D7.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPushforwardModulesComparison
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.totalRingedToposHom.pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⟶
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (h.componentRingedToposHom n).pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: the comparison of the last assertion, on sheaves of modules, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPushforwardModulesComparison_mate
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A). The comparison of the last assertion is pinned by the degreewise
square: its mate under the two adjunctions of Stacks 03D7 is the square of direct images of
sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentPushforwardModulesComparison_mate
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    mateEquiv
        (RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
          (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n))
        (RingedToposHom.pullbackAdjPushforwardModules
          (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n))
        (componentPushforwardModulesComparison h n) =
      TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (componentPushforwardModulesSquareIso h n).hom
declarations.comment: the comparison of the last assertion is the mate of the square, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.isIso_componentPushforwardModulesComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A), the last assertion: the comparison is invertible. On underlying
sheaves of sets it is the mate of the degreewise square of topoi, which is invertible by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.Morphism.isIso_totalComponentPushforwardMate`.
declarations.statement:
instance isIso_componentPushforwardModulesComparison
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    IsIso (componentPushforwardModulesComparison h n)
declarations.comment: the comparison of the last assertion is invertible, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.componentPushforwardModulesIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH0**, case (A), the last assertion, on sheaves of modules:

`(g'_n)^* ∘ h_{total,*} ≅ h_{n,*} ∘ g_n^*` as functors `Mod(𝒪) ⟶ Mod(𝒪'_n)`,

the isomorphism being the canonical comparison `componentPushforwardModulesComparison`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentPushforwardModulesIso
    (h : RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O')) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    h.totalRingedToposHom.pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (h.componentRingedToposHom n).pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: the last assertion, on sheaves of modules, case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH1**, case (A). With notation and hypotheses as in Stacks 0DH0, for simplicial
sites whose transitions are morphisms of sites and a morphism of ringed simplicial sites built
from morphisms of sites: for `K` in the unbounded derived category of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on
the total site,

`(g'_n)^* Rh_{total,*} K = Rh_{n,*} g_n^* K`.

The source's equality is read as a natural isomorphism of functors on the derived category.
Both sides are right derived functors of one and the same functor on the unbounded homotopy
category of `𝒪`-modules, by
`isRightDerivedFunctor_derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictModulesUnit` and
`isRightDerivedFunctor_derivedRestrictTotalPushforwardModulesUnit` of this namespace, the two
being identified by the canonical comparison of Stacks 0DH0, `componentPushforwardModulesIso`.
The isomorphism is the induced comparison of the two right derived functors, pinned down by
`derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso_fac`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso
    (h : SimplicialSite.RingedMorphism C C' (C.totalRingSheaf O) (C'.totalRingSheaf O'))
    (n : SimplexCategory) :
    derivedTotalPushforwardModules h ⋙
        C'.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O' n ≅
      C.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O n ⋙
        derivedComponentPushforwardModules h n
declarations.comment: case (A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackModules_preservesFiniteLimits
declarations.doc:
**Pullback of sheaves of modules to the simplicial component of degree `n` is left exact.**
The component structure sheaf is the restriction of the total one, so the component structure
map is invertible and the pullback of modules has the inverse image of sheaves of sets as its
underlying sheaf, by
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackUnderlyingIso`; the inverse image is
left exact because `g_n` is a morphism of topoi, and the underlying-sheaf functor on sheaves of
modules preserves finite limits and reflects isomorphisms, hence reflects finite limits.

This is the source's observation that `g_n^* = g_n^{-1}` is exact, which is what makes `Lg_n^*`
computable on any representative complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentPullbackModules_preservesFiniteLimits :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (componentRingedToposHom S O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
declarations.comment: exactness of the pullback of modules to a component

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentPullbackModules_preservesFiniteColimits
declarations.doc:
**Pullback of sheaves of modules to the simplicial component of degree `n` is right exact**,
being a left adjoint. This is the finite case of Stacks 03DC part (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem componentPullbackModules_preservesFiniteColimits :
    PreservesFiniteColimits (componentRingedToposHom S O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
declarations.comment: exactness of the pullback of modules to a component

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.RingedMorphism.derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH1**, case (B). With notation and hypotheses as in Stacks 0DH0: for `K` in the
unbounded derived category of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the total site,

`(g'_n)^* Rh_{total,*} K = Rh_{n,*} g_n^* K`.

The source's equality is read as a natural isomorphism of functors on the derived category.
Both sides are right derived functors of one and the same functor on the unbounded homotopy
category of `𝒪`-modules, by
`isRightDerivedFunctor_derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictModulesUnit` and
`isRightDerivedFunctor_derivedRestrictTotalPushforwardModulesUnit` of this namespace, the two
being identified by the canonical comparison of Stacks 0DH0, `componentPushforwardModulesIso`.
The isomorphism is the induced comparison of the two right derived functors, pinned down by
`derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso_fac`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso :
    derivedTotalPushforwardModules h ⋙
        C'.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O' n ≅
      C.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O n ⋙
        derivedComponentPushforwardModules h n
declarations.comment: case (B)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH1**, case (B). With notation and hypotheses as in Stacks 0DH0: for `K` in the
unbounded derived category of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the total site,

`(g'_n)^* Rh_{total,*} K = Rh_{n,*} g_n^* K`.

The source's equality is read as a natural isomorphism of functors on the derived category.
Both sides are right derived functors of one and the same functor on the unbounded homotopy
category of `𝒪`-modules, by
`isRightDerivedFunctor_derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictModulesUnit` and
`isRightDerivedFunctor_derivedRestrictTotalPushforwardModulesUnit` of this namespace, the two
being identified by the underived comparison `e`.

The hypothesis `e` is the last assertion of Stacks 0DH0 at the level of sheaves of modules, and
`hK` is Stacks 09WH for sheaves of modules; see the implementation notes of this file for why
both are deferred.
declarations.statement:
def derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso
    (e : (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).pushforwardModules)
    (hK : ∀ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).J)
            (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).O))) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective →
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective
          (((C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
              |>.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)) :
    derivedTotalPushforwardModules h φ ⋙
        C'.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O' n ≅
      C.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O n ⋙
        derivedComponentPushforwardModules h φ n
declarations.comment: case (B)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso_fac
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH1**, the isomorphism is the canonical one. Composing the canonical comparison
into the first right derived functor with the isomorphism gives the underived comparison
followed by the canonical comparison into the second. Since a morphism out of a right derived
functor is determined by that identity, this pins the isomorphism down completely.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso_fac
    (e : (h.totalRingedToposHom φ).pushforwardModules ⋙
        (C'.situation.componentRingedToposHom O' n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      (C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        ((h.componentRingedToposHom φ) n).pushforwardModules)
    (hK : ∀ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).J)
            (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).O))) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective →
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective
          (((C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
              |>.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)) :
    derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictModulesUnit h φ n ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh
          (derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso h φ n e hK).hom =
      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (homotopyComponentPushforwardModulesIso h φ n e)
            DerivedCategory.Qh).hom ≫
        derivedRestrictTotalPushforwardModulesUnit h φ n
declarations.comment: case (B), the canonical comparison

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIsoOfSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH1**, case (B), over the canonical comparison of the degreewise square. With
notation and hypotheses as in Stacks 0DH0: for `K` in the unbounded derived category of sheaves
of `𝒪`-modules on the total site,

`(g'_n)^* Rh_{total,*} K = Rh_{n,*} g_n^* K`.

This is `derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIso` with the underived comparison taken to be the
canonical one of
`CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.componentPushforwardModulesIso`,
rather than an arbitrary isomorphism. The only hypothesis is `hK`, Stacks 09WH for sheaves of
modules; see the implementation notes of this file.
declarations.statement:
def derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIsoOfSquare
    (hK : ∀ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).J)
            (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).O))) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective →
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective
          (((C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
              |>.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)) :
    derivedTotalPushforwardModules h φ ⋙
        C'.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O' n ≅
      C.situation.derivedComponentPullbackModules O n ⋙
        derivedComponentPushforwardModules h φ n
declarations.comment: case (B), over the canonical comparison of the degreewise square

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CocontinuousSimplicialSite.Morphism.derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIsoOfSquare_fac
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH1**, case (B) over the canonical comparison: the isomorphism is pinned by the
canonical comparison of the degreewise square. Composing the canonical comparison into the
first right derived functor with it gives the canonical underived comparison, applied
degreewise to complexes, followed by the canonical comparison into the second right derived
functor. Since a morphism out of a right derived functor is determined by that identity, this
determines the isomorphism completely from the square of ringed topoi.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIsoOfSquare_fac
    (hK : ∀ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).J)
            (C.situation.totalRingedTopos O).O))) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective →
        CochainComplex.IsKInjective
          (((C.situation.componentRingedToposHom O n).toModulesHom.pullbackModules
              |>.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)) :
    derivedTotalPushforwardRestrictModulesUnit h φ n ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh
          (derivedComponentPushforwardModulesIsoOfSquare h φ n hK).hom =
      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight
            (homotopyComponentPushforwardModulesIso h φ n
              (componentPushforwardModulesIso h φ n)) DerivedCategory.Qh).hom ≫
        derivedRestrictTotalPushforwardModulesUnit h φ n
declarations.comment:
case (B), the canonical comparison of the degreewise square pins the
  isomorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentModuleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
In the situation of Stacks 09WE let `O` be a sheaf of rings on the total site, let `U` be
an object of the degree-`n` component and let `p : ℕ`. For a sheaf of `O`-modules `F` one has
`H^p(U, g_n^*F) ≅ H^p(U, F)`, where on the right-hand side `U` is viewed as an object of the
total category; the isomorphism is natural in `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentModuleCohomologyIso (U : S.component n) (p : ℕ) :
    componentModuleRestriction S O n ⋙ SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} (componentRingSheaf S O n) ⋙
        cohomology (S.componentTopology n) U p ≅
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} O ⋙
        cohomology S.totalTopology ((componentFunctor S n).obj U) p

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentModuleCohomologyObjIso
declarations.doc:
**`H^p(U, g_n^*F) ≅ H^p(U, F)` at a single sheaf of modules.** For `F` a sheaf of
`O`-modules on the total site of a simplicial-site situation and `U` an object of the degree-`n`
component, `H^p(U, g_n^*F) ≅ H^p(U, F)` with `U` viewed on the right-hand side as an object of
the total category.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentModuleCohomologyObjIso (F : SheafOfModules.{u} O)
    (U : S.component n) (p : ℕ) :
    (cohomology (S.componentTopology n) U p).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} (componentRingSheaf S O n)).obj
          ((componentModuleRestriction S O n).obj F)) ≅
      (cohomology S.totalTopology ((componentFunctor S n).obj U) p).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} O).obj F)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentRingedAugmentation_isFlat
declarations.doc:
If the augmentation `a` of the total ringed topos is flat, then so is the augmentation `a_n`
of every simplicial component.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedAugmentation_isFlat (ha : a.IsFlat) (n : SimplexCategory) :
    (componentRingedAugmentation S O a n).IsFlat
declarations.comment: the forward implication: flatness of a gives flatness of every a_n

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentRingedAugmentation_isFlat_iff_forall
declarations.doc:
The augmentation `a` of the total ringed topos of a simplicial-site situation is flat if and
only if the augmentation `a_n` of every simplicial component is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentRingedAugmentation_isFlat_iff_forall :
    a.IsFlat ↔ ∀ n : SimplexCategory, (componentRingedAugmentation S O a n).IsFlat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleComponent.smallEtale_inverseImage_fullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH6, sheaves of sets.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, and
`a : U → X` an augmentation of a simplicial algebraic space over `S` which is an fppf
hypercovering of `X`. Let `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` be the morphism of topoi of
Section 0DE7, where `X_étale` is the small étale site of `X` (Stacks 03ED), its topos identified
with that of `X_spaces,étale` by restriction along `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor`
(Stacks 03G1, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor_sheafEquivalence`).
Then `a⁻¹ : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(U_étale)` is fully faithful, its essential image consists exactly of
the cartesian sheaves, and `a_*` is a quasi-inverse: the unit of `a⁻¹ ⊣ a_*` is invertible, and
so is its counit at every cartesian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtale_inverseImage_fullyFaithful (hyp : IsFppfHypercovering A) :
    ((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).inverse ⋙
        (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage).Full ∧
      ((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).inverse ⋙
        (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage).Faithful ∧
      (∀ G, ((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).inverse ⋙
          (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage).essImage G ↔
        SimplicialSiteSituation.IsCartesianSheaf (etaleSimplicialSite A).situation G) ∧
      (∀ F, IsIso (((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).symm.toAdjunction.comp
        (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).adj).unit.app F)) ∧
      (∀ G, SimplicialSiteSituation.IsCartesianSheaf (etaleSimplicialSite A).situation G →
        IsIso (((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).symm.toAdjunction.comp
          (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).adj).counit.app G))
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleComponent.smallEtale_abelianInverseImage_fullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH6, sheaves of abelian groups.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over
`S`, and `a : U → X` an augmentation of a simplicial algebraic space over `S` which is an fppf
hypercovering of `X`. Let `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` be the morphism of topoi of
Section 0DE7, where `X_étale` is the small étale site of `X` (Stacks 03ED), its category of
abelian sheaves identified with that of `X_spaces,étale` by restriction along
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor` (Stacks 03G1,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.comparisonFunctor_sheafEquivalence`). Then
`a⁻¹ : Ab(X_étale) ⥤ Ab(U_étale)` is fully faithful, its essential image consists exactly of the
cartesian abelian sheaves, and `a_*` is a quasi-inverse: the unit of `a⁻¹ ⊣ a_*` is invertible,
and so is its counit at every cartesian abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtale_abelianInverseImage_fullyFaithful (hyp : IsFppfHypercovering A) :
    ((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).inverse ⋙
        Sites.abelianInverseImage (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).Full ∧
      ((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).inverse ⋙
        Sites.abelianInverseImage (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).Faithful ∧
      (∀ G, ((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).inverse ⋙
          Sites.abelianInverseImage (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).essImage G ↔
        SimplicialSiteSituation.IsCartesianAbSheaf (etaleSimplicialSite A).situation G) ∧
      (∀ F, IsIso (((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).symm.toAdjunction.comp
        (Stacks.Topos.AbelianPushforward.abelianInverseImageAdjPushforward
          (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology (etaleAugmentationMorphism A))).unit.app F)) ∧
      (∀ G, SimplicialSiteSituation.IsCartesianAbSheaf (etaleSimplicialSite A).situation G →
        IsIso (((((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence).symm.toAdjunction.comp
          (Stacks.Topos.AbelianPushforward.abelianInverseImageAdjPushforward
            (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology (etaleAugmentationMorphism A))).counit.app G))
declarations.comment: sheaves of abelian groups

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFppfHypercovering.isIso_smallEtaleDerivedUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH7.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a simplicial
algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation which is an fppf hypercovering of `X`.
Then for every `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale)` the map `K ⟶ Ra_*(a⁻¹K)` is an isomorphism. Here
`a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is the morphism of topoi of Section 0DE7, with `X_étale` the small
étale site of `X` (Stacks 03ED) and its abelian sheaves identified with those of `X_spaces,étale`
by the equivalence of Stacks 03G1, so that `a⁻¹ ⊣ a_*` is the composite of that equivalence with
the adjunction of Section 0DE7; the map is the unit of the derived adjunction `a⁻¹ ⊣ Ra_*` on
bounded below derived categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsFppfHypercovering.isIso_smallEtaleDerivedUnit (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    IsIso ((Stacks.ComparingTopologies.derivedPlusAdjunction
      (((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
        (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence.symm.toAdjunction.comp
          (etaleAugmentationAbelianAdjunction A))).unit.app K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFppfHypercovering.smallEtaleDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DH8.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a simplicial
algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation which is an fppf hypercovering of `X`.
Then `RΓ(X_étale, K) = RΓ(U_étale, a⁻¹K)` for `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale)`, naturally in `K`. Here
`a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is the morphism of topoi of Section 0DE7, with `X_étale` the small
étale site of `X` (Stacks 03ED) and `a⁻¹` as in `IsFppfHypercovering.isIso_smallEtaleDerivedUnit`.
The isomorphism is the pullback on derived global sections: `RΓ(X_étale, -)` of the map
`K ⟶ Ra_*(a⁻¹K)` of Stacks 0DH7 followed by the factorization
`RΓ(U_étale, -) = RΓ(X_étale, -) ∘ Ra_*` of Stacks 08J6.
declarations.statement:
def IsFppfHypercovering.smallEtaleDerivedGlobalSectionsIso (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A) :
    (Sheaf.Γ (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ≅
      (((comparisonFunctor B S hS A.right).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS A.right.1)
        (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)).asEquivalence.symm.functor ⋙
          etaleAugmentationAbelianInverseImage A).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (Sheaf.Γ (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DH9.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a
simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation, and let
`𝒜 ⊂ Ab(U_étale)` be the weak Serre subcategory of cartesian abelian sheaves. If `U` is an fppf
hypercovering of `X`, then `a⁻¹` defines an equivalence

`D⁺(X_étale) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜(U_étale)`

with quasi-inverse `Ra_*`, where `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is the morphism of topoi of
Section 0DE7 and `D⁺_𝒜(U_étale)` consists of the bounded below complexes whose cohomology sheaves
are cartesian. The functors are identified by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering_functor` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering_inverse`.

The proof is the source's: the content of Stacks 0DH6 (every cartesian abelian sheaf on
`U_étale` is `a⁻¹` of an abelian sheaf on `X_étale`) and of Stacks 0DH7 (`K ≅ Ra_*a⁻¹K` on
`D⁺(X_étale)`) are the inputs of the formal equivalence of Stacks 0D7U,
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.derivedPlusInverseImageEquivalence`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering_functor
declarations.doc:
**The equivalence of Tag 0DH9 is `a⁻¹`**: its forward functor, followed by the inclusion of
`D⁺_𝒜(U_étale)` into `D⁺(U_étale)`, is `a⁻¹ : D⁺(X_étale) ⥤ D⁺(U_étale)`, the right derived
functor of the exact functor `a⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering_functor (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A) :
    (derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering hA).functor ⋙
        (cartesianDerivedPlus (etaleSituation A)).ι =
      (totalInverseImageAb (etaleSituation A) _ _ (etaleAugmentation A)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
declarations.comment: the equivalence is `a⁻¹`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering_inverse
declarations.doc:
**The quasi-inverse of the equivalence of Tag 0DH9 is `Ra_*`**: its inverse functor is the
inclusion of `D⁺_𝒜(U_étale)` into `D⁺(U_étale)` followed by `Ra_* : D⁺(U_étale) ⥤ D⁺(X_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering_inverse (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A) :
    (derivedPlusEquivalenceOfIsFppfHypercovering hA).inverse =
      (cartesianDerivedPlus (etaleSituation A)).ι ⋙
        (abelianTotalPushforward (etaleSituation A) _ _
          (etaleAugmentation A)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
declarations.comment: the quasi-inverse is `Ra_*`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFppfHypercovering.etaleSpectralSequence_pageOne_abutsTo
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DHA.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a
simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation. Let `𝓕` be an abelian sheaf
on `X_étale` and `𝓕_p` its pullback to `U_{p, étale}`. If `U` is an fppf hypercovering of `X`,
then the canonical spectral sequence `etaleSpectralSequence A` at `𝓕` has

`E_1^{p,q} = H^q_ét(U_p, 𝓕_p)`

(vanishing outside the first quadrant) and converges to `H^{p+q}_ét(X, 𝓕)`.

Here `X = A.right`, `U = A.left` and `a = A.hom`, the étale sites are the spaces-étale sites of
Section 0DE7, `𝓕_p` is the abelian inverse image along the morphism of topoi of Stacks 03G2 induced
by `a_p : U_p → X`, and `H^n_ét` is `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH`; the first page is identified
naturally in `𝓕` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleSpectralSequence_pageOneIso`, and the abutment is
zero in negative degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsFppfHypercovering.etaleSpectralSequence_pageOne_abutsTo (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A)
    (F : Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty ((((etaleSpectralSequence A).obj F).page 1 le_rfl).X ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ)) ≅
      (Sheaf.functorH.{u + 1, u + 1} (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (A.left.obj (op ⦋p⦌))) q).obj
        ((Sites.abelianInverseImage (EtaleComponent.baseChangeMorphism (A := A) ⦋p⦌)).obj F))) ∧
    (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((((etaleSpectralSequence A).obj F).page 1 le_rfl).X
      (p, q))) ∧
    SpectralSequence.AbutsTo ((etaleSpectralSequence A).obj F)
      (fun n => if 0 ≤ n then Sheaf.functorH.{u + 1, u + 1}
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right) n.toNat |>.obj F
        else AddCommGrpCat.of PUnit)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFppfHypercovering.isIso_derivedGlobalSectionsSemilinearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DHG.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a
simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation. If `a : U → X` is an fppf
hypercovering of `X`, then

`RΓ(X_étale, K) = RΓ(U_étale, a^*K)`

for `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, where `a : (Sh(U_étale), 𝒪_U) → (Sh(X_étale), 𝒪_X)` is the morphism of
ringed topoi of Section 0DE7 (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleAugmentationRingedHom`) and `a^*` its
derived pullback: the canonical map `RΓ(X_étale, K) ⟶ RΓ(U_étale, a^*K)` is an isomorphism.

Here `RΓ(X_étale, -)` and `RΓ(U_étale, -)` are the total right derived functors of global
sections, with values in the derived categories of modules over coefficient rings `R'` and `R`
mapping to `Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` and to `Γ(U, 𝒪_U)` through `ψ'` and `ψ`, compatibly (`h`) with
`ρ : R' → R` and the map `Γ(X, 𝒪_X) → Γ(U, 𝒪_U)` of `a`; the right hand side is read in `D(R')`
through restriction of scalars along `ρ`. For instance `R = R' = ℤ`. The canonical map
(`Stacks.Cohomology.LerayOfToposHom.derivedGlobalSectionsSemilinearMap`) is `RΓ(X_étale, -)` of the
derived unit `K → Ra_*a^*K`, invertible on `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFppfHypercovering.isIso_derivedAdjunction_unit_app`, followed by the
identification `RΓ(X_étale, -) ∘ Ra_* = RΓ(U_étale, -)` of Cohomology on Sites, Remark 08J6.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsFppfHypercovering.isIso_derivedGlobalSectionsSemilinearMap (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A)
    {R : Type r} [Ring R] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)]
    {R' : Type r'} [Ring R'] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R')]
    (ψ : R →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := ((etaleSituation A).totalRingedTopos (etaleStructureSheaf A)).J))
        ((etaleSituation A).totalRingedTopos (etaleStructureSheaf A)).O).obj)
    (ψ' : R' →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (J := (etaleRingedAugmentation A).augmentationRingedTopos.J))
        (etaleRingedAugmentation A).augmentationRingedTopos.O).obj)
    (ρ : R' →+* R)
    (h : (toposGlobalSectionsRingHom (etaleAugmentationRingedHom A)).comp ψ' = ψ.comp ρ)
    (K : @DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (spacesEtaleRingedTopos B S hS A.right).O)) _ _
      (HasDerivedCategory.standard _))
    (hK : etaleQuasicoherentComplexes A K) :
    IsIso (derivedGlobalSectionsSemilinearMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1, r, r',
      _, _}
      (etaleAugmentationRingedHom A) ψ ψ' ρ h K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SimplicialSpacesEtaleSite.moduleSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**The spectral sequence of a module pulled back to a simplicial algebraic space**
`a : U → X`, as a functor of the `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕`: the spectral sequence of Stacks 0D7E for the
pullback of `𝓕` to the total site of the strict components of `U_{spaces, étale}`.
declarations.statement:
def moduleSpectralSequence :
    SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (spacesEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X).O) ⥤
      CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} 1
declarations.comment: the spectral sequence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SimplicialSpacesEtaleSite.moduleSpectralSequencePageOneIso
declarations.doc:
**`E_1^{p,q} = H^q_ét(U_p, a_p^*𝓕)`**, naturally in the `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕`, where `a_p^*` is
the pullback of modules along the morphism of ringed topoi
`(Sh((U_p)_{spaces, étale}), 𝒪_{U_p}) ⟶ (Sh(X_{spaces, étale}), 𝒪_X)` of `a_p : U_p → X`.
declarations.statement:
def moduleSpectralSequencePageOneIso (p q : ℕ) :
    moduleSpectralSequence a ⋙
        (CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.pageFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} _ 1 1 le_rfl ⋙
          HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} _ ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ))) ≅
      (spacesEtaleRingedToposHom (Z₂ := X) (a.app (op ⦋p⦌))).toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙
        (spacesEtaleRingedTopos B S hS (U.obj (op ⦋p⦌))).moduleGlobalSections.rightDerived q
declarations.comment: its first page `E_1^{p,q} = H^q_ét(U_p, 𝓕_p)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SimplicialSpacesEtaleSite.moduleSpectralSequence_abutsTo_of_isFppfHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHH.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a simplicial
algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation which is an fppf hypercovering of `X`.
Let `𝓕` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and `𝓕_p = a_p^*𝓕` its pullback to `U_{p, étale}`. Then
the spectral sequence `moduleSpectralSequence`, with first page
`E_1^{p,q} = H^q_ét(U_p, 𝓕_p)` (`moduleSpectralSequencePageOneIso`), converges to
`H^{p+q}_ét(X, 𝓕)`. The algebraic spaces are those of a big fppf site `T` of algebraic spaces
over `S` (Stacks 0DBV).
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleSpectralSequence_abutsTo_of_isFppfHypercovering
    {A : SimplicialObject.Augmented T.Spaces} (hA : IsFppfHypercovering A)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem A.right).O))
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.AbutsTo ((moduleSpectralSequence A.hom).obj F)
      (fun n => if 0 ≤ n then
        ((spacesEtaleRingedTopos T.schemeSite S T.scheme_mem
            A.right).moduleGlobalSections.rightDerived n.toNat).obj F
        else AddCommGrpCat.of PUnit.{u + 2})
declarations.comment: the spectral sequence converges to `H^{p+q}_ét(X, 𝓕)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.phComparisonMorphism
declarations.doc:
**The upper horizontal arrow of Tag 0DHJ**, `h : Sh((Spaces/U)_total) → Sh(U_étale)`, the
morphism of topoi of the morphism of sites given by `V/U_n ↦ V/U_n`.
declarations.comment: the upper horizontal arrow h : Sh((Spaces/U)_{ph, total}) → Sh(U_étale)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.spacesEtaleComparisonMorphism
declarations.doc:

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phEtaleComparisonSquarePushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Tag 0DHJ, on direct images.** Let `a : U → X` be an augmented simplicial algebraic space
over `S`. The diagram of topoi
```
Sh((Spaces/U)_{ph, total}) --h--> Sh(U_étale)
        | a_ph                       | a
Sh((Spaces/X)_ph)        --h₋₁--> Sh(X_étale)
```
commutes: the direct image of `h₋₁ ∘ a_ph` is that of `a ∘ h`.
declarations.statement:
def phEtaleComparisonSquarePushforwardIso :
    (SimplicialOver.augmentationMorphismOfTopoi P.topology A.left A.hom).pushforward ⋙
        (spacesEtaleComparisonMorphism P.topology A.right).pushforward ≅
      (phComparisonMorphism A P.topology).pushforward ⋙ (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).pushforward
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram of topoi, on direct images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phEtaleComparisonSquareInverseImageIso
declarations.doc: **Tag 0DHJ, on inverse images**: `h⁻¹ ∘ a⁻¹ ≅ a_ph⁻¹ ∘ h₋₁⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
def phEtaleComparisonSquareInverseImageIso :
    (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage ⋙ (phComparisonMorphism A P.topology).inverseImage ≅
      (spacesEtaleComparisonMorphism P.topology A.right).inverseImage ⋙
        (SimplicialOver.augmentationMorphismOfTopoi P.topology A.left A.hom).inverseImage
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram of topoi, on inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.etaleAugmentation_inverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isProperHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHK, sheaves of sets.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a
simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation which is a proper hypercovering
of `X`. Then `a⁻¹ : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(U_étale)` is fully faithful, its essential image consists
exactly of the cartesian sheaves, and `a_*` is a quasi-inverse: the unit of `a⁻¹ ⊣ a_*` is
invertible, and so is its counit at every cartesian sheaf. Here `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is
the morphism of topoi of Section 0DE7, and the category of algebraic spaces over `S` is the one of
a big ph site `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleAugmentation_inverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isProperHypercovering
    (hA : IsProperHypercovering P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem A) :
    (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage.Full ∧
      (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage.Faithful ∧
      (∀ G, (etaleAugmentationMorphism A).inverseImage.essImage G ↔
        (etaleSituation A).IsCartesianSheaf G) ∧
      (∀ F, IsIso ((etaleAugmentationMorphism A).adj.unit.app F)) ∧
      (∀ G, (etaleSituation A).IsCartesianSheaf G →
        IsIso ((etaleAugmentationMorphism A).adj.counit.app G))
declarations.comment: sheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.etaleAugmentation_abelianInverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isProperHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHK, sheaves of abelian groups.** Let `a : U → X` be an augmented simplicial
algebraic space which is a proper hypercovering of `X`. Then the inverse image
`a⁻¹ : Ab(X_étale) ⥤ Ab(U_étale)` on abelian sheaves is fully faithful, its essential image
consists exactly of the cartesian abelian sheaves, and the abelian direct image `a_*` is a
quasi-inverse: the unit of `a⁻¹ ⊣ a_*` is invertible, and so is its counit at every cartesian
abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleAugmentation_abelianInverseImage_fullyFaithful_of_isProperHypercovering
    (hA : IsProperHypercovering P.fppfSite S P.fppf_mem A) :
    (Sites.abelianInverseImage (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).Full ∧
      (Sites.abelianInverseImage (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).Faithful ∧
      (∀ G, (Sites.abelianInverseImage (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).essImage G ↔
        (etaleSituation A).IsCartesianAbSheaf G) ∧
      (∀ F, IsIso ((Stacks.Topos.AbelianPushforward.abelianInverseImageAdjPushforward
        (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).unit.app F)) ∧
      (∀ G, (etaleSituation A).IsCartesianAbSheaf G →
        IsIso ((Stacks.Topos.AbelianPushforward.abelianInverseImageAdjPushforward
          (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).counit.app G))
declarations.comment: sheaves of abelian groups

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_etaleAugmentation_derivedPlusUnit_of_isProperHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DHL**, corrected statement. Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic
space over `S`, `U` a simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation. If
`a : U → X` is a proper hypercovering of `X`, then for `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale)` with torsion cohomology
sheaves the canonical map

`K → Ra_*(a⁻¹K)`

is an isomorphism, where `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is the morphism of topoi of
Section 0DE7.

Here `X = A.right`, `U = A.left` and `a = A.hom`; `X_étale` is the spaces-étale site of `X`, the
proper hypercovering condition is Section 0DHI (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsProperHypercovering`),
and `D⁺` is the bounded below derived category of abelian sheaves. The map is the unit at `K` of
the adjunction `a⁻¹ ⊣ Ra_*` on `D⁺`, `a⁻¹` being exact and applied degreewise.

The source states this for every `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale)`, and as printed it fails for `K = ℚ`; its proof
cites Stacks 0DGU, a statement about complexes with torsion cohomology sheaves. Counterexample: let
`k` be an algebraically closed field of characteristic `≠ 2`, let `f = y²z - x³ - x²z + z⁴`, and let
`X` be the spectrum of the strict henselization of `k[x, y, z]/(f)` at the origin. The tangent cone
of `X` is the nodal cubic `N = V(y²z - x³ - x²z) ⊂ ℙ²`, and the blow-up `π : Y → X` of the closed
point is regular, with exceptional curve `E ≅ N` (in the chart `z = 1` its equation is
`y² - x³ - x² + z = 0`). Let `U` be the Čech nerve of the proper surjective morphism `π`, a proper
hypercovering of `X`. Since `Y ×_X ⋯ ×_X Y = Δ(Y) ∪ E × ⋯ × E`, closed Mayer-Vietoris gives
`RΓ(U_étale, ℚ) = fib(RΓ(Y, ℚ) ⊕ ℚ → RΓ(E, ℚ))`. As `Y` is normal and connected, `H¹(Y, ℚ) = 0`,
while `H¹(E, ℚ) = ℚ`; hence `H²(U_étale, ℚ) = ℚ`. But `X` is strictly henselian local, so
`H²(X_étale, ℚ) = 0`, and `ℚ → Ra_*a⁻¹ℚ` is not an isomorphism. The torsion hypothesis on `K` is
the correction.

The proof is that of the source: a big ph site `(Spaces/S)_ph` on the algebraic spaces over `S`
exists (`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.bigPHSpaceSite`), and in it the square of Tag 0DHJ, the
comparison of ph and étale cohomology of torsion sheaves (Stacks 0DGT, Stacks 0DGU), and descent
along the ph hypercovering `U` of `X` (Stacks 0DA8, Stacks 0D8N) give
`Ra_*a⁻¹K = Rh₋₁,* Ra_{ph,*} a_ph⁻¹ h₋₁⁻¹ K = K`; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.isIso_etaleAugmentation_derivedPlusUnit_of_torsion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_etaleAugmentation_derivedPlusUnit_of_isProperHypercovering
    (hA : IsProperHypercovering B S hS A)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K))) :
    IsIso ((Stacks.ComparingTopologies.derivedPlusAdjunction
      (abelianInverseImageAdjPushforward (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology
        (etaleAugmentationMorphism A))).unit.app K)
declarations.comment:
for `K` with torsion cohomology sheaves; the torsion hypothesis is required: for
  `K = ℚ` the statement is false

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedGlobalSectionsIsoOfIsProperHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DHM**, corrected statement. Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic
space over `S`, `U` a simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation. If
`a : U → X` is a proper hypercovering of `X`, then

`RΓ(X_étale, K) = RΓ(U_étale, a⁻¹K)`

for `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale)` with torsion cohomology sheaves, where `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is the
morphism of topoi of Section 0DE7.

The isomorphism is the canonical one: `RΓ(X_étale, -)` of the unit `K → Ra_*a⁻¹K` followed by the
factorisation `RΓ(U_étale, -) = RΓ(X_étale, -) ∘ Ra_*` of Cohomology on Sites, Remark 08J6
(`Stacks.LerayPullbackComparison.lerayPullback`), invertible by
`isIso_etaleAugmentation_derivedPlusUnit_of_isProperHypercovering` (Stacks 0DHL).

As for Stacks 0DHL, the source states this for every `K ∈ D⁺(X_étale)`, and as printed it fails
for `K = ℚ`: for the Čech nerve `U` of the blow-up `Y → X` of the strictly henselian surface
singularity described at `isIso_etaleAugmentation_derivedPlusUnit_of_isProperHypercovering`,
`H²(U_étale, ℚ) = ℚ` while `H²(X_étale, ℚ) = 0`. The torsion hypothesis on `K` is the
correction.
declarations.statement:
def derivedGlobalSectionsIsoOfIsProperHypercovering (hA : IsProperHypercovering B S hS A)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K))) :
    (Sheaf.Γ (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        K ≅
      (Sheaf.Γ (etaleSimplicialSite A).totalTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        ((CategoryTheory.Sites.abelianInverseImage
          (etaleAugmentationMorphism A)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
          K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DHN**, for torsion coefficients. Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic
space over `S`, `U` a simplicial algebraic space over `S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation, and let
`𝒜 ⊂ Ab(U_étale)` be the weak Serre subcategory of cartesian abelian sheaves. If `U` is a proper
hypercovering of `X`, then `a⁻¹` defines an equivalence

`D⁺_tors(X_étale) ⟶ D⁺_{𝒜, tors}(U_étale)`

with quasi-inverse `Ra_*`, where `a : Sh(U_étale) → Sh(X_étale)` is the morphism of topoi of
Section 0DE7, `D⁺_tors(X_étale)` consists of the bounded below complexes with torsion cohomology
sheaves and `D⁺_{𝒜, tors}(U_étale)` of those whose cohomology sheaves are cartesian and torsion.
The functors are identified by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering_functor` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering_inverse`.

The source states this for `D⁺(X_étale) ⟶ D⁺_𝒜(U_étale)`, and as written it is false: its proof
uses Stacks 0DHL, whose proof cites Stacks 0DGU, which holds only for complexes with torsion
cohomology sheaves. For a counterexample with rational coefficients let `X` be a normal surface
over an algebraically closed field with a cusp singularity `x`, let `π : X̃ → X` be a resolution
whose exceptional curve `E` over `x` is a cycle of rational curves, and let `U` be the Čech nerve
of the proper surjective morphism `X̃ ⊔ {x} → X`, a proper hypercovering. If `a⁻¹` were fully
faithful on `D⁺(X_étale)` with quasi-inverse `Ra_*`, then `ℚ = Ra_*a⁻¹ℚ`, and the spectral sequence
of the hypercovering would give `H²(X_étale, ℚ) ≠ 0`, coming from `H¹(E, ℚ) = ℚ`; but
`Hⁱ(X_étale, ℚ) = 0` for `i > 0` because `X` is normal. The torsion hypothesis is therefore part of
the statement, and this is the corrected form. The erratum, with the counterexample checked in
full, is recorded in `errata.md` (batch of 2026-11-06).

The proof is the source's: Stacks 0DHK (`a⁻¹` on abelian sheaves is fully faithful with essential
image the cartesian sheaves) and Stacks 0DHL (`K ≅ Ra_*a⁻¹K` on `D⁺_tors(X_étale)`) are the inputs
of the formal equivalence of Stacks 0D7U,
`CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.Augmentation.derivedPlusTorsionEquivalence`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering (hA : IsProperHypercovering B S hS A) :
    ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
        (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right))).inverseImage
          DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).FullSubcategory ≌
      ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (cartesianTorsionAbSheaf (etaleSituation A))).inverseImage
          DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment:
corrected form (errata.md, 2026-11-06):
  `a⁻¹ : D⁺_tors(X_étale) ≌ D⁺_{𝒜, tors}(U_étale)` with quasi-inverse `Ra_*`; as printed, for all of
  `D⁺(X_étale)`, the statement is false

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering_functor
declarations.doc:
**The equivalence of Tag 0DHN is `a⁻¹`**: its forward functor, followed by the inclusion into
`D⁺(U_étale)`, is the inclusion of `D⁺_tors(X_étale)` followed by
`a⁻¹ : D⁺(X_étale) ⥤ D⁺(U_étale)`, the right derived functor of the exact functor `a⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering_functor
    (hA : IsProperHypercovering B S hS A) :
    (derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering hA).functor ⋙
        ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (cartesianTorsionAbSheaf (etaleSituation A))).inverseImage DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).ι =
      ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right))).inverseImage DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).ι ⋙
        (totalInverseImageAb (etaleSituation A) _ _
          (etaleAugmentation A)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
declarations.comment: the equivalence is `a⁻¹`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering_inverse
declarations.doc:
**The quasi-inverse of the equivalence of Tag 0DHN is `Ra_*`**: its inverse functor, followed
by the inclusion into `D⁺(X_étale)`, is the inclusion of `D⁺_{𝒜, tors}(U_étale)` followed by
`Ra_* : D⁺(U_étale) ⥤ D⁺(X_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering_inverse
    (hA : IsProperHypercovering B S hS A) :
    (derivedPlusTorsionEquivalenceOfIsProperHypercovering hA).inverse ⋙
        ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS A.right))).inverseImage DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).ι =
      ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (cartesianTorsionAbSheaf (etaleSituation A))).inverseImage DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).ι ⋙
        (abelianTotalPushforward (etaleSituation A) _ _
          (etaleAugmentation A)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
declarations.comment: the quasi-inverse is `Ra_*`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigPHSpaceSite.phHypercoveringEtaleSpectralSequenceOfTorsion
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, `U` a simplicial algebraic space over
`S` and `a : U → X` an augmentation. Let `𝓕` be a torsion abelian sheaf on `X_étale` and let
`𝓕_p` be its pullback to `U_{p, étale}`. If `U` is a ph hypercovering of `X`, there is a
canonical spectral sequence

`E₁^{p,q} = H^q_étale(U_p, 𝓕_p)`

converging to `H^{p+q}_étale(X, 𝓕)`.

The spectral sequence is `phHypercoveringEtaleSpectralSequence`, the ph cohomology spectral
sequence of the hypercovering (Stacks 09WJ on the total ph site, with ph descent along the
hypercovering) at the pullback of `𝓕` to the big ph site of `X`; its first page and abutment are
identified with étale cohomology by Stacks 0DGV and Stacks 0DGW.

The source states the lemma for an arbitrary abelian sheaf `𝓕` and deduces it from Stacks 0DHM,
whose proof only covers torsion coefficients (it rests on Stacks 0DGU). As written, for all
abelian sheaves, the statement is false, and this is the corrected form, for torsion sheaves,
which is the form the proof gives. A counterexample with `𝓕 = ℚ`: let `X` be a normal surface
over an algebraically closed field with a cusp singularity `x`, let `X̃ → X` be its resolution,
with exceptional curve `E` a cycle of rational curves, so that `H¹_étale(E, ℚ) = ℚ`, and let `U`
be the Čech nerve of the proper surjective morphism `X̃ ⊔ {x} → X`, a proper and hence ph
hypercovering. Convergence of the canonical spectral sequence to `H^{p+q}_étale(X, ℚ)` is
cohomological descent for `ℚ` along `U`, which yields the Mayer–Vietoris sequence
`H¹(X̃, ℚ) ⊕ H¹(x, ℚ) → H¹(E, ℚ) → H²(X, ℚ)` of the abstract blow-up square; as `X̃` is normal,
`H¹(X̃, ℚ) = 0`, so `H²_étale(X, ℚ) ≠ 0`. But `H^i_étale(X, ℚ) = 0` for `i > 0` on the normal
scheme `X`.
declarations.statement:
def phHypercoveringEtaleSpectralSequenceOfTorsion
    (hA : MorphismProperty.IsHypercovering P.IsPHCoveringMorphism A)
    (F : Sheaf (etaleTopology P E h A.right) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : Stacks.Torsion.torsionSheafProperty _ F) :
    PhHypercoveringEtaleSpectralSequence P E h A F

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.relativelyPseudoCoherent_iff_pseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHQ.** Let `R → A` be a pseudo-coherent ring map. An object of `D(A)` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `R` exactly when it is `m`-pseudo-coherent, and it is
pseudo-coherent relative to `R` exactly when it is pseudo-coherent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativelyPseudoCoherent_iff_pseudoCoherent
    {R : Type u} {A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (hRA : Algebra.PseudoCoherent R A)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (m : ℤ) :
    (IsRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom (R := R) K m ↔ IsPseudoCoherentFrom K m) ∧
    (IsRelativelyPseudoCoherent (R := R) K ↔ IsPseudoCoherent K)

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.IsRelativelyPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHS.** For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, an object `K` of `D(A)` is
perfect relative to `R` if it is pseudo-coherent over `A` and its restriction of scalars has
finite Tor dimension over `R`.
declarations.statement:
public def IsRelativelyPerfect
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (derivedTensor :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R))
    (comparison : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R,
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          derivedTensor.flip.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) 0).obj M) ⟶
        (StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.tensorModuleRight M).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerived : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R,
      (derivedTensor.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) 0).obj M)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (comparison M)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A)) : Prop

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms_relativelyPerfect
declarations.doc:
For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, the objects of `D(A)` perfect relative to
`R` form a *strictly full* subcategory: relative perfectness is invariant under isomorphism in
`D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedUnderIsomorphisms_relativelyPerfect :
    (relativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} (A := A) derivedTensor comparison
      isLeftDerived).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isTriangulated_relativelyPerfect
declarations.doc:
For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, the objects of `D(A)` perfect relative to
`R` form a *triangulated* subcategory: the property contains the zero object, is stable under all
shifts, and is closed under extensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTriangulated_relativelyPerfect :
    (relativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} (A := A) derivedTensor comparison
      isLeftDerived).IsTriangulated

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isSaturated_relativelyPerfect
declarations.doc:
For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, the objects of `D(A)` perfect relative to
`R` form a *saturated* (thick) subcategory: a direct summand of a relatively perfect object is
relatively perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSaturated_relativelyPerfect :
    (relativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} (A := A) derivedTensor comparison
      isLeftDerived).IsSaturated

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isRelativelyPerfect_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHU.** For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, a perfect object of `D(A)`
is perfect relative to `R`: a bounded complex of finite projective `A`-modules representing it is
pseudo-coherent by Stacks 064U, and its terms are flat over `R` by transitivity of flatness, so
its restriction to `R` has finite Tor dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyPerfect_of_isPerfect (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A))
    (hK : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K) :
    IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} derivedTensor comparison isLeftDerived K

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isRelativelyPerfect_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHU.** For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, the derived tensor product
over `A` of a perfect object of `D(A)` with an `R`-perfect object is `R`-perfect.

Pseudo-coherence: a bounded-above finite free representative of the perfect object is K-flat, so
the derived tensor product is computed by the total tensor product with a bounded-above finite
free representative of the `R`-perfect object, and that has bounded-above finite free terms.

Finite Tor dimension: a *bounded* finite projective representative of the perfect object is also
K-flat, and the `R`-perfect object has a bounded representative whose terms are flat over `R`
(Stacks 0653); the total tensor product of the two is bounded with terms flat over `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyPerfect_derivedTensor
    (K M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A))
    (hK : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K)
    (hM : IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} derivedTensor comparison isLeftDerived M) :
    IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} derivedTensor comparison isLeftDerived
      ((derivedTensorA.obj K).obj M)

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isRelativelyPerfect_iff_exists_bounded_flat_finitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHV.** For a flat, finitely presented ring map `R → A`, an object of `D(A)` is
perfect relative to `R` if and only if it is isomorphic to a finite complex of `A`-modules that
are flat over `R` and finitely presented over `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyPerfect_iff_exists_bounded_flat_finitePresentation
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A)) :
    IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, v, w} derivedTensor comparison isLeftDerived K ↔
      ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
        P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Flat R
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).obj (P.X i))) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.FinitePresentation A (P.X i)) ∧
        Nonempty (K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.derivedExtensionScalars_isRelativelyPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHW.** If `A` is flat and finitely presented over `R`, then arbitrary base change
`R → R'` sends an `R`-perfect object of `D(A)` to an `R'`-perfect object of `D(A ⊗[R] R')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedExtensionScalars_isRelativelyPerfect
    {R A R' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (derivedTensorR :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (comparisonR : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          derivedTensorR.flip.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj M) ⟶
        (tensorModuleRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerivedR : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      (derivedTensorR.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj M)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (comparisonR M)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (derivedTensorR' :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R') ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R') ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R'))
    (comparisonR' : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R',
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          derivedTensorR'.flip.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R') 0).obj M) ⟶
        (tensorModuleRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerivedR' : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R',
      (derivedTensorR'.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R') 0).obj M)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (comparisonR' M)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R') (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, u, u} derivedTensorR comparisonR isLeftDerivedR K) :
    let A' := A ⊗[R] R'
    letI : Algebra R' A' := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let e : (R' ⊗[R] A) ≃ₐ[R'] A' :=
      AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' A).toRingEquiv)
        (fun r' => by
          change (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R R' A)
            (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] A) r') = _
          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply,
            Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
          rfl)
    letI : Module.Flat R' A' := Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv e.symm.toLinearEquiv
    letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation R' A' := Algebra.FinitePresentation.equiv e
    let f : A →+* A' := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
    IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, u, u} derivedTensorR' comparisonR' isLeftDerivedR'
      ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u} f).functor.obj K)

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.relativelyPerfectComplexes_filteredColimit
declarations.doc:
Relatively perfect complexes descend through filtered colimits, derived Hom from a
pseudo-coherent complex to a complex of finite Tor-dimension commutes with such a colimit, and
the category of relatively perfect complexes over the limit is the categorical colimit of the
categories at the stages.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativelyPerfectComplexes_filteredColimit
    {R₀ : Type uR} [CommRing R₀]
    {I : Type uI} [Category.{uJ} I] [IsFiltered I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommAlgCat.{uR} R₀) (c : Cocone F)
    (hc : IsColimit ((CommAlgCat.uliftFunctor.{max uI uJ, uR, uR} R₀).mapCocone c))
    (A₀ : Type uA) [CommRing A₀] [Algebra R₀ A₀]
    [Module.Flat R₀ A₀] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R₀ A₀]
    (D₀ : DerivedTensoringDatum.{uR, max uR uA uM} R₀)
    (D : ∀ i : I, DerivedTensoringDatum.{uR, max uR uA uM} (F.obj i))
    (Dlim : DerivedTensoringDatum.{uR, max uR uA uM} c.pt) :
    let E := fun {A B : Type (max uR uA)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) ↦
      totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{max uR uA, max uR uA, uM} f
    let liftBase : ULift.{uR} A₀ →+* A₀ := ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom
    let W := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uR uA uM} liftBase).mapDerivedCategory
    let b := fun i : I ↦ (baseToStageMap F A₀ i).comp liftBase
    let blim := (baseToLimitMap c A₀).comp liftBase
    let B := fun i : I ↦ W ⋙ (E (b i)).functor
    let Blim := W ⋙ (E blim).functor
    let S := fun (i : I) ↦ E (stageToLimitMap c A₀ i)
    let P : ∀ i : I, ObjectProperty
        (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} (stageAlgebra F A₀ i))) := fun i K ↦
      IsRelativelyPerfect.{uR, max uR uA, uM}
        (D i).tensor (D i).comparison (D i).isLeftDerived K
    let Plim : ObjectProperty
        (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} (c.pt ⊗[R₀] A₀))) := fun K ↦
      IsRelativelyPerfect.{uR, max uR uA, uM}
        Dlim.tensor Dlim.comparison Dlim.isLeftDerived K
    ∃ (comp : ∀ {A B C : Type (max uR uA)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
          (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* C),
          (E f).functor ⋙ (E g).functor ≅ (E (g.comp f)).functor)
      (unit : ∀ (A : Type (max uR uA)) [CommRing A],
        𝟭 (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A)) ≅ (E (RingHom.id A)).functor),
      (∀ {A B C : Type (max uR uA)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
          (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* C)
          (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A) ℤ),
        letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{max uR uA, max uR uA, max uR uA uM} f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
          (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uA uM, max uR uA, max uR uA}
            f).isLeftAdjoint
        (E g).functor.map ((E f).comparison.app Q) ≫
            (E g).comparison.app
              (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{max uR uA, max uR uA, max uR uA uM}
                f).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
            (extensionOfScalarsComplexComp.{max uR uA, uM} f g).inv.app Q =
          (comp f g).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
            (E (g.comp f)).comparison.app Q) ∧
      (∀ {A B C D' : Type (max uR uA)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D']
          (f : A →+* B) (g : B →+* C) (h : C →+* D')
          (X : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A)),
        (E h).functor.map ((comp f g).hom.app X) ≫ (comp (g.comp f) h).hom.app X =
          (comp g h).hom.app ((E f).functor.obj X) ≫
            (comp f (h.comp g)).hom.app X) ∧
      (∀ {A B : Type (max uR uA)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
          (X : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A)),
        (E f).functor.map ((unit A).hom.app X) ≫
            (comp (RingHom.id A) f).hom.app X = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ {A B : Type (max uR uA)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
          (X : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A)),
        (unit B).hom.app ((E f).functor.obj X) ≫
            (comp f (RingHom.id B)).hom.app X = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} (c.pt ⊗[R₀] A₀))), Plim K →
        ∃ (i : I) (Kᵢ : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} (stageAlgebra F A₀ i))),
          P i Kᵢ ∧ Nonempty ((S i).functor.obj Kᵢ ≅ K)) ∧
      (∀ (K₀ L₀ : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uR uA uM} A₀)),
        StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent K₀ →
        HasFiniteTorDimension D₀.tensor D₀.comparison D₀.isLeftDerived
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R₀ A₀)).mapDerivedCategory.obj L₀) →
        ∃ (H : I ⥤ Type (max uI uJ (max uR uA uM + 1)))
          (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≃ ((B i).obj K₀ ⟶ (B i).obj L₀))
          (s : Cocone H)
          (eTarget : s.pt ≃ (Blim.obj K₀ ⟶ Blim.obj L₀))
          (_hs : IsColimit s),
          (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (x : H.obj i),
            let h : (stageMap F A₀ f).comp (b i) =
                b j := by
              ext a
              simp [b, liftBase, stageMap, baseToStageMap, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
                Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
            let stageComp := comp (b i) (stageMap F A₀ f) ≪≫
              derivedExtensionScalarsCongr.{max uR uA, uM} h
            eH j (H.map f x) =
              stageComp.inv.app (W.obj K₀) ≫ (E (stageMap F A₀ f)).functor.map (eH i x) ≫
                stageComp.hom.app (W.obj L₀)) ∧
          (∀ (i : I) (g : (B i).obj K₀ ⟶ (B i).obj L₀),
            let h : (stageToLimitMap c A₀ i).comp (b i) =
                blim := by
              ext a
              simp [b, blim, liftBase, stageToLimitMap, baseToStageMap, baseToLimitMap,
                Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
            let limitComp := comp (b i) (stageToLimitMap c A₀ i) ≪≫
              derivedExtensionScalarsCongr.{max uR uA, uM} h
            eTarget (s.ι.app i ((eH i).symm g)) =
              limitComp.inv.app (W.obj K₀) ≫ (S i).functor.map g ≫ limitComp.hom.app (W.obj L₀))) ∧
      (∀ i : I, (P i).IsTriangulated) ∧ Plim.IsTriangulated ∧
      ∃ (G : I ⥤ Cat.{max uI uJ (max uR uA uM + 1), max uI uJ (max uR uA uM + 1)})
        (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≌ (P i).FullSubcategory)
        (transition : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
          (eG i).inverse ⋙ (G.map f).toFunctor ⋙ (eG j).functor ⋙
              ObjectProperty.ι (P j) ≅
            ObjectProperty.ι (P i) ⋙ (E (stageMap F A₀ f)).functor)
        (_transition_id : ∀ (i : I) (X : (P i).FullSubcategory),
          let mapIdIso : (G.map (𝟙 i)).toFunctor ≅ 𝟭 (G.obj i) :=
            eqToIso (congrArg Cat.Hom.toFunctor (G.map_id i))
          let h : RingHom.id (stageAlgebra F A₀ i) = stageMap F A₀ (𝟙 i) := by
            ext <;> simp [stageMap]
          ((eG i).functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).map
                (mapIdIso.hom.app ((eG i).inverse.obj X)) ≫
              (ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).map ((eG i).counitIso.hom.app X) ≫
              (unit (stageAlgebra F A₀ i)).hom.app ((ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).obj X) ≫
              (derivedExtensionScalarsCongr.{max uR uA, uM} h).hom.app
                ((ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).obj X) =
            (transition (𝟙 i)).hom.app X)
        (_transition_comp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k)
            (X : (P i).FullSubcategory),
          let mapCompIso : (G.map (f ≫ g)).toFunctor ≅
              (G.map f).toFunctor ⋙ (G.map g).toFunctor :=
            eqToIso (congrArg Cat.Hom.toFunctor (G.map_comp f g))
          let h : (stageMap F A₀ g).comp (stageMap F A₀ f) =
              stageMap F A₀ (f ≫ g) := by
            ext <;> simp [stageMap, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
          let Z := (eG i).inverse.obj X
          let Y := (eG j).functor.obj ((G.map f).toFunctor.obj Z)
          ((eG k).functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (P k)).map (mapCompIso.hom.app Z) ≫
              ((eG k).functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (P k)).map
                ((G.map g).toFunctor.map
                  ((eG j).unitIso.hom.app ((G.map f).toFunctor.obj Z))) ≫
              (transition g).hom.app Y ≫
              (E (stageMap F A₀ g)).functor.map ((transition f).hom.app X) ≫
              (comp (stageMap F A₀ f) (stageMap F A₀ g)).hom.app
                ((ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).obj X) ≫
              (derivedExtensionScalarsCongr.{max uR uA, uM} h).hom.app
                ((ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).obj X) =
            (transition (f ≫ g)).hom.app X)
        (sG : Cocone G) (_hsG : IsColimit sG)
        (eLimit : sG.pt ≌ Plim.FullSubcategory)
        (leg : ∀ i : I,
          (eG i).inverse ⋙ (sG.ι.app i).toFunctor ⋙ eLimit.functor ⋙
                ObjectProperty.ι Plim ≅
            ObjectProperty.ι (P i) ⋙ (S i).functor),
        ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (X : (P i).FullSubcategory),
          let mapCoconeIso : (G.map f).toFunctor ⋙ (sG.ι.app j).toFunctor ≅
              (sG.ι.app i).toFunctor :=
            eqToIso (congrArg Cat.Hom.toFunctor (sG.w f))
          let h : (stageToLimitMap c A₀ j).comp (stageMap F A₀ f) =
              stageToLimitMap c A₀ i := by
            ext x
            · simp [stageToLimitMap, stageMap]
            · simp [stageToLimitMap, stageMap]
          let limitComp := comp (stageMap F A₀ f) (stageToLimitMap c A₀ j) ≪≫
            derivedExtensionScalarsCongr.{max uR uA, uM} h
          let Z := (eG i).inverse.obj X
          let Y := (eG j).functor.obj ((G.map f).toFunctor.obj Z)
          ((eLimit.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι Plim).map (mapCoconeIso.hom.app Z)) ≫
                (leg i).hom.app X =
            (((sG.ι.app j).toFunctor ⋙ eLimit.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι Plim).map
                ((eG j).unitIso.hom.app ((G.map f).toFunctor.obj Z))) ≫
              (leg j).hom.app Y ≫
              (S j).functor.map ((transition f).hom.app X) ≫
              limitComp.hom.app ((ObjectProperty.ι (P i)).obj X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineRelativeTorAmplitude.hasTorAmplitude_relativeComplex_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHY, part (1).** Let `f : Spec A ⟶ Spec R` be the morphism of affine schemes of a
ring map `R → A`, let `M^•` be a complex of `A`-modules and let `E` be the complex of
`f^{-1}𝒪_{Spec R}`-modules attached to it. Then `E` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` over
`f^{-1}𝒪_{Spec R}` if and only if `M^•`, read as a complex of `R`-modules, has Tor amplitude in
`[a, b]` over `R`.

Tor amplitude on the sheaf side is tested at the fibres of the topological points by
`hasTorAmplitude_iff_forall_pointFiber`, where it becomes the Tor amplitude of the localisation
of `M^•` at each prime of `A` over the corresponding localisation of `R`
(`hasTorAmplitudeCanonical_derivedModuleFiber_iff`); that family of conditions is Tor amplitude
over `R` by `hasTorAmplitudeCanonical_restrictScalars_iff_forall_isPrime`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_relativeComplex_iff (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ) :
    Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitude (relativeRingedSpace R A)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (relativeComplex R A M)) a b ↔
      HasTorAmplitudeCanonical R (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) a b
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineRelativeTorAmplitude.locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_relativeComplex_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DHY, part (2).** In the situation of part (1), the complex `E` of
`f^{-1}𝒪_{Spec R}`-modules locally has finite Tor dimension if and only if `M^•`, read as a
complex of `R`-modules, has finite Tor dimension over `R`.

The space `Spec A` is quasi-compact, so locally finite Tor dimension is Tor amplitude in a
single interval (`locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_iff_hasFiniteTorDimension`), and part (1)
translates each interval.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_relativeComplex_iff
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) :
    LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension (relativeRingedSpace R A)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (relativeComplex R A M)) ↔
      HasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical R (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsPerfectRelativeTo
declarations.doc:
**A generalisation of Stacks 0DI0.** An object `E` of `D(𝒪_X)` is perfect relative to `S`
when it is pseudo-coherent and, after restriction of scalars along `f^{-1}𝒪_S ⟶ 𝒪_X`, locally
has finite Tor dimension on the inverse-image ringed space `(X, f^{-1}𝒪_S)`.

The derived tensor product is read off the family of certificates `D`, one on each open subspace
of the inverse-image ringed space, as in part (3) of Stacks 08CG. Since the underived half of a
certificate is free data, this is weaker than Stacks 0DI0 at a general `D`, and it is
Stacks 0DI0 — `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativelyPerfect` — exactly when `D` is pinned to
the tensor product of sheaves of modules; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPerfectRelativeTo_iff_isRelativelyPerfect`.
declarations.statement:
public def IsPerfectRelativeTo [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (D : ∀ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens
        (RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).carrier,
      RingedSpace.CertifiedDerivedSheafTensoring.{d', u}
        ((RingedSpace.inverseImage S.toRingedSpace f.base).restrict U.isOpenEmbedding))
    (E : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace)) : Prop
declarations.comment: the notion of a relatively perfect object, for a morphism flat and locally of finite presentation, generalised to an arbitrary family of certificates

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsRelativelyPerfect
declarations.doc:
An object `E` of `D(𝒪_X)` is perfect relative to `S` when it is pseudo-coherent and, after
restriction of scalars along `f^{-1}𝒪_S ⟶ 𝒪_X`, locally has finite Tor dimension on the
inverse-image ringed space `(X, f^{-1}𝒪_S)`.

Pseudo-coherence is part (3) of Stacks 08CB, and local finiteness of the Tor dimension is part (3)
of Stacks 08CG taken against the derived tensor product `- ⊗^{L}_{f^{-1}𝒪_S} -` of Stacks 06YU on
each open subspace, the total left derived functor of the tensor product of sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
public def IsRelativelyPerfect [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace)) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPerfectRelativeTo_dualNumberResidueComplex_and_not_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DI1, the closing warning.** Over a field, relative perfectness is not perfectness
on the fibres: the residue field of the dual numbers, sheafified and placed in degree zero, is
`Spec k`-perfect on the scheme `Spec k[ε]` — which is of finite presentation over `k`, and whose
only fibre over `Spec k` is itself — and it is not a perfect object of `D(𝒪_{Spec k[ε]})`.

The first half is Stacks 0DI1 itself,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPerfectRelativeTo_canonical_iff_boundedCoherent`, applied to a coherent
module in degree zero. The second is Stacks 08EB,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPerfect_tilde_iff`, against
`AlgebraicGeometry.not_isPerfectModule_residueField_dualNumber`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPerfectRelativeTo_dualNumberResidueComplex_and_not_isPerfect (k : Type u)
    [Field k] :
    (dualNumberStructureMap k).IsPerfectRelativeTo
        (RingedSpace.canonicalCertifiedDerivedSheafTensoringFamily
          (RingedSpace.inverseImage (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).toRingedSpace
            (dualNumberStructureMap k).base))
        (dualNumberResidueComplex k) ∧
      ¬ Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect
          (X := (Spec (CommRingCat.of (DualNumber k))).toRingedSpace)
          (dualNumberResidueComplex k)
declarations.comment: relative perfectness over a field is not perfectness on the fibres
