      TL.emb n ≫ h.hom n
declarations.comment:
variant: a morphism of flat lifts carries the kernel identification to the kernel
identification, a step of the proof; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.obstructionMap_eq_of_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, `ω(K₀)` does not depend on the flat lift.** Given a kernel identification on
every bounded above flat lift of `K₀` -- no compatibility between them assumed, since
`Deformation.ComplexLift.emb_coherence` supplies it -- the map `ω(K₀)` computed from any two
flat lifts is the same. The comparison that forces the agreement is
`Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLiftHom_pair`, Stacks 0DIT applied to the direct sum of the
two lifted families.
declarations.statement:
theorem obstructionMap_eq_of_lift (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n))
    (kern : ∀ M : FlatLift f K₀, IdealKernel S M) (L L' : FlatLift f K₀) :
    obstructionMap D (kern L) = obstructionMap D (kern L')
declarations.comment:
variant: ω depends on the complex alone at a supplied derived ideal tensor datum D;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, existence of a flat lift.** A complex of `O₀`-modules whose cohomology
vanishes in sufficiently high degrees admits a bounded above flat lift across a locally
surjective `f : O ⟶ O₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flatLift (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ)
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n)) :
    Nonempty (FlatLift f K₀)
declarations.comment:
variant: existence of a flat lift of a bounded above complex, a step of the proof;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLiftHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, lifting a map of complexes.** A map `φ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` of complexes of
`O₀`-modules, with the cohomology of `L₀` vanishing in sufficiently high degrees, is covered by
a morphism of flat lifts out of any given bounded above flat lift of `K₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flatLiftHom (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (L : FlatLift f K₀) (φ : K₀ ⟶ L₀)
    (hL₀ : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (L₀.homology n)) :
    ∃ M : FlatLift f L₀, Nonempty (FlatLiftHom L M φ)
declarations.comment:
variant: lifting a map of complexes to the flat lifts, a step of the proof; the tag
is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus_natural

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLiftHom_pair
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, a common enlargement of two flat lifts.** Two bounded above flat lifts of
the same complex both map to a third one, over the identity. This is the comparison that the
well-definedness of the canonical class rests on; it is Stacks 0DIT applied to the direct sum
of the two lifted families.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flatLiftHom_pair (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n)) :
    ∃ M : FlatLift f K₀,
      Nonempty (FlatLiftHom L M (𝟙 K₀)) ∧ Nonempty (FlatLiftHom L' M (𝟙 K₀))
declarations.comment:
variant: two flat lifts of a complex map to a common flat lift, a step of the proof;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLift_of_isLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, a flat lift for an object of the derived category.** An object of `D(O₀)`
with no cohomology above `b` is represented by a complex of `O₀`-modules carrying a bounded
above flat lift across a locally surjective `f : O ⟶ O₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flatLift_of_isLE (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) (b : ℤ)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafMod O₀)) [E.IsLE b] :
    ∃ K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ,
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₀ ≅ E) ∧ Nonempty (FlatLift f K₀)
declarations.comment:
variant: a flat lift of a derived object with bounded above cohomology, a step of
the proof; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLift_of_minus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, a flat lift for a bounded above object.** Every object of `D⁻(O₀)` is
represented by a complex carrying a bounded above flat lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flatLift_of_minus (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (E : DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafMod O₀)) :
    ∃ K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ,
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₀ ≅ E.obj) ∧ Nonempty (FlatLift f K₀)
declarations.comment:
variant: a flat lift of a bounded above derived object, a step of the proof; the tag
is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.obstructionMap_eq_of_common_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, independence of the flat lift.** Two flat lifts of the same complex that
both map to a third one, compatibly with the kernel identifications, give the same canonical
map `ω(K₀)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem obstructionMap_eq_of_common_lift {L L' M : FlatLift f K₀}
    (h : FlatLiftHom L M (𝟙 K₀)) (h' : FlatLiftHom L' M (𝟙 K₀))
    (TL : IdealKernel S L) (TL' : IdealKernel S L') (TM : IdealKernel S M)
    (hemb : ∀ n : ℤ, (restrict f).map (((idealTensorFunctor O₀ I).map h.red).f n) ≫ TM.emb n =
      TL.emb n ≫ h.hom n)
    (hemb' : ∀ n : ℤ, (restrict f).map (((idealTensorFunctor O₀ I).map h'.red).f n) ≫ TM.emb n =
      TL'.emb n ≫ h'.hom n) :
    obstructionMap D TL = obstructionMap D TL'
declarations.comment:
variant: independence of ω of the flat lift through a common enlargement at a
supplied derived ideal tensor datum D; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.obstructionMap_eq_of_coherentKernels
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, the canonical map does not depend on the flat lift.** Suppose every bounded
above flat lift of `K₀` carries a kernel identification, and that these are carried to one
another by every morphism of flat lifts over the identity -- which is the assertion that the
identifications are the canonical ones, normalized by the pure-tensor formula of
`Deformation.ComplexLift.IdealKernel.emb_tmul`. Then the map `ω(K₀)` computed from any two
flat lifts of `K₀` is the same, so `ω(K₀)` depends on `K₀` alone.

The common enlargement that forces the agreement is `exists_flatLiftHom_pair`, Stacks 0DIT
applied to the direct sum of the two lifted families.
declarations.statement:
theorem obstructionMap_eq_of_coherentKernels (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n))
    (kern : ∀ M : FlatLift f K₀, IdealKernel S M)
    (hcoh : ∀ {A B : FlatLift f K₀} (h : FlatLiftHom A B (𝟙 K₀)) (n : ℤ),
      (restrict f).map (((idealTensorFunctor O₀ I).map h.red).f n) ≫ (kern B).emb n =
        (kern A).emb n ≫ h.hom n)
    (L L' : FlatLift f K₀) :
    obstructionMap D (kern L) = obstructionMap D (kern L')
declarations.comment:
variant: ω depends only on the complex at a supplied derived ideal tensor datum D;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.nonempty_idealKernel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU.** Every bounded above flat lift carries an identification of its ideal part
with the kernel of its reduction, normalized by the pure-tensor formula `x̄ ⊗ a ↦ a · x`.

The identification is `Deformation.ComplexLift.idealKernel`; this is its existence statement,
which is what the independence argument consumes.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_idealKernel (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I)
    (L : FlatLift f K₀) : Nonempty (IdealKernel S L)
declarations.comment:
variant: the ideal part of a flat lift is the kernel of its reduction, a step of the
proof; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.obstructionMap_eq_of_lift'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, `ω(K₀)` depends on the complex alone.** Any two bounded above flat lifts of
`K₀`, with any kernel identifications on them, compute the same map.
declarations.statement:
theorem obstructionMap_eq_of_lift' (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I) (D : DerivedIdealTensor I)
    {K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ}
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n))
    {L L' : FlatLift f K₀} (T : IdealKernel S L) (T' : IdealKernel S L') :
    obstructionMap D T = obstructionMap D T'
declarations.comment:
variant: independence of the flat lift at a supplied derived ideal tensor datum D;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.omega
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU.** The canonical map `ω(K₀) : K₀ ⟶ (K₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)[2]` attached to a
square-zero extension `f : O ⟶ O₀` of sheaves of rings with ideal sheaf `I`, as a function of
the bounded above complex `K₀` alone: it is the curvature of the lifted differential of any
bounded above flat lift of `K₀`, read through the canonical identification of the ideal part of
that lift with the kernel of its reduction.

The kernel identification is not chosen: it is `Deformation.ComplexLift.idealKernel`, built
from the lift. The lift itself is chosen -- `Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLift` -- and
that is irreducible here, because the bound the lifting construction is indexed by is available
only inside the propositional hypothesis `hK`. That the choice does not matter is
`Deformation.ComplexLift.obstructionMap_eq_of_lift'`, and `Deformation.ComplexLift.omega_eq`
computes `ω(K₀)` from any lift and any kernel identification, so nothing about `ω(K₀)` is
hidden by it.
declarations.statement:
def omega (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I)
    (D : DerivedIdealTensor I) (K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ)
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n)) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₀ ⟶ (D.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₀))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
declarations.comment:
variant: the map ω(K₀) of a bounded above complex at a supplied derived ideal tensor
datum D; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.omega_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU.** The canonical map is computed by *any* bounded above flat lift and any
kernel identification on it.
declarations.statement:
theorem omega_eq (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I)
    (D : DerivedIdealTensor I) {K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ}
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n))
    {L : FlatLift f K₀} (T : IdealKernel S L) :
    omega hf S D K₀ hK = obstructionMap D T
declarations.comment:
variant: ω is computed by any flat lift at a supplied derived ideal tensor datum D;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.omega_natural
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, naturality of `ω`.** For a map `φ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` of bounded above complexes of
`O₀`-modules the square formed by `ω(K₀)`, `ω(L₀)` and the maps induced by `φ` commutes. No
compatibility of lifts is assumed: the lift of `φ` is
`Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_flatLiftHom` and the lift-independence is
`Deformation.ComplexLift.omega_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem omega_natural (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I)
    (D : DerivedIdealTensor I) {K₀ L₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ} (φ : K₀ ⟶ L₀)
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n))
    (hL : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (L₀.homology n)) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫ omega hf S D L₀ hL =
      omega hf S D K₀ hK ≫
        (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (SheafMod O₀)) (2 : ℤ)).map
          (D.functor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ))
declarations.comment:
variant: naturality of ω along a map of complexes at a supplied derived ideal tensor
datum D; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus_natural

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.omega_natural_derived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU, naturality of `ω` for an arbitrary morphism of the derived category.** For
any `ψ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` in `D(O₀)` between bounded above complexes -- not merely one coming from a map
of complexes -- the square formed by `ω(K₀)`, `ω(L₀)` and the maps induced by `ψ` commutes.

Every such `ψ` is a roof `K₀ ⟶ M ⟵ L₀` of maps of complexes with the second leg a
quasi-isomorphism (`Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_roof_of_derived_hom`), so this follows from
naturality along maps of complexes applied to the two legs.
declarations.statement:
theorem omega_natural_derived (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I)
    (D : DerivedIdealTensor I) {K₀ L₀ : CochainComplex (SheafMod O₀) ℤ}
    (hK : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (K₀.homology n))
    (hL : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → IsZero (L₀.homology n))
    (ψ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₀ ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L₀) :
    ψ ≫ omega hf S D L₀ hL =
      omega hf S D K₀ hK ≫
        (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (SheafMod O₀)) (2 : ℤ)).map
          (D.functor.map ψ)
declarations.comment:
variant: naturality of ω along a derived map at a supplied derived ideal tensor
datum D; the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus_natural

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.obstructionMap_eq_of_hom'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIU.** Two flat lifts of the same complex joined by a morphism of flat lifts over
the identity give the same canonical class `ω(K₀)`. No compatibility of the ideal parts is
assumed: it is automatic.
declarations.statement:
theorem obstructionMap_eq_of_hom' [HasDerivedCategory.{d} (SheafMod O₀)]
    (D : DerivedIdealTensor I) (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f) {L M : FlatLift f K₀}
    (h : FlatLiftHom L M (𝟙 K₀)) (TL : IdealKernel S L) (TM : IdealKernel S M) :
    obstructionMap D TL = obstructionMap D TM
declarations.comment:
variant: independence of the flat lift at a supplied derived ideal tensor datum D;
the tag is Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.isIso_homologyMap_derivedTensorSingle_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIV (2), the isomorphisms.** If `H^i(α)` is an isomorphism in every degree `> n`
and a surjection in degree `n`, then `H^i(α ⊗_O^{L} 1_F)` is an isomorphism in every degree
`> n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homologyMap_derivedTensorSingle_of_epi
    {K L : DerivedModules R} (α : K ⟶ L) (F : Modules R) (n : ℤ)
    (hiso : ∀ i : ℤ, n < i → IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) i).map α))
    (hepi : Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) n).map α))
    (i : ℤ) (hi : n < i) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) i).map
      ((derivedTensorSingle R F).map α))
declarations.comment: tensoring keeps the isomorphisms above the degree

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.epi_homologyMap_derivedTensorSingle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIV (2), the surjection.** If `H^i(α)` is an isomorphism in every degree `> n`
and a surjection in degree `n`, then `H^n(α ⊗_O^{L} 1_F)` is a surjection.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_homologyMap_derivedTensorSingle
    {K L : DerivedModules R} (α : K ⟶ L) (F : Modules R) (n : ℤ)
    (hiso : ∀ i : ℤ, n < i → IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) i).map α))
    (hepi : Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) n).map α)) :
    Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) n).map
      ((derivedTensorSingle R F).map α))
declarations.comment: tensoring keeps the surjection in the degree

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.isIso_homologyMap_derivedTensorSingle_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIV (1).** If `H^i(α)` is an isomorphism in every degree `≥ n`, then so is
`H^i(α ⊗_O^{L} 1_F)`.

Above `n` this is part (2). In degree `n` surjectivity is again part (2), and injectivity comes
from the vanishing of the connecting map `H^{n-1}(C ⊗^{L} F) ⟶ H^n(K ⊗^{L} F)` of the tensored
triangle, equivalently from surjectivity of `H^{n-1}(L ⊗^{L} F) ⟶ H^{n-1}(C ⊗^{L} F)`. That is
part (2) applied in degree `n - 1` to `τ^{<n} L ⟶ L ⟶ C`: this composite is surjective on
`H^{n-1}` — the truncation map is an isomorphism there and `H^{n-1}(L) ⟶ H^{n-1}(C)` is
surjective because `H^n(α)` is injective — and it is an isomorphism on cohomology above
`n - 1` for the trivial reason that both its source and its target vanish there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_homologyMap_derivedTensorSingle_of_isIso
    {K L : DerivedModules R} (α : K ⟶ L) (F : Modules R) (n : ℤ)
    (hα : ∀ i : ℤ, n ≤ i → IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) i).map α))
    (i : ℤ) (hi : n ≤ i) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules R) i).map
      ((derivedTensorSingle R F).map α))
declarations.comment: tensoring keeps the isomorphisms in all degrees at least the bound

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus_eq_zero_iff_nonempty_derivedLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIW.** Let `C` be a site and `f : O ⟶ O₀` a surjection of sheaves of commutative
rings whose kernel is an ideal sheaf `I` of square zero (`S`), with no further hypothesis on
`I`. For every object `K₀` of `D⁻(O₀)` the following are equivalent:

1. the canonical class `ω(K₀) : K₀ ⟶ (K₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)[2]` of Tag 0DIU,
   `Deformation.ComplexLift.tensorOmegaMinus`, is zero;
2. there exists `K ∈ D⁻(O)` with `K ⊗^L_O O₀ ≅ K₀` in `D(O₀)`.

Here `- ⊗^L_{O₀} I` is the derived tensor product `Deformation.ComplexLift.derivedTensorRight I`
and `- ⊗^L_O O₀` the derived base change `Deformation.ComplexLift.derivedExtensionOfScalarsData`,
both constructed from flat resolutions (Tag 0794).
declarations.statement:
theorem tensorOmegaMinus_eq_zero_iff_nonempty_derivedLift (hf : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective f)
    (S : SquareZeroIdeal f I) (E : DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafMod O₀)) :
    tensorOmegaMinus.{v, u, w, d₀} hf S E = 0 ↔
      Nonempty (DerivedLift (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f) E)
declarations.comment:
ω is the class tensorOmegaMinus with values in the derived tensor product
K₀ ⊗^L I, and K ⊗^L O₀ the derived base change derivedExtensionOfScalarsData; no flatness on I

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_quasiIso_with_extensionOfScalars_factorization
declarations.doc:
A quasi-isomorphism to the extension of scalars of `F` can be lifted, after
replacing `F` by a quasi-isomorphic complex, to a factorization in the
homotopy category.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasiIso_with_extensionOfScalars_factorization
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [Epi f]
    (F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O)))) ℤ)
    (K₀ : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀)))) ℤ)
    (q : K₀ ⟶ (extensionOfScalarsCochainComplex J f).obj F)
    (hq : QuasiIso q) :
    ∃ (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O)))) ℤ)
      (g : G ⟶ F),
      QuasiIso g ∧
    (∃ h :
          (HomotopyCategory.quotient
              (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀))))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
                ((extensionOfScalarsCochainComplex J f).obj G) ⟶
            (HomotopyCategory.quotient
                (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀))))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₀,
          (HomotopyCategory.quotient
              (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀))))
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
              ((extensionOfScalarsCochainComplex J f).map g) =
            h ≫
              (HomotopyCategory.quotient
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀))))
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map q)

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedReduction.liftObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY.** The obstruction to lifting a morphism `α₀ : K₁ ⊗^L O₀ ⟶ K₂ ⊗^L O₀` of
reductions to a morphism `K₁ ⟶ K₂`: the composite of the unit of the adjunction with `α₀` and
the connecting morphism of the reduction triangle of `K₂`, a morphism
`K₁ ⟶ (K₂ ⊗^L I)⟦1⟧`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def liftObstruction
    (K₁ K₂ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O)))))
    (α₀ : T.baseChange.obj K₁ ⟶ T.baseChange.obj K₂) :
    K₁ ⟶ (R.restriction.obj (idealTensor.obj (T.baseChange.obj K₂)))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
declarations.comment: the obstruction class of a morphism of reductions

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedReduction.liftObstruction_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY.** The obstruction class of `α₀` vanishes exactly when `α₀` is the derived
base change of a morphism `K₁ ⟶ K₂`. The forward implication is exactness of `Hom(K₁, -)` at
the third vertex of the reduction triangle of `K₂`, followed by the universal property of the
unit; the converse is the vanishing of the composite of the last two morphisms of that
triangle.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftObstruction_eq_zero_iff
    (K₁ K₂ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O)))))
    (α₀ : T.baseChange.obj K₁ ⟶ T.baseChange.obj K₂) :
    R.liftObstruction K₁ K₂ α₀ = 0 ↔ ∃ a : K₁ ⟶ K₂, T.baseChange.map a = α₀
declarations.comment: the vanishing criterion

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedReduction.extLiftObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY.** The obstruction class `o(α₀)` of a morphism `α₀ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` of reductions
as an element of `Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)`, the group the tag states it in:
`Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedReduction.liftObstruction` read through the adjunction.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extLiftObstruction
    (K₁ K₂ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)))
    (α₀ : T.baseChange.obj K₁ ⟶ T.baseChange.obj K₂) :
    T.baseChange.obj K₁ ⟶ (idealTensor.obj (T.baseChange.obj K₂))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
declarations.comment: the obstruction class in Ext¹

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedReduction.extLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY.** The obstruction class in `Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)` vanishes exactly
when `α₀` is the derived base change of a morphism `K₁ ⟶ K₂`: the identification of that group
with the group of morphisms `K₁ ⟶ ((L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)|_O)⟦1⟧` is an isomorphism, so it reflects
vanishing from `Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedReduction.liftObstruction_eq_zero_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff
    (K₁ K₂ : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)))
    (α₀ : T.baseChange.obj K₁ ⟶ T.baseChange.obj K₂) :
    R.extLiftObstruction K₁ K₂ α₀ = 0 ↔ ∃ a : K₁ ⟶ K₂, T.baseChange.map a = α₀
declarations.comment: the vanishing criterion in Ext¹

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY, the obstruction class.** Let `f : O ⟶ O₀` be a surjection of sheaves of
commutative rings whose kernel `I` has square zero, let `K, L ∈ D⁻(O)`, and write
`K₀ = K ⊗^L_O O₀`, `L₀ = L ⊗^L_O O₀` for their derived base changes. For a morphism
`α₀ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` in `D(O₀)` this is the class
`o(α₀) ∈ Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I) = Hom_{D(O₀)}(K₀, (L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)⟦1⟧)`: the composite
`K ⟶ K₀ ⟶ L₀ ⟶ (L ⊗^L_O I)⟦1⟧` of the unit, `α₀` and the connecting morphism of the reduction
triangle of `L`, read through the adjunction.
declarations.statement:
def squareZeroObstruction
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)))
    (α₀ : (derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).obj K.obj ⟶
      (derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).obj L.obj) :
    (derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).obj K.obj ⟶
      ((derivedTensorRight.{d₀, u, u, u'} (squareZeroIdeal.{u, u, u'} f hf hsq)).obj
        ((derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).obj L.obj))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
declarations.comment: the obstruction class o(α₀) in Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroObstruction_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY.** The obstruction class `o(α₀)` vanishes if and only if `α₀` is the derived
base change `α ⊗^L_O id` of a morphism `α : K ⟶ L` in `D(O)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroObstruction_eq_zero_iff
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)))
    (α₀ : (derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).obj K.obj ⟶
      (derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).obj L.obj) :
    squareZeroObstruction f hf hsq K L α₀ = 0 ↔
      ∃ α : K.obj ⟶ L.obj, (derivedExtensionOfScalars.{d, d₀} f).map α = α₀
declarations.comment: o(α₀) = 0 iff α₀ = α ⊗^L_O id for some α : K → L in D(O)

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroObstructionMinus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY, the obstruction class, with `K₀` and `L₀` in `D⁻(O₀)`.** For `K, L ∈ D⁻(O)`
the derived base changes `K₀ = K ⊗^L_O O₀` and `L₀ = L ⊗^L_O O₀` are bounded above
(`Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedExtensionOfScalars.baseChangeMinus`), and a morphism
`α₀ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` of `D⁻(O₀)` has the class `o(α₀) ∈ Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)` of
`Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroObstruction`.
declarations.statement:
def squareZeroObstructionMinus
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)))
    (α₀ : (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.obj K ⟶
      (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.obj L) :
    ((derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.obj K).obj ⟶
      ((derivedTensorRight.{d₀, u, u, u'} (squareZeroIdeal.{u, u, u'} f hf hsq)).obj
        ((derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.obj L).obj)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
declarations.comment: the obstruction class o(α₀) in Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, L₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I), with K₀ and L₀ in D⁻(O₀)

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroObstructionMinus_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIY, with `K₀` and `L₀` in `D⁻(O₀)`.** The obstruction class of a morphism
`α₀ : K₀ ⟶ L₀` of `D⁻(O₀)` vanishes if and only if `α₀ = α ⊗^L_O id` for a morphism
`α : K ⟶ L` of `D⁻(O)`, the functor `- ⊗^L_O O₀ : D⁻(O) ⥤ D⁻(O₀)` being
`Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedExtensionOfScalars.baseChangeMinus`.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroObstructionMinus_eq_zero_iff
    (K L : DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)))
    (α₀ : (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.obj K ⟶
      (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.obj L) :
    squareZeroObstructionMinus f hf hsq K L α₀ = 0 ↔
      ∃ α : K ⟶ L, (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f).baseChangeMinus.map α = α₀
declarations.comment: o(α₀) = 0 iff α₀ = α ⊗^L_O id for some α : K → L, with K₀, L₀ in D⁻(O₀)

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.DerivedLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ.** A lift of a bounded above object `K₀` of the derived category of
`O₀`-modules across the derived base change `T` along `f : O ⟶ O₀`: a bounded above object `K`
of the derived category of `O`-modules together with an isomorphism
`K ⊗_O^L O₀ ≅ K₀` in the derived category of `O₀`-modules.
declarations.statement:
structure DerivedLift (T : DerivedExtensionOfScalars f)
    (K₀ : DerivedCategory.Minus
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀)))))
declarations.comment: a lift of a bounded above derived complex

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.automorphismsOfLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ.** The automorphisms of a lift `(K, α)` of `K₀`: the automorphisms of `K`
whose derived base change is the identity. Since `α` is an isomorphism these are exactly the
automorphisms of the pair, and the subgroup does not depend on `α`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def automorphismsOfLift (T : DerivedExtensionOfScalars f)
    {K₀ :
      DerivedCategory.Minus (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (O₀))))}
    (L : DerivedLift T K₀) : Subgroup (Aut L.K.obj)
declarations.comment: the automorphism group of a lift

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.boundary
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ.** The canonical map `Ext⁻¹(K₀, K₀) ⟶ Hom(K₀, K₀ ⊗^L I)`: the connecting map
of the reduction triangle of `K`, read in the two groups of the source through the adjunction
and the identification `α`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def boundary :
    (K₀.obj ⟶ K₀.obj⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧) →+ (K₀.obj ⟶ idealTensor.obj K₀.obj)
declarations.comment: part (1): the map whose cokernel the automorphism group is

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.automorphismsOfLiftMulEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ (1).** The automorphisms of a lift `(K, α)` of `K₀` form the cokernel of the
canonical map `Ext⁻¹(K₀, K₀) ⟶ Hom(K₀, K₀ ⊗^L I)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def automorphismsOfLiftMulEquiv :
    Multiplicative (K₀.obj ⟶ idealTensor.obj K₀.obj) ⧸
        AddSubgroup.toSubgroup (boundary R L).range ≃* automorphismsOfLift T L
declarations.comment: part (1): the automorphisms of a lift are a cokernel

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroFlatLiftBoundary
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ (1), the map.** For a lift `(K, α)` of `K₀ ∈ D⁻(O₀)` across the square-zero
surjection `f`, the canonical map

`Ext⁻¹_{O₀}(K₀, K₀) ⟶ Hom_{O₀}(K₀, K₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)`

whose cokernel the automorphism group of `(K, α)` is: the connecting map of the reduction
triangle `K ⊗^L_O I ⟶ K ⟶ K ⊗^L_O O₀ ⟶ (K ⊗^L_O I)⟦1⟧` of `f` (computed by a flat resolution),
read through the adjunction between derived base change and restriction of scalars and
through `α`.
declarations.comment: (1), the map Ext⁻¹(K₀, K₀) → Hom(K₀, K₀ ⊗^L I)

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroFlatLiftAutEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ (1).** Let `f : O ⟶ O₀` be a surjection of sheaves of commutative rings on a
site whose kernel `I` is an ideal of square zero, let `K₀ ∈ D⁻(O₀)` and let `(K, α)` be a lift
of `K₀`, i.e. `K ∈ D⁻(O)` with `α : K ⊗^L_O O₀ ≅ K₀` in `D(O₀)`. Then the group of
automorphisms of the pair `(K, α)` is canonically the cokernel of the map
`Ext⁻¹_{O₀}(K₀, K₀) ⟶ Hom_{O₀}(K₀, K₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)` of
`Deformation.ComplexLift.squareZeroFlatLiftBoundary`.
declarations.statement:
def squareZeroFlatLiftAutEquiv (L : DerivedLift (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f) K₀) :
    Multiplicative (K₀.obj ⟶
        (derivedTensorRight.{d₀} (squareZeroIdeal f hf hsq)).obj K₀.obj) ⧸
        AddSubgroup.toSubgroup (squareZeroFlatLiftBoundary.{d, d₀} f hf hsq L).range ≃*
      automorphismsOfLift (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f) L

declarations.name: Deformation.ComplexLift.exists_addTorsor_squareZeroLifts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DIZ (2).** Let `f : O ⟶ O₀` be a surjection of sheaves of commutative rings on a
site whose kernel `I` is an ideal of square zero, and let `K₀ ∈ D⁻(O₀)`. If `K₀` has a lift
`(K, α)`, `K ∈ D⁻(O)`, `α : K ⊗^L_O O₀ ≅ K₀`, then the set of isomorphism classes of lifts of
`K₀` is principal homogeneous under `Ext¹_{O₀}(K₀, K₀ ⊗^L_{O₀} I)`: there is a free and
transitive action of that group on it under which `ξ` carries the class of `(K', α')` to the
class of `(K'', α'')` exactly when `ξ` is the obstruction class of Stacks 0DIY of the comparison
`α'' ∘ α'⁻¹` of the two lifts.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addTorsor_squareZeroLifts
    [Nonempty (DerivedLift (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f) K₀)] :
    ∃ τ : AddTorsor (K₀.obj ⟶
        ((derivedTensorRight.{d₀} (squareZeroIdeal f hf hsq)).obj K₀.obj)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
        (Quotient (DerivedLift.setoid (T := derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f) (K₀ := K₀))),
      ∀ (ξ : K₀.obj ⟶ ((derivedTensorRight.{d₀} (squareZeroIdeal f hf hsq)).obj K₀.obj)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
        (L' L'' : DerivedLift (derivedExtensionOfScalarsData.{d, d₀} f) K₀),
        τ.vadd ξ ⟦L'⟧ = ⟦L''⟧ ↔
          liftDifference (squareZeroFlatReduction.{d, d₀} f hf hsq) L'' L' = ξ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curveDegree_eq_curveDegree_exteriorPower_eq_invertibleCurveDegree_determinant
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DJ5].** Let `k` be a field, `X` a proper scheme of dimension at most one over
`k` and `ℰ` a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module of constant rank `n`. Then

`deg(ℰ) = deg(⋀ⁿ ℰ) = deg(det(ℰ))`.

Both equalities are asserted, under exactly the source's hypotheses. `det(ℰ)` is the determinant
of [Stacks, Tag 0FJN], `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinant`, and its invertibility —
which `AlgebraicGeometry.invertibleCurveDegree` needs and the source does not assume — is derived
from the rank of `ℰ` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isInvertible_determinant`.

The first equality is
`AlgebraicGeometry.curveDegree_eq_curveDegree_exteriorPower_of_isProper`: the source's dévissage
on a proper curve, passed to `X` through the one-dimensional components ([Stacks, Tag 0AYW]). The
second is the identification `⋀ⁿ ℰ ≅ det(ℰ)` of [Stacks, Tag 0B37] together with the agreement of
the invertible degree with the rank-one degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem curveDegree_eq_curveDegree_exteriorPower_eq_invertibleCurveDegree_determinant
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) (E : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E n] :
    curveDegree k f hdim E n =
        @curveDegree k _ X f _ hdim (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (n : ℤ)) 1
          (Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_exteriorPower_self E n) ∧
      @curveDegree k _ X f _ hdim (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (n : ℤ)) 1
          (Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_exteriorPower_self E n) =
        @invertibleCurveDegree k _ X f _ hdim (Scheme.Modules.determinant E)
          (Scheme.Modules.isInvertible_determinant E n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.baseChangeCohomologyMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJ7.** The canonical pointwise base-change map on stalkwise cohomology induced by
a morphism `φ : L(g')^* K ⟶ K'` over a commutative square of schemes. No flatness,
cartesianness or Tor independence is required.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeCohomologyMap {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g' : X' ⟶ X) (w : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} X.Modules] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} X'.Modules]
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K ⟶ K')
    (x' : X')
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} (S.presheaf.stalk (f (g' x'))))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk (g' x')))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} (S'.presheaf.stalk (f' x')))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk x'))]
    (n : ℤ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart
declarations.doc:
**A Cartesian affine-open chart for a base-change square of schemes.** This is the
quadruple `U, V, V', U'` of Stacks 0DJ8 (2): affine opens `U ⊆ X` and `V' ⊆ S'` both mapping
into an affine open `V ⊆ S`, together with `U' = V' ×_V U`, the last expressed by the pushout
square of coordinate rings.
declarations.statement:
public structure BaseChangeChart {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
declarations.comment: the Cartesian affine-open chart quantified over in (2) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.isOpenImmersion_incU'
declarations.doc:
**`U'` is an open of `X'`.** The structure imposes no open-immersion hypothesis on
`Spec 𝒪_{X'}(U') ⟶ X'`: once the outer square is cartesian the chart data determine that
morphism uniquely, and it is then automatically an open immersion, being the base change of
`U ⊆ X` and `V' ⊆ S'` over `V ⊆ S`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isOpenImmersion_incU' (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g') : IsOpenImmersion ch.incU'
declarations.comment: the U' of a chart is an open of X'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.ofAffineOpens
declarations.doc:
**The chart on given affine opens.** For affine opens `U ⊆ X`, `V ⊆ S`, `V' ⊆ S'` with
`f(U) ⊆ V` and `g(V') ⊆ V`, the coordinate rings and the tensor product
`𝒪_X(U) ⊗_{𝒪_S(V)} 𝒪_{S'}(V')` form a chart, its `U'` being the canonical open
`V' ×_V U` of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
public def ofAffineOpens (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (U : X.Opens) (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hV' : IsAffineOpen V')
    (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hV'V : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) : BaseChangeChart f g f' g'
declarations.comment: the chart on a triple of affine opens

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_baseChangeChart_covering
declarations.doc:
**Every point of `X'` lies in the `U'` of a chart.** Choose an affine open `V ⊆ S` around
`f(g' x')`, then an affine open `U ⊆ X` around `g' x'` inside `f⁻¹V`, then an affine open
`V' ⊆ S'` around `f' x'` inside `g⁻¹V`; the resulting chart's `U' = V' ×_V U` contains `x'`,
because `x'` corresponds to a point of `U ×_V V'` under the cartesian square.

This is the covering input to the step (2) ⟹ (3) of Stacks 0DJ8.
declarations.comment: every point of X' lies in the U' of a chart, the covering input to (2) ⟹ (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_coveringFamily_of_forall_baseChangeChart
declarations.doc:
**The step (2) ⟹ (3) of Stacks 0DJ8.** If a property of charts holds for every chart then
there is a family of charts on which it holds whose opens `U'` cover `X'`: take the family of
all charts and apply `exists_baseChangeChart_covering`.

The property is left abstract because this step uses nothing about it. Reading `P ch` as
"the comparison map of `ch` is an isomorphism" turns this into the implication (2) ⟹ (3) of
the source, which is the only use intended.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_coveringFamily_of_forall_baseChangeChart {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {f' : X' ⟶ S'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (P : BaseChangeChart f g f' g' → Prop) (h : ∀ ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g', P ch) :
    ∃ 𝒞 : Set (BaseChangeChart f g f' g'), (∀ ch ∈ 𝒞, P ch) ∧
      ∀ x' : X', ∃ ch ∈ 𝒞, ∃ y : Spec ch.A', ch.incU' y = x'
declarations.comment: (2) ⟹ (3), for an arbitrary property of charts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.cohomologyComparison
declarations.doc:
The chart comparison in degree `n`: on a chart with coordinate rings `R`, `A`, `R'`, `A'`,
the `A'`-linear map

`A' ⊗_{A ⊗_R R'} H^n(RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_R R') ⟶ H^n(RΓ(U',K'))`

given by `ringCohomologyComparison` for the chart's pushout square of rings.
declarations.comment: the comparison map of (2) on a Cartesian affine-open chart, in degree n: the A'-linear map of Tag 0DJ7's ring form for the chart's pushout square of rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.cohomologyComparison_tmul_one
declarations.doc:
The degree-`n` map of a chart is `H^n` of the chart comparison: its value on `1 ⊗ m` is
`H^n(comparison)` of `m`, read through the identification of the cohomology of a complex of
`A'`-modules with the cohomology of its restriction to `R'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cohomologyComparison_tmul_one (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (n : ℤ) :
    letI : Algebra ch.R ch.A := ch.a.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra ch.R ch.R' := ch.b.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra ch.R ch.A' := (ch.c.hom.comp ch.a.hom).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra ch.A ch.A' := ch.c.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra ch.R' ch.A' := ch.d.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.A ch.A' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    letI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.R' ch.A' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' ch.isPushout_hom
    ∀ m : baseChangeCohomology (R := ch.R) (R' := ch.R')
      ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU).obj K) n,
      let B := ch.A ⊗[ch.R] ch.R'
      let k : B →+* ch.A' :=
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ch.R ch.A ch.A')
          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ch.R ch.R' ch.A') (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom
      (ch.cohomologyComparison K K' φ n).hom ((1 : ch.A') ⊗ₜ[B, k] m) =
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ch.d.hom).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyIso n).app
            ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU').obj K')).hom.hom
          (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} ch.R') n).map
            (ch.comparison K K' φ)).hom m)
declarations.comment: the degree-n map of a chart is H^n of the comparison map of (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.isIso_comparison_iff_forall_isIso_cohomologyComparison
declarations.doc:
The chart comparison

`RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_S(V)} 𝒪_{S'}(V') ⟶ RΓ(U',K')`

is an isomorphism exactly when, in every degree `n`, the `A'`-linear map

`A' ⊗_{A ⊗_R R'} H^n(RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_R R') ⟶ H^n(RΓ(U',K'))`

of the chart's pushout square of rings is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_comparison_iff_forall_isIso_cohomologyComparison
    (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g') (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ) ↔
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (ch.cohomologyComparison K K' φ n)
declarations.comment: condition (2) at a Cartesian affine-open chart, read degree by degree: the chart comparison is invertible exactly when the A'-linear base-change maps on cohomology of the chart's pushout square of rings are invertible in every degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.isIso_comparison_iff_forall_localized
declarations.doc:
The chart comparison is an isomorphism exactly when, at every prime `y` of
`A' = 𝒪_{X'}(U')` (that is, at every point of `U'`) and in every degree `n`, the localization at
`y` of the degree-`n` map of the chart is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_comparison_iff_forall_localized (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ) ↔
      ∀ (y : PrimeSpectrum ch.A') (n : ℤ),
        IsIso ((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor.{u} y.asIdeal.primeCompl).map
          (ch.cohomologyComparison K K' φ n))
declarations.comment: condition (2) at a Cartesian affine-open chart is a pointwise condition on the points of U': invertibility of the localization at each prime of A' of each degree-n map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.sectionsBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**The identification in condition (2).** On a chart, derived sections of `K` over `U` base
changed along `𝒪_X(U) ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}(U')` compare with derived sections over `U'` of the derived
pullback of `K`: `RΓ(U, K) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X(U)} 𝒪_{X'}(U') ⟶ RΓ(U', L(g')^*K)`.
declarations.comment: the second arrow of the composition in (2): the identification RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X(U)} 𝒪_{X'}(U') = RΓ(U', L(g')^*K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.isIso_sectionsBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**The identification `sectionsBaseChangeMap` is an isomorphism** when every cohomology sheaf
of `K` is quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_sectionsBaseChangeMap (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    IsIso (ch.sectionsBaseChangeMap K)
declarations.comment: the second arrow of the composition in (2) is an isomorphism for K with quasi-coherent cohomology, so (2) tests the composition the source displays

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.comparison
declarations.doc:
**The chart comparison map.** On a chart, the composition

`RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_S(V)} 𝒪_{S'}(V') ⟶ RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X(U)} 𝒪_{X'}(U') ⟶ RΓ(U',K')`

in `D(𝒪_{S'}(V'))`: `pullbackComparison` followed by `RΓ(U', -)` applied to the given morphism
`φ : L(g')^*K ⟶ K'`.
declarations.statement:
public def comparison (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    (CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
        ch.b.hom).functor.obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ch.a.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU).obj K)) ⟶
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars ch.d.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU').obj K')
declarations.comment: the comparison map on a Cartesian affine-open chart: the morphism whose invertibility is condition (2), and, asked only of a family of charts whose opens U' cover X', condition (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_coveringFamily_isIso_comparison
declarations.doc:
**The step (2) ⟹ (3).** If the comparison map of every Cartesian affine-open chart is an
isomorphism, then there is a family of charts on which it is, whose opens `U'` cover `X'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_coveringFamily_isIso_comparison {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {f' : X' ⟶ S'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (h : ∀ ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g', IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ)) :
    ∃ 𝒞 : Set (BaseChangeChart f g f' g'), (∀ ch ∈ 𝒞, IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ)) ∧
      ∀ x' : X', ∃ ch ∈ 𝒞, ∃ y : Spec ch.A', ch.incU' y = x'
declarations.comment: (2) ⟹ (3) for the comparison map itself, which is the step of the three-way equivalence that needs no affine reduction: take the family of all charts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.comparison_eq_ringComparison
declarations.doc:
The comparison map of a chart is the ring-level comparison of the chart's square of
coordinate rings, applied to the morphism `RΓ(U,K) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X(U)} 𝒪_{X'}(U') ⟶ RΓ(U',K')` assembled
from the identification `sectionsBaseChangeMap` and `RΓ(U', φ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comparison_eq_ringComparison (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    letI := ch.a.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.b.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.c.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.d.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (ch.c.hom.comp ch.a.hom).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.A ch.A' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.R' ch.A' :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => DFunLike.congr_fun ch.isPushout_hom r
    ch.comparison K K' φ =
      RingTheory.TorIndependence.ringComparison
        (R := ch.R) (R' := ch.R')
        ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU).obj K)
        ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU').obj K')
        (ch.sectionsBaseChangeMap K ≫ (affineDerivedSections ch.incU').map φ)
declarations.comment: the comparison map of (2) is the ring-level comparison of the chart's square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.isIso_comparison_iff
declarations.doc:
The comparison map of a Cartesian affine-open chart is an isomorphism exactly when, in
every degree, the induced map on cohomology is bijective after localizing at every prime of
`𝒪_X(U) ⊗_{𝒪_S(V)} 𝒪_{S'}(V')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_comparison_iff (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    letI := ch.a.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.b.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.c.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.d.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (ch.c.hom.comp ch.a.hom).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.A ch.A' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.R' ch.A' :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => DFunLike.congr_fun ch.isPushout_hom r
    (IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ) ↔
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : Ideal (ch.A ⊗[ch.R] ch.R')) (_ : q.IsPrime),
        Function.Bijective (LocalizedModule.map q.primeCompl
          (RingTheory.TorIndependence.cohomologyComparisonLinearMapGeneral
            (R := ch.R) (R' := ch.R')
            ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU).obj K)
            ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU').obj K')
            (ch.sectionsBaseChangeMap K ≫ (affineDerivedSections ch.incU').map φ) n).hom))
declarations.comment: (2) at one chart, reduced to the primes of the chart's coordinate ring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.isIso_comparison_iff_forall_isIso_ringBaseChangeCohomologyMap
declarations.doc:
The comparison map of a Cartesian affine-open chart is an isomorphism exactly when the
ring-level map `RingTheory.TorIndependence.ringBaseChangeCohomologyMapGeneral` of Stacks 0DJ7 for
the chart's square of coordinate rings is invertible in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_comparison_iff_forall_isIso_ringBaseChangeCohomologyMap
    (ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g')
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    letI := ch.a.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.b.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.c.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := ch.d.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (ch.c.hom.comp ch.a.hom).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.A ch.A' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower ch.R ch.R' ch.A' :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => DFunLike.congr_fun ch.isPushout_hom r
    (IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ) ↔
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (RingTheory.TorIndependence.ringBaseChangeCohomologyMapGeneral
        (R := ch.R) (R' := ch.R')
        ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU).obj K)
        ((affineDerivedSections ch.incU').obj K')
        (ch.sectionsBaseChangeMap K ≫ (affineDerivedSections ch.incU').map φ) n))
declarations.comment: (2) at one chart is the invertibility, in every degree, of the ring-level map of Stacks 0DJ7 for the chart's rings: the affine reduction of the source proof

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.baseChange_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJ8.** Let

`X' ⟶ X`, `X' ⟶ S'`, `X ⟶ S`, `S' ⟶ S`

be a Cartesian square of schemes, `K` an object of `D(𝒪_X)` with quasi-coherent cohomology
sheaves, `K'` an object of `D(𝒪_{X'}')` with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves, and
`φ : L(g')^*K ⟶ K'`. Then the following are equivalent.

1. The pointwise map of Stacks 0DJ7 is an isomorphism at every point of `X'` and in every
   degree.
2. The comparison map of every Cartesian affine-open chart is an isomorphism.
3. The comparison map of every chart in some family whose opens `U'` cover `X'` is an
   isomorphism.

The implications are read off the source bridge
`AlgebraicGeometry.baseChange_tfae_of_sourceBridge`: at a chart, a point `y` of
`Spec 𝒪_{X'}(U')` and a degree, `AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.sourceBridgeMap` is a
bijection of the two maps' sources — `AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.bijective_sourceBridgeMap`
— commuting with them through the identification of their targets, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeChart.baseChangeCohomologyMap_sourceBridgeMap`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem baseChange_tfae {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hK' : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X'.Modules n).obj K').IsQuasicoherent)
    (φ : (Stacks.Duality.derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    List.TFAE
      [∀ (x' : X') (i : ℤ), IsIso (baseChangeCohomologyMap f g f' g' sq.w K K' φ x' i),
       ∀ ch : BaseChangeChart f g f' g', IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ),
       ∃ 𝒞 : Set (BaseChangeChart f g f' g'),
         (∀ ch ∈ 𝒞, IsIso (ch.comparison K K' φ)) ∧
           ∀ x' : X', ∃ ch ∈ 𝒞, ∃ y : Spec ch.A', ch.incU' y = x']

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_baseChangeCohomologyMap_derivedPullbackNatTrans_of_isFlatOver
declarations.doc:
**The stalk check of Stacks 0DJ8 for a complex flat over the base, at one point.**  For a
cartesian square of schemes and a bounded-above complex `𝒢^•` of `𝒪_X`-modules whose terms are
flat over `S`, the map of Stacks 0DJ7 at the derived-to-ordinary comparison
`L(g')^*𝒢^• ⟶ (g')^*𝒢^•` is an isomorphism at `x'` in degree `n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_baseChangeCohomologyMap_derivedPullbackNatTrans_of_isFlatOver
    (hpb : IsPullback g' f' f g) (w : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (G : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hG : CochainComplex.minus X.Modules G)
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom (G.X n)) (x' : X') (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (baseChangeCohomologyMap f g f' g' w (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((pullbackComplex g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj G))
      ((derivedPullbackNatTrans g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).app G) x' n)
declarations.comment: condition (1), at every point and in every degree, for the derived-to-ordinary comparison L(g')^*G ⟶ (g')^*G of a bounded-above complex G whose terms are flat over S, over a cartesian square: the stalk check the proof of Tag 0A1D performs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivedStalkAffineSectionsIsoToStalk
declarations.doc:
**The derived stalk at a point of an affine open is the derived localization of the sections
over that open.** Let `i : Spec R ⟶ X` be a morphism of schemes out of an affine scheme, `y` a
point of `Spec R`, and `K ∈ D(𝒪_X)` an object with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves. Then

`RΓ(U, K) ⊗ᴸ_R 𝒪_{Spec R, y} ≅ (K_{i y}) ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_{X, i y}} 𝒪_{Spec R, y}`,

where `RΓ(U, K)` is `AlgebraicGeometry.affineDerivedSections i` applied to `K`.  When `i` is an
open immersion with image `U` the extension of scalars on the right is along the germ
isomorphism `𝒪_{X, i y} ≅ 𝒪_{Spec R, y}`, so the right-hand side *is* the derived stalk of `K`
at the point `i y` of `U`, and the two sides are the two readings of that derived stalk; the
statement itself asks nothing of `i`.

The left-hand side is the derived localization at `y` of the derived global sections of the
derived pullback of `K` to `Spec R`, which has quasi-coherent cohomology by Stacks 08DW, so
`affineDerivedStalkSectionsIso` identifies it with the derived stalk at `y` of that pullback;
`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedPullbackStalkIso` then moves the stalk from `Spec R` to `X`.
declarations.statement:
public def derivedStalkAffineSectionsIsoToStalk {X : Scheme.{u}} {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (i : Spec A ⟶ X) (y : Spec A) (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    (totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u}
        (A := ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk y : Type u))
        (StructureSheaf.toStalk A y).hom).functor.obj
        ((affineDerivedSections i).obj K) ≅
      (totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u} (i.stalkMap y).hom).functor.obj
        ((derivedStalkFunctor (i y)).obj K)
declarations.comment: the first of the two inputs still needed to turn condition (1) into condition (2): the derived stalk of K at a point of an affine open, identified with the derived localization of RGamma(U,K) there. This is that identification only; the compatibility of the base-change comparison of Tag 065Z with localization, which is the second input, is not proved anywhere, so condition (1) implies condition (2) is NOT formalized

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.localizedHomologyAffineSectionsStalkIso
declarations.doc:
**The derived stalk at a point of an affine open, read degree by degree.**  For
`i : Spec A ⟶ X`, a point `y` of `Spec A` and `K ∈ D(𝒪_X)` with quasi-coherent cohomology
sheaves, the localization at `y` of the degree-`n` cohomology of `RΓ(U,K)` is the degree-`n`
cohomology of the derived stalk of `K` at `i y`, base changed to `𝒪_{Spec A,y}`:

`(Hⁿ RΓ(U,K))_y ≅ Hⁿ(K_{i y} ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_{X, i y}} 𝒪_{Spec A,y})`.

When `i` is an open immersion `𝒪_{X, i y} ⟶ 𝒪_{Spec A,y}` is invertible and the right-hand side
is the degree-`n` cohomology of the derived stalk itself; the statement asks nothing of `i`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.derivedStalkAffineSectionsIsoToStalk` with `Hⁿ` applied, the left-hand
side being recognized as a localization because the germ map is one.
declarations.statement:
public def localizedHomologyAffineSectionsStalkIso {X : Scheme.{u}} {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (i : Spec A ⟶ X) (y : Spec A) (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent)
    (n : ℤ) :
    (CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.localizedModuleFunctor.{u, u}
        (show PrimeSpectrum (A : Type u) from y).asIdeal.primeCompl).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} (A : Type u)) n).obj
          ((affineDerivedSections i).obj K)) ≅
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u, u, u} (StructureSheaf.toStalk A y).hom).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk y : Type u)) n).obj
          ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u} (i.stalkMap y).hom).functor.obj
            ((derivedStalkFunctor (i y)).obj K)))
declarations.comment: the degreewise reading of the first of the two inputs needed to turn condition (1) into condition (2): the localization at a prime of the degree-n cohomology of RGamma(U,K) is the degree-n cohomology of the derived stalk there. The identification of this localized module with the localization of the degree-n chart map of condition (2), which needs the compatibility of the base-change comparison of Tag 065Z with localizing ALL FOUR rings of the chart's square and not only its right-hand column, is not proved anywhere, so condition (1) implies condition (2) is NOT formalized

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.globalBaseChangeIsIsoOfPointwise
declarations.doc:
**`GlobalBaseChangeIsIsoOfPointwise` holds**: it is Stacks 0DJ9,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_derivedBaseChangeComp_of_pointwiseBaseChange`, quantified over all
cartesian squares.
declarations.statement: theorem globalBaseChangeIsIsoOfPointwise : GlobalBaseChangeIsIsoOfPointwise.{u}
declarations.comment: the conclusion over every cartesian square at once, in the spelling of GlobalBaseChangeIsIsoOfPointwise, with the conditions of Tag 0DJ8 read in form (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_derivedBaseChangeComp_of_pointwiseBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJ9.** For a cartesian square of schemes with `f` quasi-compact and
quasi-separated, an object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and a morphism `φ : L(g')^*K ⟶ K'` to an object
of `D_QCoh(𝒪_{X'})` whose pointwise maps of Stacks 0DJ7 are invertible at every point of `X'` and
in every degree, the composition `Lg^*Rf_*K ⟶ Rf'_*L(g')^*K ⟶ Rf'_*K'` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedBaseChangeComp_of_pointwiseBaseChange (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.not_pointwiseBaseChangeSheafHomOfPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
The statement of part (3) of Stacks 0DJA, with the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0DJ8 read in
form (1) and `g` an arbitrary morphism, fails: for `A = ℤ/4`, the cartesian square with
`g : Spec ℤ/2 ⟶ Spec ℤ/4` the closed immersion and identities as vertical arrows,
`K = 𝒪_{Spec ℤ/4}`, `K' = L g^* K`, `φ = id`, and `E` the pseudo-coherent object attached to the
resolution `⋯ --2--> ℤ/4 --2--> ℤ/4` of `ℤ/2`, condition (1) of Stacks 0DJ8 holds for `φ` but
fails for `L g^* R𝓗om(E, K) ⟶ R𝓗om(L g^* E, K')`, whose source has cohomology
`Tor_1^{ℤ/4}(ℤ/2, ℤ/2) ≠ 0` in degree `-1` while its target lies in degrees `≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_pointwiseBaseChangeSheafHomOfPseudoCoherent :
    ¬ (∀ {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g' : X' ⟶ X),
      IsPullback g' f' f g →
      ∀ (w : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (E K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
        (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules)
        (φ : (derivedPullback g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K ⟶ K'),
        RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent (X := X.toRingedSpace) E →
        (∃ (L : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ), L.IsStrictlyGE a ∧
          Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ K)) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X'.Modules n).obj K').IsQuasicoherent) →
        PointwiseBaseChangeIsIso f g f' g' w K K' φ →
        PointwiseBaseChangeIsIso f g f' g' w
          (((derivedSheafHom X.sheaf).obj (op E)).obj K)
          (((derivedSheafHom X'.sheaf).obj
            (op ((derivedPullback g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E))).obj K')
          (baseChangeSheafHomComparison g'.toLRSHom.toShHom E K K' φ))
declarations.comment: (3) as written is false: the statement of part (3), with no condition on g, fails by a counterexample over ℤ/4 with g : Spec ℤ/2 ⟶ Spec ℤ/4, K the structure sheaf and E the periodic resolution of ℤ/2

As printed, with no condition on `g`, part (3) is false:
`AlgebraicGeometry.not_pointwiseBaseChangeSheafHomOfPseudoCoherent` is a counterexample with
`g : Spec ℤ/2 ⟶ Spec ℤ/4`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_baseChangeCohomologyMap_baseChangeSheafHomComparison_of_hasTorAmplitude
    (hpb : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (hg : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ s' : S',
      letI := (g.stalkMap s').hom.toAlgebra
      StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitudeCanonical (S.presheaf.stalk (g s'))
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (ModuleCat.{u} (S.presheaf.stalk (g s'))) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (S.presheaf.stalk (g s')) (S'.presheaf.stalk s')))) a b)
    (E K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K)
    (K' : DerivedCategory X'.Modules) (φ : (derivedPullback g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K ⟶ K')
    (h : ∀ (x' : X') (n : ℤ), IsIso (baseChangeCohomologyMap f g f' g' hpb.w K K' φ x' n))

    IsIso (baseChangeCohomologyMap f g f' g' hpb.w
      (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHom X.sheaf).obj (op E)).obj K)
      (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHom X'.sheaf).obj
        (op ((derivedPullback g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E))).obj K')
      (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeComparison.baseChangeSheafHomComparison
        g'.toLRSHom.toShHom E K K' φ) x' n)
declarations.comment: (3), corrected: g of finite Tor dimension added (every local ring of S' of Tor amplitude in a fixed interval over the local ring of S below it); with no condition on g part (3) is false, see AlgebraicGeometry.not_pointwiseBaseChangeSheafHomOfPseudoCoherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_projectiveLine_normalization_of_genus_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DJB].** Let `X` be a proper curve over a field `k` with `H⁰(X, 𝒪_X) = k`,
singular and of genus zero, and let `ν : X' ⟶ X` be its normalization. Then there are a field
`k'`, a structure morphism `X' ⟶ Spec k'` and points `x' : Spec k' ⟶ X'`, `x : Spec k ⟶ X`
making the diagram `x' ⟶ X' ⟶ Spec k'` over `x ⟶ X ⟶ Spec k` commute, such that

1. `k'/k` is a nontrivial finite extension;
2. `X' ≅ 𝐏¹_{k'}` over `k'`;
3. `x'` is a `k'`-rational point of `X'`;
4. `x` is a `k`-rational point of `X`;
5. `ν` restricts to an isomorphism `X' ∖ {x'} ≅ X ∖ {x}`;
6. `0 ⟶ 𝒪_X ⟶ ν_* 𝒪_{X'} ⟶ 𝒬 ⟶ 0` is short exact and its cokernel `𝒬` is the skyscraper at
   `x = ν(x')` with value `κ(x') / κ(x)`, the quotient of `κ(x')` by the image of `𝒪_{X, x}`;
   the point is written `ν(x')`, which is `x` by the commutativity of the left square.

The field is `k' = H⁰(X', 𝒪_{X'})`. The dimension count at the singular points that the source
runs through the conductor and a bound on commutative subalgebras of a matrix algebra is
replaced by `Stacks.Curves.finrank_le_two_mul_finrank_quotient_range` and
`Stacks.Curves.finrank_residueField_eq_one_of_finrank_quotient_range_add_one_eq`, which use
only that `B / A` is a module over the local ring `A = 𝒪_{X, x}` and that `B / 𝔪_A B` is a
`k'`-vector space, `B = (ν_* 𝒪_{X'})_x`; see
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Curves.SingularGenusZeroAlgebra`.
The isomorphism `X' ≅ 𝐏¹_{k'}` comes from the degree-one invertible module of the rational point
`x'` by `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_projectiveLine_of_invertibleCurveDegree_eq_one`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_projectiveLine_normalization_of_genus_eq_zero (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve k f] [IsProper f]
    [IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop)]
    (hsing : (singularLocus X).Nonempty) (hgenus : genus f = 0) :
    ∃ (k' : Type u) (_ : Field k') (_ : Algebra k k')
      (f' : normalizationSchemeOverField k f ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
      (x' : Spec (.of k') ⟶ normalizationSchemeOverField k f) (x : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X),
      -- the diagram commutes
      normalizationOverField k f ≫ f = f' ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')) ∧
      x' ≫ normalizationOverField k f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')) ≫ x ∧
      -- (1)
      (Module.Finite k k' ∧ 1 < Module.finrank k k') ∧
      -- (2)
      (∃ e : normalizationSchemeOverField k f ≅
          Proj (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjPolyChart.polyGrading k' 1),
        e.hom ≫ Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjPolyChart.projToSpecCoeff k' 1 = f') ∧
      -- (3)
      x' ≫ f' = 𝟙 _ ∧
      -- (4)
      x ≫ f = 𝟙 _ ∧
      -- (5)
      (∃ U : X.Opens, (U : Set X) = {x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)}ᶜ ∧
        ((normalizationOverField k f) ⁻¹ᵁ U : Set (normalizationSchemeOverField k f)) =
          {x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k')}ᶜ ∧
        IsIso (normalizationOverField k f ∣_ U)) ∧
      -- (6)
      (letI : Algebra
          (X.presheaf.stalk (normalizationOverField k f (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k'))))
          ((normalizationSchemeOverField k f).residueField (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k'))) :=
        ((normalizationOverField k f).stalkMap (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k')) ≫
          (normalizationSchemeOverField k f).residue
            (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k'))).hom.toAlgebra
       (ShortComplex.cokernelSequence (normalizationModuleMap X
          (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k f))).ShortExact ∧
        Nonempty (normalizationQuotient X
            (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k f) ≅
          skyscraperModule X (normalizationOverField k f (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k')))
            (ModuleCat.of _
              ((normalizationSchemeOverField k f).residueField (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k')) ⧸
                LinearMap.range (Algebra.linearMap
                  (X.presheaf.stalk (normalizationOverField k f (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k'))))
                  ((normalizationSchemeOverField k f).residueField
                    (x' (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k'))))))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_pinchedProjectiveLine
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DJC.** For a nontrivial finite extension `K/k`, the pinched
projective line over `k`: a scheme with the prescribed affine gluing of `Spec A` to `Spec K[Y]`
along `Spec K[T, T⁻¹]`, with a single singular closed point at the contracted origin, with `k`
for its global functions, which is a proper curve of genus zero over `k`, and whose canonical
normalization is `ℙ¹_K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pinchedProjectiveLine [Module.Finite k K]
    (hK : 1 < Module.finrank k K) :
    ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
      (iA : Spec (.of (pinchedPolynomialRing k K)) ⟶ X)
      (iB : Spec (.of (Polynomial K)) ⟶ X)
      (ν : projectiveLine K ⟶ X)
      (xA : Spec (.of (pinchedPolynomialRing k K))),
      IsOpenImmersion iA ∧
      IsOpenImmersion iB ∧
      (iA ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (pinchedPolynomialConstant k K))) ∧
      (iB ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((Polynomial.C : K →+* Polynomial K).comp (algebraMap k K)))) ∧
      (Set.range iA.base ∪ Set.range iB.base = Set.univ) ∧
      (let pA := pinchedPuncturedChart k K
       let pB := (projectiveLineInversionIso K).hom ≫
         projectiveLinePuncturedChart K
       ∃ (hglue : pA ≫ iA = pB ≫ iB),
         IsIso (pullback.lift pA pB hglue)) ∧
      (xA.asIdeal = (Ideal.span {(Polynomial.X : Polynomial K)}).comap
        (Subring.subtype (pinchedPolynomialRing k K))) ∧
      (singularLocus X = {iA.base xA}) ∧
      IsCurve k f ∧
      IsProper f ∧
      IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop) ∧
      genus f = 0 ∧
      (projectiveLineXChart K ≫ ν =
        pinchedNormalizationAffineChart k K ≫ iA) ∧
      (projectiveLineYChart K ≫ ν = iB) ∧
      (∃ hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) →
          (irreducibleComponents U).Finite,
        ∃ e : projectiveLine K ≅
          Scheme.normalizationScheme X hX,
          ν = e.hom ≫ Scheme.normalization X hX)

declarations.name: RingTheory.TorIndependence.baseChangeCohomologyIsoOfFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJD.** Consider a commutative diagram of rings
`A' ← R' → B'` over `A ← R → B`, with `R'` flat over `R`, `A'` flat over `A ⊗_R R'` and `B'` flat
over `R' ⊗_R B` (the assumptions of Stacks 08HW). For `M ∈ D(A)` there is a canonical
isomorphism of `A' ⊗_{R'} B'`-modules

`H^i((M ⊗ᴸ_A A') ⊗ᴸ_{R'} B') ≅ H^i(M ⊗ᴸ_R B) ⊗_{A ⊗_R B} (A' ⊗_{R'} B')`.

The derived tensor products are the ones of the source: `M ⊗ᴸ_A A'` is read in `D(R')` and
base changed along `R' → B'`, and `M` is read in `D(R)` and base changed along `R → B`; the
module structures over `A' ⊗_{R'} B'` and `A ⊗_R B` on the cohomology are those of
`RingTheory.TorIndependence.baseChangeCohomology`, coming from the actions of `A'` and of `A` by
endomorphisms. Extension of scalars puts the new ring on the left of the tensor product.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeCohomologyIsoOfFlat
    {R R' A B A' B' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [CommRing A'] [CommRing B']
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra A A'] [Algebra R A'] [IsScalarTower R A A'] [Algebra R' A'] [IsScalarTower R R' A']
    [Algebra B B'] [Algebra R B'] [IsScalarTower R B B'] [Algebra R' B'] [IsScalarTower R R' B']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} R')]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} A')] [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (ModuleCat.{u} B')]
    (hR' : (algebraMap R R').Flat)
    (hA' : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R A A')
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R R' A') (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom.Flat)
    (hB' : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId R' B') (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B B')
      (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom.Flat)
    (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (i : ℤ) :
    baseChangeCohomology (R := R') (R' := B')
        ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A A')).functor.obj M) i ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
        (TorChangeOfRings.tensorProductMap R R' A B A' B' (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R A A')
          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B B'))).obj
        (baseChangeCohomology (R := R) (R' := B) M i)

declarations.name: StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.pseudoCoherent_derivedTensorProduct_largeUniverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJE.** If `K` is `n`-pseudo-coherent and has no cohomology above `a`, and `L` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent and has no cohomology above `b`, then their derived tensor product
`K ⊗ᴸ L` is `max (m + a) (n + b)`-pseudo-coherent. Moreover, the derived tensor product of two
pseudo-coherent objects is pseudo-coherent.

The modules live in a universe `max u v` independent of the ring's universe `u`, as in the
source, and the derived tensor product is the one of Stacks 064M,
`CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.derivedTensorProduct`: one endofunctor
`derivedTensorProduct L` of `D(R)` for each object `L`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pseudoCoherent_derivedTensorProduct_largeUniverse
    (K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) :
    (∀ n m a b : ℤ,
      IsPseudoCoherentFrom K n →
      (∀ i : ℤ, a < i →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) i).obj K)) →
      IsPseudoCoherentFrom L m →
      (∀ j : ℤ, b < j →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) j).obj L)) →
      IsPseudoCoherentFrom
        ((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.derivedTensorProduct L).obj K)
        (max (m + a) (n + b))) ∧
      (IsPseudoCoherent K → IsPseudoCoherent L →
        IsPseudoCoherent ((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.derivedTensorProduct L).obj K))

declarations.name: StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.FaithfullyFlat.hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_extendScalars
declarations.doc:
Let `R → A → B` be ring maps with `A → B` faithfully flat, and let `K ∈ D(A)`. Then, viewing
both `K` and `K ⊗_A^L B` as objects of `D(R)` via restriction of scalars, `K` has tor-amplitude in
`[a, b]` over `R` if and only if `K ⊗_A^L B` has tor-amplitude in `[a, b]` over `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_extendScalars
    (R A B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra A B] [Algebra R B] [IsScalarTower R A B]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat A B]
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ) :
    HasTorAmplitude ((CochainComplex.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).obj K) a b ↔
      HasTorAmplitude ((CochainComplex.restrictScalars (algebraMap R B)).obj
        ((CochainComplex.extendScalars (algebraMap A B)).obj K)) a b

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.isRelativelyPerfect_of_derivedExtensionScalars
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJG.** Let `R' → A'` be a flat ring map of finite presentation, let `R' → R` be a
surjective ring map whose kernel is a nilpotent ideal and set `A = A' ⊗[R'] R`. If the derived
extension of scalars of `K' ∈ D(A')` to `A` is perfect relative to `R`, then `K'` is perfect
relative to `R'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyPerfect_of_derivedExtensionScalars
    {R' A' R : Type u} [CommRing R'] [CommRing A'] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra R' A'] [Algebra R' R] [Module.Flat R' A']
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R' A']
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R' R))
    (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R' R)))
    (derivedTensorR' :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R') ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R') ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R'))
    (comparisonR' : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R',
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          derivedTensorR'.flip.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R') 0).obj M) ⟶
        (tensorModuleRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerivedR' : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R',
      (derivedTensorR'.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R') 0).obj M)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (comparisonR' M)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R') (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (derivedTensorR :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (comparisonR : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          derivedTensorR.flip.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj M) ⟶
        (tensorModuleRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerivedR : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      (derivedTensorR.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj M)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (comparisonR M)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (K' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A')) :
    let A := A' ⊗[R'] R
    let e : (R ⊗[R'] A') ≃ₐ[R] A :=
      AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R' R A').toRingEquiv)
        (fun r => by
          change (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R' R A')
            (algebraMap R (R ⊗[R'] A') r) = _
          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply,
            Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
          rfl)
    letI : Module.Flat R A := Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv e.symm.toLinearEquiv
    letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation R A := Algebra.FinitePresentation.equiv e
    let f : A' →+* A := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
    IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, u, u} derivedTensorR comparisonR isLeftDerivedR
        ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, u} f).functor.obj K') →
      IsRelativelyPerfect.{u, u, u} derivedTensorR' comparisonR' isLeftDerivedR' K'

declarations.name: PseudoCoherence.hasTorAmplitude_localization_of_isZero_homology_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DJH.** Let `A` be flat and of finite presentation over `R`, presented by `d`
variables, let `q ⊂ A` be a prime lying over `p ⊂ R` and let `K ∈ D(A)` be pseudo-coherent. If the
cohomology of `K_q ⊗ᴸ_{R_p} κ(p)` vanishes outside `[a, b]`, then `K_q` has Tor amplitude in
`[a - d, b]` over `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_localization_of_isZero_homology_fibre
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [Module.Flat R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (d : ℕ) (presentation : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R →ₐ[R] A)
    (hpresentation : Function.Surjective presentation)
    (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime]
    (derivedTensor :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (comparison : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          derivedTensor.flip.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj N) ⟶
        (tensorModuleRight N).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (isLeftDerived : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} R,
      (derivedTensor.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj N)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (comparison N) (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (fibreTensor :
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))))
    (fibreComparison : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R)),
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
          fibreTensor.flip.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))) 0).obj N) ⟶
        (tensorModuleRight N).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (fibreIsLeftDerived : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R)),
      (fibreTensor.flip.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))) 0).obj N)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        (fibreComparison N)
        (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
          (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent K) (a b : ℤ)
    (hfibre : ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))) i).obj
        ((fibreTensor.obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))
              (Localization.AtPrime q))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars
              (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q))).functor.obj K))).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
