declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNP.** A smooth 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is locally of finite
presentation.

Stacks 075U is the existential smooth-diagram criterion at smoothness of morphisms of algebraic
spaces, which is locally of finite presentation by **Stacks 04AJ**; monotonicity (Stacks 06PS)
gives the existential criterion at local finite presentation, and the round trip of
Stacks 06FM — whose smooth-locality hypothesis is the local-finite-presentation case of
Stacks 06FC — gives the universal criterion, which is Stacks 06Q2 part (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isSmooth
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.existsUnique_infFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNR.** Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`,
let `A → C` be a flat homomorphism of `S`-algebras, let `x` be an object of `𝒳` over `Spec A`
and let `y = x|_{Spec C}`. Then the infinitesimal automorphisms of the trivial deformations of
`x` and of `y` satisfy `Inf_x(M) ⊗_A C = Inf_y(C ⊗_A M)`: there is a unique `C`-linear
isomorphism `C ⊗_A Inf_x(M) ≅ Inf_y(N)`, for `N` a site module identified with `C ⊗_A M`,
which sends `c ⊗ θ` to the base change of `θ` scaled by `c`.

The identification of `Inf_x` with `Hom_A(Q, -)`, of `Inf_y` with `Hom_C(QC, -)`, and of `QC`
with `C ⊗_A Q`, together with the finite presentation of `Q`, are hypotheses: they are the
inputs the source takes from Stacks 0617, 05ZF and 05ZC, which this development does not have in
that combined form. See `Deformation.Artin.InfHomRepresentation`. What is proved here is the flat
base change itself, by Stacks 087R.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_infFlatBaseChange
    (D : InfHomRepresentation A C B S hS toS hA toSC hC p x y hx hy hp Dx Dy Q QC)
    (M : SiteModule A B) (N : SiteModule C B)
    (hMN : (C ⊗[A] (M.obj : Type u)) ≃ₗ[C] (N.obj : Type u)) :
    ∃ e : (C ⊗[A] (Dx.functor.obj M : Type w)) ≃ₗ[C] (Dy.functor.obj N : Type w),
      (∀ (c a : C) (θ : (Dx.functor.obj M : Type w)) (q : Q),
        D.homRepY N (e (c ⊗ₜ[A] θ)) (D.baseChangeQ (a ⊗ₜ[A] q)) =
          hMN ((a * c) ⊗ₜ[A] D.homRepX M θ q)) ∧
      ∀ e' : (C ⊗[A] (Dx.functor.obj M : Type w)) ≃ₗ[C] (Dy.functor.obj N : Type w),
        (∀ (c a : C) (θ : (Dx.functor.obj M : Type w)) (q : Q),
          D.homRepY N (e' (c ⊗ₜ[A] θ)) (D.baseChangeQ (a ⊗ₜ[A] q)) =
            hMN ((a * c) ⊗ₜ[A] D.homRepX M θ q)) → e' = e

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_infFlatBaseChange_of_inertia
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNR: infinitesimal automorphisms commute with flat base change.** Let `𝒳` be an
algebraic stack over `S` whose inertia `ℐ_𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳` is locally of finite presentation, let `A → C`
be a flat homomorphism of `S`-algebras, let `x` be an object of `𝒳` over `Spec A` and let
`y = x|_{Spec C}`, exhibited by an arrow `φ : y ⟶ x` over `Spec C ⟶ Spec A`. Then for every
`A`-module `M` there is a `C`-linear isomorphism `C ⊗_A Inf_x(M) ≅ Inf_y(C ⊗_A M)`, sending `1 ⊗ θ`
to the image of `θ` under the map `Inf_x(M) ⟶ Inf_y(C ⊗_A M)` of Stacks 07YA (restriction of
infinitesimal automorphisms along the arrow of trivial deformations over
`Spec C[C ⊗_A M] ⟶ Spec A[M]`). The modules `Inf_x`, `Inf_y` are arbitrary realizations of the
functors of Stacks 07Y9.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_infFlatBaseChange_of_inertia (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hI : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
      (inertiaProjectionAlgebraicStacks B S hS 𝒳))
    (A C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Module.Flat A C]
    (toS : Spec (.of A) ⟶ S) (hA : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
    (toSC : Spec (.of C) ⟶ S) (hC : B.Contains (Spec (.of C)))
    (hf : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C)) ≫ toS = toSC)
    (x y : 𝒳.val.val.obj) (hx : 𝒳.val.val.p.obj x = algebraOver A B S hS toS hA)
    (hy : 𝒳.val.val.p.obj y = algebraOver C B S hS toSC hC) (φ : y ⟶ x)
    (hφ : 𝒳.val.val.p.IsHomLift
      (algebraOverMapOfRingHom (algebraMap A C) B S hS toS toSC hA hC hf) φ)
    (Dx : InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData A B S hS toS hA 𝒳.val.val.p x hx
      𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids)
    (Dy : InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData C B S hS toSC hC 𝒳.val.val.p y hy
      𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids)
    (M : SiteModule A B) :
    ∃ e : (C ⊗[A] (Dx.functor.obj M : Type u)) ≃ₗ[C]
        (Dy.functor.obj ⟨ModuleCat.of C (C ⊗[A] M.obj), isSiteModule_tensor hC M⟩ : Type u),
      ∀ t : (Dx.functor.obj M : Type u), e ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ t) =
        infBaseChangeMap (algebraMap A C) B S hS toS hA toSC hC hf 𝒳.val.val.p x y hx hy φ hφ
          𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids Dx Dy (tensorCoeff (A₁ := C) M.obj) t

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.LiftClassSheaf.isSheaf_liftClassPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNS.** For an algebraic stack over a base scheme whose inertia is locally of finite
presentation, and a deformation situation `(A' → A, x)`, the functor sending an affine
`A'`-algebra `B'` to the isomorphism classes of lifts of `x|_{B' ⊗_{A'} A}` to `B'` is a sheaf on
the big affine fppf site of `Spec A'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_liftClassPresheaf
    (hI : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
      (Stack.relativeInertiaProjection B S hS (Stack.structureMorphism B S hS 𝒳)))
    (hi : IsDeformationSituation (ringMap B S hS i).hom) (P : LiftClassPresheaf B S hS 𝒳 i x hx) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf ((BigAffineFppf.topology B S hS).over U') P.presheaf

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_tangentFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNT: tangent modules of an algebraic stack commute with flat base change.** Let `𝒳`
be an algebraic stack over `S` with `𝒳 → S` locally of finite presentation, `A → C` a flat
homomorphism of `S`-algebras, `x` an object of `𝒳` over `Spec A` and `y = x|_{Spec C}`, exhibited
by a strongly cartesian arrow `β : y ⟶ x` over `Spec C ⟶ Spec A`. Then for every `A`-module `M`
there is a `C`-linear isomorphism `C ⊗_A T_x(M) ≅ T_y(C ⊗_A M)`, the one induced by pulling lifts
back along `Spec C[C ⊗_A M] ⟶ Spec A[M]`: the ring map `r : A[M] → C[C ⊗_A M]` is `A → C` on
`A` and `m ↦ 1 ⊗ m` on `M`, and `1 ⊗ t` is sent to the class of the cartesian pullback along
`Spec r` of a lift representing `t`. The tangent modules are arbitrary realizations of the
tangent functors of Stacks 07Y9.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_tangentFlatBaseChange
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ Stack.schemeFibredCategory B S hS (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS))))
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEverySmoothDiagram B S hS
      (fun _ _ g => Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g) f)
    (A C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Module.Flat A C]
    (toS : Spec (.of A) ⟶ S) (hA : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
    (toS' : Spec (.of C) ⟶ S) (hC : B.Contains (Spec (.of C)))
    (x y : 𝒳.val.obj) (hx : 𝒳.val.p.obj x = algebraOver A B S hS toS hA)
    (hy : 𝒳.val.p.obj y = algebraOver C B S hS toS' hC)
    (b : algebraOver C B S hS toS' hC ⟶ algebraOver A B S hS toS hA)
    (hb : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map b = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C)))
    (β : y ⟶ x) (hβ : 𝒳.val.p.IsStronglyCartesian b β)
    (M : SiteModule A B) (hMC : IsSiteModule C B (ModuleCat.of C (C ⊗[A] M.obj)))
    (Tx : TangentFunctorData A B S hS toS hA 𝒳.val.p x hx)
    (Ty : TangentFunctorData C B S hS toS' hC 𝒳.val.p y hy) :
    let N : SiteModule C B := ⟨ModuleCat.of C (C ⊗[A] M.obj), hMC⟩
    ∃ (r : squareZeroRing A M.obj ⟶ squareZeroRing C N.obj)
      (g : squareZeroOver C B S hS toS' N ⟶ squareZeroOver A B S hS toS M)
      (e : (C ⊗[A] (Tx.functor.obj M : Type _)) ≃ₗ[C] (Ty.functor.obj N : Type _)),
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g = Spec.map r) ∧
      (∀ z : TrivSqZeroExt A M.obj,
        (r.hom z).fst = algebraMap A C z.fst ∧ (r.hom z).snd = (1 : C) ⊗ₜ[A] z.snd) ∧
      (∀ t : (Tx.functor.obj M : Type _),
        ∃ (a : (Under.post 𝒳.val.p).Fiber
            (Under.mk (eqToHom hx ≫ squareZeroArrow A B S hS toS hA M)))
          (c : (Under.post 𝒳.val.p).Fiber
            (Under.mk (eqToHom hy ≫ squareZeroArrow C B S hS toS' hC N))),
          Quotient.mk _ a = Tx.liftEquiv M t ∧
          Quotient.mk _ c = Ty.liftEquiv N (e ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[A] t)) ∧
          ∃ φ : c.1.right ⟶ a.1.right,
            𝒳.val.p.IsStronglyCartesian g φ ∧ c.1.hom ≫ φ = β ≫ a.1.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_lift_of_fppf_lift_of_isDeformationSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNU.** Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S` whose structure morphism is locally of
finite presentation, and let `(A' → A, x)` be a deformation situation, `A' → A` being
`Γ(U') → Γ(U)` for the closed immersion `i : U ⟶ U'` of affines and `x` an object over `U`. If
there are a faithfully flat finitely presented `A'`-algebra `B' = Γ(V')` and an object `y'` of `𝒳`
over `B'` lifting the restriction `y` of `x` to `B' ⊗_{A'} A = Γ(V)`, then there is an object `x'`
over `A'` lifting `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_fppf_lift_of_isDeformationSituation
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ schemeFibredCategory B S hS (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS))))
    (hf : HasPropertyOnEverySmoothDiagram B S hS
      (fun _ _ g => Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g) f)
    (U U' V V' : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
    (i : U ⟶ U') (j : V ⟶ U) (l : V ⟶ V') (k : V' ⟶ U')
    (hsq : j ≫ i = l ≫ k)
    (hpb : IsPushout
      ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map i).appTop
      ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map k).appTop
      ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map j).appTop
      ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map l).appTop)
    (hi : Deformation.Artin.IsDeformationSituation
      ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map i).appTop.hom)
    (hff : ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map k).appTop.hom.FaithfullyFlat)
    (hfp : ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map k).appTop.hom.FinitePresentation)
    (x : 𝒳.val.obj)
    (hx : 𝒳.val.p.obj x = (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj U)
    (y : 𝒳.val.obj)
    (_hy : 𝒳.val.p.obj y = (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj V)
    (α : y ⟶ x)
    (hα : 𝒳.val.p.IsStronglyCartesian ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).map j) α)
    (hlift : ∃ (y' : 𝒳.val.obj)
      (_hy' : 𝒳.val.p.obj y' = (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj V')
      (β : y ⟶ y'), 𝒳.val.p.IsStronglyCartesian ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).map l) β) :
    ∃ (x' : 𝒳.val.obj)
      (_hx' : 𝒳.val.p.obj x' = (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj U')
      (β : x ⟶ x'), 𝒳.val.p.IsStronglyCartesian ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).map i) β

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects
declarations.doc:
The first-order lifting condition for a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids, with
the comparison square required to commute: the restriction along a first-order thickening of
affine objects is the chosen pullback `CategoryTheory.Functor.pullbackFiber`.
declarations.statement:
def IsFormallySmoothOnObjects
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS)) (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop
declarations.comment: formal smoothness of a morphism of algebraic stacks is formal smoothness on

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.InfinitesimalLiftingDiagram
declarations.doc:
The solid part of a 2-commutative infinitesimal lifting diagram for a
1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S`: a first-order thickening of affine
objects of the big fppf site of `S`, a point of `𝒳` over the smaller one, a point of `𝒴` over
the larger one, and a 2-morphism witnessing that the square 2-commutes.
declarations.statement:
structure InfinitesimalLiftingDiagram
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_iff_nonempty_dottedArrow
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNY.** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is formally smooth exactly when
every infinitesimal lifting diagram for it — the solid diagram 0DNX, i.e. a first-order
thickening of affine objects of the site together with a point of the source over the smaller
one, a point of the target over the larger one and a 2-morphism witnessing 2-commutativity —
admits a dotted arrow, i.e. the category of dotted arrows of Stacks 0H18 for that square is
nonempty.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothOnObjects_iff_nonempty_dottedArrow
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳.1 𝒴.1 f.hom ↔
      ∀ d : InfinitesimalLiftingDiagram B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 f,
        Nonempty (DottedArrow d.x d.j f.hom d.y d.γ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_dottedArrow_of_isSmooth_of_isFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DNZ.** Let `T ⟶ T'` be a first-order thickening of affine schemes, `𝒳` an algebraic
stack whose structure morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ T'` is smooth, and `x : T ⟶ 𝒳` a morphism over `T'`
(the 2-morphism `γ : j ⟶ x ≫ f`, with `j : T ⟶ T'` the morphism of represented categories
induced by the thickening). Then there is a morphism `x' : T' ⟶ 𝒳` over `T'` with `x'|_T ≅ x`:
a dotted arrow for the square `(x, j, f, 𝟙)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dottedArrow_of_isSmooth_of_isFirstOrderThickening
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (T T' : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hT : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T))
    (hT' : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T'))
    (i : T ⟶ T')
    (hi : Stacks.Thickenings.IsFirstOrderThickening (B.inclusion.map i.left))
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ schemeFibredCategory B S hS T')
    (hf : HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS
      (fun {X Y} (g : X ⟶ Y) => Space.IsSmooth B S hS g) f)
    (j : schemeFibredCategory B S hS T ⟶ schemeFibredCategory B S hS T')
    (hj : j.hom.toFunctor = Over.map i)
    (x : schemeFibredCategory B S hS T ⟶ 𝒳)
    (γ : (j ≫ 𝟙 _) ⟶ (x ≫ f)) :
    Nonempty (DottedArrow x j f (𝟙 _) γ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSmooth_iff_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_and_isFormallySmoothOnObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP0 (infinitesimal lifting criterion).** A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic
stacks over `S` is smooth if and only if it is locally of finite presentation and formally
smooth, formal smoothness of a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks being formal smoothness on
objects (Stacks 0DNW).
declarations.statement:
theorem AlgebraicStacks.isSmooth_iff_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_and_isFormallySmoothOnObjects
    {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f ↔
      AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f ∧
        IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳.1 𝒴.1 f.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation.pushforwardQuotFunctorMap
declarations.doc:
Let `B` be an algebraic space, let `π : X ⟶ Y` be an affine quasi-finite morphism of
algebraic spaces which are separated and of finite presentation over `B`, and let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `π_*` induces a morphism
`Quot_{F/X/B} ⟶ Quot_{π_*F/Y/B}`: over a scheme `T` over `B` it sends a quotient `F_T ⟶ Q` to the
quotient `(π_*F)_T ≅ π_{T,*}F_T ⟶ π_{T,*}Q`.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardQuotFunctorMap :
    D.sourceSituation.quotFunctor ⟶ D.directImageSituation.quotFunctor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP1, the standing data.**  An affine quasi-finite morphism `π : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic
spaces which are separated and of finite presentation over an algebraic space `B`, together with
a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F`: the data along which the direct image induces a morphism
`Quot_{F/X/B} ⟶ Quot_{π_*F/Y/B}`.
declarations.statement: structure QuotPushforwardSituation (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
declarations.comment: the standing data

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation.pushforwardQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP1, the direct image of a quotient.**  The quotient `G_T ⟶ π_{T,*}(F_T/K)` of
`G_T` obtained from a quotient `F_T ⟶ F_T/K` by applying `π_{T,*}` and reading the result through
the comparison `G_T ≅ π_{T,*}F_T`, recorded — as the quotients themselves are — by its kernel.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardQuotient (h : SchemeTargetAffinePushforwardQuasicoherent B S hS)
    (c : PushforwardComparison D) (T : SchemesOver D.base)
    (K : Subobject (D.sourceSituation.baseChangeModule T)) :
    Subobject ((D.targetSituation h).baseChangeModule T)
declarations.comment: the direct image of a quotient, recorded by its kernel

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation.pushforwardQuotient_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP1.**  The direct image of a quotient in `Quot_{F/X/B}(T)` lies in
`Quot_{G/Y/B}(T)`: the quotient of `G_T` by it is `π_{T,*}(F_T/K)`, which is quasi-coherent, of
finite presentation, flat over `T` and has support proper over `T` because `F_T/K` is, this being
the morphism of stacks `Coh_{X/B} ⟶ Coh_{Y/B}` of Stacks 0DN9.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardQuotient_mem (h : SchemeTargetAffinePushforwardQuasicoherent B S hS)
    (I : AffinePushforwardQuotInputs D h) (T : SchemesOver D.base)
    (K : Subobject (D.sourceSituation.baseChangeModule T))
    (hK : K ∈ D.sourceSituation.properlySupportedQuotients T) :
    D.pushforwardQuotient h I.comparison T K ∈
      (D.targetSituation h).properlySupportedQuotients T
declarations.comment: the direct image of a quotient of the Quot functor is one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation.quotFunctorMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP1.**  The morphism of Quot functors `Quot_{F/X/B} ⟶ Quot_{π_*F/Y/B}` induced by
the direct image: over a test scheme it sends a quotient `F_T ⟶ Q` to `G_T ⟶ π_{T,*}Q`.

Naturality is the compatibility of the direct image with pullback along a morphism of test
schemes, part (b) of the proof of Stacks 0DN9.
declarations.comment: the induced morphism of Quot functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation.pushforwardQuotient'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP1, the direct image of a quotient.**  The quotient `G_T ⟶ π_{T,*}(F_T/K)` of
`G_T` obtained from a quotient `F_T ⟶ F_T/K` by applying `π_{T,*}` and reading the result through
the comparison `G_T ≅ π_{T,*}F_T`, recorded — as the quotients themselves are — by its kernel.
declarations.comment: the direct image of a quotient, recorded by its kernel

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuotPushforwardSituation.pushforwardQuotient_mem'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DP1.**  The direct image of a quotient in `Quot_{F/X/B}(T)` lies in
`Quot_{G/Y/B}(T)`: the quotient of `G_T` by it is `π_{T,*}(F_T/K)`, which is quasi-coherent, of
finite presentation, flat over `T` and has support proper over `T` because `F_T/K` is, this being
the morphism of stacks `Coh_{X/B} ⟶ Coh_{Y/B}` of Stacks 0DN9.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardQuotient_mem' (I : AffinePushforwardQuotInputs' D) (T : SchemesOver D.base)
    (K : Subobject (D.sourceSituation.baseChangeModule T))
