declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyAwayComparison_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DWU, part (3).** If `Hⁱ⁻¹_{V(I)}(M)` and `Hⁱ_{V(I)}(M)` both vanish after
localization at the prime `𝔭`, the comparison out of the colimit is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem localCohomologyAwayComparison_isIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I p : Ideal A) (hp : p.IsPrime) (hI : I.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 ≤ i)
    (hvanPrev : Subsingleton
      (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl (localCohomologyModule A I hI M (i - 1))))
    (hvan : Subsingleton
      (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl (localCohomologyModule A I hI M i))) :
    IsIso (localCohomologyAwayColimitData A I p hp hI M i).comparison
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DWV, part (1).** Surjectivity of the comparison map.

The covering set of the bare tag `0DWV` is three declarations, one per part of the source. The
other two are `Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE_injective` and
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.isIso_localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE_surjective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} A) (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 ≤ i)
    (hvan : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], I ≤ p → ¬ J ≤ p →
      IsZero (localCohomologyModule (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        ((Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing p).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        (ModuleCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p) (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M)) i)) :
    Function.Surjective
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) i).map
        (Stacks.Algebraization.localCohomologyComparison A J I hJ hI hIJ
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0).obj M))).hom
declarations.comment: surjectivity

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE_injective
declarations.doc:
**Injectivity of the change of support.** For finitely generated ideals `I ≤ J` of a
Noetherian ring, the canonical map `Hⁱ_{V(J)}(M) ⟶ Hⁱ_{V(I)}(M)` is injective as soon as the
local cohomology of `M_𝔭` with support in the maximal ideal of `A_𝔭` vanishes in degree `i - 1`
for every prime `𝔭 ∈ V(I) \ V(J)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE_injective
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} A) (i : ℤ) (_hi : 0 ≤ i)
    (hvan : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], I ≤ p → ¬ J ≤ p →
      Subsingleton
        (localCohomologyModule (Localization.AtPrime p)
          (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
          ((Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing p).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
          (ModuleCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p) (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M))
          (i - 1))) :
    Function.Injective
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) i).map
        (Stacks.Algebraization.localCohomologyComparison A J I hJ hI hIJ
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0).obj M))).hom
declarations.comment: injectivity

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isIso_localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE
declarations.doc:
**The change of support is an isomorphism.** For finitely generated ideals `I ≤ J` of a
Noetherian ring, the canonical map `Hⁱ_{V(J)}(M) ⟶ Hⁱ_{V(I)}(M)` is an isomorphism as soon as the
local cohomology of `M_𝔭` with support in the maximal ideal of `A_𝔭` vanishes in degrees `i` and
`i - 1` for every prime `𝔭 ∈ V(I) \ V(J)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_localCohomologyModuleMapOfLE
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I J : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} A) (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 ≤ i)
    (hvan : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], I ≤ p → ¬ J ≤ p →
      (IsZero (localCohomologyModule (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        ((Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing p).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        (ModuleCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p) (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M)) i) ∧
      IsZero (localCohomologyModule (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        ((Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing p).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        (ModuleCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p) (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M))
        (i - 1)))) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) i).map
      (Stacks.Algebraization.localCohomologyComparison A J I hJ hI hIJ
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0).obj M)))
declarations.comment: isomorphism

declarations.name: Module.exists_open_depth_localization_ge
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWX.** If `I ⊆ p` and the depth of the finite module `M` along `I` at
`p` is `e`, then the localized depth is at least `e` on a nonempty open subset of `V(p)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_depth_localization_ge
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (_hIp : I ≤ p.asIdeal) (e : ℕ)
    (he : Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) I)
      (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M) = (e : ℕ∞)) :
    let depthAt := fun q : PrimeSpectrum A ↦
      Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) I)
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M)
    ∃ U : Set ↑(PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A)),
      IsOpen U ∧ U.Nonempty ∧
        ∀ q ∈ U, (e : ℕ∞) ≤ depthAt q.1

declarations.name: Module.exists_open_depth_localization_ge_and_finite_exceptional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWY.** If the localization of a finite module over a Noetherian ring
has finite depth `e` at `p`, then on a nonempty open subset of `V(p)` its depth is at least `e`,
and is strictly greater than `e` except at finitely many points.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_depth_localization_ge_and_finite_exceptional
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (e : ℕ)
    (he : Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
      (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M) = (e : ℕ∞)) :
    let depthAt := fun q : PrimeSpectrum A ↦
      Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
        (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M)
    ∃ U : Set ↑(PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p.asIdeal : Set A)),
      IsOpen U ∧ U.Nonempty ∧
        (∀ q ∈ U, (e : ℕ∞) ≤ depthAt q.1) ∧
        Set.Finite {q | q ∈ U ∧ ¬ (e : ℕ∞) < depthAt q.1}

declarations.name: Dualizing.annihilator_moduleExtInto_eq_annihilator_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWZ, part (5).** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring with a
normalized dualizing complex `ω`, and let `M` be a finite `A`-module. Then the dual Ext module
`Eⁱ = Ext_A^{-i}(M, ω)` and the local cohomology module `Hⁱ_𝔪(M)` have the same annihilator.

Local duality identifies the `𝔪`-adic completion of `Eⁱ` with the module of `A`-linear maps
from `Hⁱ_𝔪(M)` to an injective hull of the residue field. Neither completing a finite module
nor passing to the Matlis dual changes the annihilator, so the two annihilators agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem annihilator_moduleExtInto_eq_annihilator_localCohomology
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} K) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.annihilator A (moduleExtInto M K (-i)) =
      Module.annihilator A
        (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyWithSupportIn A
          (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A : Set A))
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)
declarations.comment: part (5): Ext^{-i}(M, ω) and H^i_m(M) have the same annihilator

declarations.name: Dualizing.moduleExtInto_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWZ, part (1): finiteness.** For a finite module `M` over a
Noetherian local ring with normalized dualizing complex `ω`, every module
`Eⁱ = Ext_A^{-i}(M, ω)` is a finite `A`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleExtInto_finite {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {M : Type (max v u)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite A (moduleExtInto M K (-i))
declarations.comment: part (1): each Ext^{-i}(M, ω) is a finite A-module

declarations.name: Dualizing.moduleExtInto_degree_range
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWZ, part (1): degree range.** For a finite module `M` over a
Noetherian local ring with normalized dualizing complex `ω`, the module
`Eⁱ = Ext_A^{-i}(M, ω)` can be nonzero only for `0 ≤ i ≤ dim Supp(M)`; in particular the
dimension of the support of `M` is then a natural number.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleExtInto_degree_range {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] {M : Type (max v u)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K) (i : ℤ)
    (hi : Nontrivial (moduleExtInto M K (-i))) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, Module.supportDim A M = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧ i ∈ Set.Icc 0 (d : ℤ)
declarations.comment: part (1): Ext^{-i}(M, ω) vanishes outside 0 ≤ i ≤ dim Supp(M)

declarations.name: Dualizing.supportDim_moduleExtInto_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWZ, part (2).** For a finite module `M` over a Noetherian local
ring with normalized dualizing complex `ω`, the support of `Eⁱ = Ext_A^{-i}(M, ω)` has
dimension at most `i`; for `i < 0` the module `Eⁱ` vanishes, so its support is empty.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDim_moduleExtInto_le {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (M : Type (max v u)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.supportDim A (moduleExtInto M K (-i)) ≤
      if 0 ≤ i then ((i.toNat : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) else ⊥
declarations.comment: part (2): dim Supp(Ext^{-i}(M, ω)) ≤ i

declarations.name: Dualizing.depth_eq_iInf_nontrivial_moduleExtInto
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWZ, part (3).** For a finite module `M` over a Noetherian local
ring with normalized dualizing complex `ω`, the depth of `M` is the least `i ≥ 0` for which
`Eⁱ = Ext_A^{-i}(M, ω)` is nonzero. If all these modules vanish, both sides are `⊤`.
declarations.statement:
theorem depth_eq_iInf_nontrivial_moduleExtInto {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] {M : Type (max v u)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K) :
    Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) M =
      ⨅ (i : ℕ) (_ : Nontrivial (moduleExtInto M K (-(i : ℤ)))), (i : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: part (3): depth(M) is the least i with Ext^{-i}(M, ω) ≠ 0

declarations.name: Dualizing.mem_support_pi_moduleExtInto_iff_depth_add_ringKrullDim_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DWZ, part (4).** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring with a
normalized dualizing complex `ω`, let `M` be a finite `A`-module and write
`Eⁱ = Ext_A^{-i}(M, ω)`. A prime `𝔭` lies in the support of `E⁰ ⊕ E¹ ⊕ ⋯ ⊕ Eⁱ` — realized as
the product over `Fin (i + 1)` — exactly when the depth of the localization `M_𝔭` over `A_𝔭`
plus the dimension of `A / 𝔭` is at most `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_support_pi_moduleExtInto_iff_depth_add_ringKrullDim_le
    {A : Type u} {M : Type (max v u)}
    [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (i : ℕ) :
    p ∈ Module.support A ((j : Fin (i + 1)) → moduleExtInto M K (-(j : ℤ))) ↔
      ((Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
          (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) +
        ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p.asIdeal) ≤ (i : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: part (4): p ∈ Supp(E⁰ ⊕ … ⊕ Eⁱ) ↔ depth(M_p) + dim(A/p) ≤ i

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isArtinian_homology_puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX0, part (2).** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring, let
`U = Spec A ∖ {𝔪}` be its punctured spectrum and let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module. Then the
`A`-module `Hⁱ(U, ℱ)` satisfies the descending chain condition for every `i > 0`.

As in the source this comes from part (1) through Local Cohomology, Lemma [Stacks, Tag 0BK0]: the
coherent module `ℱ` is `M̃|_U` for a finite `A`-module `M`, the cohomology of `M̃` on the open
`Spec A ∖ V(𝔪)` of the ambient affine scheme computes `Hⁱ(U, ℱ)` by [Stacks, Tag 01E1] (2), and
in positive degrees that module is the local cohomology `H^{i+1}_𝔪(M)`, which is Artinian by part
(1). See the module documentation for the chain of identifications.
declarations.statement:
theorem isArtinian_homology_puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A)))
    [hFc : SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    IsArtinian A ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) (p : ℤ)).obj
      ((puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections A).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u}
          (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A))) 0).obj F)))
declarations.comment: part (2), for the derived sections of the punctured spectrum read as a ringed space

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isArtinian_localCohomology_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Local cohomology of a finite module over a Noetherian local ring has the
descending chain condition in every degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isArtinian_localCohomology_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : ModuleCat.{w} A) [Module.Finite A M] (i : ℤ) :
    IsArtinian A
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{w} A) i).obj
        ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).ι.obj
          ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{w} A) 0).obj M))))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isMittagLefflerCategorical_puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX1, part (2).** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring and let
`U = Spec A ∖ {𝔪}` be its punctured spectrum. Let `(ℱₙ)` be an inverse system of coherent
`𝒪_U`-modules. Then for every `i > 0` the inverse system of `A`-modules `n ↦ Hⁱ(U, ℱₙ)` satisfies
the Mittag-Leffler condition.

As in the source this follows immediately from part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0DX0]: each term of the
system has the descending chain condition, so the images of the transition maps into a fixed term
are eventually constant. No compatibility between the modules realizing the `ℱₙ` is needed,
because the Mittag-Leffler condition is a statement about one term at a time.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMittagLefflerCategorical_puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A)))
    (hScoherent : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (S.obj n))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    IsMittagLefflerCategorical (puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem A S (p : ℤ))
declarations.comment: part (2), for the derived sections of the punctured spectrum read as a ringed space

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isMittagLeffler_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX1.** Over a Noetherian local ring, the local cohomology modules of
an inverse system of finite modules satisfy the Mittag-Leffler condition in every degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMittagLeffler_localCohomology
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (M : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} A) (hM : ∀ n, Module.Finite A (M.obj n)) (i : ℤ) :
    IsMittagLefflerCategorical
      (M ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0 ⋙
        Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing ⋙
        (Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).ι ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) i)
declarations.comment: local_cohomology_system

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.depthOneQuotient_spec
declarations.doc:
The canonical quotient is coherent, surjective, unchanged away from `T`,
and of depth at least one along `T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depthOneQuotient_spec (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (T : Set X) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    IsDepthOneQuotient T (toDepthOneQuotient X T hT F)
declarations.comment: depth_one_quotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.depthOneQuotient_unique_of_epi_of_depth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX3**, uniqueness. Let `X` be a Noetherian scheme, `T ⊆ X` stable under
specialization and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module. If `g : F ⟶ G` is a surjection onto a coherent
module `G` such that the stalk map `F_x ⟶ G_x` is an isomorphism for `x ∉ T` and
`depth_{𝒪_{X,x}}(G_x) ≥ 1` for `x ∈ T`, then `G` is identified with the canonical depth-one
quotient `depthOneQuotient X T hT F` by a unique isomorphism over `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depthOneQuotient_unique_of_epi_of_depth (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (T : Set X) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (G : X.Modules) [G.IsCoherent] (g : F ⟶ G) [Epi g]
    (hstalk : ∀ x : X, x ∉ T → IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map
      g.mapPresheaf))
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∈ T →
      letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) G.val.presheaf x) :=
        PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
          (R := X.presheaf) G.val x
      (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) G.val.presheaf x)) :
    ∃! e : depthOneQuotient X T hT F ≅ G,
      toDepthOneQuotient X T hT F ≫ e.hom = g
declarations.comment: depth_one_quotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isDepthOneQuotient_pullback
declarations.doc:
For a flat morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of Noetherian schemes, the pullback of the canonical
depth-one quotient of a coherent module along a specialization-closed set `T` is a depth-one
quotient along `f ⁻¹' T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDepthOneQuotient_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Flat f]
    (T : Set X) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    IsDepthOneQuotient (f.base ⁻¹' T)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
        (toDepthOneQuotient X T hT F))
declarations.comment: flat_pullback

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.depthOneQuotient_pullback_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX3**, flat pullback. For a flat morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of Noetherian
schemes, `f^*F ⟶ f^*F'` is the depth-one quotient of `f^*F` along `f ⁻¹' T`: the canonical
depth-one quotient of the coherent module `f^*F` along `f ⁻¹' T` is identified with the pullback
of the canonical depth-one quotient of `F` along `T` by a unique isomorphism over `f^*F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depthOneQuotient_pullback_unique
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Flat f]
    (T : Set X) (hT : StableUnderSpecialization T)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F).IsCoherent := isCoherent_pullback f F
    ∃! e : depthOneQuotient Y (f.base ⁻¹' T) (hT.preimage f.base.hom.continuous)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (depthOneQuotient X T hT F),
      toDepthOneQuotient Y (f.base ⁻¹' T) (hT.preimage f.base.hom.continuous)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) ≫ e.hom =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (toDepthOneQuotient X T hT F)
declarations.comment: flat_pullback

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_iso_pullback_pushforward_restrict_flat
declarations.doc:
For a flat morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of Noetherian schemes, `f^*F → f^*j_*(F|_U)` is the
canonical extension map for the open subscheme `f^{-1}(U) ⊆ Y`: there is a unique isomorphism
between `f^*j_*(F|_U)` and `j'_*((f^*F)|_{f^{-1}(U)})` compatible with the two canonical maps out
of `f^*F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_iso_pullback_pushforward_restrict_flat
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Flat f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)).IsCoherent] :
    ∃! e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)),
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U.ι).unit.app F) ≫ e.hom =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)
declarations.comment: flat pullback compatibility: the pullback of the canonical map is the canonical map for the inverse image of U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCoherent_pushforward_restrict_pullback_of_flat
declarations.doc:
For a flat morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of Noetherian schemes, the coherence hypothesis of
[Stacks, Tag 0DX4] holds again downstairs: `j'_*((f^*F)|_{f^{-1}(U)})` is a coherent
`𝒪_Y`-module. With `f^*F` coherent (`AlgebraicGeometry.isCoherent_pullback`), [Stacks, Tag 0DX4]
therefore applies to `f : Y ⟶ X`, `f^{-1}(U)` and `f^*F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCoherent_pushforward_restrict_pullback_of_flat
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Flat f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)).IsCoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F))).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: flat pullback compatibility: the coherence hypothesis of the source holds again for the inverse image of U, so the lemma applies verbatim downstairs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_pullback_map_unit
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `F → j_*(F|_U)` becomes an isomorphism after restriction to the open
subscheme `U`.

This is the left unitality triangle of the pullback--pushforward adjunction together with
invertibility of its counit along an open immersion.
declarations.comment: clause (1) for the canonical map: it restricts to an isomorphism over U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.two_le_depth_stalk_pushforward_restrict
declarations.doc:
The stalks of the extension `F' = j_*(F|_U)` of a module along an open subscheme have depth
at least two at every point outside `U`.

The module `F'` is canonically the pushforward of its own restriction to `U`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_unit_app_pushforward`, so the bound is [Stacks, Tag 0EY0] part (3) for
the open immersion `U.ι`, which is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.PushforwardRegularity.two_le_depth_stalk_of_isIso_unit_of_notMem`.
Only finite type of `F'` is used, so coherence of `F` is not assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem two_le_depth_stalk_pushforward_restrict
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)).IsCoherent] :
    ∀ x : X, x ∉ (U : Set X) →
      let F' := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)
      letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) F'.val.presheaf x) :=
        PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
          F'.val x
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) F'.val.presheaf x)
declarations.comment: clause (2) for the canonical map: the extension has depth at least two outside U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.unique_iso_pushforward_restrict
declarations.doc:
A coherent module carrying a map from `F` which becomes an isomorphism over the open
subscheme `U` and whose stalks have depth at least two outside `U` is uniquely isomorphic,
under `F`, to the extension `j_*(F|_U)` of the restriction of `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem unique_iso_pushforward_restrict
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F G : X.Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] [G.IsCoherent] (U : X.Opens)
    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)).IsCoherent]
    (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map φ))
    (hdepth : ∀ x : X, x ∉ (U : Set X) →
      let M := TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) G.val.presheaf x
      letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x) M :=
        PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
          G.val x
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) M) :
    ∃! e : G ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F),
      φ ≫ e.hom = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U.ι).unit.app F
declarations.comment: uniqueness under the original module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_pullback_coherent
declarations.doc:
The pullback of the extension `j_*(F|_U)` along a flat morphism is coherent.

Flatness of `f` is not needed: coherence of a pullback needs only a locally Noetherian source,
by [Stacks, Tag 0EBF].
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_pullback_coherent
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Flat f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F)).IsCoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F))).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: flat pullback coherence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.correctedImprovement_pullback
declarations.doc:
**The Cohen–Macaulay pullback under the corrected conditions.**  Let `φ : F ⟶ G` satisfy the
corrected conditions along `Z` and let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a Cohen–Macaulay morphism of Noetherian
schemes.  Then `f^*φ` has coherent target, is an isomorphism on stalks off `f^{-1}(Z)`, satisfies
condition (2) at the points of `f^{-1}(Z)` reached from outside `f^{-1}(Z)` for `f^*F` and
condition (2') at the points generalizing those, intrinsically upstairs; and it has depth at
least two at the points of `f^{-1}(Z)` lying over a point of `Z` generalizing no reached point.

The last clause is not condition (3) for `f^*F`: that would ask depth two at every point of
`f^{-1}(Z)` generalizing no point reached upstairs, and it fails already for the open immersion
`D(w) ⊆ Spec k[u, v, w]` of the counterexample:
`Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.correctedImprovement_pullback_not_intrinsic`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.isNestedImprovement_pullback` for the nested pair
`NotGeneralizingReached Z F ⊆ Z`, with the points reached upstairs placed over points of `Z`
generalizing a reached point by
`AlgebraicGeometry.notMem_notGeneralizingReached_of_reachedFromOutside_pullback`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem correctedImprovement_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : IsCorrectedImprovement Z φ) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hfib : ∀ x : X, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber x)) (hcm : f.IsCohenMacaulay hfib) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).IsCoherent ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∉ f.base ⁻¹' Z →
        IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} y).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ).mapPresheaf)) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∈ f.base ⁻¹' Z →
        ReachedFromOutside (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) y →
        Epi ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} y).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ).mapPresheaf) ∧
          (letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
              (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) :=
            PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
              (R := Y.presheaf) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val y
          Module.depth (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) = (1 : ℕ∞))) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∈ f.base ⁻¹' Z →
        ¬ ReachedFromOutside (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) y →
        GeneralizesReached (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) y →
        Epi ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} y).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ).mapPresheaf) ∧
          (letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
              (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) :=
            PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
              (R := Y.presheaf) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val y
          (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y))) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∈ f.base ⁻¹' Z → ¬ GeneralizesReached Z F (f.base y) →
        letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) :=
          PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
            (R := Y.presheaf) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val y
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y))
declarations.comment: corrected form (conditions corrected so that existence holds; the source's existence clause is false, Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf): the pullback of the corrected map along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism with Noetherian source satisfies (1), (2) and the corrected surjectivity-and-depth-one condition along f^{-1}(Z), and the depth-two condition on the inverse image of the points of Z generalizing no point as in (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_isCorrectedImprovement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX5, corrected form: the conditions corrected so that existence
holds.**  The existence clause of the source is false
(`Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf`).  Let `X` be a Noetherian,
universally catenary scheme whose local rings have `(S₁)` formal fibres, `Z ⊆ X` closed and `F`
coherent.  Then there is a map `F ⟶ G` satisfying the corrected conditions
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsCorrectedImprovement` along `Z` — the source's (1), (2) and (3), except that
at the points of `Z` which generalize a point as in (2) without being one, (3) is replaced by
surjectivity on stalks and depth at least one — and any two such maps are isomorphic by a unique
isomorphism under `F`.

This is the theorem the source's construction proves once its closed subset is chosen as the
closure of the bad locus.  Its pullback along a Cohen–Macaulay morphism is
`AlgebraicGeometry.correctedImprovement_pullback`; the source's own conditions, whose existence is
characterized by `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isImprovement_iff_two_le_depth_depthOneQuotient`, are
the primary corrected form, for the reason given in the module docstring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_isCorrectedImprovement (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : IsClosed Z) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (hX : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary X)
    (hFibres : ∀ z : X, ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk z),
        HasSerreCondition
          (X.completedLocalRing z ⊗[X.presheaf.stalk z] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :
    ∃ (G : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ G), IsCorrectedImprovement Z φ ∧
      ∀ (H : X.Modules) (ψ : F ⟶ H), IsCorrectedImprovement Z ψ →
        ∃! e : G ≅ H, φ ≫ e.hom = ψ
declarations.comment: corrected form (conditions corrected so that existence holds): the source's existence clause is false, refuted by Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf; with condition (3) at the points of Z which generalize a point as in (2) without being one replaced by surjectivity on stalks and depth at least one, a map F -> F'' exists and is unique up to a unique isomorphism under F, at exactly the source's hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isImprovement_iff_two_le_depth_depthOneQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX5, corrected form of the existence clause.**  The existence clause
of the source is false: `Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf` of
`ImprovementExistenceCounterexample.lean` refutes it for `X = Spec k[u, v, w]`, `Z = V(u, v)`,
`F = (u, v)~ ⊕ (k[u, v, w]/(u, w))~`, with every hypothesis of the source witnessed.

Let `X` be a Noetherian, universally catenary scheme whose local rings have `(S₁)` formal fibres,
`Z ⊆ X` closed and `F` coherent, and let `F'` be the depth-one quotient of `F` along `Z`
([Stacks, Tag 0DX3]).  Then a map `F ⟶ F''` of coherent modules satisfying conditions (1), (2)
and (3) of the source exists **if and only if** `depth(F'_x) ≥ 2` at every point `x ∈ Z` which
generalizes a point as in (2) without being one.  In the counterexample this fails at `(u, v)`.

The other assertions of the source hold as stated: uniqueness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.improvement_unique` and the Cohen–Macaulay pullback is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isImprovement_pullback`, so this is [Stacks, Tag 0DX5] with only its existence
assertion corrected.  The criterion is equivalent to the disjointness criterion of
`AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_improvement_of_disjoint_closure_lowDepthNotReached`, and is stated
pointwise.

For the forward direction an improvement satisfies the corrected conditions
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isCorrectedImprovement_of_isImprovement`), so it is isomorphic to the map of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isCorrectedImprovement_and_depth_eq`, whose target has the depth of `F'`
at the points in question, and condition (3) bounds that depth below by two.  Conversely, under
the criterion that map satisfies condition (3) there as well.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isImprovement_iff_two_le_depth_depthOneQuotient (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian X]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : IsClosed Z) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (hX : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary X)
    (hFibres : ∀ z : X, ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk z),
        HasSerreCondition
          (X.completedLocalRing z ⊗[X.presheaf.stalk z] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :
    (∃ (G : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ G), IsImprovement Z φ) ↔
      ∀ x : X, x ∈ Z → ¬ ReachedFromOutside Z F x → GeneralizesReached Z F x →
        letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
              (depthOneQuotient X Z hZ.stableUnderSpecialization F).val.presheaf x) :=
          PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
            (R := X.presheaf) (depthOneQuotient X Z hZ.stableUnderSpecialization F).val x
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            (depthOneQuotient X Z hZ.stableUnderSpecialization F).val.presheaf x)
declarations.comment: corrected form of the existence clause, which is false as stated (refuted by Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf): at exactly the source's hypotheses, a map F -> F'' satisfying (1), (2) and (3) exists if and only if the depth-one quotient F' of Tag 0DX3 has depth at least two at every point of Z which generalizes a point as in (2) without being one; uniqueness and the Cohen-Macaulay pullback hold as stated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isImprovement_iff_and_unique_and_isImprovement_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX5, the whole lemma in corrected form.**  Let `X` be a Noetherian,
universally catenary scheme whose local rings have `(S₁)` formal fibres, `Z ⊆ X` closed and `F` a
coherent `𝒪_X`-module, and let `F'` be the depth-one quotient of `F` along `Z`
([Stacks, Tag 0DX3]).  For maps `F ⟶ F''` satisfying conditions (1), (2) and (3) of the source
(`AlgebraicGeometry.IsImprovement`, which includes coherence of `F''`):

* **existence**, corrected: such a map exists if and only if `depth(F'_x) ≥ 2` at every point
  `x ∈ Z` which generalizes a point as in (2) without being one.  The source asserts existence
  unconditionally, which is false:
  `Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf` refutes it at the source's
  hypotheses, and the criterion fails there at `(u, v)`;
* **uniqueness**, as printed: any two such maps are isomorphic by a unique isomorphism under `F`;
* **the pullback**, as printed: for a Cohen–Macaulay morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` with `Y` Noetherian,
  `f^*F ⟶ f^*F''` satisfies (1), (2) and (3) with respect to `f^{-1}(Z) ⊆ Y`.

The three parts are `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isImprovement_iff_two_le_depth_depthOneQuotient`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.improvement_unique` and `AlgebraicGeometry.isImprovement_pullback`.  The
correction is the one recorded for 0DX5 in `errata.md`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isImprovement_iff_and_unique_and_isImprovement_pullback (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian X] (Z : Set X) (hZ : IsClosed Z) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (hX : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary X)
    (hFibres : ∀ z : X, ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk z),
        HasSerreCondition
          (X.completedLocalRing z ⊗[X.presheaf.stalk z] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :
    ((∃ (G : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ G), IsImprovement Z φ) ↔
      ∀ x : X, x ∈ Z → ¬ ReachedFromOutside Z F x → GeneralizesReached Z F x →
        letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
              (depthOneQuotient X Z hZ.stableUnderSpecialization F).val.presheaf x) :=
          PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
            (R := X.presheaf) (depthOneQuotient X Z hZ.stableUnderSpecialization F).val x
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            (depthOneQuotient X Z hZ.stableUnderSpecialization F).val.presheaf x)) ∧
    (∀ (G H : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ G) (ψ : F ⟶ H), IsImprovement Z φ → IsImprovement Z ψ →
      ∃! e : G ≅ H, φ ≫ e.hom = ψ) ∧
    (∀ (G : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ G), IsImprovement Z φ →
      ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (hfib : ∀ x : X, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber x)), f.IsCohenMacaulay hfib →
        IsImprovement (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ))
declarations.comment: corrected form of the whole lemma, at exactly the source's hypotheses: the existence clause is false as stated (refuted by Stacks.ImprovementCounterexample.not_exists_isImprovement_cexSheaf) and is corrected to a criterion, a map F -> F'' satisfying (1), (2) and (3) exists if and only if the depth-one quotient F' of Tag 0DX3 has depth at least two at every point of Z which generalizes a point as in (2) without being one; uniqueness up to a unique isomorphism under F, and the assertion that the pullback along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism with Noetherian source satisfies (1), (2) and (3) with respect to the inverse image of Z, as printed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCoherent_pullback_of_isImprovement
declarations.doc:
The target of the pullback of an improvement along a morphism with locally Noetherian
source is again coherent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCoherent_pullback_of_isImprovement {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) (h : IsImprovement Z φ) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: coherence of the target of the pullback, in the assertion about the pullback along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_stalk_pullback_map_of_isImprovement
declarations.doc:
The pullback of an improvement along any morphism of schemes is an isomorphism on stalks at
every point outside the inverse image of the closed subset.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_stalk_pullback_map_of_isImprovement {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) (h : IsImprovement Z φ)
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∉ f.base ⁻¹' Z) :
    IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} y).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ).mapPresheaf)
declarations.comment: the isomorphism away from the inverse image of the closed subscheme, in the assertion about the pullback along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.two_le_depth_stalk_pullback_of_notReachedFromOutside
declarations.doc:
**The depth bound at a point not reached upstairs.** Let `F → F''` be an improvement of a
coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F` along `Z` and let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a Cohen–Macaulay morphism of Noetherian
schemes. At a point `y` of `f^{-1}(Z)` which is not reached from outside `f^{-1}(Z)` for `f^*F`,
the stalk of `f^*F''` has depth at least two.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.depth_stalk_pullback_eq` the depth upstairs is the depth of the stalk of
`F''` at `f y` plus the depth of the fibre of the local ring. If `f y` is not reached from outside
`Z` the first summand is already at least two. If it is reached, the first summand is exactly one,
so it suffices that the fibre have positive depth; a fibre of depth zero would carry the point
reaching `f y` up to a point reaching `y`, which is excluded by hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
public theorem two_le_depth_stalk_pullback_of_notReachedFromOutside {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} [F.IsCoherent] (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : IsImprovement Z φ) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hfib : ∀ x : X, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber x)) (hcm : f.IsCohenMacaulay hfib)
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ f.base ⁻¹' Z)
    (hnr : ¬ ReachedFromOutside (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) y) :
    letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) :=
      PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
        (R := Y.presheaf) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val y
    (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y)
declarations.comment: condition (3) for the pullback along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism: depth at least two at a point of the inverse image of Z which is not itself reached from outside that inverse image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isImprovement_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX5, the assertion about the pullback.** The pullback of an improvement
of a coherent module along a Cohen–Macaulay morphism of Noetherian schemes is an improvement along
the inverse image of the closed subset: it satisfies conditions (1), (2) and (3) with respect to
`f^{-1}(Z) ⊆ Y`.

An improvement along `Z` is an improvement along the nested pair `Z ∖ {reached points} ⊆ Z`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isNestedImprovement_of_isImprovement`), whose pullback is an improvement along
the inverse images of that pair (`AlgebraicGeometry.isNestedImprovement_pullback`). Those inverse
images are the pair belonging to `f^*F` and `f^{-1}(Z)`, because the points of `f^{-1}(Z)` reached
from outside `f^{-1}(Z)` for `f^*F` are exactly the points lying over points of `Z` reached from
outside `Z` for `F`; that is the content of
`AlgebraicGeometry.reachedFromOutside_base_of_reachedFromOutside_pullback` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.two_le_depth_stalk_pullback_of_notReachedFromOutside`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isImprovement_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} [F.IsCoherent] (φ : F ⟶ G) (hφ : IsImprovement Z φ) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hfib : ∀ x : X, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber x)) (hcm : f.IsCohenMacaulay hfib) :
    IsImprovement (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ)
declarations.comment: the final assertion: the pullback of the map along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism with Noetherian source satisfies conditions (1), (2) and (3) with respect to the inverse image of the closed subscheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.epi_stalk_pullback_of_isImprovement
declarations.doc:
The pullback of an improvement along a Cohen–Macaulay morphism of Noetherian schemes is
surjective on the stalk at every point of the inverse image of the closed subset which is reached
from outside that inverse image: the surjectivity half of condition (2) upstairs.
declarations.statement:
public theorem epi_stalk_pullback_of_isImprovement {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} [F.IsCoherent] (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : IsImprovement Z φ) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hfib : ∀ x : X, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber x)) (hcm : f.IsCohenMacaulay hfib)
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ f.base ⁻¹' Z)
    (hr : ReachedFromOutside (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) y) :
    Epi ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} y).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map φ).mapPresheaf)
declarations.comment: the surjectivity in condition (2) for the pullback along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.depth_stalk_pullback_eq_one_of_isImprovement
declarations.doc:
The target of the pullback of an improvement along a Cohen–Macaulay morphism of Noetherian
schemes has stalk of depth exactly one at every point of the inverse image of the closed subset
which is reached from outside that inverse image: the depth half of condition (2) upstairs.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depth_stalk_pullback_eq_one_of_isImprovement {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] {Z : Set X} {F G : X.Modules} [F.IsCoherent] (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : IsImprovement Z φ) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hfib : ∀ x : X, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber x)) (hcm : f.IsCohenMacaulay hfib)
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ f.base ⁻¹' Z)
    (hr : ReachedFromOutside (f.base ⁻¹' Z) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) y) :
    letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) :=
      PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
        (R := Y.presheaf) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val y
    Module.depth (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y))
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G).val.presheaf y) = (1 : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: the depth equality in condition (2) for the pullback along a Cohen-Macaulay morphism: the depth is exactly one, not merely at least one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.improvement_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX5, uniqueness.** Two improvements of a coherent module along the same
closed subset are isomorphic by a unique isomorphism compatible with the two maps.

Each is an improvement along the nested pair `NotReachedFromOutside Z F ⊆ Z`, a subset determined
by `Z` and `F` alone, so the comparison is the one of [Stacks, Tag 0EI4]. Neither the universal
catenarity of `X` nor the `(S₁)` condition on the formal fibres of its local rings is used: those
hypotheses of the source enter only its existence proof.
declarations.statement:
public theorem improvement_unique (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (Z : Set X) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (F G H : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (φ : F ⟶ G) (ψ : F ⟶ H)
    (hφ : IsImprovement Z φ) (hψ : IsImprovement Z ψ) :
    ∃! e : G ≅ H, φ ≫ e.hom = ψ
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the map F → F'': two maps satisfying conditions (1), (2) and (3) are isomorphic by a unique isomorphism under F

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomology_vanishing_tfae
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DX7].** Let `I` be a finitely generated ideal of a commutative ring `A`, let
`Y = V(I) ⊆ X = Spec A` and let `d ≥ -1` be an integer. The following are equivalent:
`H^i_Y(A) = 0` for `i > d`; `H^i_Y(M) = 0` for `i > d` for every `A`-module `M`; and the
geometric condition that `Y = ∅` if `d = -1`, that `Y` be open and closed in `X` if `d = 0`, and
that `H^n(X \ Y, ℱ) = 0` for `n ≥ d` for every quasi-coherent `𝒪_{X∖Y}`-module `ℱ` if `d > 0`.

The three regimes of the third condition are proved separately:
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomology_vanishing_tfae_of_nonpos` for `-1 ≤ d ≤ 0`, where the
condition is one on `Y` itself, and
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomology_vanishing_tfae_of_one_le` for `d ≥ 1`, where it is the
acyclicity of the complement.
declarations.statement:
theorem localCohomology_vanishing_tfae
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ d) :
    List.TFAE [
      ∀ (i : ℤ), d < i →
        IsZero (localCohomologyModule A I hI (ModuleCat.of A A) i),
      ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (i : ℤ), d < i →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) i).obj
          ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI).ι.obj
            ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A I hI).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) 0).obj M)))),
      ((d = -1 → PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = ∅) ∧
        (d = 0 → IsClopen (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))) ∧
        (0 < d →
          let U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens :=
            ⟨(PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))ᶜ,
              (PrimeSpectrum.isClosed_zeroLocus (I : Set A)).isOpen_compl⟩
          ∀ (F : (U : Scheme).Modules),
            F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ (n : ℕ), d ≤ (n : ℤ) →
              IsZero (Hgroup (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf ⊤ n F)))]

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX8.** The cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal is
the least integer `d ≥ -1` above which its local cohomology vanishes.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologicalDimension
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) : ℤ
declarations.comment: the least integer

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_localCohomologyBound
declarations.doc:
Finite generation gives a finite upper bound on the degrees in which local cohomology is
nonzero; equivalently, the set defining the cohomological dimension is nonempty.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_localCohomologyBound
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, IsLocalCohomologyBound A I hI d
declarations.comment: existence of a vanishing bound

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_le_card_affine_cover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DX9 (3).** The cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal
`I` of `A` is at most the number of members of an affine open cover of `Spec A ∖ V(I)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_le_card_affine_cover
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    {c : ℕ} (V : Fin c → (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    (hcov : ⨆ i, V i = complZeroLocusOpen A I) :
    cohomologicalDimension A I hI ≤ (c : ℤ)
declarations.comment: part (3): the bound by an affine cover of the complement

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_le_card_zeroLocus_generators
declarations.doc:
The cohomological dimension is at most the number of equations in any finite family
defining the same zero locus.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_le_card_zeroLocus_generators
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → A)
    (hf : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ((Ideal.span (Set.range f) : Ideal A) : Set A) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)) :
    cohomologicalDimension A I hI ≤ (n : ℤ)
declarations.comment: part (2): the bound by a family cutting out the same zero locus

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_le_card_generators
declarations.doc:
The cohomological dimension is at most the number of generators in any finite generating
family of the ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_le_card_generators
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → A) (hf : I = Ideal.span (Set.range f)) :
    cohomologicalDimension A I hI ≤ (n : ℤ)
declarations.comment: part (1): the bound by the number of generators

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_map_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXA.** Cohomological dimension does not increase under extension of
the ideal along a ring homomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_map_le
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    cohomologicalDimension B (I.map f) (hI.map f) ≤ cohomologicalDimension A I hI
declarations.comment: inequality under a ring map

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_map_eq_of_faithfullyFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXA.** Faithfully flat extension preserves cohomological
dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_map_eq_of_faithfullyFlat
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.FaithfullyFlat) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    cohomologicalDimension B (I.map f) (hI.map f) = cohomologicalDimension A I hI
declarations.comment: equality under faithfully flat extension

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_eq_sSup_localizations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXB.** The cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal is
the supremum of the cohomological dimensions of its extensions to the local rings of the
spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_eq_sSup_localizations
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    cohomologicalDimension A I hI =
      sSup (insert (-1 : ℤ) (Set.range fun p : PrimeSpectrum A =>
        cohomologicalDimension (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (I.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
          (hI.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_le_of_ringKrullDim_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXC.** The cohomological dimension of a finitely generated ideal of a
commutative ring is at most the Krull dimension of the ring.

By Stacks 0DXB the cohomological dimension is the supremum of the cohomological dimensions of
the localizations `A_𝔭`, each local of dimension `ht 𝔭 ≤ dim A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_le_of_ringKrullDim_le
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ringKrullDim A ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    cohomologicalDimension A I hI ≤ (d : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the bound of the cohomological dimension by the Krull dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isZero_localCohomologyModule_of_supportDim_lt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXC.** For a finite module `M` over a commutative ring `A` and a
finitely generated ideal `I ⊆ A`, the local cohomology `H^i_{V(I)}(M)` vanishes in every degree
`i` above the dimension of the support of `M`.

With `𝔞 = ann(M)` and `B = A/𝔞` one has `Spec B = Supp M`, so `dim B = dim Supp M < i`; the
bound `cd(B, IB) ≤ i - 1` then gives the vanishing through Stacks 0BJB and the implication
(1) ⇒ (2) of Stacks 0DX7. A subsingleton module is treated separately, the dimension of an empty
support being `⊥`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_localCohomologyModule_of_supportDim_lt
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) [Module.Finite A M] (i : ℤ)
    (hi : Module.supportDim A M < (i.toNat : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    IsZero (localCohomologyModule A I hI M i)
declarations.comment: the vanishing above the dimension of the support

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_compl_zeroLocus_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXD.** If a finitely generated ideal has cohomological dimension one,
the complement of its zero locus in the prime spectrum is nonempty.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_compl_zeroLocus_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension A I hI = 1) :
    (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))ᶜ.Nonempty
declarations.comment: nonemptiness

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isAffine_complZeroLocusOpen_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXD.** If a finitely generated ideal has cohomological dimension one,
the complement of its zero locus, as an open subscheme of `Spec A`, is affine.

Serre's criterion for affineness (Stacks 01XF) applies to the complement
`U = complZeroLocusOpen A I`: it is quasi-compact by `compactSpace_complZeroLocusOpen`, and the
`d = 1` instance of Stacks 0DX7
(`isZero_hgroup_complement_of_isZero_localCohomologyModule_self`) turns the vanishing of
`H^i_{V(I)}(A)` for `i > 1`, which is what cohomological dimension one means, into the vanishing
of `H¹(U, F)` for every quasi-coherent `F` on `U`, in particular for every quasi-coherent ideal
sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffine_complZeroLocusOpen_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension A I hI = 1) :
    IsAffine (complZeroLocusOpen A I).toScheme
declarations.comment: affineness

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_and_isAffine_complZeroLocusOpen_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXD.** Let `I` be a finitely generated ideal of a commutative ring
`A`. If the cohomological dimension `cd(A, I)` equals `1`, then `Spec A ∖ V(I)` is a nonempty
affine scheme.

This is the source statement, both of its assertions made about the single open subscheme
`complZeroLocusOpen A I = Spec A ∖ V(I)`: nonemptiness from
`nonempty_compl_zeroLocus_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one` and affineness from
`isAffine_complZeroLocusOpen_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_and_isAffine_complZeroLocusOpen_of_cohomologicalDimension_eq_one
    (hcd : cohomologicalDimension A I hI = 1) :
    Nonempty (complZeroLocusOpen A I).toScheme ∧
      IsAffine (complZeroLocusOpen A I).toScheme

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_maximalIdeal_eq
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring of dimension `d` whose completion carries a normalized
dualizing complex. Then `cd(A, 𝔪) = d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_maximalIdeal_eq
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hm : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hBFR : ∃ ω : DerivedCategory
        (ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)),
      Dualizing.IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω) :
    cohomologicalDimension A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) hm = (d : ℤ)
declarations.comment: cohomological dimension of the maximal ideal; existence of a normalized dualizing complex on the completion, the local case of Stacks 0BFR, is an explicit hypothesis

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.not_isZero_topLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring of dimension `d` whose completion carries a normalized
dualizing complex. Then `H^d_𝔪(A)` is nonzero.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isZero_topLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hm : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hBFR : ∃ ω : DerivedCategory
        (ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)),
      Dualizing.IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω) :
    ¬ IsZero (localCohomologyModule A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) hm
      (ModuleCat.of A A) (d : ℤ))
declarations.comment: nonvanishing of top local cohomology; existence of a normalized dualizing complex on the completion, the local case of Stacks 0BFR, is an explicit hypothesis

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension_maximalIdeal_eq'
declarations.doc: Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring of dimension `d`. Then `cd(A, 𝔪) = d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologicalDimension_maximalIdeal_eq'
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hm : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    cohomologicalDimension A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) hm = (d : ℤ)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.not_isZero_topLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal'
declarations.doc: Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring of dimension `d`. Then `H^d_𝔪(A)` is nonzero.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isZero_topLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal'
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hm : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ¬ IsZero (localCohomologyModule A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) hm
      (ModuleCat.of A A) (d : ℤ))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_cohomologicalDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXF.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring, `I ⊆ A` a finitely
generated ideal and `𝔭 ⊆ A` a prime ideal with `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}`. Then
`dim(A/𝔭) ≤ cd(A, I)`.

The extension of `I` to `A/𝔭` has the same zero locus as `𝔪/𝔭`, so its cohomological dimension
is `dim(A/𝔭)` by Stacks 0DXE, and extending an ideal along a ring map cannot raise the
cohomological dimension by Stacks 0DXA.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_cohomologicalDimension
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (hinter : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
      {IsLocalRing.closedPoint A})
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hBFR : ∃ ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A ⧸ p)) (A ⧸ p))),
      Dualizing.IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω) :
    (d : ℤ) ≤ cohomologicalDimension A I hI
declarations.comment: existence of a normalized dualizing complex on the completion of A/𝔭, the local case of Stacks 0BFR, is an explicit hypothesis

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_cohomologicalDimension'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXF.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring, `I ⊆ A` a finitely
generated ideal and `𝔭 ⊆ A` a prime ideal with `V(𝔭) ∩ V(I) = {𝔪}`. Then
`dim(A/𝔭) ≤ cd(A, I)`.

This is `Stacks.LocalCohomology.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_cohomologicalDimension` with its
hypothesis on the completion of `A/𝔭` discharged by
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.exists_isNormalizedDualizingComplex_adicCompletion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_cohomologicalDimension'
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (hinter : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (p : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
      {IsLocalRing.closedPoint A})
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    (d : ℤ) ≤ cohomologicalDimension A I hI

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.InverseSystems.isMittagLefflerCategorical_of_finite_cohomology_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DXG.** Let `A` be a ring, `f ∈ A`, `X` a topological space and `… → ℱ₂ → ℱ₁` an
inverse system of sheaves of `A`-modules satisfying condition (1) of Stacks 0H39. If for some
`m` the image of `H^{p+1}(X, ℱ_m) → H^{p+1}(X, ℱ₁)` has finite length over `A`, or `A` is
Noetherian and the intersection of all those images is a finite `A`-module, then the inverse
system `n ↦ H^p(X, ℱ_n)` satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMittagLefflerCategorical_of_finite_cohomology_image
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    [∀ U, IsMulCommutative (R.obj.obj U)]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [Algebra A (R.obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X)))] (f : A)
    (obj : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (map : ∀ n, obj (n + 1) ⟶ obj n) (p : ℕ) :
    let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op (⊤ : Opens X))
    let G := E.rightDerived (p + 1)
    letI : Module A (G.obj (obj 0)) :=
      Module.compHom (G.obj (obj 0)) (algebraMap A (R.obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))))
    letI : IsScalarTower A (R.obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) (G.obj (obj 0)) :=
      ⟨fun a b x => by
        rw [Algebra.smul_def]
        change (algebraMap A (R.obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) a * b) • x =
          (algebraMap A (R.obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) a) • (b • x)
        exact mul_smul _ _ _⟩
    ((∃ n : ℕ, IsFiniteLength A
        (↥((LinearMap.range (G.map (Stacks.Cohomology.InverseSystems.TorsionFreeDivisible.proj obj
          map n)).hom).restrictScalars A))) ∨
      (IsNoetherianRing A ∧ Module.Finite A
        (↥(⨅ n : ℕ,
          (LinearMap.range (G.map (Stacks.Cohomology.InverseSystems.TorsionFreeDivisible.proj obj
            map n)).hom).restrictScalars A)))) →
      Stacks.Cohomology.InverseSystems.TorsionFreeDivisible.Condition1
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.terminalSectionToEnd R (⊤ : Opens X) isTerminalTop
          (algebraMap A (R.obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))) f)) obj map →
      IsMittagLefflerCategorical
        (Functor.ofOpSequence map ⋙ E.rightDerived p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_toLimit_homology_derivedCompletion_puncturedSpectrumSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXI.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring, let
`U = Spec A ∖ {𝔪}` be its punctured spectrum, let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module and let
`I ⊆ A` be an ideal, presented by a finite generating family `a_1, …, a_r`. Then for every `i`
the comparison map

`Hⁱ(RΓ(U, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ lim_n Hⁱ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`

is an isomorphism, where `RΓ(U, ℱ)^∧` is the derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ(U, ℱ)` in `D(A)`
and `ℱ/Iⁿℱ` is the adic quotient tower at the sheaf of ideals `I𝒪_U`.

The comparison map is the one determined by the Milnor triangle: it is characterized by its
composites with the limit projections through a morphism
`α : RΓ(U, ℱ)^∧ ⟶ ∏ₙ RΓ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)` which is required to exhibit `RΓ(U, ℱ)^∧` as a derived limit
of `n ↦ RΓ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`, so the conclusion is about the comparison map and not about some map.

Nothing is assumed: the derived limit of the tower, the identification of its derived sections
with `RΓ(U, ℱ)^∧` and the Mittag-Leffler condition that makes the comparison invertible are all
produced — by [Stacks, Tag 0A0K] parts (3) and (4), by [Stacks, Tag 0BLX], and by
[Stacks, Tag 0DX1] part (2) together with its degree-zero and negative-degree companions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_toLimit_homology_derivedCompletion_puncturedSpectrumSections
    (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = I) (i : ℤ) :
    let S := puncturedSpectrumAdicQuotientSystem A a F
    let Hi := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i
    let C := (DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A a).obj
      ((puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections A).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A))) 0).obj F))
    let RΓS : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      S ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A))) 0 ⋙
        puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections A
    let Y : ℕ → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) := fun n ↦ RΓS.obj (op n)
    let d : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π Y n - Pi.π Y (n + 1) ≫ RΓS.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    ∃ (α : C ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y) (β : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ C⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk α d β ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) ∧
      ∃ q : Hi.obj C ⟶ limit (puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem A S i),
        (∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π (puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem A S i) (op n) =
          Hi.map α ≫ Hi.map (Pi.π Y n)) ∧ IsIso q
declarations.comment: the whole lemma: for `(A, 𝔪)` Noetherian local with punctured spectrum `U`, a coherent `𝒪_U`-module `ℱ` and an ideal `I ⊆ A`, the comparison map `Hⁱ(RΓ(U,ℱ)^∧) ⟶ lim_n Hⁱ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)` is an isomorphism in every degree `i`, the left-hand side being the derived `I`-adic completion in `D(A)` of the derived sections `RΓ(U,ℱ)` and the tower on the right being the adic quotient tower at `I𝒪_U`. The map shown invertible is the comparison map, characterized by the limit projections through an `α` required to exhibit `RΓ(U,ℱ)^∧` as a derived limit of `n ↦ RΓ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`, sitting in the distinguished Milnor triangle with `1 - shift`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_homologyIso_limit_derivedCompletion_puncturedSpectrumSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXI, read as an isomorphism of `A`-modules.** In the situation of
`Stacks.Algebraization.isIso_toLimit_homology_derivedCompletion_puncturedSpectrumSections`, the
degree-`i` cohomology of the derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ(U, ℱ)` is isomorphic to the
inverse limit of the `A`-modules `Hⁱ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`.

The isomorphism keeps the characterization by the limit projections and `α` is still required to
be a derived-limit structure map of `n ↦ RΓ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`, so what is asserted is that the
comparison map is invertible and not merely that the two modules are abstractly isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_homologyIso_limit_derivedCompletion_puncturedSpectrumSections
    (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = I) (i : ℤ) :
    let S := puncturedSpectrumAdicQuotientSystem A a F
    let Hi := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i
    let C := (DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A a).obj
      ((puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections A).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A))) 0).obj F))
    let RΓS : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      S ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (puncturedSpectrumRingedSpace A))) 0 ⋙
        puncturedSpectrumDerivedSections A
    let Y : ℕ → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) := fun n ↦ RΓS.obj (op n)
    let d : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π Y n - Pi.π Y (n + 1) ≫ RΓS.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    ∃ (α : C ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y) (β : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ C⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk α d β ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) ∧
      ∃ eq : Hi.obj C ≅ limit (puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem A S i),
        ∀ n : ℕ, eq.hom ≫ limit.π (puncturedSpectrumCohomologySystem A S i) (op n) =
          Hi.map α ≫ Hi.map (Pi.π Y n)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma read as an isomorphism of `A`-modules: `Hⁱ(RΓ(U,ℱ)^∧) ≅ lim_n Hⁱ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)` in every degree `i`, for `(A, 𝔪)` Noetherian local with punctured spectrum `U`, a coherent `𝒪_U`-module `ℱ` and an ideal `I ⊆ A`. The isomorphism is the comparison map, characterized by the limit projections through an `α` required to exhibit `RΓ(U,ℱ)^∧` as a derived limit of `n ↦ RΓ(U, ℱ/Iⁿℱ)`

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isIso_completedLocalCohomologyToLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXJ.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring, let `I ⊆ A` be an
ideal and let `M` be a finite `A`-module. For every `i`, the comparison map from the degree-`i`
cohomology of a derived limit of the tower `n ↦ RΓ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` to the inverse limit of the local
cohomology modules `Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` is an isomorphism: the `R¹lim` term of the Milnor short exact
sequence vanishes because the system `n ↦ H^{i-1}_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` is Mittag-Leffler.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_completedLocalCohomologyToLimit
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    [Module.Finite A M] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hK : IsDerivedLimit (Dualizing.adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M) K)
    (i : ℤ) :
    IsIso (Dualizing.completedLocalCohomologyToLimit A I (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M K hK i)
declarations.comment: for a derived limit of the tower of local cohomologies of the adic quotients

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isIso_completedLocalCohomologyToLimit_derivedCompletion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXJ, for the derived `I`-adic completion.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a
Noetherian local ring, let `I ⊆ A` be an ideal and let `M` be a finite `A`-module. For every
`i` the comparison map `Hⁱ(RΓ_𝔪(M)^∧) ⟶ lim Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` is an isomorphism.

Tag 0EEW part (1), `Dualizing.isDerivedLimit_completedLocalCohomology`, identifies the derived
`I`-adic completion of `RΓ_𝔪(M)` with a derived limit of the tower `n ↦ RΓ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)`; feeding
that identification into `isIso_completedLocalCohomologyToLimit` transports the conclusion from
an abstract derived limit to the completion itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_completedLocalCohomologyToLimit_derivedCompletion
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    [Module.Finite A M] (i : ℤ) :
    IsIso (Dualizing.completedLocalCohomologyToLimit A I (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M
      (Dualizing.completedLocalCohomology A I (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
        I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M)
      (Dualizing.isDerivedLimit_completedLocalCohomology A I (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
        I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M) i)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.completedLocalCohomologyDerivedCompletionIsoLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DXJ.** For a finite module `M` over a Noetherian local ring
`(A, 𝔪)` and an ideal `I ⊆ A`, the degree-`i` cohomology of the derived `I`-adic completion
`RΓ_𝔪(M)^∧` is isomorphic to the inverse limit of the local cohomology modules
`Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)`, for every `i`. This is the equality `Hⁱ(RΓ_𝔪(M)^∧) = lim Hⁱ_𝔪(M/IⁿM)` of the
tag, realized by the comparison map
`Dualizing.completedLocalCohomologyToLimit`.
declarations.statement:
def completedLocalCohomologyDerivedCompletionIsoLimit [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] (i : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
        (Dualizing.completedLocalCohomology A I (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
          I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M) ≅
      limit (Dualizing.adicQuotientLocalCohomologySystem A I (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing M ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i)

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_homology_derivedCompletion_localCohomology_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring with a dualizing complex, let `I` be an ideal with
`cd(A, I) ≤ d`, let `M` be a finite `A`-module and let `p` be a prime with
`depth_{A_p}(M_p) + dim(A/p) > d + s`. Then some `f ∈ A` outside `p` annihilates the degree-`i`
cohomology of the derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ_{V(𝔪)}(M)` for every `i ≤ s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_notMem_mem_annihilator_homology_derivedCompletion_localCohomology_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (s d : ℤ)
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (homega : Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex (A := A) (K := omega))
    (hcd : Stacks.LocalCohomology.cohomologicalDimension A I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing ≤ d)
    (hdepth : enatToEInt
          (Module.depth (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
            (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)) +
        krullDimToEInt (ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p.asIdeal)) > ((d + s : ℤ) : EInt))
    {r : ℕ} (gen : Fin r → A) (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range gen) = I) :
    ∃ f : A, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ s →
      f ∈ Module.annihilator A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
          ((DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A gen).obj
            ((Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (maximalIdeal A)
                (maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).ι.obj
              ((Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor.{u, u} A (maximalIdeal A)
                  (maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A M))))))
declarations.comment: the full statement: an element outside `p` annihilating the cohomology of the derived `I`-adic completion of `RΓ_{V(𝔪)}(M)` in every degree `≤ s`

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.localStabilizationHypotheses_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DXM.** Hypotheses (1)–(4) of the lemma are exactly the properness of `I` together
with the hypotheses of Stacks 0EFI for `J = 𝔪`.

This biconditional is the content of the source's proof, which reads "this is a special case of
Lemma 0EFI": at `J = 𝔪` the set `V(𝔭) ∩ V(𝔪) ∩ V(I)` of Stacks 0EFI is the single point `𝔪`,
