`B → Bʰ` on the groups `Ext¹_B(NL_{B/k}, B)` and `Ext¹_{Bʰ}(NL_{Bʰ/k}, Bʰ ⊗_B B)` that
classify them.

By Stacks 0DY3 those two groups are the tangent spaces of the deformation categories `Def_B`
and `Def_{Bʰ}`.  The tangent-space conclusion of Stacks 0DZD itself is registered on
`Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_henselizationFunctorData`, for the map the functor
of Stacks 0DYT induces; see the section note above for why the attribute is not here.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_squareZeroAlgebraExtensionClassesHenselizationTangentEquiv
    (J : Ideal B)
    (hsmooth : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, ¬ Algebra.IsSmoothAt k q.asIdeal → J ≤ q.asIdeal)
    (Bh : Type uB) [CommRing Bh] [Algebra B Bh] [Algebra k Bh] [IsScalarTower k B Bh]
    (hhens : HenselianPair Bh (J.map (algebraMap B Bh)))
    (huniv : ∀ (C : Type uB) (_ : CommRing C) (JC : Ideal C), HenselianPair C JC →
      ∀ f : B →+* C, J ≤ JC.comap f →
        ∃! g : Bh →+* C, g.comp (algebraMap B Bh) = f ∧
          J.map (algebraMap B Bh) ≤ JC.comap g) :
    ∃ e : SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.IsomorphismClasses.{uk, uk, uB, uB,
          uB} (algebraExtensionProblem k B B) ≃
        SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension.IsomorphismClasses.{uk, uk, uB, uB,
          uB} (algebraExtensionProblem k Bh (Bh ⊗[B] B)),
      ∀ x, extOneCokernelHenselizationFlatBaseChangeEquiv.{uk, uB, uB} k B B Bh J hhens huniv
              (extCokernelIso k Bh (Bh ⊗[B] B)
                (squareZeroAlgebraExtensionClassesEquivExtOne k Bh (Bh ⊗[B] B) (e x)))
            = extCokernelIso k B B (squareZeroAlgebraExtensionClassesEquivExtOne k B B x)
                ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : Bh)
declarations.comment: ONLY the second conclusion, that the functor of Stacks 0DYT induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces -- and that in the form the source's own proof produces it, as the case `N = B` of Stacks 0DZC: the tangent spaces are the groups `Ext¹_B(NL_{B/k}, B)` and `Ext¹_{Bʰ}(NL_{Bʰ/k}, Bʰ ⊗_B B)` of Stacks 0DY3, which classify isomorphism classes of square-zero extensions by Stacks 0GPT, and it is those classes the bijection is between. That the bijection is the map INDUCED by the functor of Stacks 0DYT is not established: no naturality comparing `Deformation.Examples.henselizationFunctor` with the classification of Stacks 0GPT is formalized. No hypothesis the source does not have is carried: Stacks 0DZC is proved outright, base-change input and all -- Stacks 0D08, Stacks 0GPY and flat base change of the conormal cokernel for the comparison of the two Ext groups, and Stacks 00S1 for the J-power torsion of `Ext¹_B(NL_{B/k}, N)`. The FIRST conclusion, that the functor is smooth, is NOT proved at all: it rests on Stacks 0DZ2 through Stacks 0DZB, and the nilpotent devissage needed for 0DZ2 is refuted under 0DZ2's own hypotheses -- it would need `Ext¹` to be power torsion, whereas local liftability kills only the `Ext²` obstruction. See the implementation notes.

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.bijective_adicCompletionMap_henselizedLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF.** The completion of the local ring `P_𝔪` is the completion of its
henselization `P^h_𝔪`: the canonical map induced by `P_𝔪 → P^h_𝔪` on adic completions is
bijective.

This is the identification of the final term `∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` of the chain of Stacks 0DZF,
whose functor out of `∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}}` is completion of the henselization; the source records
it as the parenthetical remark that "the completion of the henselization is the completion".
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_adicCompletionMap_henselizedLocalRing
    {P : Type w} [CommRing P] (q : PrimeSpectrum P) :
    Function.Bijective
      (adicCompletionMap (algebraMap (localRingAt q) (henselizedLocalRingAt q))
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt q)) (henselizedMaximalIdealAt q) le_rfl)
declarations.comment: the identification of the last term of the chain: the completion of the henselization of the local ring is the completion of the local ring, which the source records as the parenthetical `the completion of the henselization is the completion`. Stated with no hypothesis at all beyond a commutative ring and a prime of it, so in particular without the tag's finite type and smooth-away-from-the-maximal-ideals hypotheses, which this step of the proof does not use

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.bijective_adicCompletion_iInf_to_pi_completedLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF.** The completion of `P` along `J = 𝔪 1 ∩ … ∩ 𝔪 n` is the product of the
completions of the local rings `P_{𝔪 i}`. This is the step the source states as "`P^∧` is
`∏ P^∧_{𝔪 i}`", and it is what carries the completion leg of the chain from the finite type
algebra `P` to the family of its local rings.

The map is the product of the canonical maps `P^∧_J → (P_{𝔪 i})^∧`; the proof is the Chinese
remainder theorem on the levels `P / Jⁿ ≅ ∏ P / 𝔪 iⁿ`, by
`Stacks.AdicCompletion.bijective_adicCompletion_iInf_to_pi`, followed by the identification of
each `𝔪 i`-adic completion of `P` with the completion of `P_{𝔪 i}`, by
`Stacks.AdicCompletion.bijective_adicCompletionMap_localization_atPrime`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_adicCompletion_iInf_to_pi_completedLocalRing
    {P : Type w} [CommRing P] {ι : Type uι} [Finite ι] (m : ι → PrimeSpectrum P)
    (hmax : ∀ i, (m i).asIdeal.IsMaximal) (hinj : Function.Injective m) :
    Function.Bijective (RingHom.pi fun i =>
      adicCompletionMap (algebraMap P (localRingAt (m i))) (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))
        ((Ideal.map_mono (iInf_le (fun j => (m j).asIdeal) i)).trans_eq
          (IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal (m i).asIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))))
declarations.comment: the decomposition of the completion used by the proof: the completion of `P` along the intersection of the maximal ideals `𝔪 1, ..., 𝔪 n` is the product of the completions of the local rings `P_{𝔪 i}`, which the source states as `P^ = ∏ P_{𝔪 i}^`. Under the tag's own hypotheses on the family: the `𝔪 i` are maximal and distinct. Finite type of `P` and smoothness away from the `𝔪 i` are not used by this step and are not assumed

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.exists_ringEquiv_henselization_iInf_pi_henselizedLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF.** The henselization of the pair `(P, J)` for `J = 𝔪 1 ∩ … ∩ 𝔪 n` is the
product of the henselizations `P^h_{𝔪 i}` of the local rings. This is the step the source
states as "`P^h = ∏ P^h_{𝔪 i}`", proved there by looking at idempotents together with More on
Algebra, Lemma 15.11.6; it is what carries the henselization leg of the chain from the finite
type algebra `P` to the family of its local rings.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_ringEquiv_henselization_iInf_pi_henselizedLocalRing
    {P : Type w} [CommRing P] {ι : Type uι} [Finite ι] (m : ι → PrimeSpectrum P)
    (hmax : ∀ i, (m i).asIdeal.IsMaximal) (hinj : Function.Injective m) :
    ∃ e : (henselization P (⨅ i, (m i).asIdeal) : Type w) ≃+*
        (∀ i, henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)),
      ∀ (r : P) (i : ι),
        e (algebraMap P (henselization P (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal) : Type w) r) i =
          algebraMap (localRingAt (m i)) (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))
            (algebraMap P (localRingAt (m i)) r)
declarations.comment: the decomposition of the henselization used by the proof: the henselization of the pair `(P, J)` for `J` the intersection of the maximal ideals `𝔪 1, ..., 𝔪 n` is the product of the henselizations `P^h_{𝔪 i}` of the local rings, which the source states as `P^h = ∏ P^h_{𝔪 i}`. Under the tag's own hypotheses on the family: the `𝔪 i` are maximal and distinct. Finite type of `P` and smoothness away from the `𝔪 i` are not used by this step and are not assumed

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_piCompletedLocalRingFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, smoothness of the composite of the chain.** The map
`𝓓_P → ∏ 𝓓_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` is smooth.

This is the source's second step, in its own order: **Stacks 0DZ5** applied to `P` itself with
`J = 𝔪 1 ∩ … ∩ 𝔪 n` — for which `P` really is of finite type over `k` — gives smoothness of
`𝓓_P → 𝓓_{P^∧_J}`, and the transport of
`Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_ringDeformationTransport` along
`Deformation.Examples.adicCompletionIInfPiEquiv` carries it to the decomposed target.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_piCompletedLocalRingFunctor [Algebra.FiniteType k P]
    (hsm : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P, ¬ (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal) ≤ q.asIdeal →
      Algebra.IsSmoothAt k q.asIdeal) :
    IsSmooth (piCompletedLocalRingFunctor (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m hmax hinj)
declarations.comment: the smoothness half of the source's second step: the composite `Def_P -> ∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` of all three maps of the chain is smooth, which the source obtains from Stacks 0DZ5 at `P` with `J = 𝔪 1 ∩ ... ∩ 𝔪 n` followed by the decomposition `P^∧ = ∏ P^∧_{𝔪 i}`. The product of deformation categories is read here as the deformation category of the product ring `∏ P^∧_{𝔪 i}`; the identification of that with the product of the deformation categories of the factors is `Deformation.Examples.piDeformationFunctor_full` and `Deformation.Examples.piDeformationFunctor_faithful`, and the clause of the tag for the third map of the chain itself is `Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_completedLocalRingFunctors`. Hypotheses: the tag's own, namely `P` of finite type over `k`, the `𝔪 i` maximal and distinct, and `hsm`, smoothness away from `V(J)` -- which the tag's `smooth except at 𝔪 1, ..., 𝔪 n` supplies, since every prime not containing `J` is none of the `𝔪 i`

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_piCompletedLocalRingFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, the tangent-space conclusion for the composite of the chain.** The map
`𝓓_P → ∏ 𝓓_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces.

Same route as `Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_piCompletedLocalRingFunctor`: the tangent-space
half of **Stacks 0DZ5** at `(P, J)`, carried along the decomposition by
`Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_ringDeformationTransport`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_differential_piCompletedLocalRingFunctor [Algebra.FiniteType k P]
    (hsm : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P, ¬ (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal) ≤ q.asIdeal →
      Algebra.IsSmoothAt k q.asIdeal) :
    Function.Bijective (differential
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_ringDeformationProjection (Λ := Λ) (k := k) (P := P))
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_ringDeformationProjection (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
        (P := ∀ i, AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))
          (localRingAt (m i))))
      (piCompletedLocalRingFunctor (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m hmax hinj))
declarations.comment: the tangent-space half of the source's second step: the composite `Def_P -> ∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` of all three maps of the chain induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces, which the source obtains from Stacks 0DZ5 at `P` with `J = 𝔪 1 ∩ ... ∩ 𝔪 n` followed by the decomposition `P^∧ = ∏ P^∧_{𝔪 i}`. As for smoothness, the product of deformation categories is read as the deformation category of the product ring, the identification of the two being `Deformation.Examples.piDeformationFunctor_full` and `Deformation.Examples.piDeformationFunctor_faithful`; the clause of the tag for the third map of the chain itself is `Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_completedLocalRingFunctors`. Hypotheses: the tag's own

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_localizationFunctors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, clause 2.** The first map `Def_P → ∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}}` of the chain induces an
isomorphism on tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_differential_localizationFunctors [Algebra.FiniteType k P] :
    Function.Bijective (differential
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_ringDeformationProjection (Λ := Λ) (k := k) (P := P))
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i => localRingAt (m i))
      (localizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m))
declarations.comment: clause 2 of seven: the first map of the chain, `Def_P -> ∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}}`, induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others: `P` of finite type over `k`, the `𝔪 i` maximal and pairwise distinct, and every prime at which `P` is not smooth one of the `𝔪 i`. The product of deformation categories is the product over `𝒞_Λ`, which is the reading the proof of Stacks 0DZN records. The index type is required to live in the universe of `P`; any finite family can be reindexed into it

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_localizationFunctors
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0DZF, clause 1.** The first map `Def_P → ∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}}` of the chain is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_localizationFunctors [Algebra.FiniteType k P] :
    IsSmooth (localizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m)
declarations.comment: clause 1 of seven: the first map of the chain, `Def_P -> ∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}}`, is smooth. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others. Obtained from the criterion of Stacks 0DYP: its differential is surjective by clause 2, and a deformation of `P` lifts along a small extension whenever its image under the composite of the first two maps does, which is smoothness of that composite

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_henselizationFunctors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, clause 3.** The second map `∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}} → ∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}}` of the chain
is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_henselizationFunctors [Algebra.FiniteType k P] :
    IsSmooth (henselizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m)
declarations.comment: clause 3 of seven: the second map of the chain, `∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}} -> ∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}}`, is smooth. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others. Obtained by cancelling the first map out of the composite of the first two: the first map is smooth by clause 1, hence essentially surjective

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_henselizationFunctors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, clause 4.** The second map `∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}} → ∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}}` of the chain
induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_differential_henselizationFunctors [Algebra.FiniteType k P] :
    Function.Bijective (differential
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i => localRingAt (m i))
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
        fun i => henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))
      (henselizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m))
declarations.comment: clause 4 of seven: the second map of the chain, `∏ Def_{P_{𝔪 i}} -> ∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}}`, induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others. Obtained by cancelling the first map, which is bijective on tangent spaces by clause 2, out of the composite of the first two

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_completedLocalRingFunctors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, clause 5.** The third map `∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}} → ∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` of the
chain is smooth. The target is the tag's own: the deformation categories of the completions of
the *local rings*, which the completions of the henselizations are by
`Deformation.Examples.bijective_adicCompletionMap_henselizedLocalRing`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_completedLocalRingFunctors [Algebra.FiniteType k P] :
    IsSmooth (completedLocalRingFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m)
declarations.comment: clause 5 of seven: the third map of the chain, `∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}} -> ∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}`, is smooth, with the target the tag's own -- the completions of the local rings, not of the henselizations, the two being identified by `Deformation.Examples.bijective_adicCompletionMap_henselizedLocalRing`, which is the source's parenthetical `the completion of the henselization is the completion`. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others. Obtained by cancelling the composite of the first two maps, which is smooth, out of the composite of all three

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.bijective_differential_completedLocalRingFunctors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, clause 6.** The third map `∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}} → ∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}` of the
chain induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_differential_completedLocalRingFunctors [Algebra.FiniteType k P] :
    Function.Bijective (differential
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
        fun i => henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))
      (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i =>
        AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i))) (localRingAt (m i)))
      (completedLocalRingFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m))
declarations.comment: clause 6 of seven: the third map of the chain, `∏ Def_{P^h_{𝔪 i}} -> ∏ Def_{P^∧_{𝔪 i}}`, induces an isomorphism on tangent spaces, with the target the tag's own -- the completions of the local rings. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others. Obtained by cancelling the composite of the first two maps out of the composite of all three

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.finiteDimensional_artinianTangentSpace_chain
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZF, clause 7.** All four tangent spaces along the chain are finite dimensional
over `k`. The source's is `Ext¹_P(NL_{P/k}, P)` by **Stacks 0DY3** and is finite dimensional by
**Stacks 0DY4(2)**; the other three are carried along by the tangent-space isomorphisms of
clauses 2, 4 and 6, each of which is `k`-linear by **Stacks 06IJ**.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteDimensional_artinianTangentSpace_chain
    {ι : Type w} [Finite ι] (m : ι → PrimeSpectrum P) [Algebra.FiniteType k P]
    (hmax : ∀ i, (m i).asIdeal.IsMaximal) (hinj : Function.Injective m)
    (hsm : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P, ¬ Algebra.IsSmoothAt k q.asIdeal → ∃ i, m i = q) :
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory (ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k P).p) :=
      ⟨(ringDeformationCategory_isDeformationCategory P).predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π
      (isomorphismClasses (ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k P)
        isCofiberedInGroupoids_ringDeformationProjection))) :=
      ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_ringDeformation Λ k P⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory
        (piBasedCategory fun i => ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k (localRingAt (m i))).p) :=
      ⟨(isDeformationCategory_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
        fun i => localRingAt (m i)).predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π
      (isomorphismClasses (piBasedCategory fun i =>
          ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k (localRingAt (m i)))
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation fun i => localRingAt (m i))))) :=
      ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i => localRingAt (m i)⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory
        (piBasedCategory fun i =>
          ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))).p) :=
      ⟨(isDeformationCategory_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
        fun i => henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)).predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π
      (isomorphismClasses (piBasedCategory fun i =>
          ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)))
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation fun i => henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))))) :=
      ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
        fun i => henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory
        (piBasedCategory fun i => ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k
          (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))
            (localRingAt (m i)))).p) :=
      ⟨(isDeformationCategory_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i =>
        AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))
          (localRingAt (m i))).predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π
      (isomorphismClasses (piBasedCategory fun i => ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k
          (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i))) (localRingAt (m i))))
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation fun i =>
          AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))
            (localRingAt (m i)))))) :=
      ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i =>
        AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i))) (localRingAt (m i))⟩
    FiniteDimensional k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses (ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k P)
          isCofiberedInGroupoids_ringDeformationProjection)) ∧
      FiniteDimensional k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses (piBasedCategory fun i =>
            ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k (localRingAt (m i)))
          (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation fun i => localRingAt (m i)))) ∧
      FiniteDimensional k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses (piBasedCategory fun i =>
            ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)))
          (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation fun i => henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)))) ∧
      FiniteDimensional k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses (piBasedCategory fun i => ringDeformationBasedCategory Λ k
            (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i))) (localRingAt (m i))))
          (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation fun i =>
            AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRingAt (m i)))
              (localRingAt (m i)))))
declarations.comment: clause 7 of seven: the tangent spaces of all four terms of the chain are finite dimensional over `k`, which is the tag's `finite dimensional tangent spaces`. Under the tag's own hypotheses and no others -- in particular the finiteness of the non-smooth locus that Stacks 0DY4 wants is derived here from the tag's `smooth except at 𝔪 1, ..., 𝔪 n`. The source's tangent space is `Ext¹_P(NL_{P/k}, P)` by Stacks 0DY3; the other three are carried along by clauses 2, 4 and 6, each differential being `k`-linear by Stacks 06IJ

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.nonempty_basedIso_adicCompletionFunctor_completionFunctors
declarations.doc:
**The comparison of Stacks 0DZF for the completion leg.** Completing a deformation of `P`
along `J = 𝔪 1 ∩ … ∩ 𝔪 n` and then transporting along a ring isomorphism
`P^∧_J ≅ ∏ (P^h_{𝔪 i})^∧` gives the *same* functor over `𝒞_Λ` as localizing at each `𝔪 i`,
henselizing, completing each henselized local ring, and reading the resulting family as a
deformation of the product ring.

This is the step the source of Stacks 0DZF makes when, having applied **Stacks 0DZ5** to `P`
itself — where the finite type hypothesis genuinely holds — it says "`P^∧ = ∏ P^∧_{𝔪 i}`". The
ring isomorphism and its description on elements coming from `P` are hypotheses, so a caller may
supply the one it already has; `Deformation.Examples.adicCompletionPiHenselizedEquiv`,
`Deformation.Examples.algebraMap_adicCompletionPiHenselizedEquiv` and
`Deformation.Examples.apply_algebraMap_adicCompletionPiHenselizedEquiv` are such a triple.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_basedIso_adicCompletionFunctor_completionFunctors
    {ι : Type w} [Finite ι] [Algebra.FiniteType k P] [IsNoetherianRing P]
    (m : ι → PrimeSpectrum P) (hmax : ∀ i, (m i).asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (hinj : Function.Injective m)
    (e : AdicCompletion (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal) P ≃+*
      (∀ i, AdicCompletion (henselizedMaximalIdealAt (m i)) (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))))
    (he : ∀ a : k, e (algebraMap k (AdicCompletion (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal) P) a) =
      algebraMap k (∀ i, AdicCompletion (henselizedMaximalIdealAt (m i))
        (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))) a)
    (hchar : ∀ (x : P) (i : ι),
      e (algebraMap P (AdicCompletion (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal) P) x) i =
        algebraMap (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))
          (AdicCompletion (henselizedMaximalIdealAt (m i)) (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i)))
          (algebraMap (localRingAt (m i)) (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))
            (algebraMap P (localRingAt (m i)) x))) :
    Nonempty (BasedFunctor.comp
        (adicCompletionFunctor (Λ := Λ) (k := k) P (⨅ j, (m j).asIdeal)).functor
        (ringDeformationTransport e he) ≅
      BasedFunctor.comp (localizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m)
        (BasedFunctor.comp (henselizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m)
          (BasedFunctor.comp (completionFunctors (Λ := Λ) (k := k) m)
            (piDeformationFunctor (Λ := Λ) (k := k) fun i =>
              AdicCompletion (henselizedMaximalIdealAt (m i))
                (henselizedLocalRingAt (m i))))))
declarations.comment: the identification the source's proof makes when, after applying Stacks 0DZ5 to `P` itself with `J = 𝔪 1 ∩ ... ∩ 𝔪 n`, it says `P^ = ∏ P^_{𝔪 i}`: completing a deformation along `J` and transporting along a ring isomorphism `P^∧_J ≅ ∏ (P^h_{𝔪 i})^∧` is isomorphic, over `𝒞_Λ`, to localizing at each `𝔪 i`, henselizing, completing, and reading the family as a deformation of the product ring. Hypotheses: the tag's own on the family -- the `𝔪 i` maximal and distinct -- plus `P` of finite type over `k`, and the ring isomorphism together with its description on elements of `P`, which are inputs rather than existentials

registrations.name: finiteDimensional_naiveCotangentExtOne
registrations.comment: the finite-dimensionality of the tangent space of the source `Def_P` of the chain, which the source's proof obtains from Stacks 0DY4 and which this declaration carries. The tangent space is the group `Ext¹_P(NL_{P/k}, P)` of Stacks 0DY3. No extra hypothesis: `hfinite` asks only that the non-smooth locus be finite, which 0DZF's own hypothesis -- smooth except at the maximal ideals `𝔪 1, ..., 𝔪 n` -- gives. Finite-dimensionality for all four terms of the chain, which is the tag's own `finite dimensional tangent spaces`, is `Deformation.Examples.finiteDimensional_artinianTangentSpace_chain`

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.ringDeformationCategory_isSmooth_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZH.** In the setting of Stacks 0DY1, the deformation category of a local
complete intersection `P` over a field `k` is unobstructed: the structure functor of
`Deformation.Examples.ringDeformationCategory P` to the category of Artinian local `Λ`-algebras
with residue field `k` is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem ringDeformationCategory_isSmooth_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    {Λ : Type u} {k P : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [CommRing P] [Algebra k P]
    (hP : IsLocalCompleteIntersection k P) :
    IsSmooth
      (baseProjection
        (Over.forget (residueFieldAlgebra (Λ := Λ) (k := k) P) ⋙
          FlatAlgebraCategory.projection (Λ := Λ) (k := k)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.le_maximalSmoothOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZI, maximality.** Every open subspace on which `f` is smooth is contained in the
smooth locus: it is a member of the family the smooth locus is the supremum of.
declarations.comment: maximality of the smooth locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_maximalSmoothOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZI, openness.** The smooth locus of a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
an open subspace.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_maximalSmoothOpen (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS (maximalSmoothOpen B S hS f)
declarations.comment: the smooth locus is an open subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmooth_maximalSmoothOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZI, smoothness on the open.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is smooth
on its smooth locus.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_maximalSmoothOpen (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsSmooth B S hS ((maximalSmoothOpen B S hS f).ι ≫ f)
declarations.comment: the morphism is smooth on its smooth locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.maximalSmoothOpen_eq_preimage_of_isFlat_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZI, part (1).** Formation of the smooth locus commutes with base change by a
morphism which is flat and locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem maximalSmoothOpen_eq_preimage_of_isFlat_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hgflat : IsFlat B S hS g.hom)
    (hglfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g.hom) :
    maximalSmoothOpen B S hS f'.hom = (maximalSmoothOpen B S hS f.hom).preimage g'.hom
declarations.comment: part (1): base change by a flat morphism locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.maximalSmoothOpen_eq_preimage_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZI, part (2).** For a morphism locally of finite presentation, formation of the
smooth locus commutes with every flat base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem maximalSmoothOpen_eq_preimage_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_isFlat
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hflfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (hgflat : IsFlat B S hS g.hom) :
    maximalSmoothOpen B S hS f'.hom = (maximalSmoothOpen B S hS f.hom).preimage g'.hom
declarations.comment: part (2): flat base change of a morphism locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedProduct
declarations.doc:
The *product* of two categories cofibered in groupoids `𝓕` and `𝓖` over `𝒞_Λ` is their
`2`-fibre product `𝓕 ×_{𝒞_Λ} 𝓖`, taken over `𝒞_Λ` itself: the `2`-fibre product of the two
structure morphisms of `𝓕` and `𝓖` into the base category read through the identity functor as a
category cofibered in groupoids over itself.
declarations.comment: the product of two categories cofibered in groupoids over 𝒞_Λ is their 2-fibre product over 𝒞_Λ

declarations.name: Deformation.isCofiberedInGroupoids_cofiberedProduct
declarations.doc:
The product of two categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` is again cofibered in
groupoids.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCofiberedInGroupoids_cofiberedProduct
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p) :
    IsCofiberedInGroupoids (cofiberedProduct 𝓕 𝓖).p
declarations.comment: the product of two categories cofibered in groupoids is cofibered in groupoids

declarations.name: Deformation.twoFibreProductBasedCategory_comp_baseProjection
declarations.doc:
Given morphisms `p₁ : 𝓗 → 𝓕` and `p₂ : 𝓖 → 𝓕` of categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ`,
the `2`-fibre product of `𝓗` and `𝓖` formed over `𝒞_Λ` — that is, over the two composites of `p₁`
and `p₂` with the structure morphism of `𝓕` — is the product `𝓗 ×_{𝒞_Λ} 𝓖`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem twoFibreProductBasedCategory_comp_baseProjection
    (p₁ : BasedFunctor 𝓗 𝓕) (p₂ : BasedFunctor 𝓖 𝓕) :
    twoFibreProductBasedCategory (BasedFunctor.comp p₁ (baseProjection 𝓕.p))
        (BasedFunctor.comp p₂ (baseProjection 𝓕.p)) = cofiberedProduct 𝓗 𝓖
declarations.comment: the 2-fibre product over 𝒞_Λ along the structure morphisms is the product

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_baseProjection_iff_formallySmoothNAdic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZK.** A predeformation category with a versal formal object over `R` is
unobstructed if and only if `Λ → R` is formally smooth in the `m_R`-adic topology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_baseProjection_iff_formallySmoothNAdic
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ) :
    IsSmooth (baseProjection p) ↔
      RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max u (max v w)}
        (algebraMap Λ ξ.base) (maximalIdeal ξ.base)
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2)

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_baseProjection_iff_powerSeries
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZK.** In the classical case, a predeformation category with a versal formal
object over `R` is unobstructed if and only if `R` is a formal power series algebra in
finitely many variables over `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_baseProjection_iff_powerSeries
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ)
    (hΛ : IsClassical Λ k) :
    IsSmooth (baseProjection p) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (ξ.base ≃ₐ[Λ] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ)
declarations.comment: condition (3), classical case

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.existsUnique_ringDeformationClass_artinianDualNumbers_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZL.** For a smooth algebra `P` over a field `k`, the tangent space of the
deformation category of `P` is zero: the flat deformations of `P` over the dual numbers
form a single isomorphism class.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_ringDeformationClass_artinianDualNumbers_of_smooth
    [Algebra.Smooth k P] :
    ∃ x : Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid
        ((objectsOverFunctor (FlatAlgebraCategory.projection (Λ := Λ) (k := k))
          (residueFieldAlgebra (Λ := Λ) (k := k) P)).Fiber
          (artinianDualNumbers.{u, w, w} Λ k))),
      ∀ y, y = x

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.localRingDeformationFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZM.** Taking the local ring at a point of a scheme defines a functor of
deformation categories over the category of Artinian local algebras.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def localRingDeformationFunctor
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : X.left) :
    letI : Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      letI : Algebra k ((Spec (.of k)).presheaf.stalk (X.hom.base x)) :=
        StructureSheaf.stalkAlgebra k (X.hom.base x)
      ((X.hom.stalkMap x).hom.comp (algebraMap k _)).toAlgebra
    BasedFunctor
      (BasedCategory.ofFunctor
        (schemeDeformationCategoryProjection (Λ := Λ) (k := k) X))
      (BasedCategory.ofFunctor
        (Over.forget
          (residueFieldAlgebra (Λ := Λ) (k := k) (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) ⋙
          FlatAlgebraCategory.projection (Λ := Λ) (k := k)))
declarations.comment: the functor

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.localRingDeformationFunctor_fiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZM.** The underlying algebra of the image deformation is the stalk of the
deformed scheme at the image of the chosen point.
declarations.statement:
theorem localRingDeformationFunctor_fiber
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : X.left)
    (P : SchemeDeformationCategory (Λ := Λ) (k := k) X) :
    letI : Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      letI : Algebra k ((Spec (.of k)).presheaf.stalk (X.hom.base x)) :=
        StructureSheaf.stalkAlgebra k (X.hom.base x)
      ((X.hom.stalkMap x).hom.comp (algebraMap k _)).toAlgebra
    ((localRingDeformationFunctor X x).obj P).left.fiber =
      P.scheme.presheaf.stalk (P.specialMap.base x)
declarations.comment: fibers

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.localRingDeformationFunctor_specialMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZM.** The special-fibre map of the image is the stalk map of the special-fibre
embedding.
declarations.statement:
theorem localRingDeformationFunctor_specialMap
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : X.left)
    (P : SchemeDeformationCategory (Λ := Λ) (k := k) X) :
    letI : Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      letI : Algebra k ((Spec (.of k)).presheaf.stalk (X.hom.base x)) :=
        StructureSheaf.stalkAlgebra k (X.hom.base x)
      ((X.hom.stalkMap x).hom.comp (algebraMap k _)).toAlgebra
    HEq ((localRingDeformationFunctor X x).obj P).hom.map.hom
      (P.specialMap.stalkMap x).hom
declarations.comment: special-fiber maps

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.localRingDeformationFunctor_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZM.** On morphisms, the induced algebra map is the stalk map of the morphism
between the deformed schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem localRingDeformationFunctor_map
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : X.left)
    {P Q : SchemeDeformationCategory (Λ := Λ) (k := k) X} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    letI : Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      letI : Algebra k ((Spec (.of k)).presheaf.stalk (X.hom.base x)) :=
        StructureSheaf.stalkAlgebra k (X.hom.base x)
      ((X.hom.stalkMap x).hom.comp (algebraMap k _)).toAlgebra
    HEq ((localRingDeformationFunctor X x).map f).left.map.hom
      (f.map.stalkMap (Q.specialMap.base x)).hom
declarations.comment: morphism maps

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.GluingSituation.isSmooth_toChartProductOfCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DZN**, first clause. In Situation 0DYY, if `U₁₂ → Spec(k)` is smooth
then `Def_X ⟶ Def_{U₁} × Def_{U₂} = Def_{P₁} × Def_{P₂}` is smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_toChartProductOfCover (hU₁₂ : Algebra.Smooth k S.P₁₂) :
    IsSmooth (toChartProductOfCover S)
declarations.comment: clause 1: Def_X ⟶ Def_{P_1} × Def_{P_2} is smooth when U_12 is smooth over k; unconditional, the hypothesis on P_12 being the source's own

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.GluingSituation.isSmooth_toChartProductOfCover_comp_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0DZN**, second clause. In Situation 0DYY, if `U₁₂ → Spec(k)` is smooth
and `U₁` is in addition a local complete intersection over `k`, then
`Def_X ⟶ Def_{U₂} = Def_{P₂}` is smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_toChartProductOfCover_comp_snd (hU₁₂ : Algebra.Smooth k S.P₁₂)
    (hU₁ : IsLocalCompleteIntersection k S.P₁) :
    IsSmooth (BasedFunctor.comp (toChartProductOfCover S)
      (cofiberedProductSnd (ringDeformationCategoryOver Λ k S.P₁)
        (ringDeformationCategoryOver Λ k S.P₂)))
declarations.comment: clause 2: Def_X ⟶ Def_{P_2} is smooth when U_12 is smooth over k and U_1 is a local complete intersection over k; unconditional, the hypotheses on P_12 and P_1 being the source's own

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_localRingFunctors_and_chain
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a separated scheme of finite type over `k` with `dim X ≤ 1`, and let `p_i` be
finitely many distinct closed points of `X` outside of which `X → Spec k` is smooth. In the chain
of deformation categories
`Def_X ⟶ ∏ Def_{𝒪_{X, p_i}} ⟶ ∏ Def_{𝒪^h_{X, p_i}} ⟶ ∏ Def_{𝒪^∧_{X, p_i}}`
the first map is smooth, and the second and third maps are smooth and induce isomorphisms
(bijections of `k`-vector spaces, by Stacks 06IJ) on tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_localRingFunctors_and_chain [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    [QuasiCompact X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (X.left : Type u) ≤ 1) [Finite ι]
    (hinj : Function.Injective p) (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed ({p i} : Set X.left))
    (hsm : ∀ x : X.left, x ∉ Set.range p → x ∈ X.hom.smoothLocus) :
    letI : ∀ i, Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i)) := fun i => stalkAlgebraOver X (p i)
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
    IsSmooth (localRingFunctors (Λ := Λ) X p) ∧
      IsSmooth (stalkHenselizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) X p) ∧
      Function.Bijective (differential
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
          fun i => X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i))
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
          fun i => (henselization (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i))
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i))) : Type u))
        (stalkHenselizationFunctors (Λ := Λ) X p)) ∧
      IsSmooth (stalkCompletionFunctors (Λ := Λ) X p) ∧
      Function.Bijective (differential
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
          fun i => (henselization (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i))
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i))) : Type u))
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_pi_ringDeformation (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
          fun i => AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i)))
            (X.left.presheaf.stalk (p i)))
        (stalkCompletionFunctors (Λ := Λ) X p))

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_baseProjection_schemeDeformationCategoryProjection_of_lci
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0DZQ].** Let `X` be a scheme over a field `k` which is separated and of finite
type over `k`, of dimension at most one, a local complete intersection over `k`, and smooth over
`k` outside a finite set of points. Then the deformation category `Def_X` of Example 0DY7 is
unobstructed: its structure morphism over `𝒞_Λ` is smooth.

The proof is the source's: a cover of `X` by two affine opens, the first inside the smooth locus
(Tags 0A25 and 01ZY, through Tag 09NZ), then Tag 0DZN for `Def_X ⟶ Def_{U₂}`, Tag 0DYX for
`Def_{U₂} = Def_{P₂}` and Tag 0DZH for `Def_{P₂} ⟶ 𝒞_Λ`. It is
`Deformation.Examples.isSmooth_baseProjection_schemeDeformationCategoryProjection` applied to the
four inputs proved in this file and `Deformation.isDeformationCategory_id`.

The base ring `Λ` is any commutative ring of which `k` is an algebra; the source's
standing assumption that `Λ` is a Noetherian complete local ring with residue field `k` is not
needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_baseProjection_schemeDeformationCategoryProjection_of_lci {Λ k : Type u}
    [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    [QuasiCompact X.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (X.left : Type u) ≤ 1)
    (hlci : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionOverField X.hom)
    (hfinite : ((X.hom.smoothLocus : Set X.left)ᶜ).Finite) :
    IsSmooth (baseProjection (schemeDeformationCategoryProjection (Λ := Λ) (k := k) X))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.smoothLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZR.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S`. There is a
maximal open substack `𝒰 ⊆ 𝒳` such that `f|_𝒰 : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒴` is smooth — an open substack on which `f`
is smooth containing every other one, unique by maximality. Moreover, formation of this open
substack commutes with

1. precomposing by smooth morphisms: for `g : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒳` smooth, the open substack of `g ≫ f` is
   the inverse image along `g` of that of `f`;
2. base change by morphisms which are flat and locally of finite presentation: for any 2-fibre
   product `P` of `f` along such a `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴`, the open substack of the base change `P.fst` is
   the inverse image along the projection `P.snd` of that of `f`;
3. base change by flat morphisms, provided `f` is locally of finite presentation.

The open substack is constructed from a smooth chart of `f`: the image of the smooth locus of the
chart's morphism of algebraic spaces (**Stacks 0DZI**), read as an open substack by
**Stacks 06FJ** (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.openSubstackOfPoints`). Clause (1) is descent along the
smooth `𝒰' ⟶ 𝒳`, and clauses (2) and (3) reduce to **Stacks 0DZI** on a cartesian square of
charts.
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothLocus {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    (∃! W : OpenSubstack 𝒳, IsSmoothLocus B S hS f W) ∧
    (∀ (𝒳' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) (g : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒳),
      AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS g →
      ∀ (W : OpenSubstack 𝒳) (W' : OpenSubstack 𝒳'),
        IsSmoothLocus B S hS f W → IsSmoothLocus B S hS (g ≫ f) W' →
          W'.property = fun x => W.property (g.hom.hom.toFunctor.obj x)) ∧
    (∀ (𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴) (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f),
      Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P →
      AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g → AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g →
      ∀ (W : OpenSubstack 𝒳) (W' : OpenSubstack P.pt),
        IsSmoothLocus B S hS f W → IsSmoothLocus B S hS P.fst W' →
          W'.property = fun x => W.property (P.snd.hom.hom.toFunctor.obj x)) ∧
    (AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f →
      ∀ (𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴) (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f),
        Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P → AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g →
        ∀ (W : OpenSubstack 𝒳) (W' : OpenSubstack P.pt),
          IsSmoothLocus B S hS f W → IsSmoothLocus B S hS P.fst W' →
            W'.property = fun x => W.property (P.snd.hom.hom.toFunctor.obj x))
declarations.comment: the maximal open substack on which f is smooth exists and is unique, and its formation commutes with precomposition by smooth morphisms, with base change by flat morphisms locally of finite presentation, and with flat base change when f is locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsSmoothLocus.property_iff_isFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZS, the equivalence of (1) and (2).** In Situation 0DQU — `𝒳` an algebraic stack
locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian scheme `S` — let `x₀ : Spec k ⟶ 𝒳` be a point with
`Spec k ⟶ S` of finite type, presented over an affine open `Spec Λ ⊆ S`, with image `s`, and let
`A` be a versal ring to `𝒳` at `x₀`. Then `x₀` lies in the smooth locus `W` of `𝒳 ⟶ S`
(Stacks 0DZR) if and only if `𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ A` is formally smooth for the `𝔪_A`-adic topology.

The proof is the source's: condition (2) does not depend on the versal ring (Stacks 0DQX) and is
unchanged by finite extensions of the residue field (Stacks 0DQY), so it may be tested at a point
of a smooth chart `U ⟶ 𝒳`, where the versal ring is `𝒪^∧_{U, u₀}` (Stacks 0DQZ); there
membership in the smooth locus of `𝒳 ⟶ S` is membership of `u₀` in the smooth locus of `U ⟶ S`
(Stacks 0DZR), which is formal smoothness of `𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ 𝒪^∧_{U, u₀}` (Stacks 07VH).
declarations.statement:
theorem IsSmoothLocus.property_iff_isFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint
    {W : OpenSubstack D.𝒳}
    (hW : IsSmoothLocus D.B D.S D.hS (structureMorphism D.B D.S D.hS D.𝒳) W)
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (iΛ : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ D.S) (hiΛ : _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion iΛ)
    (x₀ : D.𝒳.val.val.obj)
    (hx₀ : (D.𝒳.val.val.p ⋙ Over.post D.B.inclusion).obj x₀ =
      Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hfinite : LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ) ∧
      QuasiCompact (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (A : Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ k)
    (hA : IsVersalRingAt D iΛ hiΛ x₀ hx₀ hfinite A) :
    W.property x₀ ↔
      IsFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ A)) ≫ iΛ)
declarations.comment: the equivalence of (1) and (2): x₀ is in the smooth locus of 𝒳 → S iff 𝒪_{S,s} → A is formally smooth in the 𝔪_A-adic topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint_iff_isSmooth_baseProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZS, the equivalence of (2) and (3).** In Situation 0DQU let `x₀ : Spec k ⟶ 𝒳` be a
point with `Spec k ⟶ S` of finite type, presented over an affine open `Spec Λ ⊆ S` with `Λ → k`
finite (the presentation of Artin's Axioms, Section 07T2, on which the predeformation category
`𝓕_{𝒳, k, x₀}` is built), and let `A` be a versal ring to `𝒳` at `x₀`. Then `𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ A` is
formally smooth for the `𝔪_A`-adic topology if and only if `𝓕_{𝒳, k, x₀}` is unobstructed, that
is its structure functor to `𝒞_Λ` is smooth. This is Formal Deformation Theory, Lemma 0DZK,
together with the observation that `𝒪_{S, s}` is a localization of `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint_iff_isSmooth_baseProjection
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (iΛ : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ D.S) (hiΛ : _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion iΛ)
    (x₀ : D.𝒳.val.val.obj)
    (hx₀ : (D.𝒳.val.val.p ⋙ Over.post D.B.inclusion).obj x₀ =
      Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hfinite : LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ) ∧
      QuasiCompact (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (A : Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ k)
    (hA : IsVersalRingAt D iΛ hiΛ x₀ hx₀ hfinite A) :
    IsFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ A)) ≫ iΛ) ↔
      let C := Deformation.Artin.predeformationCategory iΛ
        (D.𝒳.val.val.p ⋙ Over.post D.B.inclusion) x₀ hx₀
      letI : Category C.carrier := C.category
      Deformation.IsSmooth (Deformation.baseProjection C.projection)
declarations.comment: the equivalence of (2) and (3): 𝒪_{S,s} → A is formally smooth in the 𝔪_A-adic topology iff the predeformation category of x₀ is unobstructed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.tfae_smoothLocus_formallySmooth_unobstructed
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_smoothLocus_formallySmooth_unobstructed
    {W : OpenSubstack D.𝒳}
    (hW : IsSmoothLocus D.B D.S D.hS (structureMorphism D.B D.S D.hS D.𝒳) W)
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (iΛ : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ D.S) (hiΛ : _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion iΛ)
    (x₀ : D.𝒳.val.val.obj)
    (hx₀ : (D.𝒳.val.val.p ⋙ Over.post D.B.inclusion).obj x₀ =
      Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hfinite : LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ) ∧
      QuasiCompact (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (A : Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ k)
    (hA : IsVersalRingAt D iΛ hiΛ x₀ hx₀ hfinite A) :
    List.TFAE [W.property x₀,
      IsFormallySmoothAtClosedPoint (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ A)) ≫ iΛ),
      let C := Deformation.Artin.predeformationCategory iΛ
        (D.𝒳.val.val.p ⋙ Over.post D.B.inclusion) x₀ hx₀
      letI : Category C.carrier := C.category
      Deformation.IsSmooth (Deformation.baseProjection C.projection)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSmoothLocus_property_iff_isSmooth_schemeDeformation
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension at most one over `k`, and let `Λ`
be a Cohen ring for `k`: a complete discrete valuation ring whose maximal ideal is generated by a
prime number `p` (`IsCohenRing`), with a surjection `Λ → k`, so that `k` is its residue field.
Then the following are equivalent:

1. the classifying morphism `Spec(k) → Curves` of `X` factors through the open substack where
   `Curves → Spec(ℤ)` is smooth;
2. the deformation category `Def_X` of `X` over `𝒞_Λ` is unobstructed.

The stack `Curves` is read on its small model `AlgebraicGeometry.curvesAlgebraicStack`, the
presentation at which it is an object of the 2-category of algebraic stacks; the classifying
morphism of `X` is the object `AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSmallPoint` over `Spec(k)`, and it factors
through an open substack exactly when it is an object of that substack. The open substack where
`Curves → Spec(ℤ)` is smooth is the maximal one of Stacks 0DZR,
`AlgebraicGeometry.curvesSmoothLocus`. Unobstructedness of `Def_X` is smoothness of its
projection to `𝒞_Λ` (Stacks 06HG).
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesSmoothLocus_property_iff_isSmooth_schemeDeformation
    {k Λ : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [IsDomain Λ] [IsCohenRing Λ] [Algebra Λ k]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ k))
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper X.hom] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1) :
    (curvesSmoothLocus.{u, w} B hZ).property (curvesSmallPoint B hZ X hk hdim) ↔
      IsSmooth (baseProjection (schemeDeformationCategoryProjection (Λ := Λ) X))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLciFamily_iff_isSyntomicFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, part (1).** The equivalence of conditions (b) and (c): a family of curves has
a local complete intersection structure morphism exactly when its structure morphism is syntomic.

A syntomic morphism of algebraic spaces is one which is flat and a local complete intersection
morphism, by Tag 06C9, and the structure morphism of a family of curves is flat, so the flatness
half of that conjunction is supplied by the family itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLciFamily_iff_isSyntomicFamily (X : CurveFamily B hZ) :
    IsLciFamily B hZ X ↔ Space.IsSyntomic B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom
declarations.comment: part (1), the equivalence of (b) and (c) for a family of curves: its structure morphism is a local complete intersection morphism if and only if it is syntomic

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesLci_isStrictlyFull
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV.** The condition that a family of curves have a local complete intersection
structure morphism is invariant under isomorphism, so `Curves^{lci}` is a strictly full
subcategory of the category of families of curves: the first of the three conditions making it an
open substack.

An isomorphism of families of curves is a morphism of families, so this is base-change invariance
of the condition applied to the inverse isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesLci_isStrictlyFull :
    (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from
      IsLciFamily B hZ).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
declarations.comment: strict fullness of the local complete intersection subcategory of the category of families of curves, which is the first of the three conditions of Tag 04YM making it an open substack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLciFamily_curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, part (2).** Condition (b) read on the family of curves attached to a proper
flat morphism of schemes of finite presentation whose source has dimension at most one: that
family has a local complete intersection structure morphism exactly when the morphism of schemes
is a local complete intersection morphism.

Over the spectrum of a field the right-hand side is the condition that the proper scheme be a
local complete intersection over that field, which is condition (b) of part (2) of the source;
see `AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThroughCurvesLci_over_field_iff`. No hypothesis on the base is
needed, so the statement is proved over an arbitrary base scheme of the site.

Both sides pass through syntomicity. The every-étale-chart condition of Tag 03MJ at a morphism of
the site is the scheme-level condition itself for a property étale local on the source and target,
which syntomicity is by Tag 04R3; at the level of schemes syntomicity is flatness together with
the local complete intersection property by Tag 069K, and the morphism is flat by hypothesis; at
the level of algebraic spaces it is the same conjunction by Tag 06C9, whose flatness half the
family supplies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLciFamily_curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism_iff
    {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W)
    (hflat : Flat ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hlfp : LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hqc : Space.IsQuasiCompact B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom)
    (hsep : Space.IsSeparated B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom)
    (hqsep : Space.IsQuasiSeparated B integerBase hZ (schemeSpaceMap g).hom)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1) :
    IsLciFamily B hZ
        (curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g hflat hproper hlfp hqc hsep hqsep hdim) ↔
      IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism
        ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)
declarations.comment: part (2), condition (b): for the family of curves attached to a proper flat morphism of schemes of finite presentation whose source has dimension at most one, the structure morphism of the family is a local complete intersection morphism if and only if that morphism of schemes is one, i.e. — over the spectrum of a field — if and only if the proper scheme is a local complete intersection over the field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesLci
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, the open substack `Curves^{lci}`.** The open substack of the algebraic stack of
curves (Stacks 0D5A) of the families of curves whose structure morphism is a local complete
intersection morphism, cut out by the method of Section 0E0E.
declarations.statement:
abbrev curvesLci :
    Stack.OpenSubstack
      (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ))
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{lci} of the algebraic stack of curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesLci_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, part (1).** Let `X → S` be a family of curves and `z : (Sch/S) → Curves` a
classifying morphism for it, a scheme-valued point of the algebraic stack of curves together with
an isomorphism between the family it classifies at `S` and `X`. Then the following are
equivalent:

* (a) `z` factors through `Curves^{lci}`, over the site and up to a 2-isomorphism;
* (b) `X → S` is a local complete intersection morphism;
* (c) `X → S` is syntomic.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesLci_tfae (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (z : BigFppfOver B S.left.1 S.left.2 ⥤
      (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
        (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
      (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.p = Over.map S.hom)
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (ξ : (curvesSmallEquivalence B hZ
      (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).inverse.obj
        (z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 S.left))) ≅ X) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map S.hom) ⥤ᵇ
            Stack.fullSubcategoryBased _ (curvesLci.{u, w} B hZ).property,
          Nonempty (g.comp (Stack.fullSubcategoryBasedInclusion _
            (curvesLci.{u, w} B hZ).property) ≅ { toFunctor := z, w := hz }),
        Space.IsLocalCompleteIntersection B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom,
        Space.IsSyntomic B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom]
declarations.comment: part (1), on the open substack Curves^{lci} of the algebraic stack of curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesLci_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, part (2).** Let `g : T ⟶ W` be a morphism of the big fppf site of the integers
whose target scheme is the spectrum of a field `k`, whose underlying morphism of schemes is
proper, and whose source scheme `X` has dimension at most one, and let `z : (Sch/Spec(k)) →
Curves` classify the family of curves of `g`. Then `z` factors through `Curves^{lci}` if and only
if `X` is a local complete intersection over `k`, that is, `g` is a local complete intersection
morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesLci_over_field_iff
    {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
    (z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤
      (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
        (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
      (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.p = Over.map W.hom)
    (ξ : (curvesSmallEquivalence B hZ
      (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).inverse.obj
        (z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left))) ≅
      curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
        (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
        (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
        ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
        ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim) :
    (∃ q : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.fullSubcategoryBased _ (curvesLci.{u, w} B hZ).property,
        Nonempty (q.comp (Stack.fullSubcategoryBasedInclusion _
          (curvesLci.{u, w} B hZ).property) ≅ { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)
declarations.comment: part (2), on the open substack Curves^{lci} of the algebraic stack of curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_openSubstack_curvesLci
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV.** There is an open substack `Curves^{lci}` of the algebraic stack of curves
such that

1. for a family of curves `X → S` with classifying morphism `z : (Sch/S) → Curves`, the following
   are equivalent: (a) `z` factors through `Curves^{lci}`, (b) `X → S` is a local complete
   intersection morphism, (c) `X → S` is syntomic;
2. for a proper scheme `X` of dimension at most one over a field `k` (a morphism `g` of the site
   to `Spec(k)`) with classifying morphism `z : (Sch/Spec(k)) → Curves`, `z` factors through
   `Curves^{lci}` if and only if `X` is a local complete intersection over `k`.

The open substack is `AlgebraicGeometry.curvesLci`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_openSubstack_curvesLci :
    ∃ U : Stack.OpenSubstack
        (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)),
      (∀ (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
        (z : BigFppfOver B S.left.1 S.left.2 ⥤
          (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
            (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.obj)
        (hz : z ⋙ (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.p = Over.map S.hom)
        (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
        (_ : (curvesSmallEquivalence B hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).inverse.obj
            (z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 S.left))) ≅ X),
        List.TFAE
          [∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map S.hom) ⥤ᵇ
                Stack.fullSubcategoryBased _ U.property,
              Nonempty (g.comp (Stack.fullSubcategoryBasedInclusion _ U.property) ≅
                { toFunctor := z, w := hz }),
            Space.IsLocalCompleteIntersection B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom,
            Space.IsSyntomic B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom]) ∧
      ∀ {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
        (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
        (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
        (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
        (z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤
          (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
            (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.obj)
        (hz : z ⋙ (curvesAlgebraicStack B hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).val.val.p = Over.map W.hom)
        (_ : (curvesSmallEquivalence B hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory_isAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B hZ)).inverse.obj
            (z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left))) ≅
          curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
            (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
            (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
            ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
            ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim),
        (∃ q : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
              Stack.fullSubcategoryBased _ U.property,
            Nonempty (q.comp (Stack.fullSubcategoryBasedInclusion _ U.property) ≅
              { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
          IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_lci
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, `Curves^{lci}` is open in `Curves`.** The inclusion into the category fibred
in groupoids of families of curves of the full subcategory `Curves^{lci}` of the families whose
structure morphism is a local complete intersection morphism is representable by algebraic spaces
and an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_curvesSubstackInclusion_lci :
    Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsLciFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isLciFamily B hZ).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ (IsLciFamily B hZ)
          (isOpenCurvesLocus_isLciFamily B hZ).prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the inclusion of Curves^{lci} into Curves is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_lci_tfae
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_lci_tfae (S : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (z : BigFppfOver B S.left.1 S.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map S.hom)
    (X : CurveFamily B hZ) (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 S.left)) ≅ X) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map S.hom) ⥤ᵇ
            Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ
              (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsLciFamily B hZ),
          Nonempty (g.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
            (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsLciFamily B hZ)) ≅ { toFunctor := z, w := hz }),
        Space.IsLocalCompleteIntersection B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom,
        Space.IsSyntomic B integerBase hZ X.toBase.hom]
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_lci_over_field_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZV, part (2).** Let `g : T ⟶ W` be a morphism of the big fppf site of the integers
whose target scheme is the spectrum of a field `k`, whose underlying morphism of schemes is
proper, and whose source scheme `X` has dimension at most one, and let `z : (Sch/Spec(k)) →
Curves` classify the family of curves of `g`. Then `z` factors through `Curves^{lci}` if and only
if `X` is a local complete intersection over `k`, that is, `g` is a local complete intersection
morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_curvesSubstack_lci_over_field_iff
    {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (hW : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W = Spec (.of k))
    (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
    (z : BigFppfOver B W.left.1 W.left.2 ⥤ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.obj)
    (hz : z ⋙ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val.p = Over.map W.hom)
    (ξ : z.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 W.left)) ≅ curveFamilyOfSchemeMorphism B hZ g
      (flat_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW) hproper
      (locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_eq_spec_field _ k hW)
      (Space.isQuasiCompact_yoneda_map B integerBase hZ g inferInstance)
      ((Space.isSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance)
      ((Space.isQuasiSeparated_yoneda_map_iff B integerBase hZ g).2 inferInstance) hdim) :
    (∃ q : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          Stack.objectPropertySubcategory B integerBase hZ
            (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsLciFamily B hZ),
        Nonempty (q.comp (Stack.objectPropertyInclusion B integerBase hZ
          (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val (IsLciFamily B hZ)) ≅
            { toFunctor := z, w := hz })) ↔
      IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurvesWithFiniteNonSmoothLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW.** The strictly full subcategory `Curves⁺ ⊂ Curves` of the families of
curves whose non-smooth locus, with its reduced closed subspace structure, is finite over
the base.
declarations.statement: abbrev CurvesWithFiniteNonSmoothLocus
declarations.comment: the substack of curves with isolated singularities

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesWithFiniteNonSmoothLocusProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW.** The projection taking a family of curves with isolated singularities to
its base scheme, which is how `Curves⁺` is regarded as a category over the big fppf site.
declarations.statement:
abbrev curvesWithFiniteNonSmoothLocusProjection :
    CurvesWithFiniteNonSmoothLocus B hZ ⥤ B.Schemes
declarations.comment: the projection of the substack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurvesPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW.** The substack `Curves⁺`: the strictly full subcategory of families of
curves whose reduced non-smooth locus is finite over the base.
declarations.statement: abbrev CurvesPlus
declarations.comment: the_substack_curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isFiniteNonSmoothLocus_iff_forall_isClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW, part (1), condition (b) with "any".** A family of curves `X → S` lies in
`Curves⁺` exactly when *every* closed subspace `Z ⊂ X` whose set of points is the singular locus
of `X → S` is finite over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isFiniteNonSmoothLocus_iff_forall_isClosedSubspace (X : CurveFamily B hZ) :
    IsFiniteNonSmoothLocus B hZ X ↔
      ∀ Z : Subfunctor X.total.1, Space.IsClosedSubspace B integerBase hZ Z →
        Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ Z.toFunctor Z.ι) =
          CurveFamily.nonSmoothLocus B hZ X →
        Space.IsFinite B integerBase hZ (Z.ι ≫ X.toBase.hom)
declarations.comment: part (1), condition (b) with 'any': every closed subspace structure on the singular locus is finite over the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CurveFamily.isFiniteNonSmoothLocus_iff_exists_isClosedSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW, part (1), condition (b) with "some".** A family of curves `X → S` lies in
`Curves⁺` exactly when *some* closed subspace `Z ⊂ X` whose set of points is the singular locus of
`X → S` is finite over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem CurveFamily.isFiniteNonSmoothLocus_iff_exists_isClosedSubspace (X : CurveFamily B hZ) :
    IsFiniteNonSmoothLocus B hZ X ↔
      ∃ Z : Subfunctor X.total.1, Space.IsClosedSubspace B integerBase hZ Z ∧
        Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ Z.toFunctor Z.ι) =
          CurveFamily.nonSmoothLocus B hZ X ∧
        Space.IsFinite B integerBase hZ (Z.ι ≫ X.toBase.hom)
declarations.comment: part (1), condition (b) with 'some': some closed subspace structure on the singular locus is finite over the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPlus_isOpenSubstack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW, the open substack.** `Curves⁺` is an open substack of the stack of curves: it
is a strictly full subcategory, and its inclusion into `Curves` is representable by algebraic
spaces and an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPlus_isOpenSubstack :
    (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from
        IsFiniteNonSmoothLocus B hZ).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ (curvesPlusInclusion B hZ).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ (curvesPlusInclusion B hZ)
declarations.comment: Curves⁺ is an open substack of Curves: a strictly full subcategory whose inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPlus_classifying_factors_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW, part (1).** For a family of curves `X → S` and its classifying morphism
`S → Curves`, the classifying morphism factors through `Curves⁺` exactly when *some* closed
subspace structure on the singular locus of `X → S` is finite over `S`, and exactly when *every*
closed subspace structure on it is.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPlus_classifying_factors_iff (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
    (y : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map X.base.hom) ⥤ᵇ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val)
    (hy : IsClassifyingMorphism B hZ X y) :
    ((∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map X.base.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          (curvesPlusFiberedCategory B hZ).val,
        Nonempty (g.comp (curvesPlusInclusion B hZ).hom ≅ y)) ↔
      ∃ Z : Subfunctor X.total.1, Space.IsClosedSubspace B integerBase hZ Z ∧
        Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ Z.toFunctor Z.ι) =
          CurveFamily.nonSmoothLocus B hZ X ∧
        Space.IsFinite B integerBase hZ (Z.ι ≫ X.toBase.hom)) ∧
    ((∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map X.base.hom) ⥤ᵇ
          (curvesPlusFiberedCategory B hZ).val,
        Nonempty (g.comp (curvesPlusInclusion B hZ).hom ≅ y)) ↔
      ∀ Z : Subfunctor X.total.1, Space.IsClosedSubspace B integerBase hZ Z →
        Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ Z.toFunctor Z.ι) =
          CurveFamily.nonSmoothLocus B hZ X →
        Space.IsFinite B integerBase hZ (Z.ι ≫ X.toBase.hom))
declarations.comment: part (1): for every family of curves X → S, the classifying morphism factors through Curves⁺ iff the singular locus with some, equivalently any, closed subspace structure is finite over S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPlus_classifying_factors_iff_of_field
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW, part (2).** Let `X` be a proper scheme of dimension at most one over a field
`k`. The classifying morphism `Spec(k) → Curves` of the attached family of curves factors through
`Curves⁺` exactly when `X → Spec(k)` is smooth except at finitely many points.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPlus_classifying_factors_iff_of_field
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
    (y : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val)
    (hy : IsClassifyingMorphism B hZ (curveFamilyOfProperOverField B hZ k g e hproper hdim) y) :
    (∃ g' : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ (curvesPlusFiberedCategory B hZ).val,
        Nonempty (g'.comp (curvesPlusInclusion B hZ).hom ≅ y)) ↔
      {x : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T |
        ¬ InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g) x}.Finite
declarations.comment: part (2): for a proper scheme X of dimension at most one over a field k, the classifying morphism Spec(k) → Curves factors through Curves⁺ iff X → Spec(k) is smooth except at finitely many points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_curvesPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW.** There is an open substack `Curves⁺` of the stack of curves — a strictly full
subcategory whose inclusion is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion — such that

1. for every family of curves `X → S` and its classifying morphism, the classifying morphism
   factors through `Curves⁺` iff the singular locus of `X → S` with some closed subspace
   structure is finite over `S`, iff it is finite over `S` with every closed subspace structure;
2. for every proper scheme `X` of dimension at most one over a field `k`, the classifying morphism
   `Spec(k) → Curves` factors through `Curves⁺` iff `X → Spec(k)` is smooth except at finitely
   many points.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_curvesPlus :
    ∃ (P : ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ))
        (hP : ∀ {F G : CurveFamily B hZ}, (F ⟶ G) → P G → P F),
      P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ (curvesSubInclusion B hZ P hP).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ (curvesSubInclusion B hZ P hP) ∧
      (∀ (X : CurveFamily B hZ)
        (y : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map X.base.hom) ⥤ᵇ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val),
        IsClassifyingMorphism B hZ X y →
          ((∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map X.base.hom) ⥤ᵇ
                (curvesSubFiberedCategory B hZ P hP).val,
              Nonempty (g.comp (curvesSubInclusion B hZ P hP).hom ≅ y)) ↔
            ∃ Z : Subfunctor X.total.1, Space.IsClosedSubspace B integerBase hZ Z ∧
              Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ Z.toFunctor Z.ι) =
                CurveFamily.nonSmoothLocus B hZ X ∧
              Space.IsFinite B integerBase hZ (Z.ι ≫ X.toBase.hom)) ∧
          ((∃ g : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map X.base.hom) ⥤ᵇ
                (curvesSubFiberedCategory B hZ P hP).val,
              Nonempty (g.comp (curvesSubInclusion B hZ P hP).hom ≅ y)) ↔
            ∀ Z : Subfunctor X.total.1, Space.IsClosedSubspace B integerBase hZ Z →
              Set.range (Space.pointsMap B integerBase hZ Z.toFunctor Z.ι) =
                CurveFamily.nonSmoothLocus B hZ X →
              Space.IsFinite B integerBase hZ (Z.ι ≫ X.toBase.hom))) ∧
      (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] {T W : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ} (g : T ⟶ W)
        (e : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj W ≅ Spec (.of k))
        (hproper : IsProper ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g))
        (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T) ≤ 1)
        (y : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ (curvesFiberedCategory B hZ).val),
        IsClassifyingMorphism B hZ (curveFamilyOfProperOverField B hZ k g e hproper hdim) y →
          ((∃ g' : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Over.map W.hom) ⥤ᵇ
                (curvesSubFiberedCategory B hZ P hP).val,
              Nonempty (g'.comp (curvesSubInclusion B hZ P hP).hom ≅ y)) ↔
            {x : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).obj T |
              ¬ InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt
                ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B integerBase hZ).map g) x}.Finite))
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves⁺ ⊂ Curves together with parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesPlus_isStrictlyFull
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZW.** Membership in the subcategory `Curves⁺` of families of curves whose
reduced non-smooth locus is finite over the base is invariant under isomorphism, so `Curves⁺`
is a strictly full subcategory.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesPlus_isStrictlyFull :
    (show ObjectProperty (CurveFamily B hZ) from
      IsFiniteNonSmoothLocus B hZ).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
declarations.comment: open_substack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.curvesLciPlus_isOpenSubstack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZX.** `Curves^{lci+} = Curves^{lci} ∩ Curves^{+}`, the strictly full subcategory of
families of curves with local complete intersection structure morphism and singular locus finite
over the base, is an open substack of `Curves`: its inclusion is representable by algebraic
spaces and an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem curvesLciPlus_isOpenSubstack :
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
        (fun F : CurveFamily B hZ => IsLciFamily B hZ F ∧ IsFiniteNonSmoothLocus B hZ F) ∧
      Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ _ (isOpenCurvesLocus_lciPlus B hZ).prop_of_hom).hom ∧
      Stack.IsOpenImmersion B integerBase hZ
        (curvesSubstackInclusion B hZ _ (isOpenCurvesLocus_lciPlus B hZ).prop_of_hom)
declarations.comment: the open substack Curves^{lci+} = Curves^{lci} ∩ Curves^{+} of Curves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.factors_curvesLciPlus_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0DZX, part (2).** The classifying morphism of a family of curves `X ⟶ S` factors
through `Curves^{lci+}` exactly when `X ⟶ S` is a local complete intersection morphism and its
singular locus, with any (equivalently, some) closed subspace structure, is finite over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factors_curvesLciPlus_iff (U : BigFppfOver B integerBase hZ)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ CurveFamily B hZ)
    (hy : y ⋙ curvesProjectionOver B hZ = Over.map U.hom) :
    let X := y.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 U.left))
